labyrinth of doom is the cancelled fourth card set of the huntik trading card game. a starter deck for the set was planned to be released on march 30, 2010, but was never released due to upper deck filing for bankruptancy.

before cancellation, the deck was set up to contain six decks, each with 49 cards, and would be made for two players. the starter deck would include six exclusive foils and new missions and would premier a new faction, the krono relic hunters. the box and rulebook art promoted the inclusion of lok lambert, grier, and megataur, whose prominence and mythological connection to the set's title suggests it would have been one of the main cards of the set. 

== trivia ==
*although labyrinth of doom was never released, it is possible that elements of its planned narrative and imagery were reused for the interactive dark ride adventure huntik 5d at magicland theme park. the ride features megataur imprisoned within a labyrinth by a group of seekers called the dark guardians, closely resembling this expansion’s title and cover art, which prominently depicts megataur within a labyrinth.

the longest night of the year begins at sundown, and the huntik team races against time to find the spiral mark. eathon appears to lok and tells him how to find nostradamus' last quatrain. as rassimov invokes void to activate the mark, zhalia alerts dante, who brings the whole team with umbra's power.

== synopsis ==
lok, sophie and dante face rassimov and the blood spiral. their attack on the spiral mark seems successful, until the spectral presence of the betrayer reveals his diabolical plan, and the truth about the red comet.

== plot ==
;casterwill foresees a new evil
long before recorded time, lord casterwill is joined by his children and the champion of casterwill at the spiral mark as he states that when the nullifiers, and himself, are gone, some seekers may attempt to bring them back. so, he seals the spiral mark. in the present day, rassimov announces that he has the means to break this seal.

;legion's return
as den leaves the team to find harrison lok, sophie and dante take on rassimov. while dante and rassimov have a final fight, lok and sophie are left to face legion. remembering what happened to lindorm, the pair agree to use fast titans who are less likely to get grabbed, they summon dendras and feyone. despite all their efforts, legion proves himself to be a formidable enemy, defeating even powerbonded baselaird. determined to save their titans, lok destroys legion's amulet with the willblade and the team watch as myriads of titans absorbed over the centuries are released back to the spirit world. at the same time, dante manages to overpower rassimov in the one-versus-one.

;the betrayer's deception
]]
with rassimov defeated, the team race to the mark with phoenix but are delayed by wind and shauna who invokes lilith the queen. dante responds with caliban. lok races and plunges the willblade into the surface. to the team's surprise, this only helps activate it. the betrayer arises and reveals how he faked the last quatrains of nostradamus and how lord casterwill sealed the mark with the willblade, which can only be used by the true of heart. furthermore, he reveals he has been doing this by impersonating lok's father, eathon lambert. lok is torn and loses all hope as he realizes what he did broke the seal. consequently, this also made the red comet change its course so as to strike the spiral mark within minutes. dante realizes how the comet is set to destroy the casterwill family and the huntik foundation and return the nullifiers in one dreaded strike. sophie and cherit try their hardest to disengage the ritual, but it is in vain. 

;rassimov's true intention
's need for control is about to be his downfall]]
the team and the other spirals get another surprise when rassimov announces that he will stop the comet with the necklace of tutankhamun, invoking void as he seeks to take control of the unlimited power and use it for himself. dante hopes that at the very least he will stop the impact and lets him leave with void. but despite rassimov's efforts, it is a failure, and rassimov is vaporized in the process. with caliban defeated by a hopeshatter from shauna, dante tells sophie that there is only one chance: that he take it out himself.

;dante's farewell
 tells a sobbing sophie to take care of lok]]
dante invokes umbra and states that it only has enough energy for a one-way trip, and bids farewell to sophie, who sends phoenix with him. the betrayer is initially skeptical of dante's plan, but dante tells him that in his arc-induced dream, he loses. the betrayer then sends shauna and win after dante, but despite their best efforts to stop him, he manages to teleport. as the three hover in the upper atmosphere, dante invokes maelstrom, and together, using copykind, they absorb the comet's energy. down below, the betrayer and the other spiral members cry in anger while sophie grieves over dante's death.

== trivia ==
* this marks the fifth and last time an episode's title is said by a character in that same episode. it also the episode whose title is said the most in that episode (a total of seven times).

==production errors==
* when summoning feyone, sophie casterwill's nails are drawn over her glove.

huntik:page:10633:
dante takes the huntik team to see his old enemy from the organization, grier. because of his respect for order, grier dislikes rassimov and the blood spirals. he leads them to the professor's castle to get organization data on rassimov. dante and grier fight side-by-side to finish wilder's group for good and complete the mission.

== synopsis ==
using the professor's files, the huntik team coordinates an attack to capture rassimov, but not everything goes to plan. 

== plot ==
harrison's new position

after an intense training session inside the blood spiral base, harrison finds tantras in a handicapped state due to vlad dracul's magic. tantras announces that he has lost his place in the blooded circle, and harrison must take his spot. additionally, he gives harrison his two strongest titans, bazela's hive and jericho.

coordinated attack

inside dante's house, the team is joined by metz through the tv as they discuss a battle plan to take down rassimov, following the analysis of his files. a new mission then arises from this attack: the eye of the storm, for which metz gave dante a new titan. however, they still need zhalia's signal to move forward.

secret mission

harrison begs rassimov for tantras' place on the blooded circle. rassimov accepts, but tells harrison they first need to go on a secret mission. zhalia overhears this, and signals dante the details through logosbook.

rassimov and harrison then head to the tomb of nefertiti in the valley of the kings. there, they encounter organization suits working in the area, and confirm their belief that rassimov has betrayed the organization. a fight ensues, but the two blood spiral members make short work of the personnel stationed there. harrison and rassimov enter the tomb, and the latter reveals that the secret mission they're in is about "control" as he grabs the key of nefertiti.

plan execution

on an airplane, lok talks with sophie about his worries regarding the willblade, saying how he's been unable to bond with pendragon and eventually protect sophie as things get worse. sophie says he can't force it, and that the bond between seekers and titans is special.

now close to the tomb of tutankhamun, the team spot harrison and rassimov, and begin their attack as ariel, metz's gift to dante, erases their footprints. rassimov talks to harrison about the necklace of tutankhamun, and how it was potentially used by the betrayer himself to control the nullifiers. he then reveals he wants to take control the nullifiers, explaining the secrecy of the mission. as they're about to enter the tomb with the key of nefertiti, the team stop them. ariel creates a sand tornado to block the view, and den is off to fight harrison by himself. 
 is helpless after the team's plan works out]]
in the meanwhile, the team initiate a coordinated sequence of attacks to counter rassimov's every move. this includes his most powerful spell, darkvoid. the team was expecting rassimov to cast it, and when the time came, dante revealed another titan given to him by metz, maelstrom. it's able to absorve the spell's power, and rassimov is left defenseless. harrison runs away from den while rassimov is restrained, his titans being taken away with the aid of sorrowbond. he's then escorted by huntik foundation personnel in vehicles. 

harrison uses powermark on a bazela's insect, used by him and rassimov to arrive to the valley. in the meanwhile, the huntik team investigate what they were up to in the tomb of tutankhamun, and deduce that rassimov might be planning something against the spirals, and what they find on the tomb may end the blood spiral threat for good. after quickly solving a puzzle about tutankhamun's family tree, the necklace shows itself from underground.

something goes wrong
 appears unscratched as it attacks the team]]
harrison makes use of his newly gained titan, jericho, to free rassimov. on their way back home, the huntik team spot the wreck caused by harrison and fight him and rassimov. dante invokes umbra, but despite harrison showing some resistance, it appears as if without rassimov's titans they're no match against dante and lok. however, rassimov reveals he had one final titan hidden inside his body all along: legion, the legendary titan of war, given to him by the betrayer. the team immediately notice legion is unlike any other titan, being able to withstand several attacks at once. rassimov affirms that it has the ability to assimilate other titans, as well as take and use their powers.
dante takes the initiative to go fight rassimov by himself, while the rest of the team struggle against his legendary titan. sophie gets hurt and lok invokes powerbonded lindorm. just as it seems lok managed to take down legion, it comes back up and absorbs lindorm, destroying his amulet forever. turns out the legendary titan of war has been doing this for eons, and is now virtually unbeatable. 
 is taken down after using the necklace as bait for the team to escape]]
sophie suggests invoking phoenix to fight it, but dante stops her by saying it'd be a disaster if legion were to absorb a legendary titan, calling umbra back to its amulet in the process. rassimov takes advantage of dante's distraction, striking him. he then invokes solwing as lok attempts to invoke pendragon, but fails. dante is left helpless against rassimov, but he manages to powerbond with ariel, which saves him. dante tries to get his team out of the situation by using the necklace of tutankhamun as bait. however, solwing goes rogue and flies away with it. this prompts rassimov to send legion chasing the necklace, which gives the huntik team an opportunity to escape. in the process, solwing is assimilated by legion.

post-disaster

as dante drives lok, sophie and den to a huntik foundation hospital, he remembers his first moments with solwing as its amulet fades out of existence. dante says his goodbyes to the flying titan, while lok is disappointed in himself for not being able to invoke pendragon. inside the blood spiral base, zhalia sees harrison look at his spiral mark tattoo with excitement. 

==production errors==
* in the french dub, harrison saying "fireswarm!" when using it against den fears is not voiced.

huntik:page:10644:
in a bold move, the huntik team executes a brave plan to capture rassimov while he is on a mission to retrieve the necklace of tutankhamun. disaster strikes when rassimov unleashes the legendary titan of war, legion, which can absorb titans and destroy amulets. the huntik team barely escapes.

== synopsis ==
resting at lok's mother's house in ireland, scarlet byrne enlists the huntik team's help with a mission to find the legendary castle of tír na nóg. there, they uncover more secrets while eathon lambert coaches lok on willblade combat.

== plot ==
some needed rest

lok lambert finds himself in a dream surrounded by harlekins, and sees his father in the distance. lok fights off the titans with the willblade and makes his way towards eathon, but gets sucked into a void right before reaching him. lok then wakes up in his childhood house in county kerry, ireland, and joins the rest of the team as well as his mom for breakfast.
 talks about her days as a seeker while cherit craves bread]]
dante and lok discuss how den seems to be enjoying himself in the family environment and how the battle against rassimov and legion took a toll on all of them, both getting flashbacks from losing their respective titans. lok wonders if it's his fault for not being able to invoke pendragon, but dante comforts him. the rest of the team talk about sandra lambert's past as a seeker, and how kathy is the only one in the lambert family unaware of the seeker world. den, sophie and cherit get into a play fight over a piece of bread, and kathy walks in through the front door as the two seekers are using their spells. she is confused about the situation and dante clears her memory with simplemind.

in the meanwhile, scarlet byrne is fighting a giant-like titan with gybolg, barely being able to take it out. she then joins the team inside the lambert house, and flirts with dante, but he doesn't reciprocate. kathy tells sophie about this and lets her know there's no need to be jealous. sandra asks her daughter to go to town and grab some milk while the team discuss what scarlet was doing. she reveals she was after tír na nóg, a floating castle; however, scarlet reveals she ended up not seeing anything at the valley she was at. sandra then tells the story of how eathon once took her to a nearby valley, and only when the moon broke through the clouds was a floating castle visible.

the floating castle

the team then head to the valley, and lok reveals how the dreams he's been having took place there. it's not long before the moonlight reveals tír na nóg. they get inside the castle with dante warning that they only have until morning to explore. as they get deeper into the castle, they find statues of titans similar to the one scarlet encountered, and lok and cherit fall into a void. dante invokes umbra and orders it to find them. 
 is about to take out the first firbolg titan]]
it's revealed that the statues react to seeker powers, and now the team has to fight against the titans inside them. umbra finds lok and cherit in a dimension that serves as a medium between the human dimension and the spirit world. dante attempts to invoke caliban, but can't because of exhaustion from the battle against rassimov. it's then up to sophie, den and scarlet to fight off the firbolg and dullahan titans that emerged from the statues. the fight initially goes their away as they defeat both titans, but more then come out of their statues. 

pendragon's new seeker 

at the same time, umbra leads lok and cherit to a part of the inter-dimensional world with a mirror-like object. lok then uses his father's holotome to form a link with him in huntik through the mirror. the rest of the team is still struggling against the opponents as their own titans are taken out and even more firbolgs and dullahans appear as eathon talks with lok about the latter's failure to invoke pendragon when the situation calls for it. eathon states that pendragon's owner must be chosen by lord casterwill, and tells lok to remind himself of the first time he held the willblade in avalon. after struggling for a bit, lok remembers casterwill was there, and in the same instant he appears behind lok and makes him bond with the legendary titan of champions. eathon finishes by warning lok about the spirals and how he may need something else other than pendragon. lok, cherit and umbra are then sent back to the castle where the rest of the team are in the brink of defeat. 
 arrives to save the team with pendragon]]
at one point, den is grabbed by a firbolg titan and scarlet gets knocked back. dante, still exhausted, gets in front of her. sophie, despite dante's warnings, is about to use soulburn and invoke phoenix just as lok arrives to stop her. he is able to invoke pendragon, who easily takes out the enemy titans. the statues invoking them then turn into their respective amulets, making den bond with dullahan and scarlet bond with firbolg. scarlet thanks the team for the opportunity to be inside tír na nóg and the rest of the seekers discuss lok's talk with his father back in his house.

== trivia ==
*in some countries and digital guides, this episode is titled home is where the titans are. this is a play on the well-known phrase "home is where the heart is". 
*only the french dub gives the full stats of both dullahan and firbolg when their amulets are scanned by the holotome. in the english dub, the holotome gives just their type, size and special abilities without giving their attack and defence info. in the italian dub, the holotome gives all of dullahan's stats, but does not mention firbolg's at all. the missing information across the different dubs was likely cut down due to the episode runtime.

huntik:page:10651:
after being defeated by rassimov, the huntik team rests at lok's mother's house. they end up helping scarlet with a mission to tír na nóg, and lok falls into a gap between dimensions. there, he is able to talk with his father, eathon, who helps him finally bond with the titan in the willblade, pendragon.

== synopsis ==
the final battle shapes up as the longest night of the year begins. lok, dante, sophie and den head to the tomb of nostradamus to find his last quatrain. as they await zhalia's signal, it is a race against time to get to the spiral mark.

== plot ==
;preparations
inside dante's house, he tells himself the story of how in ancient times, the nullifiers were called to earth, and how everyone is coming to terms with this being the night that the spirals could reactivate the mark. sophie and dante talk to the huntik foundation council via a video call and reassure them that they will receive the location of the spiral mark from zhalia soon. the blood spiral is also preparing for tonight, as rassimov holds an audience with the blooded circle as they discuss how the casterwill family will try and stop them, this time with a ghost-like form of the betrayer arising to give orders. rassimov sends marduk to destroy sophie. eathon, through the holotome, tells lok and the team that the last quatrain is located at nostradamus's tomb which is hidden in a forest south of salon graveyard. a notable feature includes a tree with red leaves. 

;arrival in salon
 fights a casterwill hunter by the plane's wreckage]]

the blooded circle is a council consisting of the five highest level members of the blood spiral. commanded by rassimov, they would convene at the throne of lies, before rassimov and the betrayer's corpse, and plot their next moves. each member's place in the circle is highly regarded, and if a member leaves, they must be replaced by a seeker who has proven themself to be just as powerful.

== history ==
the blooded circle met before rassimov where shauna informed him that stack hoped to join the blood spiral and offered to acquire them medusa as proof of his allegiance. although initially order them to destroy him, rassimov's mind changed when tantras suggested they send kiel and his casterwill hunters to medusa's island. [zhalia's mission]

following kiel's downfall, marduk took his place in the blooded circle. [an ally from the organization]

after tantras lost all his power to the heart of vlad dracul, he lost his place in the circle. however, harrison fears then took his place. [rassimov's secret]

on the longest night of the year, the betrayer's spirit appeared before the blooded circle, warning them that sophie casterwill would stand at nostradamus' tomb at sundown. when harrison expressed concern, saying sophie's name, shauna punished him by hitting him with a bladewave. rassimov then sent marduk to finish her. [words from eathon]

== history ==
chaingolem battled with a jokoul titan and was able to demobilize it with his chains. [tcg:oal-034]

sophie faces her fears again to challenge shauna and wind to a deadly battle in the volcano. lok, dante, cherit, and den fight with all they have, but it looks like they're in trouble. finally, sophie leaps into the lava. she rises from the ashes, having bonded with the legendary titan of rebirth, phoenix.

== synopsis ==
joined by an old enemy, a battle erupts between the huntik team and mr. wilder at the professor's castle, where lok hopes to find an access key and retrieve rassimov's file.

== plot ==
an old enemy

in velos, greece, a couple of organization suits are attacked by silent soldiers as they attempt to bring back supplies to sutos island. the suits fight back but focus on stopping them from invoking titans as to not alert civilians. they're initially overpowered but then saved by dante, den, lok, and sophie, who end up making the soldiers flee. dante tells the suits that he is not interested in fighting them, and asks them for help.

the two suits guide the huntik team to sutos on a boat as lok and sophie explain den the history behind sutos, and how they're here to talk to a respected organization seeker to help fight the blood spiral. 

after arriving at the island, the injured suits meet with grier and the governor of sutos at the palace. they're both thankful they made it out in one piece, unlike other organization groups attacked by the spirals. dante and his team also enter the palace to talk with grier about the blood spiral, and although he doesn't have anything against them, says that sutos is not the place for huntik foundation seekers to be at and that he already has enough problems related to his mean being attacked. the team convince grier by stating that his old colleague, rassimov, is the one leading the blood spiral.
 has an idea on how to take out the spirals]]
on the shore, the team explain that rassimov betrayed the organization and is now planning to destroy civilization alongside the other spirals. grier realizes the importance of the situation, but doesn't want to leave his people behind. however, he does come up with something to help the foundation defeat rassimov. he realizes that the professor was probably suspicious of rassimov, and must have been keeping data on his weaknesses. from this is born "the professor's dossier" mission.

raiding the castle

the team is joined by grier at the professor's castle. there, they encounter several suits and dante insists he and grier should take them out by themselves for the others to save power. they fight in perfect synchrony and without any titans take out the suits with ease. in the meanwhile, den is annoyed that he can't fight, but sophie and lok explain that dante and grier used to be rivals, and a moment like this is important for them. this makes den remember the relationship between him and his brother, harrison, and cherit tells him one day they'll be on the same side.
 and undergolem clash as dante tries to take out doberman]]
wilder then appears on an elevated part of the castle and tells the team that he's planning on using rassimov's files to blackmail him into being the spirals' leader. he's joined by hoffman and eathon the dog, and the latter invokes two undergolem titans as an emotional response to the castle being threatened, while hoffman invokes doberman. dante tells lok to complete the mission alongside den and cherit, and sophie states that she will handle wilder. lok invokes powerbonded baselaird to help dante and grier with the organization's titans, the latter also invoking megataur.

the titans begin fighting and eventually one undergolem titan is taken out, and hoffman sends alpha and beta to attempt to defeat grier and dante. in the meanwhile, sophie faces wilder and asks him once again to help the foundation in taking out the spirals, but this time as leader of the casterwill elders. sophie states that she thought wilder was different from the likes of defoe or klaus, but as wilder attacks sophie while describing his ambitions, she calls him and a coward. wilder begins to think sophie is just distracting him while the others get the files, and invoking incubane to fight sophie and runs away to look for the files. 

the professor's room 

elsewhere in the castle, lok and den are stopped by unnamed suit 057 and unnamed suit 058, as well as the former's doom warden titan. the two foundation seekers make quick work of the enemies and head to simon's room as sophie invokes phoenix to deal with incubane. now in the professor's study, cherit notices how den looks up to lok; this gives lok the idea of going to his childhood house in ireland alongside den in a vacation. while searching the room, lok finds an old picture of simon, metz and eathon, with a date on the back. 
 disciplines wilder]]
at the entrance, the previously summoned titans continue fighting and dante approaches hoffman, also trying to convince him to fight the spirals. but he's too stubborn and a fight ensues. grier goes up the castle and heads to the professor's room to help lok, who finds out a hidden safe whose password is the date on the old photograph. they find the files, but wilder attacks lok from behind, severely injuring him. wilder invokes grand façade and den struggles to fight them. with cherit's help, den temporarily prevents him from getting the files, but gets overpowered. as he's about to be taken out by wilder, grier enters the room and fights the organization leader, but gets grabbed by grand façade. as the titan is about to take out grier, he powerbonds with breaker, who is able to send grand façade back to its amulet while grier swiftly defeats wilder, telling him that they're going back to sutos, where wilder will learn the meaning of "organization control". 

the organization's downfall 

the team's titans manage to overpower the remaining organization titans, and dante restrains hoffman with stopglue and bristlebind. the others return with the files, and grier tells hoffman to protect the castle, but to never leave its walls. later, dante asks grier to join the foundation, but he says his people need him, and it's better for him to stay on the island given he's not proud of some things he has done while in the organization. on the helicopter, den again wonders if him and his brother will ever be on the same side again. in the blood spiral base, rassimov announces he will deal with the huntik foundation with a power given to him by the betrayer himself.

on the shore, the team explain that rassimov betrayed the organization and is now planning to destroy civilization alongside the other spirals. grier realizes the importance of the situation, but doesn't want to leave his people behind. however, he does come up with something to help the foundation defeat rassimov. he realizes that the professor was probably suspicious of rassimov, and must have been keeping data on his weaknesses. from this is born "the professor's dossier" mission.

raiding the castle

the team is joined by grier at the professor's castle. there, they encounter several suits and dante insists he and grier should take them out by themselves for the others to save power. they fight in perfect synchrony and without any titans take out the suits with ease. in the meanwhile, den is annoyed that he can't fight, but sophie and lok explain that dante and grier used to be rivals, and a moment like this is important for them. this makes den remember the relationship between him and his brother, harrison, and cherit tells him one day they'll be on the same side.
 and undergolem clash as dante tries to take out doberman]]
wilder then appears on an elevated part of the castle and tells the team that he's planning on using rassimov's files to blackmail him into being the spirals' leader. he's joined by hoffman and eathon the dog, and the latter invokes two undergolem titans as an emotional response to the castle being threatened, while hoffman invokes doberman. dante tells lok to complete the mission alongside den and cherit, and sophie states that she will handle wilder. lok invokes powerbonded baselaird to help dante and grier with the organization's titans, the latter also invoking megataur.

the titans begin fighting and eventually one undergolem titan is taken out, and hoffman sends alpha and beta to attempt to defeat grier and dante. in the meanwhile, sophie faces wilder and asks him once again to help the foundation in taking out the spirals, but this time as leader of the casterwill elders. sophie states that she thought wilder was different from the likes of defoe or klaus, but as wilder attacks sophie while describing his ambitions, she calls him and a coward. wilder begins to think sophie is just distracting him while the others get the files, and invoking incubane to fight sophie and runs away to look for the files. 

the professor's room 

elsewhere in the castle, lok and den are stopped by unnamed suit 057 and unnamed suit 058, as well as the former's doom warden titan. the two foundation seekers make quick work of the enemies and head to simon's room as sophie invokes phoenix to deal with incubane. now in the professor's study, cherit notices how den looks up to lok; this gives lok the idea of going to his childhood house in ireland alongside den in a vacation. while searching the room, lok finds an old picture of simon, metz and eathon, with a date on the back. 
 disciplines wilder]]
at the entrance, the previously summoned titans continue fighting and dante approaches hoffman, also trying to convince him to fight the spirals. but he's too stubborn and a fight ensues. grier goes up the castle and heads to the professor's room to help lok, who finds out a hidden safe whose password is the date on the old photograph. they find the files, but wilder attacks lok from behind, severely injuring him. wilder invokes grand façade and den struggles to fight them. with cherit's help, den temporarily prevents him from getting the files, but gets overpowered. as he's about to be taken out by wilder, grier enters the room and fights the organization leader, but gets grabbed by grand façade. as the titan is about to take out grier, he powerbonds with breaker, who is able to send grand façade back to its amulet while grier swiftly defeats wilder, telling him that they're going back to sutos, where wilder will learn the meaning of "organization control". 

the organization's downfall 

the team's titans manage to overpower the remaining organization titans, and dante restrains hoffman with stopglue and bristlebind. the others return with the files, and grier tells hoffman to protect the castle, but to never leave its walls. later, dante asks grier to join the foundation, but he says his people need him, and it's better for him to stay on the island given he's not proud of some things he has done while in the organization. on the helicopter, den again wonders if him and his brother will ever be on the same side again. in the blood spiral base, rassimov announces he will deal with the huntik foundation with a power given to him by the betrayer himself.

__notoc__
this page is to help organize information about the different suit teams in order to expound upon the current information.
----

 
suits are the lowest level minions of the organization. typically dressed in dark suits, they are the pawns whom the higher-level organization operatives use to achieve their nefarious goals.

== history ==
most suits were banded together by the professor, practically overnight, through the use of araknos' mind control ability. [the secret of two generations]

=== defoe's suits ===
defoe had his suits pursue lok lambert in an attempt to retrieve eathon lambert's journal and its secrets of the amulet of will. [a seeker is born] pursuing the foundation's clue regarding the golem, the organization gained jodis lore's key. [words of truth, heart of lies] the team was later sent to rouen, france, to retrieve gar-ghoul. [into the river of secrets]

however, they missed the more important information on the ring of arc and were then sent by the professor to paris, france, following dante's team into the paris catacombs. [crawling the catacombs] despite gaining a number of new recruits from paris, they were unsuccessful at retrieving the ring. [divide and conquer]

his suits were later sent after king basilisk, but lost the titan to zhalia moon. they also lost unnamed suit 001 to a petrification trap within the titan's chamber. [absent heroes]

upon this failure, defoe lost command of his original team of suits and thus had to rally his remaining loyal suits within velo, greece, in an attempt to finally get his revenge on dante vale. this team failed and were escorted back under grier. [the treasures of the argonauts]

=== grier's suits ===
upon taking defoe's place of leadership within the organization, grier had his suits accompany him to sutos island in order to reclaim the rulership of the island. the suits were led into a trap by lok lambert and sophie casterwill, and the two sides battled until dante vale and grier announced a truce. his suits were then permitted to help enforce order on sutos in order to promote peace on the island. [like father, unlike son]

two of grier's suits were attacked by four silent soldiers while loading a boat with supplies for sutos. they were saved by dante's team. grier acknowledged that not all his men had been so lucky. his suits later accompanied him to the professor's castle. [an ally from the organization]

=== klaus's suits ===
klaus' viennese suits were sent, under the instructions of rassimov, to go after dante vale in county kerry, ireland. his team of suits ambushed scarlet byrne and dante's team in the new grange passage tomb but were eventually defeated. [home turf] his egyptian suits were sent to excavate the tomb of nefertiti, and both groups were sent after the sceptre of nefertiti, which was taken from the foundation members after a skirmish. [the sceptre deception] during the mission to secure the amulets of vlad dracul, three of his suits were transformed through the power of overmode. even with this power, however, they were defeated when zhalia moon chose to side with the huntik foundation. [the vampire loses its fangs]

=== rassimov's suits ===
defoe's former suits were placed under rassimov and given an improved arsenal of titans. they were then sent by rassimov to ambush lok lambert and sophie casterwill, who were working at a burger joint in venice, italy. the suits were defeated by lok and sophie, who were joined by zhalia moon. [all work and no pay]

two of the recruits from paris, also formerly under defoe, were sent by rassimov in an attempt to eliminate sophie casterwill and company. they failed to hinder the foundation members, however. more of his suits, who had infiltrated the mausoleum of sir lancelot, confronted the foundation team but were swiftly defeated. [memory lane]

his own team of suits were then sent by the professor to the coasts of turkey in search for the ring of behemoth. though two of his suits were overpowering the native amazons, they were defeated by dante, lok, and sophie. rassimov later joined his team, but the suits were defeated dante received the ring of behemoth from zhalia moon. [ladies' choice]

rassimov and his suits travelled to the temple of poseidon to beat dante's team to the amulet of will but were unable to stop them from getting through the entrance to atlantis. [the unseen guide] upon eventually catching up with the huntik team at the casterwill compound, they fought against zhalia and sophie while lok and rassimov battled one-on-one. they were defeated however, with numerous suits being turned to stone by king basilisk. [coming of age]

rassimov and his team along with the professor and his two elite agents travelled to king solomon's mines on the trail of the ring of tao. they pursued the huntik team and their guide otto via car but were stopped when metagolem demolished the ndago bridge. they later attacked the team in the desert before taking zhalia and otto prisoner. [the golden asp] after entering the mines, two of rassimov's suits were deployed to stop the team but failed. later the suits fought aginst the huntik team and montehue and tersly. despite overpowering the foundation's forces, they were forced to retreat when lok bonded with tao. [to be together]

a number of rassimov's suits were positioned at the professor's castle but were defeated by the dante's team. [the divine comedy]

=== the professor's suits ===
the professor and his two elite agents travelled to king solomon's mines on the trail of the ring of tao. [the golden asp] after entering the mines, the suits fought aginst the huntik team and montehue and tersly. despite overpowering the foundation's forces, they were forced to retreat when lok bonded with tao. [to be together]

the two agents later attacked dante's house and left the team considerably injured and worse for wear. [the secret of two generations] they fought against the team at the professor's castle but were defeated. [the divine comedy]

following the professor's defeat, the two agents attacked the huntik team after they broke into organisation central but were defeated. [doorway to huntik]

under the command of wilder and hoffman, the two agents defended the professor's castle from dante and grier before being defeated. [an ally from the organization]

=== wilder's suits ===

== abilities ==
the suits' greatest asset is their sheer numbers, but they also make capable spies and are excellent at gathering information. in a battle, the suits fight with a variety of spells and titans. just as the organization brings about cold, unfeeling order with the help of savage evil deeds, its troops fight with titans such as the cold mindrone and the savage redcap.

the spiral mark, located in siberia, under the blood spiral base, is an ancient magic sigil created by void as a beacon to call the nullifiers to earth. it was sealed by lord casterwill and could only be re-activated when stabbed by the willblade, combined with void, with phoenix flying up above, on the longest night of the year whilst the red comet was in the sky. the sigil itself became the symbol of the blood spiral brotherhood, with every member being endowed with a tattoo on their body upon joining. 

==history==
long before recorded time, void, a nullifier scout, found earth by chance and created the spiral mark as a beacon, calling his brethren to earth to wipe out all life. [words from eathon] after 500 years of fighting, before lord casterwill defeated the nullifiers, he sealed the mark so that could it be used again, sealing it with the willblade of his elder daughter as it could only be wielded by the true of heart. [the spiral mark] after his death, his best friend, later known as the betrayer, tried to open the mark again with void on the longest night of the year. casterwill's children defeated him, preventing the nullifiers' return, and from there on the casterwill family's purpose was to never let it open again.[chasing void]

lok lambert and sophie casterwill, however, activated the spiral mark by mistake, having been led by the betrayer's faked quatrains of nostradamus to think that stabbing the heart of the mark with the willblade would prevent nullifiers from returning to earth, though this was planned by the betrayer himself eons ago.[the spiral mark]

even though dante vale destroyed the red comet, the betrayer revealed that he could actually use his own powers to open the spiral mark and bring the nullifiers back.[lok and the betrayer] lok invoked two legendary titans, quetzalcoatl and pendragon, to defeat demigorgan. after stabbing the betrayer through the spiral symbol on his back, the betrayer disintegrated. though the betrayer was seemingly defeated, the spiral mark appeared to still be active and could be seen signalling out to something far across space. [dante's return]

the casterwill library is located in the suburbs of montmorency, paris, france nearby the old paris casterwill house where sophie casterwill grew up. the library later served as the base of operations for lucas casterwill's team.

==history==
the place had been first discovered by sophie and cherit, when dante sent them to look for a foundation library while he and lok went to mausoleum of sir lancelot. as they entered they had been observed by lane and dellix. inside they found the key to a casterwill cypher. [memory lane]

later the whole team returned there to look for information about willblade. it was then when they first encountered lucas and his teammates. the two teams fought before coming to an understanding. [chasing void]

sophie, lok and cherit returned to the library to update lucas and his team on the emergence of the blood spiral after their failed mission to recover void from klaus' bookshop. [the blood spiral]

lucas, lane and dellix were residing here when lok lambert summoned quetzalcoatl, and activated the blue star. [the titan in the temple of sun]

the library was also one of sophie's recurring childhood memories. [memory lane] [chasing void] [the phoenix's ashes]

huntik magazine is a comic book series based on huntik: secrets & seekers. it was released monthly in italy and europe by tridimensional s.r.l. and kappa edizioni, beginning in march 2009 and ending in february 2012. in total, 18 issues were released, despite a 19th issue being ready for publication and a 20th being pencilled. 

==contents==
each issue consisted of a new comic book story, accompanied by character profiles, features on a specific titan type, fact files on real-life legends and historical locations in a place of mystery section, and several exclusive posters or gifts. it also allowed readers to send in their own titan ideas to which the artists would draw their idea which would then be shown in the your own titans section.

the fire of georgiopolis is the third issue of the huntik magazine comic book series.

== synopsis ==
the huntik team is after the legendary lance of saint george, ascalon, but ryder is determined to gain the artifact for the organization. as the team, joined by gil, must deal with a dragon using the tale of "saint george and the dragon" and eathon lambert's journal, they find that they have been infiltrated and that their success has been orchestrated by ryder.

== plot ==
; trouble in tel aviv
in tel aviv, israel, gil, scans a spearhead for the huntik foundation to determine whether it has any magical properties. while scanning, a knock comes from the door, and gregor breaks in. during the scuffle, gil loses his glasses, and gregor steals the spearhead. though gil manages to escape through the window, he is caught and frozen by ford's frostanna.

; the lance of saint george
later, dante vale, sophie casterwill, and lok lambert travel with gil, discussing their mission involving ascalon, a spear used 2000 years ago by saint george to slay a dragon. upon arriving, the team enters a shrine to saint george. sophie uses breakspell to open a door in the lower levels that the workmen were unable to open. inside the dark room, dante uses boltflare to reveal a statue of a dragon. against dante's warning, cherit touches the statue and causes it to come to life.

; the dragon's fire

the dragon breathes a jet of fire, causing the team to scatter. dante uses armorbrand to protect himself and lok, while lok uses hyperstride to get away from the immediate danger. dante, assuming the dragon to be a magical trap, has sophie use breakspell on it, but to no avail. the team and the workmen then retreat from the shrine.

outside, lok searches his father's journal for information. upon finding a reference to the "girdle of the princess," sophie recalls how saint george originally defeated the dragon. instead of killing it, he merely wounded it while princess silene used her girdle as a leash to tame the dragon.

; dragon tamers
re-entering the shrine, dante uses nimblefire as sophie uses honorguard to protect themselves from the dragon. finding the girdle, cherit throws it to lok, who tries to use it as a leash on the dragon. that attempt failing, lok recalls that the original tamer was a princess so has sophie take over. the dragon then disappears, allowing the lance of saint george to be reclaimed.

; mission accomplished?
the team goes to gil's office, and they decide to leave the country by boat as the organization doesn't usually checks sea rout. gil tells the others that the spear is in a transport capsule to protect it during transport.

the team decides to take turns being on guard duty, with gil and his two assistants taking the first shift. in the night, an assailant attempts to cast augerfrost on lok but is stopped by dante. using dopplemorph, gil is revealed to by ryder in disguise, who has his men attack.

; trouble at sea
one of the crew members invokes a redcap, and lok invokes his freelancer in response. dante uses hyperstride to dodge ryder and reveals that ryder had taken the real artifact and left a fake on the ship. in the conflict, ryder and dante fall overboard, but dante uses bubblelift to bring them back to the surface. ryder's crew members are defeated by lok and sophie, and sophie uses raypulse to help freelancer to defeat redcap. the other crew member manages to invoke a mindrone as sophie summons sabriel. once sabriel and freelancer make quick work of mindrone, ryder's men have no choice but to surrender.

on the main deck, dante and ryder do battle, with ryder summoning his elegast. dante apparently is put to sleep by elegast's sandman ability but actually held his breath to avoid being affected. though dante uses caliban to take out elegast and is joined by lok and sophie, ryder then uses a self-destruct mechanism to blow up the boat.

however, zhalia moon arrives in a speedboat along with the real gil. dante's team members all use hyperstride to get off the sinking boat, but ryder uses shadowspeed to attack dante. thinking quickly, dante breaks the main mast, leaving ryder on the sinking ship.

; at dante's house
back at dante vale's house, zhalia explains that though she wasn't initially involved in the mission, she happened to be in the area and noticed what was going on. lok and sophie ask dante how he knew that gil was ryder, and dante informs them that he previously knew that gil was very nearsighted and needed to wear glasses, which ryder's disguise lacked. he then tells them that ryder was specifically targeting lok as he defeated ford back in yorkshire and as ford was seeking revenge.

; at organization central
in prague at organization central, gregor smashes a pillar in frustration due to ryder's defeat. however, ford calms him by saying that they still had managed to get ascalon and that it can be used to defeat the huntik foundation.

== gallery ==

huntik:page:12880:
the treasures of alexandria is the fourth issue of the huntik magazine comic book series.
== synopsis ==
the huntik team set out to sea to recover several amulets of the titan triton. however, gregor and another organization agent, captain caine, are not going to make the quest easy for them.
==plot==
;the ancient lighthouse
in prague at the organization headquarters, gregor meets up with the professor. gregor blames ford for his recent failures and the professor gives him one more chance to lead a mission: to find captain caine and recover the triton amulets. meanwhile, sophie and zhalia break into a museum in order to find the amulets; however, someone grabs sophie's arm while she's distracted. lok walks in and sees sophie and zhalia fighting the organization, so he uses hyperstride to rush at a suit. another suit tries to hit lok with a dragonfist but he manages to avoid it at the last second. sophie sees an inscription on one of the objects in a glass case, recognizing the lettering as ancient greek. dante arrives and destroys a skylight window using touchram, taking out two of the last suits in the process. lok defeats a suit using boltflare and dante urges them to get out of there. the team returns to dante's house where guggenheim reviews their findings and tells the team what the next part of the mission will entail.

the next day, the team travels to fort qaitbey, alexandria in search of the triton titans. they dive to the ruins of the ancient lighthouse (which, much to cherit's dismay, was destroyed by a earthquake around 1,300 years ago). they arrive at the entrance and enter the lighthouse despite the sign that warns that "only the keeper" is allowed there; inside, they find a large area that somehow isn't flooded. back on land, a suit slashes the tires of the team's car and returns to gregor, who comments that caine should be returning to them soon.

in the ruins, sophie solves a riddle and uses breakspell on a bust of posideon, revealing the first triton amulet. lok solves the puzzle in the next room and finds the second triton amulet hidden in an alcove in the wall. dante enters the next room and avoids an array of projectile traps with the help of hyperstride. he then uses farslip and spidertouch to retrieve the third triton amulet. in the final room, captain caine appears with the fourth triton amulet and taunts the huntik team, telling them to catch him if they can. dante tries to hit him with raypulse and boltflare, but he misses, causing caine to jump into the water and use oceankind.

;chasing the fish
the team follows him, but zhalia - the only member of the team without a triton amulet - is blocked by a magical barrier. dante and cherit join zhalia in searching for a way through while lok and sophie chase after cainee. unable to find any weak points or gaps in the barrier, dante then gives zhalia his triton amulet, assuring her that he'll last longer without air than she will thanks to his extensive training. sophie and lok summon their triton titans in an attempt to catch caine. caine then summons his triton and a huge megladeath in response. lok fights the dark triton while sophie and the tritons fight the megladeath. the tritons stab the megladeath with their spear, but one of them is lost when it retaliates; sophie uses honorguard to prevent the remaining triton from being hit by the beast and then uses raypulse to go on the offensive. captain caine then recalls megladeath and lok recalls his triton. lok and sophie manage to get above water, where they find gregor, captain caine and a near-army of suits with their redcaps and mindrones waiting. a redcap charges lok, preparing for a finishing move but is shot down by zhalia's gareon; cherit uses his energy blast to defeat the redcap. the team summons freelancer, sabriel and kilthane and gregor summons his executioner to combat them. zhalia fights gregor while lok dodges several augerfrost shots. sophie blocks a dragonfist and augerfrost with honorguard, barely managing to get the shield up in time. zhalia reveals that dante gave her his triton amulet, and now he's the one who's unable to cross the barrier. beneath the waves, already suffering from oxygen deprivation, dante searches for a way to bypass the barrier. freelancer manages to send a mindrone back to its amulet but executioner crushes killthane and sabriel. gregor then orders his executioner to smash lok, sophie and zhalia. as things look grim for the rest of the team, dante rises from the water on metagolem's shoulder, and gregor orders his executioner to attack it instead. however metagolem grabs his chain, trapping the two in a tug-of-war-like stalemate. dante uses farslip to take the last triton amulet from gregor and metagolem knocks the executioner back to its amulet. the organization then flees and lok wants to pursue them, but dante suspects that their enemies are already facing a harsh punishment from the professor. back at dante's house, cherit and zhalia argue about whether everyone was worried about dante; however, dante himself tells everyone to calm down...including sophie and lok, who had been listening in from the kitchen.

in the ruins, sophie solves a riddle and uses breakspell on a bust of posideon, revealing the first triton amulet. lok solves the puzzle in the next room and finds the second triton amulet hidden in an alcove in the wall. dante enters the next room and avoids an array of projectile traps with the help of hyperstride. he then uses farslip and spidertouch to retrieve the third triton amulet. in the final room, captain caine appears with the fourth triton amulet and taunts the huntik team, telling them to catch him if they can. dante tries to hit him with raypulse and boltflare, but he misses, causing caine to jump into the water and use oceankind.

;chasing the fish
the team follows him, but zhalia - the only member of the team without a triton amulet - is blocked by a magical barrier. dante and cherit join zhalia in searching for a way through while lok and sophie chase after cainee. unable to find any weak points or gaps in the barrier, dante then gives zhalia his triton amulet, assuring her that he'll last longer without air than she will thanks to his extensive training. sophie and lok summon their triton titans in an attempt to catch caine. caine then summons his triton and a huge megladeath in response. lok fights the dark triton while sophie and the tritons fight the megladeath. the tritons stab the megladeath with their spear, but one of them is lost when it retaliates; sophie uses honorguard to prevent the remaining triton from being hit by the beast and then uses raypulse to go on the offensive. captain caine then recalls megladeath and lok recalls his triton. lok and sophie manage to get above water, where they find gregor, captain caine and a near-army of suits with their redcaps and mindrones waiting. a redcap charges lok, preparing for a finishing move but is shot down by zhalia's gareon; cherit uses his energy blast to defeat the redcap. the team summons freelancer, sabriel and kilthane and gregor summons his executioner to combat them. zhalia fights gregor while lok dodges several augerfrost shots. sophie blocks a dragonfist and augerfrost with honorguard, barely managing to get the shield up in time. zhalia reveals that dante gave her his triton amulet, and now he's the one who's unable to cross the barrier. beneath the waves, already suffering from oxygen deprivation, dante searches for a way to bypass the barrier. freelancer manages to send a mindrone back to its amulet but executioner crushes killthane and sabriel. gregor then orders his executioner to smash lok, sophie and zhalia. as things look grim for the rest of the team, dante rises from the water on metagolem's shoulder, and gregor orders his executioner to attack it instead. however metagolem grabs his chain, trapping the two in a tug-of-war-like stalemate. dante uses farslip to take the last triton amulet from gregor and metagolem knocks the executioner back to its amulet. the organization then flees and lok wants to pursue them, but dante suspects that their enemies are already facing a harsh punishment from the professor. back at dante's house, cherit and zhalia argue about whether everyone was worried about dante; however, dante himself tells everyone to calm down...including sophie and lok, who had been listening in from the kitchen.

headless hessian is a caped draco-titan horseman who wields a large curved sword. he bears golden armor as well as a fake, detachable pumpkin-like head which he hurls at his enemies.

== history ==
headless hessian's amulet was abandoned on an old battlefield near the town of sleepy hollow. it was found by geoffrey crayon, an old man with no knowledge of the seeker world, who invoked it and let it run loose in the hopes of scaring off the builders and buyers who wanted to turn the battlefield into houses. geoffrey was unable to properly control it however, and the titan began to attack innocent bystanders at night, leading to reports of a headless horseman terrorising the town. 

both the huntik foundation and the organization came to the town to investigate. headless hessian fought with ford's belgrieve. it then attacked lok lambert and defeated his freelancer. lok and sophie managed to convince geoffrey to stop using the titan and help them stop the organization. by leaving headless hessian's sword for gregor to use and lok dropping the titans' helmet on his head, they succesfully framed him for the attacks, leaving him to be arrested by the town's police. headless hessian then saved lok from ford and his frostanna. geoffrey then gave headless hessian's amulet to dante, confident that he would find a better use for the titan. [the headless horseman]

== abilities ==
headless hessian is able to remove his head and throw at his enemies to frighten them. the head can be used as a fire bomb, exploding into an engulfing ball of flames on impact with a target or surface. a master of riding, headless hessian is extremely fast while he is undeniably talented at his swordsman abilities. he will often ride around his target and strike them from behind when they least expect it. [the headless horseman]

viktor casterwill was a corrupt casterwill family member from the 17th century who attempted to steal the ring of kronos. he was the ancestor of dr. benway, a disowned casterwill family member. 

== history ==
in the original timeline, viktor betrayed the casterwill family by stealing the ring of kronos, the legendary titan of time. michel de notre dame, had a vision warning him of what would happen, but was unaware it was viktor who would steal it. [the power of kronos] the ring of kronos would later be inherited by viktor's descendant dr. benway. a portrait of viktor would remain on display in dr. benway's mansion. [the power of kronos]

when lok lambert and sophie casterwill were sent back in time by kronos, viktor and his fellow casterwill member, michel de notre dame attacked the pair when they caught them obtaining kronos' ring from its hiding place. however, viktor turned on michel when he tried to protect lok and sophie but was defeated by lok and the willblade, who recognised viktor as the corrupt casterwill in the portrait in benway's mansion. having now prevented viktor from stealing kronos, lok and sophie had changed history, stopping kronos from ever falling into dr. benway's hands. [the power of kronos]

== personality ==
viktor had a short temper and reacted aggressively to situations. viktor was selfish and greedy, betraying his own family's values for the power kronos possesses. he was also violent, even attacking his own fellow casterwill, michel, in order to attack lok and sophie.

== abilities ==
although he did not use titans,  viktor proved that he packed a powerful punch along with an assortment of spells.

=== spells utilized ===
*augerfrost
*boltflare
*featherdrop
*hyperstride
*raypulse
*thundercut

=== bonded titans ===
*kronos (original timeline only)

lord casterwill was the first known seeker in history and the ancestor of the powerful group of seekers within the casterwill family. casterwill is best known for his leading the 500-year war against the nullifiers and his bringing the titans to earth from huntik. he was the original seeker of the legendary titans. many other details of his life, however, subsequently were lost to history.

== history ==
casterwill was the original and first seeker responsible for bringing the titans to earth from the spirit world, huntik, in order to battle and defeat the nullifiers. [all work and no pay] at some point in the conflict, casterwill called for the assistance of cherit. [memory lane]

casterwill took 500 years to defeat the nullifiers and to seal the spiral mark with the willblade. [the spiral mark] when he finally did so, casterwill died right where he was standing. [coming of age] lord casterwill's legacy was passed on to his sons and daughters, who each received a legendary titan to fight against the nullifiers if they ever return. [the spiral mark]

cherit had a several dreams remembering his time at the side of lord casterwill. [memory lane] it later led him to discover the golden asp where the ring of tao was buried. [the golden asp]

lord casterwill appeared to sophie casterwill in the crystal caves, signifying to her that she was a direct descendant of his. [cave of the casterwills]

on avalon, lord casterwill's spirit appeared to lok lambert when he drew the willblade, knighting him and empowering him to invoke pendragon, the legendary titan of champions. although no one could remember the event, his spectral form watched cherit at dante vale's house. [knight of the willblade]

the statue of lord casterwill in the fortress of iron will later disapppeared to awaken titans, coralgolem, icarus and feyone as they stormed into battle against the blood spiral. [the spiral war]

casterwill appeared to lok again in the inter-dimensional world at tír na nóg, where he gave lok the power to properly bond with pendragon. [back home]

== abilities ==
casterwill was the original owner of the amulet of will and the original seeker bonded to the legendary titans as well as cherit. such powers permitted him to outlive normal human beings and to fight the nullifiers for a full 500 years, maintaining himself alive for sheer force of will. [coming of age] in addition to his titans, casterwill and his descendants were capable of powerful and unique casterwill spells, including curses, barriers, powerful offensive magic, and even the power to seal and unlock the spiral mark at will with the aid of the willblade.

the pyramid of the sun, also known as the temple of sun, is the largest temple in the aztec capital of teotihuacan, mexico, and was dedicated to quetzalcoatl, the legendary titan of summons, whose ring it contained. using an ancient ritual, the temple could activate the blue star as part of an ancient signal to call the scattered casterwill family members to reunite at the fortress of iron will.

== history ==
the pyramid was built by an unknown civilisation as the largest structure in the city. it was taken over by many cultures, each trying to erase the history of those before them. it was dedicated by the aztecs to the quetzalcoatl, a mythical feathered serpent. according to legend, when the sun's path directly aligned with the pyramid, the shadow of the serpent would be cast on the square of the ancient city. [the titan in the temple of sun] another temple, the pyramid of the moon was built in the city nearby, and an ancient pyramidallion was hidden between them. [tcg:lgs-b4]

teien casterwill sent the huntik team on a mission to activate the blue star from the temple in order to call the out of hiding in order to fight the blood spiral. [the titan in the temple of sun]

kiel and his team of casterwill hunters pursued the team to the pyramid of the sun. while dante vale and sophie casterwill fought against kiel outside the temple, lok lambert, den fears, and cherit fought against marduk. amid the frenzy, lok was able to invoke the legendary titan of summons, quetzalcoatl, who was revealed to be the blue star. the star was spotted by many of the casterwills, including nimue casterwill, vivian casterwill, lucas casterwill and focauld casterwill. [the titan in the temple of sun]

sir lancelot was a powerful seeker who was head of one of the main casterwill family branches. in ancient times, he searched for the holy grail and was the champion of king arthur. 

==history==
sir lancelot was an ancient and powerful seeker and a member of the casterwill family. during his time, he served as the head of one of the family's main houses. he was searching for the holy grail, and he had to prove that he was worthy through a series of tests. however, he failed the test in the end by falling in love with guinevere, who was already the wife of king arthur.

sir lancelot was bonded with cavalier, and, when he died, he left behind this titan and scrolls about the amulet of will and casterwill powers. after his death, a ghost trap bearing his image was left to guard his mausoleum. [memory lane]

==abilities==
sir lancelot was himself a trained warrior and a powerful seeker whose powers protected his sanctuary for century's even thought it was inside a major city. along with access to powerful casterwill spells and cavalier, a mighty warrior titan. [memory lane]

rahmas is a former organization mercenary and agent of rassimov. he bears the symbol of an ankh on his right arm.

== history ==
rahmas worked as a mercenary for the organization and was an agent of rassimov until his disappearance. zhalia moon was aware of his work. [cerberus (comic)]

rahmas had been working for dr. benway who, following the defeat of the professor, was trying to gain control of the oganization. rahmas had helped get benway to a high position, however, benway had disappeared before giving rahmas what he was owed. knowing benway was after the titan cerberus, he went to look for it himself. he fought against lok lambert, sophie casterwill, cherit and zhalia moon while they tried to find the location of the amulet of cerberus. after beating the huntik team, rahmas prepared to leave with the holotome of the sybil but zhalia, recognising him, suggested they join forces as he wouldn't be able to get past the traps in the "mouth of hell". rahmas reluctantly agreed, but was soon double-crossed by zhalia who knocked him out.

rahmas was then betrayed by dr. benway who revealed he already had the amulet of cerberus. benway then attempted to execute him and dante vale but the pair worked together to beat benway's forces and dante recovered the amulet. dante was unable to bond with cerberus due to being a "boy scout", leaving him with no other choice but to give the titan to rahmas who called cerberus back, saving the team. rahmas then drove off with the titan, something dante thought was worth losing to save his team. [cerberus (comic)]

== personality ==
rahmas is a ruthless mercenary who cares about himself. he doesn't hesitate to exploit a situation to his advantage, quickly pushing dante to give him cerberus, knowing dante would want to save his friends. however, rahmas also had some perspective as he openly admitted that he was a bad man and noted dante vale had a lot of honour which was a rare sight. nevertheless, he kept his side of the bargain and called cerberus back. [cerberus (comic)]

== abilities ==
rahmas is a powerful seeker and relies mainly on the hecto-titans of ancient egypt. he was also able to return cerberus to his amulet something that even dante couldn't do due to the darkness in him.[cerberus (comic)]
