the cloisters were a casterwill base in new york were focauld casterwill guarded the secrets of the casterwill family. the base was disguised under the front of a museum to allow focauld to remain in hiding from the blood spiral.

==history==
once the blood spiral discovered the location of the cloisters, they sent their silent soldiers to recover the casterwill secrets. upon realizing that a whole army had been sent to the cloisters, focauld contacted teien casterwill, the liaison with the huntik foundation, with a distress call. meanwhile, focauld used knowledgelock to transfer the casterwill secrets into a crystal for safekeeping. dante vale's team arrived to defend the knowledge within the cloisters from kiel and his casterwill hunters. due to some quick thinking by sophie casterwill, who had leblanche and santiago target the cloisters with the power of kindlestrike from the plane, the crystal was safe, though the cloisters suffered heavy damage from the fight. [the casterwill connection]

focauld was at the cloisters when he witnessed the blue star, calling together the casterwill family. [the titan in the temple of sun]

==trivia==
the cloisters is a real-life museum specialized in european medieval art and located in upper manhattan, new york city. the building depicted in the show is strikingly similar to the real-life building.

mr. mactavish is a suit working for the organization. he is one the agents working in venice, italy, and in prague, czech republic. he was commanded by defoe.

== history ==
mr. mactavish was under orders from defoe to recover eathon lambert's journal from lok lambert and sophie casterwill. he was the first suit to break in lok's dormitory. after a long chase, mactavish and the suits finally cornered lok, but dante vale arrived to save him. this angered mactavish but after a brief battle, he and his fellow agents ran away. he returned later with defoe, grier and reinforcements. [a seeker is born]

he was one of the many suits called in by defoe to stop dante, lok, and sophie in the venice huntik library. managing to get within proximity of sophie, mactavish nearly hit her directly, but the attack was intercepted by dante. mactavish, along with the others, was defeated by dante's team and santiago. [the casterwill client]

he later guarded the organization safehouse on the road of alchemists. he was then knocked out by lok lambert using his overslam power. [chasing void]

== abilities ==
like most suits, mactavish was issued with the standard organization titans.

=== spells utilized ===
*augerfrost
*hyperstride
*raypulse

=== bonded titans ===
*mindrone
*redcap
*strix

==trivia==
* he is the first suit to appear on screen, also the first character to use any power on screen with augerfrost.

steel and another suit attempted to retrieve eathon lambert's journal. however he was no match for sophie casterwill. [a seeker is born]

"it's come to this? the organization's enemies come and go as they please?!"
- wilder to stack about the huntik team, (doorway to huntik)

"how fitting, destroying the scum that tore the organization apart will be the banner that unites it once more."
- wilder to stack (doorway to huntik)

"dante vale i must thank you, your destruction will pave the way for a new united organization with me at it's head."
- wilder to dante vale and zhalia moon (doorway to huntik)

"it's a pity that i will have to get my hands dirty."
- wilder to dante vale, (doorway to huntik)

"i can see why the professor liked you so much, hoffman. you find the best help."
- wilder to hoffman, (the tower of nostradamus)

"sometimes, kid, the simplest plans are the most effective."
- wilder to one of his suits, (the tower of nostradamus)

"nostradamus would't have conceal this place if there wasn't something worth hiding!"
- wilder to his suits, hoffman and stack (the tower of nostradamus)

"surpises, surprises, you're full of surprises, dante vale."
- wilder to dante vale, (the tower of nostradamus)

"real soon, avalon's power is just the thing i need to restore the organization to it's former glory."
- wilder to stack (cave of the casterwills)

"incubane and i have come to take care of things, personally."
- wilder to lok lambert (knight of the willblade

"now that the kids are put to bed, lets see what i can do with this so call willblade. with my sorrowbond power i will severe it's link to the casterwills."
- wilder about the willblade (knight of the willblade

"i must confess that i received an anonymous tip, i'm going to enjoy spendng some time with you two."
- wilder to lok lambert and sophie casterwill (chasing void)

"don't be so naïve. evil is for the storybooks, my boy."
- wilder to lok lambert, (chasing void)

"you must have learnt what could happen if void fell into the wrong hands!"- dante vale
 
"yes, legends say it's power can bring the end of the world, but what if i harness that might, i will employ it to control the world instead!"- wilder (the blood spiral)

"undisciplined fighters are no match for me."
- wilder to wind (the blood spiral)

"how dare they!"
- wilder to the blood spirals, (the blood spiral)

"we will find a way to control them from the inside, then i will have the ultimate army to fuel my ambitions!"
- wilder to the huntik team (zhalia's mission)

"i've to much at stake, i won't lose."
- wilder to lok and dante, (zhalia's mission)

"as long as i promise glory for the organization i will always have followers."
- wilder to dante, (zhalia's mission)

"i have had enough of your mouth."
- wilder to dante vale (the power of umbra)

"me in charge is what's best."
- wilder to grier (an ally from the organization)

"it looks like i will have to find a more permanent solution for you kids!"
- wilder to lok lambert and den fears (an ally from the organization)

"ha, i don't even need to get my hands dirty, finish him!"
- wilder to grier (an ally from the organization)

"anymore where that came from?
- wilder to grier (an ally from the organization)

"i will get more men, i will return to lead."
- wilder to grier (an ally from the organization)

"we really must stop meeting like this."
- montehue to dante vale after saving his life from chemosh

"what's the point of being king or queen if you can't do whatever you want." (lok lambert on king solomon and queen sheba) 

"love is seldom simple, lok." (sophie casterwill)

"how quickly the kids grow up these days..." 
- cherit as lok and sophie almost confess their feelings to each other

"man, you've got some timing, you know that?"
- lok lambert sarcastically to tersly after he interrupted lok confessing his feelings to sophie

"sophie, i- i've been trying to tell you for a while, but i'm not really very good at this." (lok lambert) 

"lok, i will listen to anything you have to say." (sophie casterwill)

"sophie, i know we're both from different worlds, sorta like solomon and sheba, but i don't want us to end up like them... never having the chance to be together." (lok lambert)

"enjoy the view, professor, 'cause this is as close as you're gonna get."
- dante vale on the amulet of will before tossing it to lok lambert

"he's come a long way, that boy."
- cherit on lok lambert after he acquired tao's ring

"sir, they still have behemoth in reserve. we cannot win unless you use it." (rassimov on the professor invoking araknos) 

"now is not the time. we will fight them, and win, but on my terms, not these." (the professor)
huntik:page:15602:
"simon judeau, i presume." (dante vale)

"so, you know the truth. you're quite the resourceful detective." (the professor)

"team of detectives, actually." (dante vale)

"you call that pain? you don't know anything about pain!"
- shauna to lok lambert
huntik:page:15603:
"lok, this is the most dangerous mission i've ever planned." (dante vale)

"what metz means to you, you mean to me. so if you're gonna to fight for him, i'll fight for you." (lok lambert)

"dante vale, this battle will be your last." (rassimov) 

"sorry, rassimov. you're the one up for early retirement." (dante vale)

"not so fast. it's time for your nap." (zhalia moon) 

"filthy traitor. you'll pay for betraying the organization!" (alpha) 

"probably, but not today." (zhalia moon before casting darksleep)

"impressive." (rassimov) 

"i thank you for the compliment, but i don't care what scum like you thinks." (dante vale)

"it's impossible! no one could have improved so much so quickly." (rassimov) 

"it's taken some time, but i've memorized all your moves." (dante vale)

"dante! beware the professor, he's stronger than you think."
- rassimov's fake last words to dante vale as he hands him archwarder's amulet

"i hope that the evening finds you in good health." (the professor) 

"certainly in better health than you, if you don't give us what we came for." (dante vale)

"you know every amulet holds a titan. haven't you ever wondered about this one?"
- the professor to the huntik team about the amulet of will

"i tried the honest path, but when i heard metz was taken by the same illness, it was no longer a quest to save my own life." 
- the professor on creating the organiation

"huh, let me guess. by saing him, you'll redeem yourself." (zhalia moon) 

"is looking for redemption really so strange, zhalia moon?" (the professor)

"simon is still alive, buried under all these curses. if you help me, i can become him again."
- the professor to dante vale

"as a casterwill, i've got to fight evil, even if it means fighting dante, or you!" (sophie casterwill) 

"let's teach miss priss a lesson." (zhalia moon, before invoking king basilisk)

"i can't let you hurt dante. he means more to me than anything else in the world."
- zhalia moon to sophie casterwill

"no! i just gave it all up. it's the end."
- dante vale after giving the professor his legendary titans
huntik:page:15604:
"i didn't think you'd actually do it. i trusted you, i looked up to you, i even gave you the legendary titan of spirit. [...] no matter what the professor does with those titans, he's planning to make everyone in the world his slave, and you just helped him. [...] your mentor's life for the future of everyone on earth?"
- lok lambert lashing out at dante vale

"his feelings are fighting with his sense of right and wrong. he's tearing up inside."
- cherit to lok lambert on dante vale

"i expected eathon lambert's son to have a few more tricks up his sleeve."
- the professor to sophie casterwill about lok lambert

"what about me?" (sophie casterwill) 

"[chuckles] what about you? [...] you're merely a holdover from a washed-up fan of seekers. do you really think you can stop me?" (the professor)

"infuriating. every time i move to destroy you, you come with some trick to keep yourself alive."
- the professor to sophie casterwill

"it's not over; it's just getting started. sabriel was more than a titan, she was my friend, and she's been with me my entire life."
- sophie casterwill to the professor about sabriel

"i guess this is it. dante, i wanted to tell you, when we met i acted tough but really i was weak until you..." (zhalia moon thinking it's all over) 

"until i what? [...] i'm sorry i kept you waiting." (dante vale suddenly gaining consciousness) 

"i'll chew you out later." (zhalia moon)

"good thing i always carry a spare!"

- dante vale reveals to zhalia moon that he always owned two caliban titans

"i have ten times your power!"
- the professor to sophie casterwill

"eathon lambert was always by simon's side. i had a hunch the professor wanted someone just as loyal." 
-dante vale to zhalia moon about eathon the dog's name

"lok, i can't undo what i've done, but i'm gonna try and make up for it, starting right now."
-dante vale to lok lambert

"dante, i've got a plan." (lok lambert) 

"it's your show, lok. we're just here to back you up." (dante vale)

"zhalia, you were supposed to return gar-ghoul safely to huntik foundation headquarters." (dante vale) 

"sorry, but you should've known." (zhalia moon)

"no! i must retain control of overlos. i must have control, of everything!"

- simon judeau upon lok lambert gaining control of overlos

"history may very well remember you as the greatest seekers of your time."
- leblanche to the team

"my father, i know he's still out there, maybe there's a clue in what the professor said, and maybe one day i'll bring dad home." 
- lok lambert thinking to himself

"maybe lok should be team leader from now on." (sophie casterwill) 

"sure, i'm a master seeker now. no matter what happens, i've got it covered." (lok lambert) 

"oh really? because you know, school starts on monday." (sophie casterwill) 

"what? summer's vacation over? already? oh!" (lok lambert)
huntik:page:15608:
"impressive. that's not a spell you see everyday."
- dante vale to zhalia moon, about using headcage

"i'm gonna give you a chance to back out, since you don't know what you're in for."
- dante vale to suits

"are you trying to get yourself killed?" (sophie casterwill)

"yeah, uh, i mean no." (lok lambert)

"grier, i get the feeling there's more to you. something that you're hiding from me?" (dante vale) 
 "says the man who is hiding something from everybody." (grier)
huntik:page:15610:
"i swear, i'll cure you no matter what the cost."
- dante vale to metz

"sometimes looking at a problem from the opposite angle will allow to move forward."
- dante vale

"we have a guest. get ready for a scuffle."
- cherit to lok lambert and sophie casterwill

"i know how much you like disliking each other, but we need to get to the titan before the bad guys do!"
- lok lambert to sophie casterwill and zhalia moon

"you have two options - a, turn tail and hope i don't send [king basilisk] after you or b, the pedestal in the other room gets a lovely new statue."
- zhalia moon to defoe and his suits
huntik:page:15614:
"no titans in front of the amazons. we don't know how they'll react. besides, we're trying to make friends." (dante vale)

"so we're going to make friends by hitting them with our fists?" (lok lambert)

"well, it's worth a try, right?" (dante vale) 

"mr rassimov, this is not your day." dante vale to rassimov
huntik:page:15616:
"you know, in this line of work, you burn through your wardrobe pretty quickly." 
- dante vale to lok lambert

"let's get 'em!" (sophie casterwill) 
 "get 'em? that's my kind of plan!" (lok lambert)
huntik:page:15618:
"someone needed to try a little anger management." 
- zhalia moon, upon seeing the marks left by the battle between eathon lambert and the professor's personal guard 

"hey, you look too hard, and you may miss the answer right in front of you."
-lok lambert

"these flames are an illusion. they will not harm you if you are courageous." (atlantis guardian) 

"i don't care if it is real fire, if it means finding my dad, i'll walk through it no matter what!" (lok lambert)

"i'm sensing a strange power. is this part of the test?" (sophie casterwill) 

"i don't think so. i think it's part of lok." (dante vale)

"go easy on 'em, dante." 
- zhalia moon right before dante vale begins the test of prowess
 

"you don't appear to be titans. too bad for you." 
- dante vale to the mermen

"there is no equivalent power to a legendary titan. trying to copy it is a bad idea." 
- dante vale

"wow, dante! i didn't even think it was possible to invoke caliban, metagolem and behemoth back to back like that." (lok lambert)

"it's not." (dante vale, before collapsing from exhaustion)

"you've got to be more careful! you wouldn't see me doing that."
- cherit to zhalia moon, after she runs into the force barrier

"okay, just get it over with." (zhalia moon) 

"young miss, you look uneasy. is there something the matter?" (atlantis guardian) 

"maybe because i'm not noble. i was born poor. i lied, bullied, cheated and stole my way up in the world. i even betrayed the only people who were ever good to me." (zhalia moon) 

"you don't need royal blood, or a spotless past. in order to pass you have to show inner nobility by being honest even if it hurts, which you have. you pass. (atlantis guardian)

"i barely remember how to open this cumbersome thing. it has been ten thousand years."
- atlantis guardian

"i've come for the amulet of will. no exceptions."
- rassimov to the huntik team

"[my] dad never made it past the battle. it's because of the organization. it's because of you!"
- lok lambert to rassimov

"what's gotten into lok?"
- cherit to sophie casterwill 

"i'm about to change my mind. rassimov's going to be my friend in five seconds. five, four... now!"
- lok lambert to the atlantis guardian, ordering it to open the gates so that lindorm can strike rassimov

"lok lambert, your luck has run out." (rassimov)

"wrong, i still have my father's amulet." (lok lambert, before invoking baselaird)

"go ahead. invoke something. the more you throw at me, the more baselaird will throw at you."
- lok lambert to rassimov

"lok is starting to show his true potential."
- dante vale on lok lambert overpowering rassimov

"i've been making a complete fool out of myself, haven't i? jumping around shouting 'i know my dad's right around the corner!'. i don't how you put up with me." (lok lambert)

"don't say that! your energy is what keeps all of us going. at least, well, you're the one who keeps me going." (sophie casterwill)

"so, where do we go now?" (lok lambert)

"lok, the amulet is right in front of us, but only you can get it. you can't find your father now, but don't forget, he left for a reason, for a goal." (sophie casterwill)
huntik:page:15620:
"any friend of zhalia is a friend of mine."
- otto to the team

"i thought we were looking for snakes."
- otto to lok lambert, when asked if there are poisonous spiders in the desert.

"already i do not like this mission."

"you are guides, aren't you? working for the huntik foundation until your unfortunate seperation?" (the professor)

"the time of my coming is almost at hand. nothing must be allowed to stand in my way."
- the betrayer to rassimov, ("the dead magic island")

"rassimov. you will finish the casterwill girl. she could be a threat to us this night!"
- the betrayer
to rassimov, ("words from eathon")

"tonight, by my designs, the spiral mark shall open."
- the betrayer to rassimov, ("words from eathon")

"nothing. everything is going exactly as i planned. casterwill sealed the mark so it could not be used again, even on the longest night. and when he did he sealed it with a wild blade, because it only can be wielded by the true of heart."
- the betrayer to sophie casterwill, ("the spiral mark")

"fear not, the spiral mark is my domain."
- the betrayer to shauna, ("the spiral mark")

"yes, i have taken pains to gather all potential threats, foundation, casterwill, and spiral, to this very spot."
- the betrayer to dante vale, ("the spiral mark")

"to be certain you would stab the mark of your own free will, i have been setting these events in motion since ancient times."
- the betrayer to lok lambert, ("the spiral mark")

"all witness the betrayer, risen again! who stands with me?"
- the betrayer after rising again, ("lok and the betrayer")

"hear my words my sons and daughters, hear my words my friends and enemies. i have come to herald your doom! the blood spiral will inherit the earth".
- the betrayer to the blood spirals, huntik foundation and the casterwill family, ("lok and the betrayer")

"fools! your strongest has already been destroyed. listen to the truth and despair. dante vale is no more. i can feel it. our enemies will to fight has drained away. they cannot stand against us now!".
- the betrayer to the blood spirals, huntik foundation and the casterwill family, ("lok and the betrayer")

"sons and daughters, deliver the invaders their doom!"
- the betrayer to the blood spirals, ("lok and the betrayer")

"did you really believe you could stop what i set in motion so many eons ago? watch helplessly as i bring the spiral mark back to life!"

the blue star is a signal to reunite the scattered members of the casterwill family and is the antithesis to the red comet. the blue star, in actuality, is a form of the legendary titan of summons, quetzalcoatl.

== history ==
upon meeting with the huntik foundation council, dante vale's team were sent on a mission by teien casterwill to activate the blue star and to bring the casterwill family members out of hiding. following the quatrains on eathon lambert's holotome, lok lambert managed to acquire the ring of quetzalcoatl from the pyramid of the sun in the ruins of teotihuacan, mexico. upon summoning the titan and saving his teammates from kiel and the blood spirals, lok transformed quetzalcoatl into the blue star. [the titan in the temple of sun]

with the blue star high in the heavens, the scattered members of the casterwill family reunited at the fortress of iron will. [sophie on trial]

when lok fell into a gap between dimensions while exploring tír na nóg, he spoke with his father, eathon lambert, who hinted to lok that the blue star would be necessary when confronting the betrayer. [back home]

during the battle against the betrayer and the legendary titan of betrayal, demigorgan, lok transformed the blue star back into quetzalcoatl. [dante's return]

the crystal caves are a casterwill base located in northern coast of england. the magic of lord casterwill courses through the large, blue crystals within the caves. the caves were the home of the first lady of the lake, as well as nimue casterwill and her granddaughter, vivian. the two means of entering the caves are through an entrance on the other side of the cliffs and through a portal near the beach which could be opened by the lady of the lake.

==history==
the huntik team found the caves while searching for avalon and the willblade. however, the team was attacked by the guardians of nimue casterwill, the lady of the lake, upon nearing the nearby shore. the huntik team then took refuge in a nearby cave. one of the entrances to the crystal caves was later discovered by zhalia moon. she, dante vale, and lok lambert returned to investigate the caves. here, they were attacked by mallory and white, nimue's guardians.

meanwhile, the magic of the crystal caves began to react with sophie casterwill's hand, causing it to emit a blue, magic light. sensing this reaction to a member of the casterwill bloodline, nimue casterwill opened the portal to the crystal caves to let sophie enter. after passing the magical traps with the aid of leblanche, sophie entered the actual caves. here, she was offered the amulet of sorcerel, the sister of sabriel, should sophie prove herself worthy through passing a test. sophie succeeded in gaining the amulet, reuniting and powerbonding with sabriel in the process. following the test, sophie and nimue joined dante and company, stopping the fight and welcoming the newcomers to the crystal caves as friends. [cave of the casterwills]

huntik:page:16861:
the pied pipe is a magical pipe originally used by the pied piper.

== history ==
the pied pipe was unlocked after sophie casterwill successfully used a flute to lead the gremlow titans back to their amulet. a radiating light from the amulet changed the flute into the pied pipe. [gremlow infestation!]

after the huntik team was captured by wilder's team, cherit was forced to play the pipe, charming conquistador into letting them in to hernán cortés's vault on the search for umbra. mid-battle, cherit dropped the pied pipe which left conquistador uncharmed, causing the team to be attacked by the titan. [the power of umbra]

== abilities ==
when playing a children's song, the fife can enchant any titan who hears its sweet music: it was used to control the titan conquistador and let the musician into hernán cortés's vault of treasures.

huntik:page:16887:
"the blue star is high in the heavens so by our secret lore, we casterwills gathered in our ancient stronghold, the fortress of iron will." 
- nimue casterwill

"nimue, what's the meaning of this? sophie may come before us, but that boy is no casterwill."
- focauld casterwill to nimue casterwill

"nothing but trees and boulders in sight. where's a guy gonna get a sandwich around here?"
- den fears to dante vale

"fools, the arms of the spiral can reach all. none will escape us!" 
- a silent soldier to dante vale and den fears

"powers like simplemind only work on the weak-minded. a seeker would barely be affected"
-dante vale to den fears

"the purpose of the casterwill family, is to ensure that spiral mark is never activated. if it is, the greatest evil, the nullifiers, will return to poison the world." 
- nimue casterwill

"it's the foundation's time now. ours has ended. let us preserve our history by surviving." 
- focauld casterwill

"despite the signal, only a fraction of casterwills is here. our resources must be used finding and protecting the others." 
- lucas casterwill

"lucas don't you think it's an emergency? if the elders can't take action, i will fight in the name of our whole family."
- sophie casterwill to lucas casterwill

"everyone's older brother or sister can be a pain sometimes, leblanche."
-lok lambert to leblanche

"i've been just a caretaker of casterwill family safehouse when they sent you. i knew little of family secrets and they didn't even leave me a way to contact them. the less i knew, the safer you'd be."
-leblanche to sophie casterwill

"leblanche, you gave me something more important than secrets. you gave me a home. even more, you were like a father to me when i didn't have one."
- sophie casterwill to leblanche

"don't get your hopes up." (lucas casterwill)

"what makes you so sure i won't pass the test, lucas?" (sophie casterwill)

"because i'm a stronger seeker than you and i failed." (lucas casterwill)

"courage? no problem. balance, i need to work on."
- lok lambert to sophie casterwill

"maybe we can pencil in some time between hating my brother and saving life on earth?"
- sophie casterwill to lok lambert

"forget what lucas said. my dad's clues pointed us here. he knew you can do it and i trust him"
-lok lambert to sophie casterwill

"to bond with legendary titan of valor, you must have deep confidence in your heart."
-cherit to sophie casterwill

"look at the willblade, i'm a casterwill but it bonded with you not me. guess i'm not really cut out to lead the casterwill family."
- sophie casterwill to lok lambert

"you should just go into hiding for the rest of your life."
-the illusion of lucas casterwill to sophie casterwill

"this is not your brother sophie. it's a trap. it's reading your mind, looking for your fears."
-lok lambert to sophie casterwill

"you can't beat fear just by whacking it with a sword!"
- lok lambert to sophie casterwill

"everyone is counting on me. i know in my heart i can't fail them."
- sophie casterwill

"it's a good think i've been keeping an eye on you, spy."
tantras to zhalia moon

"you've been reporting to huntik foundation and this dante vale. you must care very much for him."
- tantras to zhalia moon

"kiel will achieve his ultimate purpose today." (harrison fears)

"then what will kiel do tomorrow?" (zhalia moon)

"you're causing a disturbance. please step back from the gate"
lucas casterwill to santiago

"lady nimue, i have faith in sophie but please allow us to go and check on her"
-leblanche to nimue casterwill

"the trial of courage must be done alone."
- nimue casterwill to leblanche

"special delivery! who ordered one casterwill princess?"
- lok lambert to casterwill family

"i'm sorry i've kept you all waiting"
- sophie casterwill to santiago  and casterwill family

"all is clear. sophie is now leader of casterwill elders"
-nimue casterwill to casterwill family 

"yes, we have no choice but to accept you. but our opinions have not changed"
-lucas casterwill to sophie casterwill 

"no, they're right. i proved myself to mythras, not them. besides, leader or not, the casterwill family can't act if we're divided like this." sophie casterwill

"you know, for leaders in many cultures, election by ancient magic lion would be quite acceptable."
- cherit to lok lambert

"nothing is out of reach for the grip of chaos." tantras

"i'm no good with maths, but i think we're outnumbered."(lok lambert)

"in numbers perhaps, but not in spirit."(nimue casterwill)

"they've got an army down there. won't they overwhelm us?"
- lok lambert to dante vale

"there is nothing we can do now."lucas casterwill

"there's only three of us and they've got an army!" (lok lambert)

"i almost feel sorry for them." (dante vale)

"we've got your back!"
- lane to leblanche and santiago

"sir, aren't we going to protect the others?"(dellix)

"we're not here to fight, remember, dellix?"(lucas casterwill)

"but together we're one of the strongest casterwill squads! we should be helping!"(lane)

"there's no point. i'm going to talk to elders and figure a way to escape. come on."(lucas casterwill)

"our brothers and sisters are fighting down there. you can help or go and talk!"(dellix)

"no i said we should fight and i have to stand by my word!" (sophie casterwill)

"no. their strongest are hanging back! he is hanging back!" (sophie casterwill)

"ha! they're trapped. no one can stop us"(kiel)

"you're not a casterwill! what a waste of time"(kiel)
"sorry to disappoint you. now fight me"(dante vale) 

"why didn't it work? is it because i'm avoiding kiel?" (sophie casterwill)

"it's over and it's all my fault. i wasn't brave enough." (sophie casterwill)

"the life of a casterwill must sometimes be given for what is good and true."
- nimue casterwill to sophie casterwill

"sophie, deep down there is something you fear more than kiel's fire. i saw how quickly you gave up casterwill leadership. such a responsibility, so many lives depending on you. sophie, don't fear your future." (nimue casterwill)

"that light. it made me feel strange"(harrison fears)
"that was radiating hope, courage, life"(tantras) 

"oh? i remember how much you like fire."
- kiel to sophie casterwill

"am i still afraid of my past? my future? nimue..." (sophie casterwill)

"vivian needs me. all casterwills need me now. i'll avenge my past and i'll lead the casterwills." (sophie casterwill)

"he's right isn't he? you only live to destroy us! how empty! you're pathetic! i almost feel sorry for you." (sophie casterwill)

"don't you fear me?"(kiel)

"mother, father i've won." (sophie casterwill)

"sophie, grandma nimue is gone." (vivian casterwill)

"i know vivian, but we must take care of casterwill family in her place." (sophie casterwill)

"we do?" (vivian casterwill)

"yes, you're now the new lady of the lake and a member of casterwill elders. but you can do it. i'll prove it. mythras only bonds with courageous heart right? from now on mythras will protect you."(sophie casterwill)

"now last i checked, sophie was looking for some support from her family."(lok lambert)

"sophie, i was wrong. i'm sorry and i'm proud of you. so i pledge my loyalty to sophie, leader of the casterwills!"
- lucas casterwill to sophie casterwill

"today, you gave me something to believe in again."
- focauld casterwill to sophie casterwill

"then it's unanimous." (dante vale)

huntik:page:16921: recover void was taken on by the huntik team to retrieve the amulet of void in order to prevent the return of the nullifiers. having now learnt that void was being stored in klaus' bookshop, the team required klaus' help to find it and thus turned him back to normal form. despite lok, cherit and springer beating wilder and the organization to the amulet, the mission was thrown into disarray due to the arrival of the blood spiral and the return, wind, shauna and rassimov. although dante was able to save him and the team by powerbonding with caliban, shauna managed to snatch void's amulet from lok. the spirals then departed, burning klaus' base to the ground in the process. [the blood spiral]
huntik:page:16923: the piper of hamlin was a mission assigned to lok, sophie, and den along with guggenheim to investigate a rogue titan in the cathedral. the titan was revealed to be the gremlow but using its "swarm" ability, it was able to create an entire colony of identical titans, growing by the minute. to stop them, sophie purchased a flute, using the notes on a stained glass window within the cathedral to transform it into the pied pipe once used by the pied piper himself. using it, sophie made gremlow return to its amulet to complete the mission. the team faced a pair of suits while purchasing the flute. [gremlow infestation!]
huntik:page:16924:
vampire hunter was a mission assigned to lok lambert, den fears and sophie casterwill that consisted in putting vlad dracul's strongest titan, the wild antedeluvian, under control. however, unbeknownst to the huntik foundation, tantras was already in the castle, trying to use the heart of vlad dracul's power to open the spiral mark early. 

== history ==
metz assigned this mission to lok lambert while dante vale was away in china training, putting him on charge. upon entering the castle, sophie notes that the foundation agents stationed there are missing, and shortly after the team run into harrison fears, which prompts her to use powerscan and detect a powerful evil magic surrounding the castle. harrison makes use of his newly gained authority to make some silent soldiers (including the undercover zhalia moon) fight for him. in the midst of the brawl, zhalia is able to hint to sophie what the spirals are up to, and that harrison has gotten stronger. the huntik team then try to hurry up, with lok taking harrison one-on-one, but he's outmatched and the situation doesn't look good for the foundation. lok asserts himself as the leader in this mission and confidently defeats the soldiers by invoking lindorm, stalling harrison in the process. 

the team quickly head to the throne room, where tantras is found to be trying to use the heart of vlad dracul to activate the spiral mark. however, harrison quickly reappears and reveals he has already powerbonded to antedeluvian. lok, sophie and den struggle heavily against powerbonded antedeluvian, and are unable to stop tantras' ritual by themselves, with lok unsuccessfully attempting to invoke pendragon. in the meanwhile, dante has gotten wind of the news and uses umbra to teleport to the castle and help his team. with the help of ignatius and his newly learned spell copykind, dante defeats antedeluvian and distracts tantras from his ritual, just about as zhalia was about to blow her cover and invoke king basilisk to stop him. ultimately, the mission was unsuccessful, as the team couldn't subdue antedeluvian. [lok's leadership]

== trivia ==

huntik:page:16939:
the eye of the storm was a mission taken by the huntik team that consisted of a battle plan built by the huntik foundation after analyzing the files on rassimov recovered at the professor's castle in their previous mission, the professor's dossier. it intends to isolate and capture rassimov, the leader of the blood spirals. 

== history ==
the information regarding rassimov's location was given by zhalia moon, who undercover at the blood spiral base, overheard him pitch a secret mission to harrison fears regarding the necklace of tutankhamun.

after ariel erased the team's footsteps, the plan was set in motion when rassimov was about to enter the tomb of tutankhamun. a coordinated sequence of attacks by the huntik team, aided by ariel's tornado to hinder rassimov's vision, countered his magic while harrison was fighting den fears. rassimov then tried to use his most powerful spell, darkvoid, to get himself out of the situation. this was already expected by the huntik team, as dante invoked maelstrom to absorb his power. now completely cornered, he was restrained and taken by two huntik foundation members in a vehicle, his titans being taken by dante. harrison then ran away and used powermark on a bazela's insect, recovering quickly from the encounter.

however, as the team explored the tomb, harrison attacked the vehicles taking rassimov. dante and company then encountered them on the way back. a fight ensues where the huntik team have the upper hand, but things take a turn for the worse when rassimov invokes legion, whose amulet was hidden inside his body. the team struggles heavily against the nigh-invincible legendary titan of war, and it manages to absorve solwing and lindorm, with rassimov taking the necklace of tutankhamun. dante is then forced to retreat and take everyone injured to a huntik foundation hospital, and the mission is ultimately unsuccessful. [rassimov's secret]

the mission was so exhausting for the team that even in the following days, dante could not invoke caliban and was overall too tired to fight or use any magic. [back home]

"i'm glad dante isn't here to see this. i'd hate it if he had to waste his time on someone like you."
- lok lambert to the betrayer after he mocked dante vale's sacrifice

"he had a plan, i know it. dante wouldn't have sacrificed himself if he didn't believe in us, if he didn't believe we could finish this without him. he stopped the red comet to save us, get it? we're the plan! the casterwills are the plan, the huntik foundation is the plan. "i've lost my husband. i won't lose my son too."

"found a new chew toy, i see."
- montehue to fenris

- harrison fears to den fears on zhalia moon

"brother, please, i need your help to save my friend zhalia."
- harrison fears to den fears

"sorry, ugly. first you deal with us." (den fears)

"...together." (harrison fears)

- the brothers to the betrayer as they unite against him

unnamed suit 001 was a suit working for the organization. he was one of the group's operatives working under defoe out of venice, italy.

== history ==
this suit attacked lok lambert and sophie casterwill to retrieve the eathon's journal. he invoked a mindrone and was a part of the team that cornered lok outside of dante vale's house. this suit was defeated when dante vale intervened and defeated the titan with solwing. [a seeker is born]

he was one of the many suits called in by defoe to stop dante vale, lok lambert, and sophie casterwill in the venice huntik library. this suit, along with the others, was defeated by dante's team and santiago. [the casterwill client] they did, however, acquire the foundation's clue regarding the golem, and his team of suits gained jodis lore's key for the organization. [words of truth, heart of lies] 

the team was later sent to rouen, france, to retrieve gar-ghoul. [into the river of secrets] however, they missed the more important information on the ring of arc and were then sent by the professor to paris, france, following dante's team into the paris catacombs. [crawling the catacombs] however, his team was unsuccessful at retrieving the ring. [divide and conquer]

this suit was later a part of the investigation of the basilisk house and the amulet of king basilisk. he was entrusted with a key which was given to defoe to enter an underground labyrinth. upon reaching the chamber containing king basilisk, this suit was turned to stone when he looked at the head of the mural of king basilisk. [absent heroes] he was later released by sophie's breakspell power, which zhalia and lok discussed following the mission. [huntik.com]

this suit was later sent to zhalia moon's apartment to eliminate her following her betrayal of the organization. after the building exploded, he assumed that zhalia had perished in the blaze and reported her as dead. [the unseen guide]

== abilities ==
like most suits, he was issued with the standard organization titans.

== spells utilized ==
* hyperstride
* raypulse
* shadowspeed

== bonded titans ==
* mindrone
* redcap

charlene hubbs is a suit working for the organization. she mainly works in venice, italy and was previously commanded by defoe.

== history ==
hubbs helped surround dante's house, under orders from defoe and grier to retrieve eathon lambert's journal from lok lambert, cherit and dante vale. [a seeker is born] hubbs and her fellow suits pursued the three along the rooftops of venice but failed to stop them. [the casterwill client]

at road of alchemists, hubbs invoked a mindrone to fight lok's freelancer but it was defeated. she and mr. koskin both hit lok with an augerfrost, rendering him unconscious. defoe order the group to retreat when dante retrieved and invoked metagolem. [words of truth, heart of lies]

hubbs later attacked lok lambert and sophie casterwill with mr. koskin and unnamed suit 004 at a burger restaurant where the huntik team were trying earn enough to travel to egypt. hubbs was defeated when santiago used her to shield himself from a raypulse attack from one of hubbs' colleagues. huntik international hq is the main headquarters of the huntik foundation where the huntik foundation council meets to discuss the progress and problems of the seeker world. this base is located in manhattan, new york.

== history ==
when metz, the leader of the council, fell victim to the curse of the legendary titans, the hq hosted hologram meetings. [coming of age] however, following metz' recovery, the council members gathered in the hq and started to deliberate again. [the tower of nostradamus]

the council discussed the reemergence of the organization following the defeat of the professor. nasher then alerted the council that his seekers in tower of nostradamus had been attacked by the organization. [the tower of nostradamus]

when focauld casterwill alerted teien casterwill that the blood spiral had found him, metz allowed her to bring the matter before the council. [the casterwill connection] dante's team later came before the council to discuss the blood spiral and were tasked with the mission call of the casterwill. [the titan in the temple of sun]

the council gathered in the international hq on the longest night of the year to discuss plans to stop the activation of the spiral mark. [words from eathon] several members, including metz, momax, guggenheim and teien fought during the final battle against the blood spiral. [dante's return]

following the defeat of the betrayer, the huntik council gathered at the international hq, now joined by a new member, dante vale. [dante's return]

the trap located in basilisk house consisted of a large stone carving of king basilisk, with its head blocked by a curtain. pulling back the curtain and looking into the carving's eyes unleashed a purple energy that petrifies its victim. this trap was used to guard the resting place of king basilisk.

==history==
this trap was disarmed by lok lambert by using a mirror to reflect the petrifying energy back on the trap, thus destroying it. doing so revealed a secret room behind the carving containing a statue of king basilisk with its amulet resting inside. [absent heroes]

the path of trust is a magical test in the mausoleum of sir lancelot consisting of two rows of green ghosts holding their shields upwards across a bottomless pit.

==history==
the path of trust was created by the seeker sir lancelot to guard the treasures of his mausoleum, notably the amulet of his titan, cavalier, and the encoded instructions for the spell, findshape. [memory lane]

many years later, dante vale and lok lambert came before this test. though lok attempted to use kipperin to fly across the room, the ghosts fired beams of energy from their swords to dematerialize the titan. as a result, lok was sent falling but was caught by dante. before the ghosts could attack dante, rassimov covertly used his titan, thornment, to halt the attack. after the foundation duo passed the test, the trap was destroyed by rassimov's darkvoid spell. [memory lane]

many years later, dante vale and lok lambert came before this test. though lok attempted to use kipperin to fly across the room, the ghosts fired beams of energy from their swords to dematerialize the titan. as a result, lok was sent falling but was caught by dante. before the ghosts could attack dante, rassimov covertly used his titan, thornment, to halt the attack. after the foundation duo passed the test, the trap was destroyed by rassimov's darkvoid spell. [memory lane]

this is the final trap created by sir lancelot to guard his titan, cavalier, and the coded instructions for the findshape spell.

==history==
this series of tests was created to mirror the challenges faced by sir lancelot on his quest for the holy grail. choosing the wrong option would result in crossbow bolts being fired from near the ceiling.

the first test takes the form of a pedestal with an amulet placed on it. when lok lambert saw the amulet, dante vale commented that one of his titans was missing, revealing that the amulet actually belonged to him. lok, not wanting to unwittingly steal from his friend, passed up the amulet and thus proceeded to the next test.

the second test presented two tables, one filled with food and the other filled with money. both of these were passed up to progress to the next test .

the third test presented an illusion of the seeker's enemy tied to a column with two swords placed in front. this test was passed through refusing to attack.

the fourth and final test presented an illusion of lady guinevere, representing when sir lancelot fell in love with king arthur's wife and subsequently fell from grace. guinevere's hand was kissed , permitting the final test to be passed.

through passing all of the tests, dante's team was able to find the resting place of cavalier's amulet and instructions for the findshape spell.

klaus' bookshop was the house and bookstore owned by the evil seeker, klaus. it served as a front for the organization. hidden underneath was a massive laboratory containing many of klaus' experiments and a vault containing a vast collection of artifacts. among the items kept here were the bottle of djinn, spear of vlad the impaler, and the amulet of void. it also served as living quarters for numerous suits and was home to zhalia moon growing up.

==history==
klaus' bookshop was his main base of operations for many years and was home to zhalia moon after she was adopted by klaus. [the bookshop hunter]

rassimov paid a visit to klaus' bookstore to task klaus with the mission of recovering gybolg from new grange passage tomb in ireland. klaus then called zhalia to be his double agent and sabotage the huntik team's mission. [home turf]

after dante vale placed a tracking device on the sceptre of nefertiti which klaus had recovered, the huntik team followed him back to vienna where they infiltrated his bookstore. they encountered a series of deadly traps including klaus' mutant experimental spiders. while sophie casterwill and zhalia took basement level 1 to find the lab records for the bottle of djinn, dante, cherit and lok lambert took basement level 2 where they discovered zhalia's old room and a number of klaus' experiments including the power stopglue. after a huge battle with klaus and his forces down in the laboratory level, dante eventually revealed that he had come to collect the spear of vlad the impaler and team made their escape. [the bookshop hunter]

after the appearance of the red comet and the return of lucas casterwill, whom sophie believed to be dead, lok and sophie were tasked with finding the location of void which was revealed by wilder to be klaus' bookstore. [chasing void]

after klaus opted to help the huntik foundation and provide them with the passwords for his vault, the team returned to klaus' bookstore where they faced heavy opposition from wilder and his men. however, the team recovered void's amulet, they were bombarded by the arrival of the blood spiral, led by rassimov. after shauna took the amulet from lok, shakrit and the silent soldiers destroyed the laboratory and the whole base burnt down. this brought back painful memories for sophie, and saddened zhalia to see her former home burn to ashes. [the blood spiral]

the newgrange passage tomb is located in ireland and is one of the oldest burial mounds in the worlds. it served as the resting place for the titan gybolg.

==layout==
the main mortuary chamber has stairs leading down to an enchanted door, behind which the secret chamber with the obelisk of cú chulainn is.

==history==
the newgrange passage tomb was built in 3500 bc, making it older than stonehenge and the pyramids. [s1e13]

scarlet byrne theorized that the irish seeker cú chulainn had to defeat a water titan or clear a water trap in order to find the amulet of gybolg. he eventually sealed the amulet within an obelisk in the secret chamber. [s1e13]

years later, scarlet and dante's team travelled to newgrange passage tomb to investigate. after locating the secret chamber's entrance, sophie casterwill managed to open it with breakspell, albeit for a short amount of time due to the immense power of the seeker who sealed it. scarlett then discovered and bonded with gybolg, then summoned it to fight alongside dante's team against klaus' suits and defeat one of their bonelasher titans. [home turf]

the power amplifier is an item employed by the huntik foundation, seeing usage during the re-appearance of the blood spiral. as its name suggests, it amplifies the power of normal seeker spells - due to its bulk however, it is only employed on certain aircraft, notably the huntik foundation's scramjets, making up for their lack of heavy weaponry.

== history ==
the power amplifer was used by the huntik team on their mission defend the cloisters. in order to defeat kiel and his men, the power amplifier was activated by leblanche to magnify the effects of sophie casterwill's magic, destroying the room at the cloisters and defeating the enemy forces. [the casterwill connection]

during the final battle at the blood spiral base, teien casterwill ordered all huntik foundation and casterwill family teams to ready the power amplifiers to which they were used to attack the blood spiral soldiers. [lok and the betrayer]

==abilities==
the power amplifier is a powerful item, able to affect all designated seeker spells in a given area, or focus upon a single room and/or individual. once affected, a seeker's chosen spell is given a general boost in power, as well as range - this is seen when leblanche fired a kindlestrike from a huntik jet, knocking down a silent soldier instantly.

when focused upon a single individual, at full power they have the potential to become person's of mass destruction, essentially. sophie casterwill used this to cast an unidentified magic, which affected the whole room and simultaneously blasted the combined forces of the blood spirals, titans and all, for a relatively low investment of energy. omens and legacies is the third and final regular card set of the huntik trading card game. this set saw the introduction of new blood spiral heroes and the new "forceful" special power. it also delved into the backstories of established seekers, featuring cards of younger versions of characters such as the professor and zhalia moon. the set was planned to be followed by labyrinth of doom, but upper deck filed for bankruptcy before the next set of cards could be released.

huntik:page:19069:
scramjets are super sleek blue jets used by the huntik foundation that are equipped with magical weaponry. their speed allows them to be anywhere in the world in less than four hours whilst they are armed with power amplifiers which make up for their lack of heavy weaponry.

== history ==
higgans advised that the huntik foundation use their scramjets to transport the huntik foundation and casterwill family to the location of the spiral mark. after zhalia moon informed dante vale of the location, four scramjets headed to the siberian plateau. [words from eathon]

the four jets headed to the spiral mark, one piloted by metz and lady s., one piloted by leblanche and santiago, one piloted by teien and focauld casterwill and another piloted by scarlet byrne who was joined by sandra lambert, who had a stowed away using camoforge. however, as the scramjets arrived in the territory of the betrayer, he jammed the radios, planning for them to be in the blast radius of the red comet which had changed course and begun heading towards the earth. dante managed to stop the impact, albeit at the cost of his own life. [the spiral mark]

lok lambert managed to contact all the scramjets and lead them into a full-on attack on the blood spiral base. all power amplifiers were used and a large battle ensued with bazela's insect carrying silent soldiers into the sky to attack the jets. [lok and the betrayer]

wind and shakrit destroyed one of the scramjets, with santiago rescuing leblanche in the nick of time. momax's jet was also heavily damaged by the pair, but montehue arrived in time for them to both use mjolnir to defeat the pair. [dante's return]

the oracle was a wise man suffering from an unspecified magical curse who was residing in a cave with lich, deep underground near the greek coast. he had considerable knowledge on the whereabouts of atlantis.

== history ==
eathon lambert fell into the cave and discovered the oracle in a decrepit state whilst on his quest to find the ancient amulet of will. eathon had hoped to find a wise man who could point him in the right direction of atlantis. after helping to revive him, eathon promised to return with a cure for his curse and protected his cave with a magical force barrier. [the unseen guide]

ten years later, just like his father, lok lambert fell down the hole and into the oracle's cave. after defeating lok's freelancer, the oracle grabbed lok. after realising who lok was and that he had fallen through the barrier with eathon lambert's journal, the oracle, now in his young man form, revealed that the entrance to atlantis lay at the temple of poseidon before passing on eathon's message, "those things most precious are often hidden in plain sight". [the unseen guide]

== abilities ==
the extent of the oracle's abilities is unknown but freelancer was defeated simply by touching him whilst his magic was enough to floor lok.

the temple of tecobai was a lost monument located deep in the ecuadorian jungle across a canyon of liquid hot magma. the surrounding forest was inhabited by hostile ecuadorian natives.

== history ==
in the mid late 1950s, the lost temple of tecobai was discovered by simon judeau, eathon lambert and metz who hoped to claim the treasure held there. they were relieved at how easy it had been. however, they were attacked by a tribe of ecuadorian natives and were forced to flee across the bridge. after the bridge collapses, metz nearly fell to his death but was saved by simon who held out his caliban amulet for him to clasp. [the divine comedy]

many years later, simon, now known as the professor, used the story of him saving metz at the temple to trick dante vale into handing him the rings of behemoth and tao. dante noted that metz had told him all about it. [the divine comedy]

the equadorian natives were a tribe who inhabited the ecuadorian jungle. they watched over the lost temple of tecobai and were typically hostile and aggressive towards strangers.

== history==
in the mid late 1950s, the tribe attacked simon judeau, eathon lambert and metz on their quest to find the treasures of the temple of tecobai. a crazy witch doctor had warned them of the natives, and the trio attempted to escape over a rope bridge across a canyon of liquid hot magma. the tribe's arrows damaged the bridge and metz nearly fell to his death, however he was saved by simon and they lived to tell the tale. [the divine comedy]

== abilities ==
the natives were skilled in combat and armed with an array of weapons including spears, bows and arrows. their persistence and aggression towards strangers was made clear in the numerous arrows fired at metz, simon and eathon. [the divine comedy]

the post street museum is a museum located in london, england and the base of operations for montehue and his assistant, tersly. the museum holds an impressive collection of historical treasures ranging from artworks to artifacts.

== history ==
in preparation for their mission, the hammer of thor, dante vale, lok lambert and sophie casterwill visited the post street museum for tersly's knowledge of norse legends. montehue was out playing racket ball during their visit. sophie commented that the art collection made her feel close to her mother who apparently avidly collected art. they soon realized were being spied on by the guardians of thor and exited the museum to give chase. [the legacy of thor]

on their mission to king solomon's mines, montehue and tersly recovered numerous priceless treasures to take with them to the museum, including the raiments of king solomon and the queen of sheba which later became vital to opening the vault and retrieving the legendary titan of spirit, tao. nefertiti was an ancient egyptian queen and seeker, stepmother and adviser to tutankhamun. she was highly intelligent and a great manipulator and possessed a sceptre containing the power neverlost and a key that unlocked the tomb of tutankhamun. the tomb of nefertiti is located in the valley of the kings, egypt.

== history ==
nefertiti's sceptre was sealed deep within the tomb of nefertiti and protected by a series of deadly traps and riddles thought out by nefertiti herself. it was eventually acquired by the huntik foundation. however, in order to escape the organization forces, dante vale threw the sceptre into a waterfall to allow the team time to escape and it was recovered by klaus' suits. however dante then revealed he had placed a tracking device on the sceptre which would lead them to klaus' bookshop. [the sceptre deception]

klaus later destroyed nefertiti's sceptre after scanning it and recovering neverlost. [the bookshop hunter]

== history ==
the golden fleece was the fleece of a rare golden ram and the coveted prize of jason and the argonauts' quest. [like father, unlike son]

whilst diving down to the argo to recover jason's hoplite amulets, zhalia moon encountered the golden fleece among other items including the apple of paris and hercules' arrow. placing a coin on the pedestal of the golden fleece unlocked the vault, allowing her to recover the chest of dragon's teeth and the amulets of the hoplite titans. [like father, unlike son]

the dargon's teeth were planted jason on his quest to find the golden fleece and grew into hoplite titans. the teeth remained in a chest of hoplite amulets before eventually being by recovered zhalia moon for the huntik foundation.

== history ==
in the legend, the dragon's teeth were planted by jason in a field before growing into warriors, the hoplites. [like father, unlike son]

whilst diving down to the argo to recover jason's hoplite amulets, zhalia moon recovered the dragon's teeth while encountering numerous other items including the golden fleece, apple of paris and hercules' arrow. placing a coin on the pedestal of the golden fleece unlocked the vault, allowing her to recover the chest of dragon's teeth and the amulets of the hoplite titans which she gave to the rest of the team. while zhalia initially thought they were just shark's teeth, sophie explained how jason has planted them in a field and out had grown warriors. [like father, unlike son]

huntik:page:19648: the ndego bridge was a large rope bridge over a stream of water situated on the outskirts of mek'ele, ethiopia, a short drive away from otto's house. whilst being pursued by rassimov's suits in a car, dante vale invoked metagolem from the roof of otto's car who demolished the bridge, sending the organization into the water below. [the golden asp]

nostradamus' scrying glass is an ancient magical scrying glass that supposedly told him the future. it was placed in a wooden chest, concealed by nostradamus' casterwill family illusion powers rendering it invisible to the naked eye, and left in the hidden observatory of the tower of nostradamus, formerly known as the seer's tower.

== history ==
nostradamus left his scrying glass protected from plain sight with an illusion power in his tower's hidden observatory, guarded by three sentry triclops titans, concealed by the same power. [the tower of nostradamus]

many years later, stack uncovered details of the hidden observatory and the scrying glass in the organization archives. wilder and his team then arrived at the tower, now the tower of nostradamus and base for the huntik foundation. after taking peter, billie and the other operative stationed there hostage, the organization then ransacked the observatory looking for the scrying glass but were unable to see past the illusion placed nostradamus. after dante vale's team arrives, a fight for the scrying glass took place before the three sentry triclops threw the organization from the building. after recovering the scrying glass, lok lambert used it to reveal a new quatrain and send them in the direction of the willblade on avalon, along with a message saying "good luck, lok". [the tower of nostradamus]

the mystery of shadowing is the nineteenth issue of the huntik magazine comic book series. it takes place after season 2. although completed and advertised, the issue was cancelled and ultimately never published. a following issue was also pencilled but cancelled.

== synopsis ==
the huntik team, now joined by harrison fears, travel to the snowy mountains of west virginia to investigate the mysterious mothman. there they face the wild titan shadowing and their old enemy, the blood spiral.

== triva ==
* although this issue was never published, the comic itself was completed prior to the cancellation orders. one page shows the huntik team on a plane, joined by den and harrison fears. another page shows den and his powerbonded vigilante fighting against shadow kuolit.

lok lambert is the son of legendary seeker, eathon lambert, whose chance discovery of his father's journal changed his life forever. thrown into the magical world of seekers and titans, lok gained the help of his classmate, sophie casterwill, and dante vale, the master seeker who would become his friend and mentor. together, they embarked on a quest to find the ancient amulet of will before the evil organization, and uncover the truth behind his father's disappearance. he may not be book smart, but lok's enthusiasm, intuition and knack for solving puzzles let him find answers where others can't, and his courage to persevere no matter the odds has seen him rise from a rookie to become one of the most powerful seekers in the huntik foundation. 

== appearance ==
lok is a boy with blond hair and blue eyes. his usual attire includes an unbuttoned white shirt over a long navy undershirt, a pair of brown bracelets, blue cargo jeans with a loose brown belt, and gray sneakers with red highlights. [a seeker is born] occasionally, he also wears a two-toned brown jacket. [chasing void] for some desert missions, he wears a two-pocketed white shirt tucked into a pair of khaki cargo shorts. [the golden asp]

== history ==
 for the first time]]
though born into a family of seekers, lok and his sister, kathy lambert, remained blissfully unaware of his latent seeker abilities. only knowing his father, eathon lambert, to be an explorer, lok often dreamed of going on a adventures and discovering what happened to cause the disappearance of his father. living as an ordinary teenaged student at venice preparation academy, he developed a crush on sophie casterwill, who had been unaware of him, despite his sitting behind her in class for mathematics one year, science the next year, and history the following year. [a seeker is born]

when sophie and lok went to lok's dormitory to study, one of lok's father's ancient vases accidentally was broken, revealing the amulet of kipperin and eathon lambert's journal hidden within and immediately placing them on the organization's radar. forced to flee from the organization with sophie, lok lambert was forced to sprint around the city in search of answers and for safety from the enemy seekers. those answers came to him in the form of dante vale, the huntik foundation's most renowned seeker. [a seeker is born] dante then gave lok the amulet of freelancer who would become a favored titan of his on many adventures. though lok was unable to pay for dante's services, sophie paid dante to investigate the disappearance of lok's father, eathon, and to train the two as part of the foundation. [the casterwill client] lok soon learnt to use his first power, everfight, and invoke his father's titan, kipperin to defeat the organization. [words of truth, heart of lies]

through working as a team on numerous missions, lok became fast friends with dante, sophie, and later zhalia moon. [the sceptre deception] on a mission to the castle of vlad dracul when zhalia revealed herself to be working undercover for klaus and fought against sophie, lok leapt in between the two and managed to stop zhalia from delivering the final blow and help bring her back to her senses. [the vampire loses its fangs]

after taking on rassimov in the mausoleum of sir lancelot, lok was almost killed after being sent by a bladewave through a wall but luckily escaped with just a head injury. the wall he went through revealed the inscription for the power findshape which sophie was able to master and use to repair the journal. [memory lane] [the unseen guide] [the unseen guide]
 alone]]
following eathon's journal entries, the team travelled to the temple of poseidon in greece where lok fell down into the cave of an the oracle before discovering the amulet of his father's titan, baselaird. the team then travelled down to atlantis where lok discovered that his father never made it as far as passing the four tests of lord casterwill and that he might never find him. in his rage, lok was able to independently defeat rassimov. sophie revealed her feelings for a saddened lok, and with her encouragement, he found the strength to complete his father's goal and use his puzzle to obtain the ancient amulet of will. [coming of age]

after following a clue about the ring of tao from eathon lambert's journal to king solomon's mines in ethiopia, lok and the team travelled to claim the legendary titan of spirit. in order to get past the trapped entrant to the vault, lok and sophie had to dress as king solomon and the queen of sheba and express their true feelings for one another before lok went on to bond with the legendary titan, defeating the organization in the process. [to be together]

through investigating the history of the organization, lok and the team eventually discovered that the professor was in fact simon judeau, the original teammate of metz and eathon. and that he possessed the ring of araknos, the titan of mind. after an altercation with blood spiral seekers, shauna and wind, lok lost possession of eathon lambert's journal and the amulet of will. [the secret of two generations]

in a dangerous mission to find out the truth about metz' curse, lok and the team travelled to the professor's castle and where they learnt of overlos, the titan of immortality, whose invocation would lift the curse of the legendary titans. after dante broke down after being tricked into giving the professor the rings of behemoth and tao , lok led the team in an offensive strike to stop the professor once and for all. during the battle, lok was sent through a wall and rescued by cherit who brought to the professor's private room. it was here that he discovered his father's holotome and the amulet of dendras and he devised a plan to defeat simon. lok then returned and, with the help of dante and zhalia, put his plan into action, taking control of overlos and banishing him and the three other legendary titans to the spirit world. in the process, araknos, dragged the professor away with him, despite the efforts of lok and dante to save him. after returning to venice, lok determined not to give up on his search for his father. [the mission]
]]
after the fall of the professor, lok continued to work with the huntik foundation and to look for his father. his search led him and his friends to the jungle of south america, the site of his father's disappearance. there he discovered the nexus, a gateway to the spirit world, huntik, and was finally able to talk to his father, who told him to lead casterwills to the spiral mark.[doorway to huntik] later, lok continued to receive messages through his father's holotome which he had found in professor's castle. [the mission] they led him to discover the nostradamus quatrains, which mentioned avalon.[the tower of nostradamus]

the new search led lok and the team to nimue casterwill, who helped them to find the island. on avalon lok managed to draw the willblade, thus becoming champion of casterwill. he battled wilder but couldn't remember anything later.[knight of the willblade] he continued his casterwill quest, however, finding quetzalcoatl, umbra, and phoenix on his way and helping sophie find her confidence and win over her family. due to dante vale being occupied in the sea of cortés, lok led a mission in hamelin, germany, winning the trust of his friends as a leader. [lok's leadership]

in tír na nóg, after falling into a hole between dimensions and then talking with his father, he finally remembered what had happened on avalon and that he is the new champion of casterwill, allowing him to use pendragon and save the team.[back home] after finding the last quatrains in salon, france, he teleported with the team to siberia and, fooled by quatrains left by the betrayer, used the willblade on the spiral mark, awakening it and the betrayer.[the spiral mark]
 to save his friends]]
after dante's death and betrayer's insulting words he became angry and delivered an inspiring speech, pulling everyone together again, but his spirits dropped when betrayer revealed that quatrains were fake and that holotome was indeed a titan known as demigorgan. only after discovering that at tír na nóg his father was real, lok fought back with everything he had, powerbonding with pendragon and calling down quetzalcoatl, destroying demigorgan's amulet in the process. this action, however, weakened lok, causing him to doubt himself, but his friends' support and dante's later return reinvigorated him. after finding the real prophecies of nostradamus on his holotome and discovering a means to defeat the betrayer, he used the willblade again and managed to defeat the enemy, saving the world. one month later, lok took over as the new leader of the huntik team after dante's departure as a member of the huntik foundation council. [dante's return]

== personality ==

lok was just a normal, fun-loving high school student, struggling to stay awake in his classes and wishing for a life of adventure. after finding his father's amulets and becoming a seeker, lok puts his enthusiasm, intuition and natural talent to the test as he is introduced to sophie casterwill, dante vale, and the world of seekers in huntik. [a seeker is born] lok eventually developed a close brotherly bond with dante [memory lane], whilst becoming best friends with cherit with the latter always at lok's side throughout their numerous escapades together. [the unseen guide] being able to relate to being a novice in the seeker world, lok became a big brother to den fears, supporting him and teaching him new spells. [boys will be seekers]

he is usually quite even tempered, but he can be remarkably aggressive when sufficiently angered. this is seen both when he gains perfect control over lindorm, who bonds best when his seeker is angry [s1e12], and when he believed his father was dead at the hands of the organization. [s1e21]

== abilities ==
, fights with the willblade]]
during his childhood, lok gained an uncanny knack for puzzles through playing games with his father. lok's puzzle skills include being able to solve a crossword puzzle in ninety seconds, whereas sophie casterwill was having difficulty working with the puzzle. [a seeker is born]

lok was initially slow at learning his seeker abilities through research. learning best while under fire, however, lok has improved by leaps and bounds through experience in the field on his way to becoming a top huntik foundation seeker. through training and missions, lok has risen quickly to become quite skilled at using magic as well as bonding with the amulets of titans. since joining the huntik foundation, he has also trained with sophie and dante on various methods of combat including martial arts, and fencing. when these skills and his amulets are not enough, lok calls upon cherit for wisdom and advice and the willblade which he wields as the champion of the casterwill family.

== trivia ==
*according to the ask guggenheim portal, lok is stated to be 15 years old. however, both the seeker community section in huntik magazine (issue 9) and the official panini huntik sticker album list his age as 16.
* in first series trailer, lok's name was originally jason, and he had an amulet of unnamed titan 001, which since then has only appeared in the series' opening.
* lok's name is pronounced like the word lock, a device which can be thought of as similar to a puzzle. lok is very adept at solving puzzles. his name also means joy in chinese.
* lok stated in "the bookshop hunter" that he hates spiders. this is referred to again in "the golden asp."
* lok has a fear of harlekin titans, and they feature in nightmares due to the ring of arc and while at home. this seems to suggest that he has coulrophobia, which is a phobia of clowns.

lok was just a normal, fun-loving high school student, struggling to stay awake in his classes and wishing for a life of adventure. after finding his father's amulets and becoming a seeker, lok puts his enthusiasm, intuition and natural talent to the test as he is introduced to sophie casterwill, dante vale, and the world of seekers in huntik. [a seeker is born] lok eventually developed a close brotherly bond with dante [memory lane], whilst becoming best friends with cherit with the latter always at lok's side throughout their numerous escapades together. [the unseen guide] being able to relate to being a novice in the seeker world, lok became a big brother to den fears, supporting him and teaching him new spells. [boys will be seekers]

he is usually quite even tempered, but he can be remarkably aggressive when sufficiently angered. this is seen both when he gains perfect control over lindorm, who bonds best when his seeker is angry [s1e12], and when he believed his father was dead at the hands of the organization. [s1e21]
, fights with the willblade]]
during his childhood, lok gained an uncanny knack for puzzles through playing games with his father. lok's puzzle skills include being able to solve a crossword puzzle in ninety seconds, whereas sophie casterwill was having difficulty working with the puzzle. [a seeker is born]

lok was initially slow at learning his seeker abilities through research. learning best while under fire, however, lok has improved by leaps and bounds through experience in the field on his way to becoming a top huntik foundation seeker. through training and missions, lok has risen quickly to become quite skilled at using magic as well as bonding with the amulets of titans. since joining the huntik foundation, he has also trained with sophie and dante on various methods of combat including martial arts, and fencing. when these skills and his amulets are not enough, lok calls upon cherit for wisdom and advice and the willblade which he wields as the champion of the casterwill family.
