huntik:page:1987:
the huntik foundation is a loosely organized confederation of philanthropists, adventurers, and historians, dedicated to protecting history and exploring ancient secrets. understanding the importance of preserving forgotten traditions and cultures, the foundation's goal is to uncover the lost titans so as to prevent them from falling into the hands of evil, and to defend the world against the evil machinations of seekers such as the organization and the blood spiral.

== history ==
]]
the huntik foundation was created early in the 20th century by a group of like minded seekers who wanted to learn the secrets of the titans. [huntik.com] the first huntik foundation council was established at some point after 1959, to deliberate plans and missions. it consisted of seven members, including eathon lambert. a painting of the first meeting was hung on the wall of the huntik italian hq. [the secret of two generations] the huntik council eventually became based at huntik international hq in manhattan, new york, while maintaining additional operational bases throughout the world. [coming of age]

when the organization revealed itself in 1959, the foundation recognised the threat it posed to the world. they strove to uncover the lost titans before they could be discovered and used for evil by the professor and his followers. [the secret of two generations]

at some point, the foundation was successfully infiltrated by the organization, with information on the prague huntik hotel somehow being passed onto defoe's suits. [words of truth, heart of lies] the double agent was revealed to be zhalia moon, who had been raised by the organization scientist, klaus. [the vampire loses its fangs] however, zhalia repented for her betrayal and was made an official member by metz after helping the foundation obtain the ring of behemoth, the legendary titan of body. [ladies' choice]

the foundation were shocked by the revelation that the professor was, in fact, simon judeau, and had once been a member of the huntik foundation. [the secret of two generations] the foundation were officially against dante vale's team travelling to the professor's castle due to the danger and recklessness of the mission, but did not stand in their way. [the divine comedy] the huntik team, in turn, succeeded in defeating the professor for good. [the mission] despite this, the threat of the organization continued to trouble the foundation, with the rise of mr. wilder who attacked their base in tower of nostradamus. [the tower of nostradamus]

when the blood spiral revealed itself to the world, the foundation called an emergency council meeting to respond how to deal with this extremely dangerous new threat. [den vs harrison] allied with the casterwill family, the foundation sent dante vale's team to rescue focauld casterwill from the cloisters and to activate the blue star to call the casterwills out of hiding. [the casterwill connection] [the titan in the temple of sun]

on the longest night of the year, the huntik foundation members travelled on scramjets to the spiral mark to launch an assault on the blood spiral base. [lok and the betrayer] eventually, after a gruelling final battle, the huntik foundation succeeded in defeating the blood spiral once and for all. [dante's return]

three months after the defeat of the betrayer, dante vale officially joined the huntik council with lok lambert becoming the new leader of the foundation's number one team. [dante's return]

==bases==
the foundation has many different safe houses located around the world. among these dante's house, huntik foundation italian hq, the cathedral of notre dame in paris and the prague huntik hotel.

== members ==
the foundation is made up many different seekers and seeker teams. among the best seekers in the huntik foundation, dante vale is officially ranked number one, with montehue ranked second. [the legacy of thor] a typical foundation operative is smart, spunky, and curious. he or she has a nose for a mystery and a keen sense of justice. foundation operatives value teammates and work together in order to make the world a better place. some members however prefer to remain out of the field. these operatives are usually profilers who remain at safe houses and research new ways to stop the organization. [divide and conquer]

== missions ==
see the full list of huntik foundation missions
missions are assigned to huntik foundation teams by the huntik foundation council, with all data sent via holotome. these missions involve uncovering more information regarding magic and titans as well as preventing the organization from achieving their nefarious goals. many notable missions were assigned by guggenheim to the team of dante vale, sophie casterwill, lok lambert, zhalia moon, and newcomer den fears.

huntik:page:1990:
the organization, which was founded in 1959, is a ruthless group of seekers with operatives in every government on the globe, and is one of the primary adversaries of the huntik foundation. the organization's goal is to dominate the world through subterfuge, strong-arm tactics, and raw, brutal power.

==history==
 builds his army of suits]]
simon judeau, under the mysterious alias of "the professor," left the huntik foundation in order to find a cure for the curse of the legendary titans and founded the organization practically overnight in new years 1959. he began building an army of followers through the use of the legendary titan of mind, araknos', mind control abilities. 

in order to cover up how quickly he built an army of international agents, judeau also falsified the history of the organization, so as to make it seem as if the organization had existed for hundreds of years, corrupting national governments and royal courts before making itself known in april 1959. this was told to every new agent, with none questioning the truth of this story. [the secret of two generations] 

the truth about the organization was discovered by zhalia moon after hacking into the organization's extensive data archive and the huntik team were able to work out who true identity of the professor. [the secret of two generations] 

after the fall of the professor, the organization was taken over and led by wilder, who always used dirty tricks and hated to get his hands dirty. [doorway to huntik]

grier later took over the organization by taking wilder as a hostage on sutos island. as grier believed in order more then dominance and was a very honorable man, it is possible that the current goals of the organization may have changed. [an ally from the organization]

wilder eventually escaped and set up base beneath shuri castle in japan, and continued to plot with the members of his organization team. [the guardian of yonaguni]

== bases ==
their primary base is organization central in prague, czech republic, but chicago, united states and rotterdam, netherlands are also hotspots for their activity. [the secret of two generations] they also have branch offices around the world used for their global activates. known locations include venice, italy; london, england; paris, france; vienna, austria; velo and athens, greece; valley of the kings, egypt and silene, libya.

==members==

defoe, grier, and rassimov were once among the organization's top operatives under the professor, attacking wherever and whenever the professor wished. the organization scientist, klaus, created the teknonomicon. after the professor's defeat, two top organization members, stack and hoffman, served wilder.

a typical organization operative is underhanded, ruthless, and cruel. they follow orders as long as it's advantageous, but will quickly betray any leader who shows weakness. organization teams are often held together by a sense of profit and opportunity.

== abilities ==
most operatives tend to rely on two major titans, redcap and mindrone, though jokoul, enforcer, bonelasher, and strix are often used by higher-up suits. the basic spell many organization operatives rely on most is augerfrost, whilst also relying on other spells like touchram, raypulse, poisonfang, among several others.

under the control of wilder, some suits receive titans such as doom warden and/or shadow agent. [gremlow infestation!]

huntik:page:1993:
amulets are the most common artifact containing titans, the other primary medium being the more-powerful rings. amulets are usually shaped with a reference to its titan or the titan's icon. a jewel is set in its center, which has a color corresponding to the type of the titan inside. amulets also anchor a titan to earth, allowing them to cross over from the spirit world known as huntik.

==history==
in ancient history, lord casterwill forged the amulets and rings in order to battle and the nullifiers, finally defeating them after a 500 year ordeal. at some unknown time after this conflict, these artifacts became hidden in locations such as tombs, dungeons, mazes, and temples. while the exact chronology is still under research, many amulets of great value once belonged to such figureheads throughout history as sir lancelot of camelot.

having been hidden for thousands of years in some cases, the amulets are currently being hunted by both the huntik foundation and the organization, with the balance of the world hanging in the midst. while most of the titans have slept throughout this time, their amulets have been activating with an increasing frequency around the time simon judeau, now known as "the professor," disturbed the ring of araknos. since then, the organization formed by him has hunted down these amulets as he sought both world domination and a cure for the curse of the legendary titans.

== amulet designs ==
although some exceptions exist, the design colors of an amulet typically denotes which one of the eight types its titan belongs to. legendary titan amulets are all unique in their design, and are primarily rings.

huntik:page:1997:
seekers are people who can control titans or utilize magic. once a seeker has bonded with a titan's amulet or ring, that titan can be summoned to fight at that seeker’s side. seekers who have collected amulets can also learn how to use magical powers that make them stronger than any regular human. when a seeker bonds with a titan, they are capable of summoning that titan for as long as they possess its amulet (although a seeker can give the titan's amulet to another). once the transfer has occurred, the new bond allows that seeker to summon the titan, as when dante vale gave lok lambert a freelancer amulet. [the casterwill client] 

seekers also have the special ability to cast spells, their knowledge of which is improved through practice and study. seekers have to be constantly vigilant and focused as they require perfect concentration to control both their powers and the titans.

the power source of a seeker is their will, which dwells in their heart and their mind. their will is what allows a seeker to cast spells and invoke titans. while most seekers learn their spells and powers from ancient tomes or artifacts, basic spells such as boltflare can be mimicked.

the first seeker, lord casterwill, used the amulet of will to bring the titans to earth. seekers often discover their abilities by bonding with a titan; from the moment they bond, they become targeted by the organization and the huntik foundation, who attempt to recruit them (the organization for power, and the huntik foundation for friendship and learning).

some people are raised to be seekers; sophie casterwill is an example of one such seeker, having been trained from birth. others, however, discover their powers by chance; den fears realized his spell casting abilities while protecting his brother from bullies as his orphanage. 

according to zhalia moon, great power often comes from regal blood, as with joan of arc. many seekers are descendants of ancient royalty of some sort. [crawling the catacombs]
huntik:page:2000:
zhalia moon is an orphan with a dark past who was raised by klaus in the organization. a trained spy and master of disguise, she used her skills for both the organization and for the huntik foundation, eventually choosing to ally herself with her newfound friends in the foundation. initially an elegant lone wolf, she found her place to belong among these friends. her primary titan is gareon, a titan who can become invisible.

== appearance ==
zhalia is a tall woman with straight, dark navy-blue hair that reaches past her shoulders and hazel eyes. her outfit consists of a muted, olive-green off-the-shoulder sweater with long, slightly puffed sleeves with a mauve tank top underneath, a thin black choker with two long, ribbons hanging down past her chest, slate-blue capris held by a wide brown leather belt with a large gold circular buckle and dark forest-green high heeled boots with light grey triangular sections at the top of the shins. attached to her right leg is a brown leather utility pouch, secured by a strap around her thigh.

==history ==
 from klaus]]
zhalia moon was an orphan living in the streets. she could barely find anything to eat and was bullied by other kids. until she was adopted by klaus, an evil organization scientist, who saw something in her. offered power and a place to belong, she was trained in espionage as an organization agent. she was given the amulet of gareon, and the two quickly bonded. [the vampire loses its fangs]

as an organization operative, she was sent as a spy to infiltrate the huntik foundation. originally a rival, she became a member of dante vale's team alongside lok lambert, sophie casterwill, and cherit. [words of truth, heart of lies] she did, however, sustain a bitter relationship with sophie.

[the vampire loses its fangs]

zhalia continued to feel guilty over her betrayal and decided to help them claim the legendary titan of body, behemoth, after posing as an amazon who wanted leadership of the tribe, she gained possession of the amulet and gave it to dante. this marked her rejoining the huntik team. the huntik foundation dutch hq is the main base and safehouse for the huntik foundation in rotterdam, netherlands where it is hidden deep in the city, near the erasmus bridge.
== history ==
lok lambert, sophie casterwill and cherit were tasked with delivering the amulet of the titan vigilante securely to the safehouse but had difficulty finding the headquarters as it was so well hidden. the pair were forced to go off-route in order lead a pair of silent soldiers away from the base. after reaching the erasmus bridge, the pair were ambushed by tantras and his new students before they could the safehouse. thankfully, vigilante's amulet ended up in the hands of den fears, a good seeker. [den vs harrison]

breaker is one of the most powerful titans in the organization. he is a massive, four-armed bear with ancient, tribal markings on his body. even a single moment of distraction can prove deadly against this traditional fighting titan. he fights furiously for his master, grier.

== history ==
breaker has some tie to native american tribes, as referenced to on the tribal markings on his arms, the feathers, and the style of his armor. native americans had great respect for the animal spirits, including the bear. legends about bears being incredibly good at wrestling come from breaker titans' ability to grapple. [huntik.com] breaker is also closely related to the breaker cub titan. [tcg:oal-053]

later a breaker amulet would come into the hands of the organization operative, grier, who would use him in numerous battles against the huntik foundation.

grier invoked breaker in the huntik foundation library in venice to attack dante vale's caliban. to give dante, lok lambert, sophie casterwill and santiago time to escape, caliban threw a large shelf on top of breaker. [the casterwill client]

in the attic of jodis lore, grier invoked breaker to again fight against dante's caliban. with help from defoe's kreutalk, breaker was able to defeat caliban before defeating zhalia moon's kilthane. after being distracted by solwing, breaker charged at sophie only to be disorientated by a boltflare from zhalia. when dante succeeded in invoking lore's titan, metagolem, breaker was defeated by a single hit from metagolem. [words of truth, heart of lies]

in the cave of the gargoyle, breaker fought against the huntik team's titans, including caliban, kilthane and lok's freelancer. despite gaining the upper hand against the titans, breaker was defeated caliban after being held back by metagolem. [into the river of secrets] breaker was later invoked by grier in the paris catacombs to fight caliban who punched him to the ground. after recovering breaker attacked dante's freelancer before being buried in rocks by dante's raypulse. [divide and conquer]

grier invoked breaker in the basilisk house to fight kilthane. after an attack from sabriel, breaker and grier pursued sophie and zhalia alongside another suit and their mindrone. later, grier used breaker to fight and defeat caliban. breaker was defeated however when zhalia bonded with king basilisk who turned breaker to stone. [absent heroes]

in greece, grier invoked breaker as part of defoe's plan to ambush the huntik team and kill dante. he fought against zhalia's kilthane while dante and his team fled to the shipwreck that they had uncovered. [the treasures of the argonauts]

when grier and his suits took control of sutos island, breaker was invoked to scare any inhabitant who challenged the organization's rule. breaker was later used to fight metagolem and caliban while grier and dante fought one on one. later, breaker was again invoked alongside megataur as grier and dante prepared to fight to the end. however, the battle was stopped when grier revealed he had come to restore order and peace to sutos after his father, zan-sutos, was killed by a mob. with the two seekers having resolved their differences, grier allowed dante and his team to leave. [like father, unlike son]

breaker became powerbonded to grier during a battle in the professor's castle in order to save him from asphyxiation at the hands wilder's grand façade, much to the amazement of den fears. powerbonded breaker then defeated grand façade with his crushing grip. [an ally from the organization]

== abilities ==
breaker is incredibly strong, and even more so when grappling opponents. his grapple ability increases his strength to the point that he can even neutralize even more powerful opponents like caliban. using his four arms, he pins his opponent to his chest and beats his opponent mercilessly. and his claws and teeth are certainly no picnic either. once he's got his opponent, it is almost certainly done for. being a bear, he also has a keen sense of smell.

== powerbonding ==
after becoming powerbonded, breaker gained the typical golden armor of a powerbonded titan with the large horns protruding his back also becoming gold in color. his grapple power became enhanced to the crushing grip ability giving even him stronger physical strength, allowing him to quickly take out powerful titans like grand façade. [an ally from the organization]

== design history ==
breaker was designed to represent the power of a wild beast and so was modeled after a four-armed bear. taking inspiration from the native americans, who associated bears with strength and a connection with the earth, breaker was given tribal markings, feathers, and tribal armor. [huntik.com]

breaker is incredibly strong, and even more so when grappling opponents. his grapple ability increases his strength to the point that he can even neutralize even more powerful opponents like caliban. using his four arms, he pins his opponent to his chest and beats his opponent mercilessly. and his claws and teeth are certainly no picnic either. once he's got his opponent, it is almost certainly done for. being a bear, he also has a keen sense of smell.
after becoming powerbonded, breaker gained the typical golden armor of a powerbonded titan with the large horns protruding his back also becoming gold in color. his grapple power became enhanced to the crushing grip ability giving even him stronger physical strength, allowing him to quickly take out powerful titans like grand façade. [an ally from the organization]
breaker was designed to represent the power of a wild beast and so was modeled after a four-armed bear. taking inspiration from the native americans, who associated bears with strength and a connection with the earth, breaker was given tribal markings, feathers, and tribal armor. [huntik.com]

breakspell is a spell used for breaking various enchantments, seals and illusions. this spell shoots a blue beam at the source of magical energy. if the enchantment is too strong, then it will only be temporarily broken. some enchantments may be so strong as to render breakspell futile against them.

== history ==
sophie casterwill used breakspell to destroy the gargoyle trap protecting the cave of the gargoyle. [into the river of secrets]

inside the paris catacombs, breakspell was used by sophie alongside other spells to deactivate the knights of arc's inner circle protecting the ring of arc, targeting every individual suit of armor. this left her exhausted afterwards. [crawling the catacombs]

sophie again used this spell to break a mystical laminate preventing cypherdex from scanning a map of the inner maze of the basilisk house. the laminate was set by defoe as a trap, predicting the huntik team would attempt to scan the map. [absent heroes]

zhalia moon and sophie casterwill undid the petrifying effects of king basilisk with this spell. [huntik.com]

breakspell was cast by sophie casterwill to break a magical barrier surrounding a ship sunk in the stavropolous river initially thought to be the argo, allowing the huntik team to explore it. [the treasures of the argonauts]

sophie once again used the spell counter the illusion of cristine, set by the titan madea to give sophie fake books about her family's history. [the beautiful trap]

this spell was cast by sophie in order to open a chamber inside the newgrange passage tomb containing the titan gybolg. as sophie had noted when she used the spell, the door opened after a short time, trapping lok on the outside of the room fighting organization suits. she attempted to cast breakspell again, but the seal was much stronger from the inside and the door couldn't be open. [home turf]

breakspell was unsuccessfully cast by sophie casterwill to attempt to break a powerful force barrier shielding a cave lok lambert had fallen into. the barrier was set ten years ago by eathon lambert to protect the oracle, residing in the cave. [the unseen guide]

in an unofficial mission to confront simon judeau in his castle, sophie used the spell to destroy a cat-like anchor concealing the various traps guarding the entrance to the castle. the professor also used breakspell to break an illusion and reveal his true appearance to the huntik team because of the curse of the legendary titans. [the divine comedy] sophie later cast breakspell once again in combination with lok lambert's boltflare to break the professor's ritual regarding the amulet of will and behemoth, tao and araknos. [the mission]

at one point, zhalia moon used the spell against a suit. [tcg:sas-104]

as part of a plan to get inside medusa's cave, sophie used breakspell to stop kiel from casting one of his powers, helping metagolem detain him. [zhalia's mission]

sophie used this spell once again against kiel to stop one of his spells when fighting him by the entrance of the fortress of iron will. [the spiral war]

in an elaborate plan to capture rassimov by the tomb of tutankhamun, sophie cast breakspell to prevent him from using one of his powers. [rassimov's secret]

after asking cherit to give her all his power with his energy charge, sophie casterwill used breakspell with doublespell on the spiral mark in an attempt to stop the dark ritual sending the red comet to their location. however, the ritual was too strong and sophie's efforts were in vain. [the spiral mark]

dante vale, as the top operative of the huntik foundation, is an expert treasure hunter, sleuth, and martial artist. originally acting as a hired detective, he took to leading the team of lok lambert, sophie casterwill, zhalia moon, and later den fears on a mission to track down the missing foundation operative and father of lok, eathon lambert, and to retrieve the legendary titans. he has developed a close bond with his titans, particularly his trusted caliban and solwing.

== history ==
]]
when he was young, dante vale met metz, who recognized dante's potential to be a seeker. through metz' tutelage, dante learned about magic and titans. dante's first amulet to bond to, that of solwing, was found all by himself while spending time in turkey. [ladies' choice] dante was also given a caliban amulet by metz, though dante took over a year to be able to invoke and master the meso-titan due to caliban's immense power. initially, dante was only able to keep caliban summoned for about a minute, though dante increased this time through training. [huntik.com] his friendship with metz also found dante working alongside eathon lambert and simon judeau. [huntik.com/profiles] as a teenager, he trained intensively under metz' friend master storm in china alongside lin storm, with whom he formed a close friendship. [lok's leadership]

some years later, dante found another caliban amulet in south america, during one of his most dangerous missions for the huntik foundation. [caliban amulet (gp card)] dante kept this a secret, with everyone believing he possessed simply the one caliban, who had become his most distinctive titan. [the mission] 

dante later gained an ignatius amulet while on an expedition to a volcano in chile. as ignatius amulets were common in this country, both dante and another seeker acquired one during this expedition. another meso-titan, dante was able to control much faster after learning how to control caliban, though ignatius' flares occasionally would set something, such as buildings, on fire. three water titans were once needed to put ignatius out. [huntik.com]

in his youth, dante also crossed paths with montehue, a student of the history of war and fellow treasure hunter, with the pair instantly forming a competitive but nonetheless friendly rivalry. whilst racing up a mountain, dante secretly slipped a tolivane amulet into montehue's pocket as a way of keeping things fair. after saving montehue from falling to his death, dante left a lasting impression on him, and introducing him to the world of seekers. the pair's competitive friendship spanned many years, with the pair eventually becoming close friends through working together to use mjolnir to defeat ymir in the temple of thor and, later, fighting side by side against the professor in king solomon's mines. [two powers become one] [to be together]

dante was manipulated by the professor into giving him the rings of behemoth and tao so that he could perform a ritual to summon lord casterwill's titan of immortality, overlos which would end the curse of the legendary titans, saving metz's life. dante also gave him back his caliban amulet, which the professor had originally used to save metz' life at the temple of tecobai. dante saw it as a way of repaying old debts, truly believing that simon could save metz one last time. however, it turned out to be a trick, as the professor had much more evil intentions with the three legendary titans. this broke dante mentally, and caused him to go into a state of shock and grief. [s1e25] lok therefore had to lead the mission to stop the professor's plan. dante eventually managed to recover from his stupour and save zhalia from two undergolem titans. he tried to put right his mistake by helping lok to stop the professor and battle the three legendary titans. he summoned archwarder, disrupting the professor's control over overlos, allowing lok to use dendras and command overlos to banish himself and the other three legendary titans to the spirit world. [s1e26]

 of caliban]]
during a mission to rescue clements from the ring of arc, dante entered a dreamworld, created by arc, the legendary titan of fate. here, dante had a vision of his own death with zhalia and his friends crying at his grave. despite being visibly haunted by this, as to not worry anybody, he kept it to himself and told no one. [the legendary titan of fate][lok's leadership][the guardian of yonaguni]

dante was left saddened when zhalia chose to leave the huntik team, adamant she plays to her strengths and infiltrate the blood spiral to fight them from the inside. [zhalia's mission] using zhalia's logosbook, the pair communicated with one another. [sophie on trial]

in the vault of hernán cortés, dante managed to beat wilder in recovering the ring of the legendary titan of dimensions, umbra, the shadow jaguar. [the power of umbra]

deeply shaken by the vision of his future and with the threat of the blood spiral looming, dante returned to train under master storm in china. after learning the copykind spell, he used umbra to join his team in the castle of vlad dracul. using copykind to mimic ignatius' flames, he caused the heart of vlad dracul to overload and injure tantras. [lok's leadership]

during the final battle at the spiral mark, dante was able to defeat rassimov one on one while helping lok and sophie destroy legion. however, the betrayer revealed that he had faked the last prophecies of nostradamus, and in attempting to destroy the mark, the team had activated it and sent the red comet hurtling towards earth. realizing the time had come to fulfill his destiny that arc had revealed, dante died sacrificing himself to prevent the red comet from hitting the earth. [the spiral mark]

attempting to destroy his enemies' will to fight, the betrayer revealed dante's death to the huntik foundation and the casterwill family, devastating zhalia moon, metz, and montehue. however, lok, enraged at the spirals' mocking of dante's sacrifice, made a motivating speech, inspiring the foundation to finish what dante started, knowing he would have believed they could win the war without him. [lok and the betrayer]

during the betrayer's ritual, dante's ashes were teleported back to earth by umbra. by using the copykind spell on phoenix, the legendary titan of the rebirth, just prior to his death, dante was able to rise back to life from his ashes. dante soon attempted to prevent the betrayer from invoking the nullifiers, battling him; however, his hyperstrides couldn't keep up with the betrayer's ability to fly, and he was knocked down and almost made immobile by the betrayer's shadowlock spell. lok and sophie, though, were quick to find a prophecy in nostradamus' real writings, telling dante to hold the betrayer, which he did so with stoneglove paired with doublespell, allowing lok to throw the willblade at the betrayer, revealing this weakness -- the spiral mark on his back, thus enabling the team to finally stop the betrayer. after the defeat of the betrayer, dante vale became a member of the huntik foundation council, leaving leadership of his old team to lok lambert. [dante's return]

== personality ==

a natural leader, dante not only takes control of the situation, but also knows how to be a present mentor to his team. through his years of experience and natural intelligence, he is an excellent tactician, often keeping several steps ahead of his opponents in the organization. enjoying the battle, he has an overall confident and sassy attitude when it comes to his combat skills, and often makes wisecracks while fighting. he manages to remain calm under stress and to adapt when unexpected events make his original plans not pan out. fiercely loyal to his team, he will do anything in his power to protect his friends, such as trying to find a cure for metz' curse. [absent heroes] as a result, he often sees the good in others before he sees the bad, such as being quick to forgive zhalia for her betrayal of the team. this goodness, however, can also be his downfall, and even led to his falling for the professor's deception and losing the legendary titans.

as a leader and mentor for sophie and lok, he teaches them how to be seekers. at first, he seemed to be a pro who doesn't do anything without getting a right payment, but it turned out that dante is a friendly, helpful man who easily puts his whole heart in discovering secrets that interest him. he got involved in search for eathon lambert just because it was his job, but his feelings changed due to the growing bond with his young students. he developed a crush on zhalia moon and, despite her betrayal of the team, is willing to risk his life to protect her or to bring her back to the right side. though he knows she will handle every job she is asked to do, he also gets worried every time she is in danger. they make a good team on the missions, fitting each other's style of fighting and perceiving what the other one is going to do.

== relationships ==
===zhalia moon ===

dante initially knew of zhalia as a fellow foundation seeker, and had a lot of respect for her skills, asking her to help the huntik team in prague after their first meeting. [s1e03] while other members of his team, particularly sophie casterwill, took a distrust to her, dante saw her as reliable and trustworthy, letting her prove herself to the team by rescuing peter in rouen. [s1e04] dante assured zhalia that he trusted her after asking her to deliver defoe's amulets which meant a great deal to her as nobody had ever told her that. [s1e10] over time, the pair began to develop feelings for one another [s1e17], and despite zhalia's betrayal of his team to klaus, dante understood her reasons and forgave her. [s1e17] after the explosion at her apartment, the pair almost kissed but were interrupted by lok lambert. [the unseen guide] they grew deeply protective of one another [s1e23] [s2e27] and zhalia later admitted that dante meant more to her than anything else in the world. [s1e25] 

when zhalia chose to leave the team to infiltrate the blood spiral, dante was deeply saddened but understood why she had to go. [s2e35] they stayed in touch by writing in a pair of logosbook journals [s2e36] from which even tantras could tell zhalia cared for him a great deal. [s2e39] when zhalia discovered dante had sacrificed himself to stop the red comet, she was devastated. [s2e51] however, dante wrote her a final message revealing his ultimate secret plan, and zhalia was overjoyed when he rose from the ashes. [s2e52]

===grier===

dante had an intense rivalry with grier, as both were powerful and charismatic seekers harboring strong values. the more the two fought, the more they recognized that the other was fighting for the good of mankind, though both had very different ideas of this good. extremely well-matched in physical combat, their conflicts were often resolved between their two gargantuan titans: dante's metagolem and grier's signature titan, the bear-brawler, breaker, with this fighting rivalry reaching its peak when the two men battled it out on sutos island. grier himself stated that he had waited his whole life to fight an opponent like dante [like father, unlike son] and lok described their relationship to den fears as having been that of archenemies. [an ally from the organization]

=== lok lambert and sophie casterwill ===
while initially dante only accepted sophie and lok's offer to help the latter find his father as a paid job, he quickly bonded with them and was willing to take a raypulse spell for sophie the same day he took took the job. [the casterwill client] dante went as far as to reverse the roles and briefly return to his work as a private investigator to afford a trip relating to the search for eathon lambert and the amulet of will when sophie's bank accounts were wiped. [all work and no pay] much like metz was a mentor to dante, he also taught sophie and lok many aspects of the seeker life; this is more noteworthy with lok, who after charged with leading a mission complemented dante's leadership. [lok's leadership]sophie, take care of lok. make sures he grows up just like his father. 
 - dante to sophie before seemingly sacrificing himself to destroy the red comet

== abilities ==
 have perfect telepathic communication]]
dante is both a leader and tactician for his team, employing his intellect, experience, and knowledge of history to push his team forward. having trained in both martial arts and the abilities of a seeker, his combat style combines the two into a formidable force with either enhancing the other. depending on the situation, he can use spells to augment his agility, enhance his martial arts, attack at a range, or provide shielding. all of this is combined with his impressive stamina and endurance, being able to withstand two days of non-stop walking without any food, water or sleep before finally passing out and still being able to invoke titans and use spells shortly after. however, dante was shown to be completely exhausted when he invoked caliban, metagolem and behemoth within a short span of time. [s1e21] 

over the years, dante has amassed a vast and varied collection of titans through his many adventures. he stores most of his amulets in concealed safes and drawers inside his home. [the casterwill client] [s1e07] although he relies primarily on a core group of titans, he chooses to bring other titans from his collection when specific missions call for different abilities. [s1e07] [s1e23] he has a close bond with several of his titans due to the time spent training together, most notably his signature titan, caliban to whom he is now powerbonded. [s2e35]

==trivia==
* dante is 28 years old, according to huntik magazine issue 9 seeker community section, and the huntik sticker album released by panini. 
* in the first series' trailer, dante and zhalia's hair colors were switched, with dante having blue hair instead.
* the show's artistic director, simone borselli, revealed in an interview with vanity fair that dante's appearance was modeled on that of the movie actor johnny depp.
* the name dante is of italian origin and means "steadfast." his last name may be derived from the word valley, the latin word for "farewell," or the portuguese phrase vale tudo which refers to full-contact and unarmed combat.
* some of dante's titans share a shakespearean theme, such as caliban, ariel and oberon.
* in the episode crawling the catacombs we can see dante opening a lock without a key in less than 25 seconds, which, to do it you need to have a lot of skill.
* several of his titans' names may be inspired by william shakespeare's dramas, including caliban, elf king oberon, and ariel.
* show creator iginio straffi stated that if he had to be one of the show's characters, he would chose to be dante.

when he was young, dante vale met metz, who recognized dante's potential to be a seeker. through metz' tutelage, dante learned about magic and titans. dante's first amulet to bond to, that of solwing, was found all by himself while spending time in turkey. [ladies' choice] dante was also given a caliban amulet by metz, though dante took over a year to be able to invoke and master the meso-titan due to caliban's immense power. initially, dante was only able to keep caliban summoned for about a minute, though dante increased this time through training. [huntik.com] his friendship with metz also found dante working alongside eathon lambert and simon judeau. [huntik.com/profiles] as a teenager, he trained intensively under metz' friend master storm in china alongside lin storm, with whom he formed a close friendship. [lok's leadership]

some years later, dante found another caliban amulet in south america, during one of his most dangerous missions for the huntik foundation. [caliban amulet (gp card)] dante kept this a secret, with everyone believing he possessed simply the one caliban, who had become his most distinctive titan. [the mission] 

dante later gained an ignatius amulet while on an expedition to a volcano in chile. as ignatius amulets were common in this country, both dante and another seeker acquired one during this expedition. another meso-titan, dante was able to control much faster after learning how to control caliban, though ignatius' flares occasionally would set something, such as buildings, on fire. three water titans were once needed to put ignatius out. [huntik.com]

in his youth, dante also crossed paths with montehue, a student of the history of war and fellow treasure hunter, with the pair instantly forming a competitive but nonetheless friendly rivalry. whilst racing up a mountain, dante secretly slipped a tolivane amulet into montehue's pocket as a way of keeping things fair. after saving montehue from falling to his death, dante left a lasting impression on him, and introducing him to the world of seekers. the pair's competitive friendship spanned many years, with the pair eventually becoming close friends through working together to use mjolnir to defeat ymir in the temple of thor and, later, fighting side by side against the professor in king solomon's mines. [two powers become one] [to be together]

dante was manipulated by the professor into giving him the rings of behemoth and tao so that he could perform a ritual to summon lord casterwill's titan of immortality, overlos which would end the curse of the legendary titans, saving metz's life. dante also gave him back his caliban amulet, which the professor had originally used to save metz' life at the temple of tecobai. dante saw it as a way of repaying old debts, truly believing that simon could save metz one last time. however, it turned out to be a trick, as the professor had much more evil intentions with the three legendary titans. this broke dante mentally, and caused him to go into a state of shock and grief. [s1e25] lok therefore had to lead the mission to stop the professor's plan. dante eventually managed to recover from his stupour and save zhalia from two undergolem titans. he tried to put right his mistake by helping lok to stop the professor and battle the three legendary titans. he summoned archwarder, disrupting the professor's control over overlos, allowing lok to use dendras and command overlos to banish himself and the other three legendary titans to the spirit world. [s1e26]

 of caliban]]
during a mission to rescue clements from the ring of arc, dante entered a dreamworld, created by arc, the legendary titan of fate. here, dante had a vision of his own death with zhalia and his friends crying at his grave. despite being visibly haunted by this, as to not worry anybody, he kept it to himself and told no one. [the legendary titan of fate][lok's leadership][the guardian of yonaguni]

dante was left saddened when zhalia chose to leave the huntik team, adamant she plays to her strengths and infiltrate the blood spiral to fight them from the inside. [zhalia's mission] using zhalia's logosbook, the pair communicated with one another. [sophie on trial]

in the vault of hernán cortés, dante managed to beat wilder in recovering the ring of the legendary titan of dimensions, umbra, the shadow jaguar. [the power of umbra]

deeply shaken by the vision of his future and with the threat of the blood spiral looming, dante returned to train under master storm in china. after learning the copykind spell, he used umbra to join his team in the castle of vlad dracul. using copykind to mimic ignatius' flames, he caused the heart of vlad dracul to overload and injure tantras. [lok's leadership]

during the final battle at the spiral mark, dante was able to defeat rassimov one on one while helping lok and sophie destroy legion. however, the betrayer revealed that he had faked the last prophecies of nostradamus, and in attempting to destroy the mark, the team had activated it and sent the red comet hurtling towards earth. realizing the time had come to fulfill his destiny that arc had revealed, dante died sacrificing himself to prevent the red comet from hitting the earth. [the spiral mark]

attempting to destroy his enemies' will to fight, the betrayer revealed dante's death to the huntik foundation and the casterwill family, devastating zhalia moon, metz, and montehue. however, lok, enraged at the spirals' mocking of dante's sacrifice, made a motivating speech, inspiring the foundation to finish what dante started, knowing he would have believed they could win the war without him. [lok and the betrayer]

during the betrayer's ritual, dante's ashes were teleported back to earth by umbra. by using the copykind spell on phoenix, the legendary titan of the rebirth, just prior to his death, dante was able to rise back to life from his ashes. dante soon attempted to prevent the betrayer from invoking the nullifiers, battling him; however, his hyperstrides couldn't keep up with the betrayer's ability to fly, and he was knocked down and almost made immobile by the betrayer's shadowlock spell. lok and sophie, though, were quick to find a prophecy in nostradamus' real writings, telling dante to hold the betrayer, which he did so with stoneglove paired with doublespell, allowing lok to throw the willblade at the betrayer, revealing this weakness -- the spiral mark on his back, thus enabling the team to finally stop the betrayer. after the defeat of the betrayer, dante vale became a member of the huntik foundation council, leaving leadership of his old team to lok lambert. [dante's return]
a natural leader, dante not only takes control of the situation, but also knows how to be a present mentor to his team. through his years of experience and natural intelligence, he is an excellent tactician, often keeping several steps ahead of his opponents in the organization. enjoying the battle, he has an overall confident and sassy attitude when it comes to his combat skills, and often makes wisecracks while fighting. he manages to remain calm under stress and to adapt when unexpected events make his original plans not pan out. fiercely loyal to his team, he will do anything in his power to protect his friends, such as trying to find a cure for metz' curse. [absent heroes] as a result, he often sees the good in others before he sees the bad, such as being quick to forgive zhalia for her betrayal of the team. this goodness, however, can also be his downfall, and even led to his falling for the professor's deception and losing the legendary titans.

as a leader and mentor for sophie and lok, he teaches them how to be seekers. at first, he seemed to be a pro who doesn't do anything without getting a right payment, but it turned out that dante is a friendly, helpful man who easily puts his whole heart in discovering secrets that interest him. he got involved in search for eathon lambert just because it was his job, but his feelings changed due to the growing bond with his young students. he developed a crush on zhalia moon and, despite her betrayal of the team, is willing to risk his life to protect her or to bring her back to the right side. though he knows she will handle every job she is asked to do, he also gets worried every time she is in danger. they make a good team on the missions, fitting each other's style of fighting and perceiving what the other one is going to do.

dante initially knew of zhalia as a fellow foundation seeker, and had a lot of respect for her skills, asking her to help the huntik team in prague after their first meeting. [s1e03] while other members of his team, particularly sophie casterwill, took a distrust to her, dante saw her as reliable and trustworthy, letting her prove herself to the team by rescuing peter in rouen. [s1e04] dante assured zhalia that he trusted her after asking her to deliver defoe's amulets which meant a great deal to her as nobody had ever told her that. [s1e10] over time, the pair began to develop feelings for one another [s1e17], and despite zhalia's betrayal of his team to klaus, dante understood her reasons and forgave her. [s1e17] after the explosion at her apartment, the pair almost kissed but were interrupted by lok lambert. [the unseen guide] they grew deeply protective of one another [s1e23] [s2e27] and zhalia later admitted that dante meant more to her than anything else in the world. [s1e25] 

when zhalia chose to leave the team to infiltrate the blood spiral, dante was deeply saddened but understood why she had to go. [s2e35] they stayed in touch by writing in a pair of logosbook journals [s2e36] from which even tantras could tell zhalia cared for him a great deal. [s2e39] when zhalia discovered dante had sacrificed himself to stop the red comet, she was devastated. [s2e51] however, dante wrote her a final message revealing his ultimate secret plan, and zhalia was overjoyed when he rose from the ashes. [s2e52]
dante had an intense rivalry with grier, as both were powerful and charismatic seekers harboring strong values. the more the two fought, the more they recognized that the other was fighting for the good of mankind, though both had very different ideas of this good. extremely well-matched in physical combat, their conflicts were often resolved between their two gargantuan titans: dante's metagolem and grier's signature titan, the bear-brawler, breaker, with this fighting rivalry reaching its peak when the two men battled it out on sutos island. grier himself stated that he had waited his whole life to fight an opponent like dante [like father, unlike son] and lok described their relationship to den fears as having been that of archenemies. [an ally from the organization]
while initially dante only accepted sophie and lok's offer to help the latter find his father as a paid job, he quickly bonded with them and was willing to take a raypulse spell for sophie the same day he took took the job. [the casterwill client] dante went as far as to reverse the roles and briefly return to his work as a private investigator to afford a trip relating to the search for eathon lambert and the amulet of will when sophie's bank accounts were wiped. [all work and no pay] much like metz was a mentor to dante, he also taught sophie and lok many aspects of the seeker life; this is more noteworthy with lok, who after charged with leading a mission complemented dante's leadership. [lok's leadership]sophie, take care of lok. make sures he grows up just like his father. 
 - dante to sophie before seemingly sacrificing himself to destroy the red comet
have perfect telepathic communication]]
dante is both a leader and tactician for his team, employing his intellect, experience, and knowledge of history to push his team forward. having trained in both martial arts and the abilities of a seeker, his combat style combines the two into a formidable force with either enhancing the other. depending on the situation, he can use spells to augment his agility, enhance his martial arts, attack at a range, or provide shielding. all of this is combined with his impressive stamina and endurance, being able to withstand two days of non-stop walking without any food, water or sleep before finally passing out and still being able to invoke titans and use spells shortly after. however, dante was shown to be completely exhausted when he invoked caliban, metagolem and behemoth within a short span of time. titans are powerful, ancient beings that were summoned from the spirit world of huntik and then sealed away in amulets by lord casterwill centuries ago. his personal titans, the powerful legendary titans, were sealed within rings. strong seekers are able to invoke titans from their amulets. titans, by nature, are neutral beings, although they tend to have the personality of their seekers impressed upon them and may be unwilling to bond with seekers whose personalities differ greatly from a previous owner. [ask guggenheim] titans do not think as humans do because they are spirit entities that rely more on their instincts. although it is unnatural for titans, bonded seekers are able to communicate strategies to them. [the treasures of the argonauts]

==history==
titans are incredible warriors that were locked away inside amulets after being summoned by lord casterwill from huntik to aid in an ancient battle against the unimaginable evil force of the nullifiers that threatened to destroy the world. the power of titans has led to many of the world's myths and legends, in addition to those started to describe the original war. as history progressed, these amulets fell into the hands of many seekers around the world, including historical figures. 
 amulets are recovered by zhalia moon from a chest hidden in the argo]]
many amulets ended up in landmarks, monuments, tombs, and other varied locations, hidden for thousands of years until a "new age" of seekers started gathering them and bonding with titans. this can be traced back to the 20th century, around the time both the organization and the huntik foundation were created and started forming a collection of amulets to aid in acheiving their respective goals and fight each other whenever necessary. other groups such as the casterwill family, blood spiral, guardians of thor and many others have also used titans for the same reasons. this new age of seekers has brought some dormant titans to life, such is the case with gar-ghoul, in rouen, france. [into the river of secrets]

a lot of powerful and influential historical figures were seekers and had used titans, which in some cases help to explain some aspects of their notability and historical significancy. such is the case with joan of arc, who had visions of the future because of arc, the legendary titan of fate; or vlad dracul, whose notoriety as an evil and monstrous human was reflected in his his bond with the titan antedeluvian.

==the bond==
 bonds with megataur]]
a titan will most easily bond with seekers whose personality is similar to its previous seeker, and titans which have not been bonded with any seekers for a long time may prove difficult to bond. also, if the new seeker's personality is completely opposite to the titan's previous seeker, it may outright refuse to bond; this effect is amplified if the old seeker of a titan has been bonded with them for a long time. this made dante vale think defoe's amulets were useless to the huntik foundation due to his intense personality and long-time use of his titans, despite the use of sorrowbond; however, zhalia moon was actually able to bond with his gar-ghoul, possibly because of her personality having a dark side. [the mission]
 about to land safely due to the effects of bonding with kipperin]]
the process of bonding with a titan generally begins when someone touches an amulet of that titan; if the bond is successful, then the amulet and the person may start emitting a glowing aura. sometimes, just the process of bonding with a titan can make that person know the titan's name, even if they have never heard it before. [the unseen guide] [den vs harrison] this process can become more intense if it is the first time someone bonds with a titan, like when lok lambert bonded with kipperin, which occasionally made him levitate and prevent falls by just having its amulet near him [a seeker is born]. when lok bonded with freelancer, he was also shown brief glimpses of the future where he later uses the titan. [the casterwill connection]

titans may unbond with their seeker if the seeker's personality changes dramatically. a titan will also unbond if its seeker dies, although this may cause the titan to go mad, as was the case with madea or if their amulet is lost for a long time [ask guggenheim]. however, titans such as fenris and antedeluvian have been known to stay invoked and protect the seeker's secrets. 
 loses control of overlos as archwarder's ability targets the amulet of will]]
a spell known as sorrowbond is capable of unnaturally severing the bond between seeker and titan and thus allowing another seeker to attempt to bond with them. the affects of this spell, however, are overcome once the original seeker touches the titan's amulet again. titans themselves also have abilities that could interfere with the seeker-titan bond. archwarder, for example, can make powerful titans hard to control or invoke; while dendras can control enemy titans, turning them against their seekers and making them follow orders from dendras' seeker instead. araknos' webs can also control the actions of other titans, rendering them useless or making ally titans fight each other. [the secret of two generations] dominator's spikes can make a titan unpredictable and agitated, refusing to follow their seeker's orders. [the mission] demigorgan, the legendary titan of betrayal, can also create seeker and titan mimics to subvert the bond and confuse both, hypnotizing them into thinking the mimics are real. [dante's return] 

titans can, in a way, remember past seekers despite being currently bonded with another one. for example, pendragon reacted to the demigorgan mimic of the first champion of casterwill despite being currently powerbonded with lok lambert. [dante's return]

== summoning ==
 summons his signature titan, venadek]]
when a titan is not invoked, it resides in the spirit world. a seeker can then invoke it by holding their amulet and calling out their name, with a few exceptions. usually, a titan is summoned only after the seeker has bonded with it, but this is not always the case, resulting in the summoned titan simply not following the person's orders. [memory lane] an exception to this is when lord casterwill's spirit is present to help summon the titan, in which case it will follow the seeker's as if they were bonded. [knight of the willblade]
 collapses after invoking caliban, metagolem and behemoth within a few minutes]]
summoning a titan, and keeping it summoned, is a process that requires willpower, [the casterwill connection] physical stamina and focus. as such, if one summons too many titans, they make runout of willpower to summon any more or cast spells [the divine comedy]. similarly, they may also get physically tired and even pass out, depending on the strength of the titans invoked and the interval between each summoning. [to be together] [coming of age] however, this exhaustion can be trained to be less significant over time. for example, the first time zhalia moon invoked king basilisk, she almost passed out [absent heroes], but later on she was able to invoke it as well as many other titans without issue. [the divine comedy] if a seeker fails to concentrate when a titan is invoked, it may transform into a glowing essence which will then return to its amulet, such as when den fears' first titan, vigilante, returned to its amulet after den was punched. [den vs harrison] something similar happened when lok lambert was hit by a poisonfang spell, causing his powerbonded baselaird to fall to its knees. [the tower of nostradamus]

a titan will also return to its amulet if it has taken too much physical damage, or if its seekers orders it to do so. when a titan is taken out the first way, its seeker may feel discomfort and even pain, incapacitating them briefly and generally exhausting them; [dante's return] the titan will then be unable to be summoned again for an extended period of time, with only the spell newlife being able to circumvent this. [the divine comedy][the mission] when a titan is sent back to its amulet the second way, however, it can be re-summoned at the seeker's will. [the spiral mark][rassimov's secret]

== destruction and banishment ==
 cries as sabriel's amulet fades into dust]]
while a titan's spirit is usually immortal and returns safely to its amulet when a standard battle is lost, there are rare instances where a titan is permanently lost to its seeker and its physical form is destroyed. titans can be entirely erased from existence through the use of dark magic or have their physical form permanently lost due to the destruction of their amulet. in some cases, the spiritual energy of a titan lives on and is permanently returned to the spirit world, while in other cases, the titan ceases to exist entirely. the destruction of an amulet also causes great discomfort to the titan's seeker. [the blood spiral] [s2e21]

there are several unique ways for a titan's physical form or amulet to be destroyed, rendering them unable to be invoked:

*if a seeker demands that a titan does not return to its amulet after taking too much damage, sustaining further consecutive blows will cause its amulet to permanently disintegrate, destroying the titan. [dante's return] similarly, if a titan refuses to follow orders or cannot return due to external forces —such as the mental hijacking effect of dominator's spikes— it and its amulet will be permanently destroyed after taking too many blows. [the mission] 

*the spell darkvoid acts as a black hole that can completely disintegrate anything beyond its event horizon in seconds. in the case of a titan, it can be pulled in and erased, with their amulets destroyed for good. [memory lane] 

*legion, the legendary titan of war, can absorb individual titans and cause their physical amulets to disintegrate. when legion's amulet was later shattered by lok lambert using the willblade, legion was destroyed, and the spirits of all the titans it had absorbed over the centuries were freed and permanently sent back to the spirit world. [the spiral mark]

*umbra represents a unique case of a titan that suffers an unrecoverable drain on its energy whenever it teleports other living entities. [the power of umbra] pushing this process past its definitive limit causes the titan's spirit to permanently disintegrate away. [dante's return]

a titan can also be permanently banished directly to the world of huntik by the power of overlos, the titan of immortality, who can create an open portal that links the human dimension to the native spirit realm, and can send titans into it leaving their physical anchors behind. [the mission] 

==behavior==
in terms of appearance, titans present in variety of forms, some of which can look like humans and certain animals. generally, titans do not talk, but do have the ability to make sounds such as grunting, groaning, screaming or other sounds depending for example on what animal they appear to relate to. they communicate with their seekers telepathically. however, titans are able to understand and follow their seeker's orders. this communication becomes enhanced when a titan becomes powerbonded, also allowing seekers to communicate telepathically. 
 gestures at dante to back out|180x180px]]
titans also do not think the way humans do, but rather behave like animals in many ways and will follow their instincts and do as their seekers orders. for example, gareon regularly comforts its seeker, zhalia moon, in a cat-like manner when she's feeling down. cherit and madea are notable known exceptions that can talk and even reason, the former can even play chess and acts nigh-identically to a human apart from the lack of physiological needs. apart from these exceptions, some titans are shown to display some level of critical thinking, such as when ariel signaled dante vale to retreat after the ambush against rassimov went south, or when solwing tried to get dante of the aforementioned situation by snatching the necklace of tutankhamun out of his hands and using it as bait for rassimov. [rassimov's secret]

some titans do appear to have what resembles a personality or temperament; lindorm, for example, requires its seeker to be assertive and in control of their emotions, otherwise it will act aggressively and ignore orders. they're also shown to immediately feel threatened and distressed in the presence of nullifiers, such as when lilith the queen and powerbonded caliban immediately stopped fighting each other when void was invoked, looking to fight it instead. [the spiral mark] in contrast to this, titans will immediately stop what they are doing to make a bow in the presence of lord casterwill's spirit. [knight of the willblade] titans generally lack any physiological needs that biological living beings do, such as the need for food, sleep or oxygen (though cherit still shows enjoyment in eating). ==types of titans==
there are eight core titan types in which the titans are classified. in general, a titan's type corresponds to the region and cultures whose myths the titan influenced. titan's type can generally be identified through the design of their amulet as well the coloration of their energy essence. the legendary titans also each belong to one of the eight titan types based on their mythological and cultural origins but the majority are contained in rings.

these tend to be the basis for celtic legends and are commonly tied to an aspect of nature.

these tend to be the basis for egyptian legends and are commonly themed around mummies and death. most of these titans are seen in the hands of evil seekers.

these tend to be the basis for greco-roman mythologies and have a tendency to be warriors like their draco-titan brethren.

these tend to be the colossal titans composed of rock or ice, forming the basis for golems found in european, norse, and greco-roman legends.

these tend to be the basis for native american legends of north and central america and are often based upon spiritual powers and animals.

these tend to be the basis for legends throughout asia, often inspired by eastern fighting arts.

 the legendary titans represent the highest tier of titans. due to their immense power, they were among the first titans brought to earth by lord casterwill to fight the nullifiers. unlike other titans, most legendary titans are sealed within rings rather than standard amulets.

main article: powerbond

a titan with an exceptionally strong bond to its seeker may become so closely synchronized as to form a powerbond. in this state, the titan undergoes a physical transformation, and becomes significantly more powerful both in attack and defense. although titans do not naturally think in human terms, powerbonded titans are able to communicate more directly with their seekers through telepathy. 

while the most visible changes occur to the titan itself, with powerbonded titans typically gaining golden armor, seekers may also gain additional abilities through the powerbond. an example of this is dante vale and caliban's "mirror fight" ability, in which the two perfectly mirror each other’s movements.

summons his signature titan, venadek]]
when a titan is not invoked, it resides in the spirit world. a seeker can then invoke it by holding their amulet and calling out their name, with a few exceptions. usually, a titan is summoned only after the seeker has bonded with it, but this is not always the case, resulting in the summoned titan simply not following the person's orders. summoning a titan, and keeping it summoned, is a process that requires willpower, [the casterwill connection] physical stamina and focus. as such, if one summons too many titans, they make runout of willpower to summon any more or cast spells [the divine comedy]. similarly, they may also get physically tired and even pass out, depending on the strength of the titans invoked and the interval between each summoning. [to be together] [coming of age] however, this exhaustion can be trained to be less significant over time. for example, the first time zhalia moon invoked king basilisk, she almost passed out [absent heroes], but later on she was able to invoke it as well as many other titans without issue. a titan will also return to its amulet if it has taken too much physical damage, or if its seekers orders it to do so. when a titan is taken out the first way, its seeker may feel discomfort and even pain, incapacitating them briefly and generally exhausting them; [dante's return] the titan will then be unable to be summoned again for an extended period of time, with only the spell newlife being able to circumvent this. [the divine comedy][the mission] when a titan is sent back to its amulet the second way, however, it can be re-summoned at the seeker's will. [the spiral mark][rassimov's secret]
cries as sabriel's amulet fades into dust]]
while a titan's spirit is usually immortal and returns safely to its amulet when a standard battle is lost, there are rare instances where a titan is permanently lost to its seeker and its physical form is destroyed. titans can be entirely erased from existence through the use of dark magic or have their physical form permanently lost due to the destruction of their amulet. in some cases, the spiritual energy of a titan lives on and is permanently returned to the spirit world, while in other cases, the titan ceases to exist entirely. the destruction of an amulet also causes great discomfort to the titan's seeker. [the blood spiral] [s2e21]

there are several unique ways for a titan's physical form or amulet to be destroyed, rendering them unable to be invoked:

*if a seeker demands that a titan does not return to its amulet after taking too much damage, sustaining further consecutive blows will cause its amulet to permanently disintegrate, destroying the titan. [dante's return] similarly, if a titan refuses to follow orders or cannot return due to external forces —such as the mental hijacking effect of dominator's spikes— it and its amulet will be permanently destroyed after taking too many blows. [the mission] 

*the spell darkvoid acts as a black hole that can completely disintegrate anything beyond its event horizon in seconds. in the case of a titan, it can be pulled in and erased, with their amulets destroyed for good. [memory lane] 

*legion, the legendary titan of war, can absorb individual titans and cause their physical amulets to disintegrate. when legion's amulet was later shattered by lok lambert using the willblade, legion was destroyed, and the spirits of all the titans it had absorbed over the centuries were freed and permanently sent back to the spirit world. [the spiral mark]

*umbra represents a unique case of a titan that suffers an unrecoverable drain on its energy whenever it teleports other living entities. [the power of umbra] pushing this process past its definitive limit causes the titan's spirit to permanently disintegrate away. [dante's return]

a titan can also be permanently banished directly to the world of huntik by the power of overlos, the titan of immortality, who can create an open portal that links the human dimension to the native spirit realm, and can send titans into it leaving their physical anchors behind. [the mission]
in terms of appearance, titans present in variety of forms, some of which can look like humans and certain animals. generally, titans do not talk, but do have the ability to make sounds such as grunting, groaning, screaming or other sounds depending for example on what animal they appear to relate to. they communicate with their seekers telepathically. however, titans are able to understand and follow their seeker's orders. this communication becomes enhanced when a titan becomes powerbonded, also allowing seekers to communicate telepathically. 
 gestures at dante to back out|180x180px]]
titans also do not think the way humans do, but rather behave like animals in many ways and will follow their instincts and do as their seekers orders. for example, gareon regularly comforts its seeker, zhalia moon, in a cat-like manner when she's feeling down. cherit and madea are notable known exceptions that can talk and even reason, the former can even play chess and acts nigh-identically to a human apart from the lack of physiological needs. apart from these exceptions, some titans are shown to display some level of critical thinking, such as when ariel signaled dante vale to retreat after the ambush against rassimov went south, or when solwing tried to get dante of the aforementioned situation by snatching the necklace of tutankhamun out of his hands and using it as bait for rassimov. [rassimov's secret]

some titans do appear to have what resembles a personality or temperament; lindorm, for example, requires its seeker to be assertive and in control of their emotions, otherwise it will act aggressively and ignore orders. they're also shown to immediately feel threatened and distressed in the presence of nullifiers, such as when lilith the queen and powerbonded caliban immediately stopped fighting each other when void was invoked, looking to fight it instead. [the spiral mark] in contrast to this, titans will immediately stop what they are doing to make a bow in the presence of lord casterwill's spirit. [knight of the willblade] titans generally lack any physiological needs that biological living beings do, such as the need for food, sleep or oxygen (though cherit still shows enjoyment in eating). thoughtspecter is an illusory spell. it is used to create illusions, usually replicas of humans or titans to cover for an escape or to distract an opponent.

the spell is similar to the illusory abilities of madea.

== history ==
ever since he was afflicted with the curse of the legendary titans, the professor had been using a power akin to thoughtspecter to hide the effects of the curse on his body. [the divine comedy]

zhalia moon learnt the spell from the power from jason's tablet on madea island. [the beautiful trap] 

zhalia used the spell right away to create a clone of lindorm and distract the raging titan, so that lok lambert could send it back to its amulet. [like father, unlike son]

in the valley of the kings, egypt, zhalia used the spell to escape from klaus's forces, masking their escape with an illusion of a sandstorm. [all work and no pay] 

while the team was investigating the castle of vlad dracul, zhalia used thoughtspecter to create a duplicate of herself during her duel with sophie casterwill. [the vampire loses its fangs]

as zhalia severed her ties with the organization, she set her apartment to explode and trick the suits into believing she died, then used thoughtspecter to become invisible and sneak out of the city. [the unseen guide] 

in the desert, after zhalia had been taken captive by the professor, she used an illusory spell, presumed by rassimov to be thoughtspecter, to create a blinding yellow aura, allowing herself and the team to escape. [to be together]

while the team travelled to tower of nostradamus in , zhalia used thoughtspecter to create decoys of the members in order to evade the the organization's combat choppers's missiles augmented with targetfind. [the tower of nostradamus]

at the casterwill library in paris, zhalia used thoughtspecter to conceal her kilthane, gar-ghoul, and king basilisk titans to gain an upper hand against lucas casterwill, lane, and dellix. [chasing void]

on medusa's island, thoughtspecter was used by zhalia so the team could retreat from the blood spiral with medusa's amulet. [zhalia's mission]

bubblelift is a spell that allows the casting seeker to create a blue bubble around an object and then lift it into the air. the spell is useful for moving heavy objects or for isolating titans or other people. this bubble, however, can be popped easily by attacks from outside.

== history ==
dante vale used the spell in the temple of thor to place tersly in a bubble in order to get him out of harm's way whilst fighting fenris. he floated over to sophie casterwill who popped the bubble and helped him up. [two powers become one]

sophie used the spell to remove and destroy traps left by klaus in a cabinet in his lab. she later used it to block a stairway with a bookcase, bolstered by dante's stopglue power. [the bookshop hunter]

in the mausoleum of sir lancelot, sophie used the spell to trap impet in a bubble before sabriel slammed it into a suit. [memory lane]

zhalia moon used the spell to take the ring of behemoth from hippolyta. [ladies' choice]

after her parachute was compromised by attacks from wilder's suits, sophie used bubblelift to stop herself from falling. the bubble was hit by another attack however, leaving her to cling to a branch of a tree. [doorway to huntik]

lok lambert used the spell to attach dendras' dragons to incubane whilst fighting wilder on avalon. [knight of the willblade] 

sophie used the spell to land a bin on top of a silent soldier in rotterdam, netherlands. [den vs harrison]

lok used it in conjunction with dendras again in medusa's cave to neutralize vulcana whilst ambushing kiel. [zhalia's mission]

sophie casterwill used bubblelift to create a water balloon to throw at den fears whilst attempting to tutor him. he later attempted to do the same but she caught him. [lok's leadership]

dante vale used the spell to remove the amulet of legion from around rassimov's neck and kick it towards lok who destroyed it using the willblade. [the spiral mark]

scarlet byrne used a red version of the spell on herself so she could safely land as she jumped off a scramjet during the final battle at the blood spiral base. [lok and the betrayer]
