huntik:page:2019:
cherit is a unique titan known to seekers. by some unknown accident or genius operation, his essence became separated from his amulet thousands of years ago. unlike his other titan cousins, cherit is always invoked and somehow manages to stay anchored to our reality despite the separation from his amulet. another result of this separation is cherit's ability to communicate in human language. he is the only titan in recorded history to do so, aside from madea, as titans communicate with their human counterparts through telepathic impression. he is a friendly and endearing little fellow and best friend to lok lambert, whom he loyally accompanies, providing both wisdom and companionship.

== history ==
cherit was once a titan of lord casterwill, the first seeker, and was called to assist in a confrontation against an ominous figure. [memory lane] the two considered each other to be good friends. [knight of the willblade] at some point, however, cherit's amulet was lost, causing him to be constantly anchored to earth for over 60,000 years. [huntik magazine] cherit has since revealed that he can no longer recall what his amulet looks like. [den vs harrison]

during his interactions with humanity, with whom he was quite interested, cherit noticed that non-seekers could not communicate with the bond. he, thus, undertook to communicate through speech, though doing so initially proved to be difficult. [the treasures of the argonauts]

cherit eventually met and befriended eathon lambert and moved into huntik foundation hq. [s2e27] he would occasionally accompany eathon on some of his missions against the organization, once battling the professor. [huntik.com] [tcg:oal-072] through eathon, cherit made the acquaintance of dante vale and lived with him following the disappearance of eathon. [s1e01]

through dante, cherit also met and befriended lok lambert, eathon's son, who had just entered into the world of seekers and titans with whom he formed a very strong friendship along their numerous adventures together. [a seeker is born] cherit then adventured alongside the team of lok lambert, sophie casterwill, dante vale, and zhalia moon, protecting the world from the evil organization.

cherit dreamed of casterwill summoning a large, darkened figure, calling out his name. [memory lane]

== personality ==

cherit is a deeply loyal, cheerful, and talkative titan whose vibrant personality stands out among his kin due to his unique ability to speak the human language. having wandered earth for centuries having lost his amulet, cherit has developed a remarkably human-like temperament, combining a quirky sense of humour with a strong fondness for modern comforts like good food and soft beds.[s1e04] [back home] despite his small size and playful demeanour, cherit possesses a vast amount of ancient wisdom. he frequently steps into a mentorship role for younger seekers, such as lok lambert, sophie casterwill and den fears, using his extensive knowledge of the titans and history to help decipher ancient mysteries and offer crucial guidance when the team faces unfamiliar threats. 
 cooking]]
while his lighthearted nature and childlike curiosity make him a fun companion, cherit is also fiercely brave and selfless in the face of danger. cherit generally avoids direct physical combat due to his limited offensive power, but his loyalty to the seekers is absolute. when his friends are in peril, he does not hesitate to fly directly into harm's way, using his unique energy-boosting abilities to empower his allies at great personal risk to himself. this perfect balance of ancient intelligence, comical charm, and fierce protectiveness makes him both the emotional heart and a vital strategic asset to the team. 

== relationships ==
===lok lambert===

cherit is lok's best friend and loyal companion who is always by his side. cherit will normally sit on lok's shoulder during their adventures, acting as his personal little helper and right-hand man. he is always the first to cheer for lok's successes and encourage him when he is unsure. when the pair first met, cherit quickly recognised eathon lambert's strength in him, and showed absolute belief in his potential. [s1e02] they quickly developed a close friendship, frequently enjoying the same youthful habits, sharing a mutual love for snacks, games, and casual banter that breaks the tension of their dangerous missions. [s1e05][s1e20] cherit's role as a mentor and support played a huge role in lok's journey to becoming a powerful seeker. 

== abilities ==

cherit is capable of flight using his bat-like wings and has displayed the ability to fire energy blast from his mouth, powerful enough to destroy most other titans with a single blast, although it leaves him exhausted afterward. [the casterwill client] after training with the huntik foundation since the fall of the professor, however, cherit can fire a blast and still be flying; at one point, he fired twice and was still okay. [knight of the willblade] still, despite this, he does show some signs of exhaustion after a blast. [chasing void] cherit has the ability to give other members of his team a power boost through a similar energy blast, which lok nicknamed 'energy charge'. [s1e16] he also has the ability to perfectly mimic peoples' voices. [absent heroes]

due to having been invoked for thousands of years, cherit can speak and decipher many ancient languages, such as when he translated ancient egyptian so as to aid lok lambert and sophie casterwill in a puzzle. [the sceptre deception] another case was when he translated ancient french to describe the personality of the casterwill seer, nostradamus, whom cherit described as being friendly. [the tower of nostradamus]

cherit is also an extremely good chess player. he has hinted that he has been around at least since the invention of chess with some indication that he was involved in its invention. [the legendary titan of fate] he also has some skill at playing the pipe. [the power of umbra]

the fog monsters are ghostly incantations made up of smoke that are conjured by the blood spiral master, tantras, to train his new recruits in mastering their titans in combat.

== history ==
tantras summoned four fog monsters in rotterdam at the orphanage of den and harrison fears whilst training them and the other orphans in the use of their titans. dirk ordered his harlekin to defeat one of the monsters while harrison ordered his marauder to hold one down before he destroyed it with a nullcurse. bruno panicked and was saved by his harlekin whilst den crouched to the ground in fright, unable to invoke his marauder as he could not bond with such a dark titan. tantras then called the final fog monster off. [den vs harrison]

== abilities ==
despite their terrifying appearance, the fog monsters were relatively easy to defeat, being defeated by a single swipe from a harlekin. [den vs harrison]

sophie casterwill is a daughter of the noble casterwill family order, who was orphaned as a young girl following a fire at her parents' home. a brilliant student who loves reading, sophie has a deep knowledge of ancient history, and an excellent memory for myths and legends. pulled into a life of adventuring with the huntik foundation after she forged an alliance with her classmate, lok lambert, sophie's ability to master complex and ancient magic is invaluable to their team in their fight against evil. when talking gets nowhere, sophie casterwill can rely on powerful casterwill family magic along with sabriel, an elegant titan that favors speed over brawn.

==history ==
 after the destruction of her home]]
sophie casterwill was born into the mysterious casterwill family and, as such, is one of the descendants of the first seeker, lord casterwill. [huntik.com/profiles] as a young girl, her parents were killed at their home in paris by the blood spiral arsonist, kiel. [the titan in the temple of sun] she was rescued by her bodyguard santiago who brought her to a casterwill warehouse where she was raised by the caretaker leblanche. [sophie on trial] [huntik.com/profiles]

they eventually moved to venice where she attended attended venice preparation academy, though was unaware that she had sat in front of lok lambert for three years. while at lok's dormitory, she and lok discovered a secret journal belonging to lok's father, eathon lambert. [a seeker is born] due to lok's inability to pay, sophie used some of her family fortune to hire dante vale of the huntik foundation to investigate the disappearance of lok's father, eathon, and to train herself and lok as part of the foundation. [the casterwill client]

when the prague huntik hotel was attacked by the organization's suits, the team was joined by zhalia moon, of whom sophie became suspicious. when the team follows a clue from eathon lambert's journal about metagolem, sophie helped them to gain access to jodis lore's tomb by smearing clay on the tombstone and inscribing the symbol for truth. [words of truth, heart of lies]

when the team decided to take a vacation at at the lambert family's house, meeting scarlet byrne caused sophie to become jealous. as they joined scarlet on a mission to the new grange passage tomb and had to protect scarlet from the organization's suits, sophie had to work together with scarlet. [home turf]

on a mission to the castle of vlad dracul, sophie realized zhalia's betrayal of the team and faced off against her former teammate. despite her prowess, sophie was defeated; however, as zhalia was about to deliver the final blow, lok leapt in between the two and managed to stop the fight. [the vampire loses its fangs]

after following a clue about the ring of tao from eathon lambert's journal to king solomon's mines in ethiopia, sophie and lok had to dress as king solomon and the queen of sheba and express their true feelings for one another. [to be together]

during the final battle against the professor, sophie suffered a great loss when her loyal titan and lifelong friend sabriel sacrificed herself to protect sophie against the professor's titans, resulting in her amulet being destroyed. [the mission] as a result, following the professor's defeat, for a time, sophie felt weak and useless to the team, particularly due to being unable to hold her own against wilder and his team on several occasions. [doorway to huntik] [the tower of nostradamus] however, in the crystal caves, sophie found her strength when sabriel returned to her through powerbonding and she recovered the amulet of her sister, sorcerel. here, sophie also discovered that she was a direct descendant of the original lord casterwill. [cave of the casterwills] 

after recovering the willblade from avalon, the team attempted to research it at the casterwill library. however they were attacked by three seekers, one of whom was revealed to be lucas casterwill, sophie's brother whom she had believed to be dead. initially conflicting with one another, sophie proved herself to lucas by recovering the location of void from the organization. [chasing void]

whilst trying to recover medusa on medusa's island, sophie was horrified to come face to face with kiel, the man who burnt her home and killed her parents so many years ago. [zhalia's mission] due to her fear of fire and traumatic memories of kiel, sophie was unable to stand up to him, until, finally, after bonding with the legendary titan of valor, mythras and inspired by the sacrifice of nimue casterwill, sophie managed to find the courage to defeat him, avenging her past and taking control of her future with leadership of the casterwill family. [the spiral war]

== personality ==

sophie is a book-smart, athletic, honorable, and clever young lady of about lok's age. she acts quite proper and mature due to her status as a member of the casterwill family, and she thus has a lot of confidence in her own skills and fighting abilities, which she isn't afraid to put to use. [huntik.com/profiles] she is usually one of the first to provide criticism, sometimes unfairly, and has a competitive streak, disliking finishing after someone else, such as when lok managed to beat her at a puzzle prior to their mission to find king basilisk's amulet. [absent heroes]

despite her sometimes egotistical personality, she is compassionate towards her teammates and included lok in the deal she made when hiring dante vale. [the casterwill client] she even expressed concern that zhalia would demean herself as a part of her rationale to betray the team for her adoptive father, klaus. [the vampire loses its fangs]

sophie was deeply affected by the loss of sabriel, which led her to feel weak and useless to the team. [cave of the casterwills] her confidence also began to falter upon encountering other, powerful members of the casterwill family, particularly her lost brother lucas, who didn't put trust in her abilities at all. [chasing void] after mastering the legendary titan of valor, mythras, and playing a pivotal role in stopping the blood spiral's assault at the fortress of iron will, she regained her confidence. [the spiral war]

sophie also confronted her severe pyrophobia (the fear of fire) upon meeting kiel, a member of the blood spiral, and realizing that he was the one who had killed her parents in an arson attempt when she was young. [the titan in the temple of sun] she eventually overcame this fear once she bonded with phoenix, the legendary titan of rebirth, by diving into the heart of a volcano. [the phoenix's ashes]

== abilities ==
 from her hand]]
sophie is an outstanding spellcaster of magic and utilizes offensive and defensive spells in combat, and is also well-practiced in spells specialized with dealing with traps. she is also a book-learned expert in much of the ancient history of the world of seekers. as a member of the casterwill family, she also possesses the innate ability to sense magical energy. [huntik.com/profiles] as result of powerbonding with sabriel, whose amulet was destroyed, sophie is able to uniquely summon her directly from her hand. [cave of the casterwills]

sophie is a skilled fighter, having received thorough training in martial arts since her childhood. [the treasures of the argonauts] she trains hard and can handle herself against more than one opponent. [s1e01] she is also has a pilot's license [the bookshop hunter], and can play the flute. [s2e41]

*during the early production of the series, sophie was originally named "sofia". this appeared as a scripting error in episode 4 "into the river of secrets" when dante introduces her as "sofia" to guggenheim. the name means "wisdom" in greek. 
*the show's artistic director, simone borselli, revealed in an interview with vanity fair that sophie's appearance was inspired by that of the movie actress, gwyneth paltrow. he has also stated that sophie was the character he most identified with.

sophie casterwill was born into the mysterious casterwill family and, as such, is one of the descendants of the first seeker, lord casterwill. [huntik.com/profiles] as a young girl, her parents were killed at their home in paris by the blood spiral arsonist, kiel. [the titan in the temple of sun] she was rescued by her bodyguard santiago who brought her to a casterwill warehouse where she was raised by the caretaker leblanche. [sophie on trial] [huntik.com/profiles]

they eventually moved to venice where she attended attended venice preparation academy, though was unaware that she had sat in front of lok lambert for three years. while at lok's dormitory, she and lok discovered a secret journal belonging to lok's father, eathon lambert. [a seeker is born] due to lok's inability to pay, sophie used some of her family fortune to hire dante vale of the huntik foundation to investigate the disappearance of lok's father, eathon, and to train herself and lok as part of the foundation. [the casterwill client]

when the prague huntik hotel was attacked by the organization's suits, the team was joined by zhalia moon, of whom sophie became suspicious. when the team follows a clue from eathon lambert's journal about metagolem, sophie helped them to gain access to jodis lore's tomb by smearing clay on the tombstone and inscribing the symbol for truth. [words of truth, heart of lies]

when the team decided to take a vacation at at the lambert family's house, meeting scarlet byrne caused sophie to become jealous. as they joined scarlet on a mission to the new grange passage tomb and had to protect scarlet from the organization's suits, sophie had to work together with scarlet. [home turf]

on a mission to the castle of vlad dracul, sophie realized zhalia's betrayal of the team and faced off against her former teammate. despite her prowess, sophie was defeated; however, as zhalia was about to deliver the final blow, lok leapt in between the two and managed to stop the fight. [the vampire loses its fangs]

after following a clue about the ring of tao from eathon lambert's journal to king solomon's mines in ethiopia, sophie and lok had to dress as king solomon and the queen of sheba and express their true feelings for one another. [to be together]

during the final battle against the professor, sophie suffered a great loss when her loyal titan and lifelong friend sabriel sacrificed herself to protect sophie against the professor's titans, resulting in her amulet being destroyed. [the mission] as a result, following the professor's defeat, for a time, sophie felt weak and useless to the team, particularly due to being unable to hold her own against wilder and his team on several occasions. [doorway to huntik] [the tower of nostradamus] however, in the crystal caves, sophie found her strength when sabriel returned to her through powerbonding and she recovered the amulet of her sister, sorcerel. here, sophie also discovered that she was a direct descendant of the original lord casterwill. [cave of the casterwills] 

after recovering the willblade from avalon, the team attempted to research it at the casterwill library. however they were attacked by three seekers, one of whom was revealed to be lucas casterwill, sophie's brother whom she had believed to be dead. initially conflicting with one another, sophie proved herself to lucas by recovering the location of void from the organization. [chasing void]

whilst trying to recover medusa on medusa's island, sophie was horrified to come face to face with kiel, the man who burnt her home and killed her parents so many years ago. [zhalia's mission] due to her fear of fire and traumatic memories of kiel, sophie was unable to stand up to him, until, finally, after bonding with the legendary titan of valor, mythras and inspired by the sacrifice of nimue casterwill, sophie managed to find the courage to defeat him, avenging her past and taking control of her future with leadership of the casterwill family. [the spiral war]
sophie is a book-smart, athletic, honorable, and clever young lady of about lok's age. she acts quite proper and mature due to her status as a member of the casterwill family, and she thus has a lot of confidence in her own skills and fighting abilities, which she isn't afraid to put to use. [huntik.com/profiles] she is usually one of the first to provide criticism, sometimes unfairly, and has a competitive streak, disliking finishing after someone else, such as when lok managed to beat her at a puzzle prior to their mission to find king basilisk's amulet. [absent heroes]

despite her sometimes egotistical personality, she is compassionate towards her teammates and included lok in the deal she made when hiring dante vale. [the casterwill client] she even expressed concern that zhalia would demean herself as a part of her rationale to betray the team for her adoptive father, klaus. [the vampire loses its fangs]

sophie was deeply affected by the loss of sabriel, which led her to feel weak and useless to the team. [cave of the casterwills] her confidence also began to falter upon encountering other, powerful members of the casterwill family, particularly her lost brother lucas, who didn't put trust in her abilities at all. [chasing void] after mastering the legendary titan of valor, mythras, and playing a pivotal role in stopping the blood spiral's assault at the fortress of iron will, she regained her confidence. [the spiral war]

sophie also confronted her severe pyrophobia (the fear of fire) upon meeting kiel, a member of the blood spiral, and realizing that he was the one who had killed her parents in an arson attempt when she was young. [the titan in the temple of sun] she eventually overcame this fear once she bonded with phoenix, the legendary titan of rebirth, by diving into the heart of a volcano. [the phoenix's ashes]
from her hand]]
sophie is an outstanding spellcaster of magic and utilizes offensive and defensive spells in combat, and is also well-practiced in spells specialized with dealing with traps. she is also a book-learned expert in much of the ancient history of the world of seekers. as a member of the casterwill family, she also possesses the innate ability to sense magical energy. [huntik.com/profiles] as result of powerbonding with sabriel, whose amulet was destroyed, sophie is able to uniquely summon her directly from her hand. [cave of the casterwills]

sophie is a skilled fighter, having received thorough training in martial arts since her childhood. [the treasures of the argonauts] she trains hard and can handle herself against more than one opponent. [s1e01] she is also has a pilot's license [the bookshop hunter], and can play the flute. grier, born prince zan-grier of sutos island, served as defoe’s right-hand man. rarely speaking, he presented himself an ordinary thug, but he carries himself with a subtle nobility with his loyalty. grier once believed that with the organization’s domination, there would come universal order to keep all people in line and prevent wars. after taking his rightful place as the prince of sutos, he later went on to seize the reins of the organization from mr. wilder.

== history ==
, dies in his arms]]
though few were aware, grier was raised on the secret seeker island-nation of sutos, where his father, zan-sutos, ruled as leader. his family had led the people of this nation to an orderly, happy existence for many years. after his father's death, grier moved on to the organization to do his part to bring order to the world using his seeker skills. with many battles and defeats at the hands of dante's team, defoe lost the favor of the organization and grier was chosen to replace him only after he got rid of defoe. grier soon returns to his home and restores order to the island torn apart by war, thereafter being recognized as the new ruler. [like father, unlike son]

after the defeat of the professor, dante vale and his team returned to sutos island to ask for help from grier. his men were attacked by the blood spiral brotherhood. grier guided the team through the professor's castle in order to find the dossier about rassimov. grier later helped lok lambert and den fears defeat mr. wilder in the professor's room. as a result of this, he captured mr. wilder and took over the organization. [an ally from the organization]

== personality ==

at first glance, grier comes off as a robotic yes-man, just another arm of his commander defoe, but under his seemingly blind loyalty is a much more complex, likable man. he is an idealist as well as a loyalist, always committed to bringing order to a chaotic world. behind his strong loyalty beats a heart of honor that desires to bring peace to sutos island. [s1e12] in many ways grier could be considered the ideal ruler as he prioritized the needs and safety of his people over going to fight an unknown war. [s2e46] grier was extremely pragmatic in making decisions, as he was conflicted about killing defoe, but ultimately decided to do it as it was in the best interests of his goal to return to sutos and bring peace to his homeland. [s1e11] 

== relationships ==
===dante vale===
 during one of their numerous clashes]]
grier had an intense rivalry with dante vale, as both were powerful and charismatic seekers harboring strong values. the more the two fought, the more they recognized that the other was fighting for the good of mankind, though both had very different ideas of this good. extremely well-matched in physical combat, their conflicts were often resolved between their two gargantuan titans: dante's metagolem and grier's signature titan, the bear-brawler, breaker, with this fighting rivalry reaching its peak when the two men battled it out on sutos island. grier himself stated that he had waited his whole life to fight an opponent like dante [like father, unlike son] and lok described their relationship to den fears as having been that of archenemies. [an ally from the organization]

===defoe===
]]
extremely respectful of his superiors, grier was initially loyal and respectful to defoe as his right-hand man and followed his orders obediently. [s1e03] however, over time, as defoe's plans continued to fail, this relationship grew increasingly strained. grier began to grow more weary of defoe's antics, notably his cowardice in leaving his men behind in the cave of the gargoyle [crawling the catacombs], and his continued poor judgement and tendency to prioritize his hate-fuelled vendetta against dante vale over the missions of the organization. [divide and conquer] he challenged defoe when he violated delivering the sword of saint george and eventually took control of the situation on atalanta's ship, carrying an insane defoe back to organization central and leaving him to be punished by rassimov. [the treasures of the argonauts] when the professor chose grier to replace defoe, but on the condition that he "disposed" of him first, grier was initially conflicted but he ultimately determined that defoe was a chaotic individual who would not follow orders. in order to carry out his ambitions of returning to his homeland, grier killed him. [the beautiful trap] grier was not proud of killing defoe, and hinted that this was part of the reason that he felt he should remain on sutos when dante asked him to join the huntik foundation. [s2e46]

===mr. wilder===
grier resented mr. wilder for his cowardice and sneaky tactics, and for putting his own personal goals over what was best for the organization. he was enraged with the way mr. wilder picked on weaker seekers and was angered when he saw how badly he had injured lok lambert and den fears. upon brutally defeating mr. wilder, he decided to take him back to his island as his prisoner to teach him the true meaning of control. [s2e46]

== abilities ==
]]
grier is a powerful seeker, able to fight on equal ground with dante vale. for many of his missions, grier never fought at full power, and none of his superiors were aware just how strong a seeker he was. when fighting him on sutos, dante stated that he was at least twice as fast as he was before. [s1e12] in combat, grier uses his raw strength to deliver knockout punches, while using magic that makes him faster and much stronger than any normal human such as shadowspeed or dragonfist. with him fights breaker, a mighty titan that hits hard with a combination of strength and speed, and can even take down the mighty caliban singehandedly. [s1e09]

defoe was a scheming, self-proclaimed mastermind. he lead a small force for the organization alongside his right-hand man, grier, under orders to track down a journal in lok’s possession and to halt the actions of the huntik foundation against them. he would stop at nothing to see that his missions were completed, although sometimes this meant putting his own men in peril to do so.

==history ==
]]
little is known about defoe's background, but his rocket-like rise through the organization hierarchy is legendary amongst suits. within a matter of months, defoe was promoted through suit rankings to be a prominent leader of his own squad. [huntik.com]

under the professor, one of defoe's earlier missions was to retrieve eathon lambert's journal, although the mission ended with the journal being all but destroyed. [a seeker is born] defoe then ordered grier to find the biggest venice huntik library because he knew that the huntik team needed to research eathon's journal. defoe later attacked the library, breaking through by pouring acid on the door's knob. though he failed to retrieve the journal he manages to learn the huntik team's next move. [the casterwill client]

after defoe learned that the huntik team is going to prague, czech republic, to get the titan metagolem he ambushed the huntik team when they were going to retrieve the jodis lore's key, he successfully obtained the key and went to the golem's attic, where he tried to bond with the titan metagolem but failed due to dante's interference so defoe retreated because dante had bonded with metagolem. [words of truth, heart of lies]
]]
afterwards, defoe's team was sent to retrieve the amulets of the re-awakening titans. in the cave of the gargoyle on the outskirts of rouen, france, defoe managed to retrieve and bond with gar-ghoul. [into the river of secrets]. defoe then was ordered by the professor to retrieve the ring of arc. he then had a rematch between dante's caliban and defoe's "new friend," his gar-ghoul, but dante fled with the other's to the catacombs. [crawling the catacombs] defoe pursued the team, intent on obtaining the ring of arc, but failed due to dante's plan, dividing up his forces and sneaking the ring past them using gareon. because of this failure, he was removed from his duties, by rassimov as the professor was too furious to lay eyes on him. defoe then swore to bring dante's end with or without the organization. [divide and conquer]

his removal was temporary, as he was later reinstated by rassimov after nearly destroying the organization's training machine while training. defoe was then given a mission to retrieve the amulet of king basilisk, but he again failed due to the intervention of dante's team. [absent heroes]

defoe was then ordered simply to deliver the sword of saint george to prague, czech republic. the sword contained the titan lindorm, but the organization considered defoe to be unworthy to bond with the titan. unsatisfied at simply being a "delivery boy," he went to greece after receiving word from his spies that dante vale was sighted there in order to kill dante. defoe, however, failed, resulting in lok bonding with lindorm and defoe's amulets being taken by the huntik foundation. [the treasures of the argonauts] 
]]
having been removed from his duties, defoe planned to to use his operative access to steal a number of titans from the organization for his revenge on dante vale. however, he was murdered by his own right-hand man, grier, by order of the professor, who thought defoe to be incapable of carrying out his orders.[the beautiful trap] 

whilst attempting to reason with wilder, sophie told him she had thought him to be different from defoe or klaus, because of his talk of uniting people, to which wilder said they were just "protecting the status quo". grier later implied his killing of defoe to be a reason for him to stay on sutos island and not join the huntik foundation, telling dante that he had done a lot of things that he was not proud of to reach his position. [an ally from the organization]

== personality ==

known for his high expectations, efficiency, and sadistic obsession with acid and many different kinds of poisons, defoe is feared by friend and foe alike, he also has a slippery habit of escaping and leaving his suits to do his dirty work for him from time to time. he seems to look down upon his subordinates.  he harbors a strong and obsessive hatred for dante vale, being willing to put a mission at risk to defeat him. dante stated that he himself does not know the reason for defoe's grudge, but defoe will try anything, even if it endangers his mission, to kill dante vale. [words of truth, heart of lies] he also seems to have a huge ego, and thinks he is better than others, due to his having an easy life, as stated by zhalia. [divide and conquer] but he does not have much in the way of fight skills and that more than likely contributes to his failures against dante vale. also he appears to be impulsive, as evidenced by his attack on dante vale, when dante, zhalia, lok, sophie and cherit were exploring the sunken ship from the argo fleet. he also seems to hold his grudge against dante vale above his missions. [the treasures of the argonauts] he apparenly also throws temper tantrums when things don't go his way, as shown when grier carried him away [the treasures of the argonauts].

== abilities ==
]]
with endless hatred, defoe pursues dante and friends using his squad of suit operatives and his own seeker abilities. his choice spells are an array of acidic and poisonous powers, and kreutalk, his signature titan, is capable of burning through anything in its way with the venomous acid it spits. in addition to his powers, defoe typically carried a silver vial of acid that he would often use to threaten his enemies up close. [absent heroes] he possessed a number of titans, and, in some cases, several amulets of the same titan, as seen in his bag. [the treasures of the argonauts]

[a seeker is born] defoe then ordered grier to find the biggest venice huntik library because he knew that the huntik team needed to research eathon's journal. defoe later attacked the library, breaking through by pouring acid on the door's knob. though he failed to retrieve the journal he manages to learn the huntik team's next move. [the casterwill client]

after defoe learned that the huntik team is going to prague, czech republic, to get the titan metagolem he ambushed the huntik team when they were going to retrieve the jodis lore's key, he successfully obtained the key and went to the golem's attic, where he tried to bond with the titan metagolem but failed due to dante's interference so defoe retreated because dante had bonded with metagolem. [words of truth, heart of lies]
]]
afterwards, defoe's team was sent to retrieve the amulets of the re-awakening titans. in the cave of the gargoyle on the outskirts of rouen, france, defoe managed to retrieve and bond with gar-ghoul. [into the river of secrets]. defoe then was ordered by the professor to retrieve the ring of arc. he then had a rematch between dante's caliban and defoe's "new friend," his gar-ghoul, but dante fled with the other's to the catacombs. [crawling the catacombs] defoe pursued the team, intent on obtaining the ring of arc, but failed due to dante's plan, dividing up his forces and sneaking the ring past them using gareon. because of this failure, he was removed from his duties, by rassimov as the professor was too furious to lay eyes on him. defoe then swore to bring dante's end with or without the organization. [divide and conquer]

his removal was temporary, as he was later reinstated by rassimov after nearly destroying the organization's training machine while training. defoe was then given a mission to retrieve the amulet of king basilisk, but he again failed due to the intervention of dante's team. [absent heroes]

defoe was then ordered simply to deliver the sword of saint george to prague, czech republic. the sword contained the titan lindorm, but the organization considered defoe to be unworthy to bond with the titan. unsatisfied at simply being a "delivery boy," he went to greece after receiving word from his spies that dante vale was sighted there in order to kill dante. defoe, however, failed, resulting in lok bonding with lindorm and defoe's amulets being taken by the huntik foundation. [the treasures of the argonauts] 
]]
having been removed from his duties, defoe planned to to use his operative access to steal a number of titans from the organization for his revenge on dante vale. however, he was murdered by his own right-hand man, grier, by order of the professor, who thought defoe to be incapable of carrying out his orders.[the beautiful trap] 

whilst attempting to reason with wilder, sophie told him she had thought him to be different from defoe or klaus, because of his talk of uniting people, to which wilder said they were just "protecting the status quo". grier later implied his killing of defoe to be a reason for him to stay on sutos island and not join the huntik foundation, telling dante that he had done a lot of things that he was not proud of to reach his position. [an ally from the organization]
known for his high expectations, efficiency, and sadistic obsession with acid and many different kinds of poisons, defoe is feared by friend and foe alike, he also has a slippery habit of escaping and leaving his suits to do his dirty work for him from time to time. he seems to look down upon his subordinates.  he harbors a strong and obsessive hatred for dante vale, being willing to put a mission at risk to defeat him. dante stated that he himself does not know the reason for defoe's grudge, but defoe will try anything, even if it endangers his mission, to kill dante vale. [words of truth, heart of lies] he also seems to have a huge ego, and thinks he is better than others, due to his having an easy life, as stated by zhalia. [divide and conquer] but he does not have much in the way of fight skills and that more than likely contributes to his failures against dante vale. also he appears to be impulsive, as evidenced by his attack on dante vale, when dante, zhalia, lok, sophie and cherit were exploring the sunken ship from the argo fleet. he also seems to hold his grudge against dante vale above his missions. [the treasures of the argonauts] he apparenly also throws temper tantrums when things don't go his way, as shown when grier carried him away [the treasures of the argonauts].
]]
with endless hatred, defoe pursues dante and friends using his squad of suit operatives and his own seeker abilities. his choice spells are an array of acidic and poisonous powers, and kreutalk, his signature titan, is capable of burning through anything in its way with the venomous acid it spits. in addition to his powers, defoe typically carried a silver vial of acid that he would often use to threaten his enemies up close. [absent heroes] he possessed a number of titans, and, in some cases, several amulets of the same titan, as seen in his bag. [the treasures of the argonauts]

the spiral demons were magical constructs concocted by arc, the legendary titan of fate, in sophie casterwill's dream, to attack the casterwill family. as minions of the betrayer, these insidious monsters appear to be grotesque hybrids of the marauder and black scarabese titans.

== history ==
sophie encountered an army of spiral demons whilst trapped in the dreamworld created by arc, in which she found herself as leader of the casterwill family. they crawled up the walls of the tower before the dream transferred them to a chess game between sophie, and the betrayer. after dispatching leblanche, the spiral demons moved closer to mallory, white, dellix, lane and santiago. in an attempt to save her family, sophie stormed the chessboard, kicking back as many spiral demons as she could, however this caused the whole board to collapse, with everyone on it falling to their doom. [the legendary titan of fate]

== abilities ==
with the upper torso of the titan marauder, the spiral demon possesses two blades. its lower torso of the black scarabese allows its to effectively climb up walls with ease, as they did the casterwill compound, and siege enemy defenses. [the legendary titan of fate]

suits are the lowest level minions of the organization. typically dressed in dark suits, they are the pawns whom the higher-level organization operatives use to achieve their nefarious goals.

== history ==
most suits were banded together by the professor, practically overnight, through the use of araknos' mind control ability. [the secret of two generations]

=== defoe's suits ===
's suits in the cave of the gargoyle]]
defoe had his suits pursue lok lambert in an attempt to retrieve eathon lambert's journal and its secrets of the amulet of will. three of them cornered him in the courtyard of dante vale's house but were defeated by dante vale. [a seeker is born] defoe's suits staked out dante's house before chasing him and lok through venice. they were defeated with help from sophie casterwill and santiago. later, a large group of suits attacked the venice huntik library where they fought dante and santiago. in the midst of battle, however, the huntik team were able to escape. [the casterwill client] 

pursuing the foundation's clue regarding the golem, the organization sent suits to infiltrate and attack the prague huntik hotel. after defoe found jodis lore's key, the suits attacked the team again. however, despite gaining the upper hand, the suits were forced to retreat when lok arrived to turn the tables giving dante time to recover the amulet and summon metagolem. [words of truth, heart of lies] 

the team was later sent to rouen, france, to retrieve gar-ghoul. [into the river of secrets] however, they missed the more important information on the ring of arc and were then sent by the professor to paris, france, following dante's team into the paris catacombs. [crawling the catacombs] despite gaining a number of new recruits from paris, they were unsuccessful at retrieving the ring. [divide and conquer]

his suits were later sent after king basilisk, but lost the titan to zhalia moon. they also lost unnamed suit 001 to a petrification trap within the titan's chamber. [absent heroes] upon this failure, defoe lost command of his original team of suits and thus had to rally his remaining loyal suits within velo, greece, in an attempt to finally get his revenge on dante vale. this team failed and were escorted back under grier. [the treasures of the argonauts]

=== grier's suits ===
's suits]]
upon taking defoe's place of leadership within the organization, grier had his suits accompany him to sutos island in order to reclaim the rulership of the island. the suits were led into a trap by lok lambert and sophie casterwill, and the two sides battled until dante vale and grier announced a truce. his suits were then permitted to help enforce order on sutos in order to promote peace on the island. [like father, unlike son]

=== klaus's suits ===
' viennese suits guarding his lab]]klaus' viennese suits were sent, under the instructions of rassimov, to go after dante vale in county kerry, ireland. his team of suits ambushed scarlet byrne and dante's team in the new grange passage tomb, using their powerful spells and titans to gain the upper hand. however, they were eventually defeated after sandra lambert arrived, making a vital intervention. [home turf] 

klaus sent his egyptian suits to excavate the tomb of nefertiti, and both his suit teams were sent after the sceptre of nefertiti, which was taken from the foundation members after a skirmish. [the sceptre deception] during the mission to secure the amulets of vlad dracul, three of his suits were transformed through the power of overmode. even with this power, however, they were defeated when zhalia moon chose to side with the huntik foundation. [the vampire loses its fangs]

=== rassimov's suits ===
 and his suits face lok in atlantis]]
defoe's former suits were placed under rassimov and given an improved arsenal of titans. they were then sent by rassimov to ambush lok lambert and sophie casterwill, who were working at a burger joint in venice, italy. the suits were defeated by lok and sophie, who were joined by zhalia moon. [all work and no pay]

two of the recruits from paris, also formerly under defoe, were sent by rassimov in an attempt to eliminate sophie casterwill and company. they failed to hinder the foundation members, however. more of his suits, who had infiltrated the mausoleum of sir lancelot, confronted the foundation team but were swiftly defeated. [memory lane]

his suits were then sent by the professor to the coasts of turkey in search for the ring of behemoth. though two of his suits were overpowering the native amazons, they were defeated by dante, lok, and sophie. rassimov later joined his team, but the suits were defeated dante received the ring of behemoth from zhalia moon. [ladies' choice]

=== the professor's suits ===
 and beta, the professor's personal elite suits]]
the professor and his two elite agents, alpha and beta, travelled to king solomon's mines on the trail of the ring of tao. [the golden asp] after entering the mines, the suits fought aginst the huntik team and montehue and tersly. despite overpowering the foundation's forces, they were forced to retreat when lok bonded with tao. [to be together] the two agents later attacked dante's house and left the team considerably injured and worse for wear. [the secret of two generations] they fought against the team at the professor's castle but were defeated. [the divine comedy]

following the professor's defeat, the two agents attacked the huntik team after they broke into organization central but were defeated. [doorway to huntik]

under the command of wilder and hoffman, the two agents defended the professor's castle from dante and grier before being defeated. [an ally from the organization]

=== wilder's suits ===

a new team of six suits was banded together by mr. wilder and sent to peru, in order to destroy the huntik team so that wilder could become the new leader of the organization. [doorway to huntik] the suits helped wilder take over tower of nostradamus and take peter, billie and annette hostage. [the tower of nostradamus] wilder's suits travelled to avalon where they fought the huntik team and leblanche. [knight of the willblade]

when lok and sophie broke into the safehouse at the golem's attic on the road of alchemists, the suits arrested them and attempted to transport them back to hq. however, they were attacked by dante, zhalia and lucas casterwill's team, forcing them to retreat. [chasing void]

when the huntik team launched an assault in klaus' lab, the suits fought against them, with one invoking a redcap titan, while two others lay in ambush with stack. later, two of them were ambushed by two silent soilders.[the blood spiral]
]]
two of wilder's suits attacked sophie casterwill in hamelin, to get information about her. they overpowered her and sabriel, with their new titans, shadow agent and doom warden. however, as one of the suit attempted to finish sophie off with stoneblade, den and cherit came in to save her.[gremlow infestation] the suits were waiting on motorbikes to ambush the huntik team as they landed in baja california but were stopped by dante, lok and den also on motorbikes. later, two suits fought the team in hernán cortés' vault, but retreated when conquistador ran riot. [the power of umbra]

wilder's suits fought the huntik team once again when they, guided by grier, invaded the professor's castle, to recover the professor's files on rassimov. four of them were defeated by dante and grier, wile the other two were defeated by lok, den and cherit, while trying to stop the three of them from moving forward through the castle.[an ally from the organization]

== abilities ==

 invokes redcap]]
the suits' greatest asset is their sheer numbers, but they also make capable spies and are excellent at gathering information. in a battle, the suits are trained to fight with a variety of spells and titans. just as the organization brings about cold, unfeeling order with the help of savage evil deeds, its troops fight with titans such as the cold mindrone and the savage redcap, and use the spell augerfrost to knock their targets out cold.

/enforcer pairing favored by klaus' suits]]
many suit teams fight using a conventional two-titan combination, matching a ground-based frontline brawler with a ranged, aerial attacker, as seen with defoe and grier's teams who often paired redcap and mindrone together. [s1e02] [s1e12] klaus' austrian suits also followed this convention by primarily using bonelasher and enforcer together. later on, wilder's suits returned to this formation by often using venomaster and gigadrone together. [s2e27] 

other suit teams do not rely on this standard combination pairing. rassimov's suit team used a far more diverse range of obscure and dangerous titans from across the organization roster, a tactic which made them far more challenging and dangerous in combat. [s1e19] [s1e22] [s1e23] more elite agents, such as beta, possess larger, more powerful titans such as terrapede. [s1e25] some suits' titan rosters also very by region, with many paris agents favoring the titan, jokoul. [divide and conquer] [s1e18] klaus' egypt team rely solely on multiple sekhmet titans along with suit 030 invoking a single ammit heart-eater. [s1e14]

ammit heart-eater — tv series — used by klaus' egypt foreman, suit 030, and a standard issue in rassimov's squad; later used by suit 025.

bonelasher — tv series — a common titan for suits under klaus, rassimov, diaz and wilder; historically used by the professor's personal guard.

dark pharaoh — tv series — a unique egyptian titan given to suit 040 by rassimov.

doom warden — tv series — wilder gave suit 057 this titan as a form of additional firepower.

enforcer — tv series — mass-deployed under klaus, rassimov and the professor for ranged and aerial combat; wilder's suit 054 also used one.

simon judeau, otherwise known as the professor, was the cruel and devious founder of the organization and one of the most powerful seekers to walk the earth. the professor was motivated by the desire to heal himself of a curse in conjunction to his past with metz, dante vale, and father of lok lambert, the famous and legendary seeker, eathon lambert. the professor's signature titan was araknos, the legendary titan of the mind.
==history ==
in the 1950's, when simon judeau was a teenager, he was a member of the huntik foundation and the mentor of a young eathon lambert. the young judeau worked along with metz and eathon to fulfill many missions and to discover several titans; within the group, judeau served as the brains, metz as the muscle, and eathon as the intuition. [the secret of two generations] at one point in their travels, simon saved metz' life at the temple of tecobai during an attack from the ecuadorian natives, by holding out his caliban amulet to stop him falling into a river of lava. [the divine comedy]

upon discovering the location of the legendary titan of mind, araknos after a year's search, simon entered the temple and put on the ring against his team's advice and against the warning inscription. instantly, simon was cursed and had to be hospitalized for several years because the effects of the curse were beyond the abilities of huntik foundation magic and medicine. during this time in 1958, eathan remained a loyal friend and was by his side everyday. when simon was well enough to walk again, he escaped and left his titan, dendras, behind so that eathon could bond with it. [the divine comedy] eventually simon made a deal with araknos that would allow him to live on for sometime until he found a cure for his ailment, without informing anyone simon vanished.

simon eventually started the organization in 1959 using the mind control abilities of araknos. judeau also falsified the history of the organization, so as to make it seem as if the organization had existed for years when in reality it was a relatively new company. while beginning the organization, simon attempted to gain the help of eathon but he rejected his offer. with the creation of the organization, judeau donned the alias of the professor. [the secret of two generations]

after discovering that eathon had found the resting place of the amulet of will, simon hunted him down with five of his best operatives. eathon managed to escape by faking his death, jumping off of a waterfall in peru and using the power of the nexus beneath the waterfall to escape to huntik, the spirit world. [doorway to huntik]

after eathon's disappearance, the professor sought after eathon lambert's journal, which held clues which would lead to the amulet of will and the other two legendary titans. [a seeker is born] though two huntik foundation members, dante vale and lok lambert, managed to uncover and bond to behemoth and tao, respectively, the professor used his wiles to claim them as his own. [the divine comedy].
 by araknos]]
the professor was then confronted by the huntik team in his castle. though the professor managed to invoke the legendary titan of immortality, overlos, dante used the power of archwarder to disrupt the professor's control of overlos so that lok could use dendras' power to control overlos and to command him to open a portal and take the legendary titans back to the spirit world of huntik. defeated, the professor found himself caught by the webbing of araknos and was also taken into huntik by araknos' web after a failed attempt to save him by lok lambert and dante vale. like eathon, the professor currently resides in huntik. [the mission]

==personality ==
simon judeau originally was an honorable seeker who cared greatly for his friends, eathon lambert and metz. among the group, simon was the most intelligent but was also more brazen than the others, disregarding an ancient warning inscription at the resting place of the ring of araknos.

however, upon being cursed by the ring, simon removed all traces of his former self, becoming cruel, evil, and devious. the ultimate dominator, the professor now lived to control. he was capable of being sly and manipulative, but rarely had to resort to such actions. normally, the absolute fear he inspired was enough. the professor had no ethics, and would do anything to expand the organization and his power base. he was also the type who liked to manage every facet of the organization himself and to make every decision personally. if any of his underlings failed him, he would not hesitate to have them removed. the professor wanted to use the amulet of will to gain immortality and to cure his curse. he was thoroughly selfish and may have also been driven insane thanks to the curse.

==abilities ==
]]
the professor was bound to the legendary titan araknos, a devastatingly powerful titan capable of mind control to the point of being able to completely rebuild someone's personality. the professor was one of the most powerful seekers in the world: he was also very strong willed, as he could invoke and control four legendary titans, dominator and nordrake all at the same time, without getting exhausted, something which even dante vale, the huntik foundation number one seeker, could not do. [the mission] [coming of age]

santiago is sophie casterwill's bodyguard and beloved guardian. he is eight years older than sophie, and saved her life when her house in paris was set on fire. his family is from madrid, spain. a man of few words, santiago is a master of stealth and agility.

== history ==
santiago grew up in the casterwill family house in paris, where his father had served as a guardian of sophie casterwill's mother. after sophie's birth, santiago was trained by his father in order to serve as sophie's guardian. [huntik.com] when santiago was still young, he was present when kiel attacked the home of sophie casterwill, killing her parents and presumably her brother. he managed to reach sophie through the flames and carried her to safety. [the spiral war] afterwards, he and leblanche took over as her guardians and trained her to be a seeker worthy of the casterwill name. [sophie on trial]

when sophie enlisted the help of dante vale to help her and lok lambert, santiago expressed distrust due to jealousy of dante's formidable skills as a seeker. upon hearing of dante's plan to take sophie to prague, czech republic, the home of the organization, santiago challenged dante to battle, though he lost to dante. when the venice huntik library was attacked by the organization for information on the golem of prague, santiago assisted dante in fighting off the suits, invoking his titan, shinobi, to fight defoe's kreutalk. however, in the midst of battle, he found himself separated from sophie and unable to protect her. he then placed his trust in dante after the latter used his body to shield sophie. [the casterwill client]

when rassimov blocked sophie's bank accounts, santiago and leblanche assisted the huntik team by getting normal jobs to earn enough money for tickets to egypt. one job resulted in santiago reacting to protect sophie from alisa clairmont. on their final job, santiago helped fight and defeat three suits. [all work and no pay]

during the battle at the fortress of iron will, santiago bravely defended the stronghold, alongside leblanche and sophie, fighting off numerous silent soldiers and casterwill hunters. as the pressure mounted and the group were outnumbered, santiago led marduk away after revealing he was the reason sophie escaped kiel's arson, in order to buy sophie time. [the spiral war]

santiago fought in the final battle at the blood spiral base, defeating numerous spirals, alongside his titan, kunoichi. the pair later rescued leblanche from a scramjet that had been seriously damaged by wind and shakrit. [lok and the betrayer] [dante's return]

== personality ==

santiago is incredibly protective over his ward, sophie casterwill, and is willing to put his life in danger in order to protect her. though initially distrustful of outside help in the form of dante vale, santiago soon found a comrade and friend in the huntik foundation operative. [the casterwill client]

== abilities ==
]]
santiago is a trained seeker and ninja who is capable of utilizing various spells including his go-to spell, shadowpoint. as a guardian serving the casterwill family, he trains for hours per day to keep his skills honed. he is also capable of invoking the ninja titans, shinobi and kunoichi, with whom he is bonded.

in addition to his abilities as a seeker, he is a skilled martial artist and studied under masters from japan, china, and korea. [huntik.com] like a true ninja, he is a master of stealth and agility. in addition to hand-to-hand combat, he is skilled with numerous weapons and can turn everyday objects into weapons.

he also makes use of knowledge of oriental cultures and meditation, having learned them in his studies. he often exercises great control over his mind and emotions and thus was able to teach the same calmness to sophie to help her to master the findshape spell.

===spells utilized===

* hyperstride
* shadowpoint
* slamcannon 
* touchram

leblanche is sophie casterwill's beloved guardian, butler, servant, and according to her, attendant. prim and proper, leblanche raised sophie, ensuring her education and safety, whilst keeping the casterwill townhouse in order.

== history ==
]]
leblanche was working as the caretaker at a casterwill safehouse when a young sophie casterwill and santiago turned up on the doorstep, having escaped from a devastating fire at her mansion in montmorency, paris. with sophie's parents having perished in the blaze, leblanche, along with santiago, raised her as his own. he continued her education and acted as a father figure for her. [s2e23] 

years later, now living in venice, italy at the casterwill townhouse, leblanche sent sophie to high school at the venice preparation academy. it was there that she met lok lambert and, through him, became affiliated with dante vale and the huntik foundation. leblanche was impressed by dante and lok and supported her becoming a member of dante's team, santiago less so. [the casterwill client]

when rassimov terminated sophie's bank accounts in an attempt to stop her travelling to egypt on the trail of the amulet of will, leblanche suffered an embarrassing ordeal while shopping for groceries and being unable to pay for them. in an attempt to help lok and sophie raise enough money for their tickets, leblanche took on the role of concierge at venice hotel. however, they lost their jobs after an incident with alisa clairmont and her dog. leblanche later worked as a cook at a buger restaurant where he ended up helping the team defeat a group of organization suits. [all work and no pay]

leblanche helped sophie with her concentration whilst learning the power findshape in order to repair eathon lambert's journal. [ladies' choice] [the unseen guide] after the professor revealed he was really simon judeau, a missing foundation seeker, lok, sophie and zhalia took shelter at the townhouse where leblanche lent sophie his strongest amulet, albion the dragonslayer. [the secret of two generations] sophie later used albion in her last stand against the professor. after his defeat, leblanche was present at the celebratory surprise party at dante vale's house to congratulate the huntik team on their victory. [the mission] 

== personality ==

leblanche is a kind and caring man and despite just being sophie's attendant, acted as a paternal figure to sophie when she had no father and sophie herself has stated that she sees him as a father, being keen to make him proud. [s2e39] a classic english gentleman, leblanche is prim and proper, addressing people as "sir" and "my lady". he dresses smartly and, even on the field of battle, ensures his tie is straight. [knight of the willblade] as the parental figure in sophie's life, leblanche also stresses the importance of education and, with wilder and the organization active, was determined to tutor sophie and lok himself so that they didn't fall behind, much to lok's boredom. [cave of the casterwills] he is courageous and defiantly loyal to sophie and, like santiago, is determined to protect her at all costs, even at great personal risk. [the spiral war] he also seems to similarly care for lok lambert. 

== abilities ==
leblanche is not an active fighter, but he is capable of utilizing martial arts to combat an opponent, along with his defender titan, sentinel, when battles arise. he can also call on albion to protect himself and his allies.

leblanche was working as the caretaker at a casterwill safehouse when a young sophie casterwill and santiago turned up on the doorstep, having escaped from a devastating fire at her mansion in montmorency, paris. with sophie's parents having perished in the blaze, leblanche, along with santiago, raised her as his own. he continued her education and acted as a father figure for her. [s2e23] 

years later, now living in venice, italy at the casterwill townhouse, leblanche sent sophie to high school at the venice preparation academy. it was there that she met lok lambert and, through him, became affiliated with dante vale and the huntik foundation. leblanche was impressed by dante and lok and supported her becoming a member of dante's team, santiago less so. [the casterwill client]

when rassimov terminated sophie's bank accounts in an attempt to stop her travelling to egypt on the trail of the amulet of will, leblanche suffered an embarrassing ordeal while shopping for groceries and being unable to pay for them. in an attempt to help lok and sophie raise enough money for their tickets, leblanche took on the role of concierge at venice hotel. however, they lost their jobs after an incident with alisa clairmont and her dog. leblanche later worked as a cook at a buger restaurant where he ended up helping the team defeat a group of organization suits. [all work and no pay]

leblanche helped sophie with her concentration whilst learning the power findshape in order to repair eathon lambert's journal. [ladies' choice] [the unseen guide] after the professor revealed he was really simon judeau, a missing foundation seeker, lok, sophie and zhalia took shelter at the townhouse where leblanche lent sophie his strongest amulet, albion the dragonslayer. [the secret of two generations] sophie later used albion in her last stand against the professor. after his defeat, leblanche was present at the celebratory surprise party at dante vale's house to congratulate the huntik team on their victory. [the mission]
leblanche is a kind and caring man and despite just being sophie's attendant, acted as a paternal figure to sophie when she had no father and sophie herself has stated that she sees him as a father, being keen to make him proud. [s2e39] a classic english gentleman, leblanche is prim and proper, addressing people as "sir" and "my lady". he dresses smartly and, even on the field of battle, ensures his tie is straight. [knight of the willblade] as the parental figure in sophie's life, leblanche also stresses the importance of education and, with wilder and the organization active, was determined to tutor sophie and lok himself so that they didn't fall behind, much to lok's boredom. [cave of the casterwills] he is courageous and defiantly loyal to sophie and, like santiago, is determined to protect her at all costs, even at great personal risk. [the spiral war] he also seems to similarly care for lok lambert.
leblanche is not an active fighter, but he is capable of utilizing martial arts to combat an opponent, along with his defender titan, sentinel, when battles arise. he can also call on albion to protect himself and his allies.

the rue guardians are a mysterious order of seekers from the casterwill family, who protect the family using ancient magic and curses. there are five rue guardians, with the elder rue guardian serving as the leader of the other four.
== history ==
in ancient times, the rue guardians protected the casterwill family with their curses. they created all kinds of dangerous casterwill tests, including the trial of courage, the quest to find the legendary titan of valour, mythras. [sophie on trial]

when the blue star was activated, the five rue guardians were among the representatives of the casterwill family who met at the fortress of iron will. their elder, along with focauld casterwill, opposed the presence of lok lambert for not being a member of the family and voted against open confrontation with the blood spiral. [sophie on trial]

during the blood spiral's assault on the fortress of iron will, the rue guardians worked with focauld casterwill an ancient incantation, simultaneously invoking coralgolem, feyone, and icarus amulets within the stronghold. [the spiral war]

on the longest night of the year, five rue guardians travelled in a scramjet to the spiral mark with the rest of the huntik foundation and casterwill alliance. [the spiral mark] during the final battle against the blood spiral, they used their powerful magic to take out numerous spiral forces in the air, much to leblanche's amazement. following the defeat of the betrayer, the rue guardians were seen coming to celebrate with the rest of their family. [dante's return]

==personality==
the rue guardians are a mysterious and mostly silent order. although sinister in appearance and description, the guardians have the best interests of the casterwill family at heart.[sophie on trial]

==abilities==
the rue guardians hold the secret knowledge of the fortress of iron will and the amulets hidden within. together, the rue guardians are capable of summoning an army of titans to their aid and creating powerful magic in tandem. [the spiral war] in ancient times, the rue guardians created all kinds of dark incantations to protect the family's secrets, including the fear monsters of the trial of courage. [sophie on trial]

medusa's island is an island located in the aegean sea. the medusa's cave is hidden here which, for many years, was home to the titan medusa.

== history ==
the huntik team traveled by boat to medusa's island on their mission medusa's trap to obtain the deadly titan medusa. the organization also took an interest in the titan with stack offering to deliver her to the kiel and the blood spiral as part of wilder's plan to infiltrate them. after reaching the shore of the island, dante vale, lok lambert and sophie casterwill fought and defeated wilder, hoffman and the suits while zhalia moon scouted ahead to determine the location of medusa's cave. after lok recovered medusa's amulet, the team left the island while kiel and his casterwill hunters returned to tantras with stack as their prisoner. the medusa's cave is a large cavern hidden away on medusa's island. for many years, the cave was home to the deadly titan medusa and a large sculpture of the gorgon sisters which could invoke the titan.

== history ==
the cave was located by stack whilst on a mission to recover the titan for kiel and the blood spiral. unbeknownst to them, they were being scouted by zhalia moon. after reaching the large statue of the three gorgon sisters, stack awakened medusa and attempted to contain her using divine mirror kagami. at the same time, kiel was ambushed and taken prisoner by metagolem and the huntik team. the situation spiraled however when marduk and the casterwill hunters arrived and in the ensuing battle, lok lambert and zhalia moon managed to solve the riddle of gorgon sisters and chase the light of their shared eye to lok, recovering medusa. the huntik team then made a swift exit while kiel returned to tantras with stack as his prisoner. [zhalia's mission]

eathon lambert is a legendary seeker and member of the huntik foundation. he is also the father of kathy and lok lambert. though he has been missing for a decade, he is still alive in the spirit world of huntik. his journal was found by lok and sophie casterwill. his signature titan is jirwolf, but what happened to it is unknown.

== history ==

eathon became a seeker at a young age, under the watch and guidance of his mentor simon judeau. in the mid-late 1950s, the pair became acquainted with metz, whom they met by chance on a street in venice, italy. forming an inseparable seeker team, together the trio embarked on many adventures, travelling around the world, including peru, finding hidden titans for the huntik foundation. within the group, metz served as the muscle, judeau the brains, and eathon as the intuition. [s1e24]

however, this all changed the day that they tried to find one of the legendary titans, araknos. upon finding at the titan's resting place, metz read the ancient scripts carved on the door of araknos' tomb and decided that they should leave the titan. simon however threw caution to the winds and forcefully entered the tomb but was cursed by the magic within. simon was left hospitalised for years, and eathon loyally stayed at his bedside, day and night, for the whole of 1958. when simon was well enough to walk again, he suddenly disappeared a word, leaving only his titan, dendras, behind so that eathon could bond with it. [s1e24] a few months later, an extremely disfigured-looking simon returned and confronted eathon in the huntik foundation italian hq, asking him to join him and be his "dog". the altercation was witnessed by clease and simon vanished again. [s1e24] 

eathon became a legendary seeker within the foundation and formed the very first huntik foundation council. [s1e24] he later met and married a fellow foundaation agent, sandra lambert. they settled down in sandra's home of county kerry, ireland, and had two children, kathy and lok. [home turf] on one occasion, eathon took sandra on a picnic to see the floating castle of tír na nóg at night, with sandra slapping him as he had promised he had retired from adventuring. [back home]

eathon continued his travels around the world, bringinf back artifacts for his son, lok, who would imagine all the places where he had found them. [divide and conquer] eathon believed lok would one day follow in his footsteps as a seeker, and therefore left several of his titans for him to find, hiding his kipperin in an old vase [s1e01], hiding springer in a puzzle in the paris catacombs [s1e05] [huntik.com] and leaving baselaird in a box at the temple of poseidon. [s1e20] 

eathon eventually disappeared after taking up a final quest for the amulet of will, a journey that took him to many different locations across the world, pursued by the simon, now known as the professor, and his personal guard. he left many of his titans for his son, lok lambert, to he eventually found the path to atlantis and fought an incredible battle there, but never managed to make it to the tests. [s1e21] the chase lasted for some number of years until it ended at the edge of a waterfall in south america, where he came face to face with simon after so many years. [the mission] eathon, not wanting to betray his secrets to the professor's mind control powers, faked his own death by jumping from the waterfall, leading him to think he was dead. in reality, he managed to enter a secret cavern behind the falls and escaped through a nexus into the spirit world, huntik. [doorway to huntik]

before his disappearance, eathon kept a journal full of his secrets as a seeker that became an item that the professor's organization were anxious to obtain. when lok and sophie found it, hidden inside an old artifact, both the organization and the huntik foundation sought their claim on its secrets. when it was damaged in a confrontation between organization suits and lok, the only remaining clue about his father's whereabouts was the mentioning of an ancient artifact, the amulet of will. [a seeker is born]

for a long time lok was uncertain whether or not his father, eathon, survived as clues both for and against his survival were found in the foundation's missions to find eathon. one main clue was found in atlantis, where its mermen guards said that no one had passed the city's gates in thousands of years. due to this, lok suspected that his father either was unable to pass or never made it to atlantis. though later suspected that he was somehow turned into the professor's dog, named eathon, the team later uncover that this was simply coincidental.

when the professor was finally confronted by lok and dante vale's team, he began to tell the tale of his men chasing down eathon, although the professor did not include whether or not eathon managed escaped. this oversight may have simply been to stall lok. [the mission]

some time after the defeat of the professor, lok lambert and the rest of the team discovered that eathon was still alive in the spirit world, huntik, by using eathon's holotome and januseea the gatekeeper with the nexus in south america. eathon warns his son of the blood spiral brotherhood, the enemy of the casterwill family, and sends his son after the lost quatrains of nostradamus. [doorway to huntik]

since this encounter, a holotome projection of eathon lambert began to give clues to lok during many of his missions. several of these missions end in failure, with the blood spiral brotherhood claiming the amulet of void and the necklace of tutankhamun.

when lok found himself in the spirit world, huntik, the holotome would not activate. instead, lok sees an image of his father on a mirror within this dimension before being returned to his own plane of existence by umbra. [back home]

the "eathon" that had been giving these clues was later found out to be the betrayer's titan, the shape-shifting legendary titan, demigorgan. demigorgan had been transformed into a holotome and placed in the professor's room of his castle by rassimov. [the spiral mark] lok was greatly troubled by this revelation, though he eventually realizes that the image of his father he saw while in the spirit world was indeed his father. [dante's return]

== personality ==
eathon lambert is strong willed, determined, and willing go to almost any length to get something done. his loyalty to simon was clear in how he spent a year at his bedside until his disappearance. [the secret of two generations] when lok was little, eathon was seen as the cool, mysterious dad that always brought home cool treasures, though he was barely seen around the house. [divide and conquer] by all accounts he seems to be a devoted parent and family man. much like his son, eathon was highly intuitive, finding unique ways around problems and had a love for puzzles, often building ones of his own for him and lok to have fun solving. [the beautiful trap]

== abilities ==
 on his holotome]]
eathon was a very talented seeker who was mentored by the highly-skilled simon judeau, from whom he presumably learnt a variety of different spells. through his adventures, eathon took possession of several titans that he would eventually would leave for his son, lok to find through puzzles. he was highly skilled fighter and held his own against the professor's personal guard for ten years as they chased him across the globe.
