venice, italy: preparatory academy of venice
lok lambert gets to know the brilliant sophie casterwill. 

venice, italy: lok's apartment

by chance, lok finds his father's diary and a mysterious amulet. the lethal organization suits break in; they dash off in pursuit of lok and sophie down the streets of venice. will they manage to steal lok's diary?

== synopsis ==
sophie casterwill joins lok lambert and dante vale in fighting against the organization. sophie then hires dante to uncover the mystery behind the disappearance of eathon lambert, lok's father, and to train herself and lok. the seekers and cherit follow a clue from eathon lambert's journal and research the golem. they find references to jodis lore, but the organization is in hot pursuit and also learns the whereabouts of the golem.

== plot ==
;surrounded!
dante vale's house is surrounded by the organization's suits; dante takes a freelancer amulet out of a safe disguised as a dial telephone. heading for the roof exit, dante gives this amulet to lok, who readily bonds with the amulet's titan. they emerge onto the roof, but to lok's surprise, dante taunts the organization members with the intent of minimizing any damages to his neighbors' properties. as dante, lok, and cherit flee from the organization and their redcap titans, dante summons freelancer from an amulet of his own. sophie casterwill intervenes with her own titan, sabriel, revealing her status as a seeker, while her bodyguard santiago takes out the last suit personally.

;the casterwill heir
after the brief skirmish, sophie introduces herself to dante, who recognizes her last name, casterwill. they head back to her mansion, as dante's house is now being monitored by the organization. when lok is unable to hire dante to train him and help him find his father, sophie draws from the casterwill fortune to hire him for the job. sophie's attendant, leblanche, then mentions to santiago that these strong allies will be key in the girl's realizing her destiny as a member of the casterwill family. based upon the legible remnants of eathon lambert's journal, eathon was last known to be searching for a casterwill artifact, the ancient amulet of will.

;a seeker in training
the next morning, after taking their history final, lok and sophie meet dante outside of the venice preparation academy. in the venice huntik library, dante begins to teach lok the skills necessary to be an accomplished seeker. although lok is initially unable to use a simple boltflare spell, he is able to invoke the freelancer titan he had bonded to earlier.

;myth of the golem
recalling that "the ancient amulet of will sleeps with the golem," sophie looks to the books of the library to research the myth of the golem in prague, czech republic, the headquarters of the organization. santiago, however, will not permit sophie to be taken to such a dangerous place and challenges dante to a fight. after wining said fight, dante and lok return to sophie and uncover the name of jodis lore, a seeker.

;mission to prague
defoe and his suits show up at the mansion, breaking in by pouring acid on the doorknob. dante and caliban team up with santiago and shinobi to defend against the suits and their titans, but grier and defoe invoke their own titans, breaker and kreutalk, respectively. cherit manages to take out a redcap titan with an energy charge, and lok invokes freelancer to defeat the other. during a distraction provided by santiago, the team manages to escape with all but one of the books on jodis lore. the team then heads to marco polo airport where santiago, having seen dante take a hit meant for sophie, entrusts her into his care. the organization, however, has ascertained where dante's team will go, with defoe and grier both heading back to the city of prague.

==production errors==
* in the french dub, when "augerfrost" is cast by unnamed suit 002, "hyperstride" is pronounced instead.

== history ==

in rouen, zhalia moon used simplemind against a police officer to make peter escape. [into the river of secrets] 

in the paris catacombs, zhalia used the spell against mr. mactavish, who had guessed her identity because of her powers. [divide and conquer] 

in the valley of the kings, zhalia used simplemind to knock unnamed suit 036 unconscious and steal his map of the tomb of nefertiti. [the sceptre deception].

in paris, zhalia used the spell to wipe out a whole family' memory, after they witnessed titans breaking out of the cathedral of notre dame and asked for explanations. lok then remarked that simplemind would be useful to make the blood spiral forget about their nefarious goals, but zhalia disproved him by explaining that the spell isn't very effective on seekers. in lambert house, dante vale used the spell on kathy lambert after she saw the huntik team using their powers. [back home]

the ring of arc is an artifact containing the legendary titan of fate, arc. anyone in contact with the ring suffers from intense visions related to that person's fears. the ring was responsible for joan of arc's spiritual powers.

== history ==
during the middle ages, joan of arc possessed the ring and received visions, which she became famous for. before her death, she left the ring in the paris catacombs and protected it with a series of magical traps, including the knights of arc's inner circle. in a secret base located in the cave of the gargoyle in rouen, she also left a map with clues leading up to the ring.

in modern times, the ring was located by the huntik foundation's team. after defeating the magical traps, lok lambert tried to take it from its display, but experienced troubling visions of the professor and his dad eathon lambert. [crawling the catacombs]

zhalia moon managed to pick up the ring by protecting her mind with the spell headcage, and later, sophie casterwill neutralized the ring's power for thirty minutes using banebound. while casting the spell, she had a vision of zhalia punching her and a vision of sabriel's sword being destroyed. after successfully dodging defoe and leaving the catacombs, the ring then came under the control of the huntik foundation. it was stabilized inside a reliquary and kept in one the foundation's safehouse in paris inside the cathedral of notre dame. local agent clements told the team that the foundation would conduct analyses and find a way to break the apparent curse and learn anything about the ring's powers. [divide and conquer]

while the team looked for vlad dracul's titans in his castle in romania, zhalia revealed herself to be a traitor helping klaus and engaged a fight with sophie, confirming the first vision that the ring gave to sophie back in the catacombs. [the vampire loses its fangs]

during the team's final fight against the professor, sabriel and her amulet were destroyed, confirming the second vision that the ring gave to sophie back in the catacombs. [the mission]

later, while being kept at notre dame, the ring started wrecking havoc by hypnotizing clements and unleashing titans. the huntik team was sent to paris to put the ring back under control. they had to be hypnotized as well and enter a dream world where they fought against visions of their deepest fears. lok was the first one to escape and return to the real world, where he saw the real source of the ring's power: the legendary titan of fate, arc. lok, thanks to powerbonded lindorm and dante vale, managed to defeat arc and sent it back to its amulet, freeing the rest of the team and clements. the team deemed the ring's tendency to inflict despair through its visions way too dangerous to be used, and decided to seal it for good. [the legendary titan of fate]

== trivia ==
* although the ring is assumed to be cursed in season 1, such idea is not brought up again in season 2. its powers are simply deemed to be the result of the legendary titan inside, the existence of which was not known at the time.

during the middle ages, joan of arc possessed the ring and received visions, which she became famous for. before her death, she left the ring in the paris catacombs and protected it with a series of magical traps, including the knights of arc's inner circle. in a secret base located in the cave of the gargoyle in rouen, she also left a map with clues leading up to the ring.

in modern times, the ring was located by the huntik foundation's team. after defeating the magical traps, lok lambert tried to take it from its display, but experienced troubling visions of the professor and his dad eathon lambert. [crawling the catacombs]

zhalia moon managed to pick up the ring by protecting her mind with the spell headcage, and later, sophie casterwill neutralized the ring's power for thirty minutes using banebound. while casting the spell, she had a vision of zhalia punching her and a vision of sabriel's sword being destroyed. after successfully dodging defoe and leaving the catacombs, the ring then came under the control of the huntik foundation. it was stabilized inside a reliquary and kept in one the foundation's safehouse in paris inside the cathedral of notre dame. local agent clements told the team that the foundation would conduct analyses and find a way to break the apparent curse and learn anything about the ring's powers. [divide and conquer]

while the team looked for vlad dracul's titans in his castle in romania, zhalia revealed herself to be a traitor helping klaus and engaged a fight with sophie, confirming the first vision that the ring gave to sophie back in the catacombs. [the vampire loses its fangs]

during the team's final fight against the professor, sabriel and her amulet were destroyed, confirming the second vision that the ring gave to sophie back in the catacombs. [the mission]

later, while being kept at notre dame, the ring started wrecking havoc by hypnotizing clements and unleashing titans. the huntik team was sent to paris to put the ring back under control. they had to be hypnotized as well and enter a dream world where they fought against visions of their deepest fears. lok was the first one to escape and return to the real world, where he saw the real source of the ring's power: the legendary titan of fate, arc. lok, thanks to powerbonded lindorm and dante vale, managed to defeat arc and sent it back to its amulet, freeing the rest of the team and clements. the team deemed the ring's tendency to inflict despair through its visions way too dangerous to be used, and decided to seal it for good. [the legendary titan of fate]
* although the ring is assumed to be cursed in season 1, such idea is not brought up again in season 2. its powers are simply deemed to be the result of the legendary titan inside, the existence of which was not known at the time.

tremayne is a four-armed, green-skinned fairy that is constantly causing mischief. with her dragonfly-like wings, she is easily able to exhaust those who chase her.

== history ==
old irish legends speak of tremayne titans as the sidhe, fairies that pulled pranks on people. due to her ability to put people to sleep for many years, her mischief is thought to have been the reason why rip van winkle fell asleep for twenty years.

== abilities ==
tremayne is not an offensive-based titan, so she uses her abilities instead to escape. when she is unable to escape by flight, she can use the potion in her magical cup to put her enemies into a deep sleep.

== design history ==
=== rough sketch ===
tremayne is a four-armed fairy titan that is always up to some kind of mischief. we wanted this picture to show a smart titan with a bit of an attitude, and the artist’s sketch shows hints of that in her face and posture.

=== pencil sketch ===
you can see tremayne’s dragonfly wings (the greenish wings that are barely visible mean she’s flapping her wings really fast). you can see that she’s holding are a wooden cup and a burning torch, and she’s wearing jewelry like the ancient celtic people of the ireland wore. tremayne has four arms, so nobody’s going to think she’s human, but we wanted to go the extra step, so we asked the artist to give her green skin.

=== final art ===
and here she is with green skin. green is a common color for gaia-titans and green is often associated with the irish, so we have two reasons to make her green. she also has red hair, a common hair color in ireland. we didn’t want this to be a “fairy in the forest” kind of picture, so we had the artist put her in a city, like someone had just summoned her. [huntik.com]

gawain is a green-skinned and green-haired gaia-titan with antler-like tree limbs growing from his head. his armor is made out of wood and green leaves. gawain was once the primary titan of the legendary king arthur.

== history ==
gawain's amulet was used by king arthur as his main titan. this bond was so close that king arthur's nephew, sir gawain, was named after the titan. after being passed down through many generations of knightly seekers, gawain was later lost within one of england's rivers. over time, this river became polluted, causing gawain to become sick and corrupted. [huntik.com]

== abilities ==
gawain can wield his shield, javelin, and hammer in battle, covering both his offensive and defensive needs.

dante decides to teach lok and sophie the secrets of the seekers, bringing them into the huntik foundation. santiago, sophie's bodyguard, is suspicious about dante. following lok's father's clues, the huntik team starts searching for the amulet of will, but slimy defoe and the organization suits lie in ambush.

== synopsis ==
pursuing clues about eathon lambert and the amulet of will, dante vale, lok lambert, sophie casterwill, and cherit head to prague, czech republic. they are ambushed by the organization but are assisted by the mysterious zhalia moon, who joins in the investigation of the golem. though the organization gain the key, the team is able to make a replica from an imprint. lok manages to invoke kipperin and allows dante to bond with the hidden titan, metagolem. they also find jodis lore's notes, but are unable to decipher them.

== plot ==
;the first mission
in a hotel in prague, czech republic, dante vale uses his holotome to gain information about his, lok lambert, and sophie casterwill's first mission together, the golem of prague. dante goes over a plan to find the tomb of jodis lore within the prague central cemetery as organization suits lurking outside catch wind of their plans. dante suggests using small and fast titans such as solwing and sabriel.

;infiltrated
on the streets outside, the mysterious seeker, zhalia moon, removes and destroys an earpiece. she and her titan, gareon, enter the prague huntik hotel where dante, lok, sophie, and cherit are under attack by organization suits and their redcap titans. with their help and that of her other titan, strix, dante’s team wins the battle. afterwards, zhalia is introduced as the huntik foundation's new "lone wolf" seeker. she says that she has heard that spies from the organization have infiltrated the huntik foundation under orders from the professor, the evil seeker in charge of the organization and who happens to be a man capable of mind manipulation. seeing a potential parallel between this power and the amulet of will, lok wonders if his father encountered the professor.

;the golem's tomb
as night falls, the heroes, including zhalia, go to the central cemetery of prague and find the secret entrance to jodis lore’s tomb. following a clue in eathon's journal and the golem myth, sophie smears a handful of clay on jodis lore's tombstone and writes the symbol for 'truth' on it, as this symbol was said to have brought the golem to life in the myth. the tomb opens to reveal a secret stairway. upon entering, dante leaves several motion detectors to tell when organization members would enter. in the next chamber, the team must get past a trap by only stepping on the lighter-colored clay bricks. dante's motion detectors go off, and he goes back to find defoe and grier. running back to help him, lok rashly forgets the nature of the chamber and sets off jodis lore's trap. outnumbered, dante fakes a fatal hit from a poisonheat spell.

;jodis lore's chambers
defoe sends kreutalk into the next chamber to retrieve jodis lore's key and then leaves with grier, not knowing that cherit has stowed away on top of their vehicle. with fewer organization operatives around, dane uses everfight to regain his strength and take out the remaining suits. with zhalia's help, dante creates an imprint of the key, and the team heads to the road of alchemists for dante to create a trap for the organization. defoe and grier enter, but dante attacks as defoe tries to bond with the metagolem titan. dante invokes caliban while zhalia invokes both gareon and kilthane. as the two battle defoe and grier, lok and sophie enter with their own titans, freelancer and sabriel. lok, however, is so one-tracked that he ends up being knocked unconscious early on in the confrontation.

;metagolem
upon gaining consciousness to see his friends in trouble, lok uses everfight and invokes kipperin from his father's amulet. just as defoe thinks he's won, lok flies in on kipperin's wings to knock the organization operative down. the time now ripe, zhalia unleashes her camouflaged gareon as dante goes to a nearby jar to bond with metagolem's amulet. as dante unleashes the power of his new titan, defoe and his men retreat.

;hieroglyphic notes
the heros return to venice, italy to study jodis lore’s coded notes about the amulet of will. however, in organization central in prague, czech republic, the professor reprimands defoe for compromising the acquisition of the amulet of will by losing jodis lore's notes.

== trivia ==
* dante told lok that kipperin was more difficult to summon than freelancer. however, in the tcg, freelancer is a major hero and requires more energy than kipperin, a minor hero.

huntik: titan defence is an app game based on huntik: secrets & seekers released on september 26, 2010. the game features a six-chapter story mode throughout which the player must defend eathon lambert's journal from the advancing titans of the organization. there is also a challenge mode which enables the player to complete different achievements, and help them unlock new and more powerful titans, and earn badges.

== chapters ==
*chapter 1 - "a seeker is born"
*chapter 2 - "the casterwill client"
*chapter 3 - "words of truth, heart of lies"
*chapter 4 - "into the river of secrets"
*chapter 5 - "absent heroes"
*chapter 6 - "like father, unlike son"

== titans ==
each seeker has has up to three titans in their possession, unlocked by completing parts of the game. prior to each battle, the player must select one titan for each seeker to use.
*lok lambert - freelancer, kipperin, lindorm
*dante vale - caliban, solwing, metagolem

the amulet seekers (titled i cercatori di amuleti in italy) is a novel written by frank j. martucci, based on season 1 of huntik: secrets & seekers. it was published by fabbri editori and was released in italy on november 19, 2008.

== synopsis ==
lok lambert is a young boy passionate about puzzles who attends the preparatory academy in venice. one day, with his friend sophie, he finds a diary and a pendant that belonged to his father, eathon, a scholar who disappeared years ago in obscure circumstances.

this new discovery puts him on the road of the seekers: explorers divided into factions scattered around the world who compete for the control of amulets, objects created by ancient civilizations to invoke the titans, magical creatures endowed with extraordinary powers...

after hard training, lok also becomes a seeker. with his friends, he goes in search of the ancient amulet of will, on a journey full of danger and twists which will lead him to battle against the malicious members of the organization, a terrifying society which plans to dominate the world...

== trivia ==
*the novel was released prior to the first broadcast of season 1, making it the first piece of published media in the franchise.

the city of atlantis (titled la città di atlantide in italy) is a gamebook written by frank j. martucci, based on huntik: secrets & seekers. it was published by fabbri editori and released in italy on november 25, 2009. it was planned to be followed by the showdown. the story is written from the perspective of lok lambert, whose actions along the journey are decided by the reader. 

== synopsis ==
lok, together with his friends from the huntik foundation, is about to embark on a new adventure, which will take him into the depths of the sea to the gates of the city of atlantis, on the traces of his father and the legendary amulet of will. but this time you, the reader, will take on the role of the young seeker and choose for him. because this is a book, where adventure combines with play and fun: whenever you find yourself at a crossroads, it's up to you to decide which direction to take. you will have to fight, solve puzzles, choose whether to help your teammates or go on alone. and the outcome of the mission will depend on you...

== trivia ==
*the gamebook is based on the events of the season 1 episodes the unseen guide and coming of age.
* as the reader decides what steps to lok should take on the journey, many events of the story deviate from that of the tv episodes. one such example is the inclusion of sea freelancer, the atlantean equivalent of freelancer, who does not appear in the original episode and is summoned by the mermen. in order to defeat them, lok orders his own freelancer to attack him.

the first season of huntik: secrets & seekers began airing in the uk and us on january 3rd, 2009, on jetix and the cw's cw4kids networks respectively. it premiered in italy on january 12th, 2009 on the rai due network. it follows the adventures of lok lambert as he is thrown into the world of seekers and titans motivated by the search for his missing father through clues left in his journal, unearthing ancient secrets along the way and battling the evil organization. 
== production ==
huntik: secrets & seekers was created by iginio straffi as the spiritual successor to his successful show, winx club. the first season was co-produced by rai fiction and big bocca productions and animated by rainbow spa. a season of 26 episodes was initially announced here in 2006 for a broadcast date of early 2008, but it was delayed by a year. it eventually premiered on the cw's cw4kids block in the united states and on jetix in the uk, both beginning on 3 january 2009. following weeks of previews, it premiered in italy on rai due on 12 january 2009. the first season ended in the uk on 29 january, in italy on 16 january, and in the us on 5 september.

== plot ==
lok's father, eathon lambert, has been missing for ten years, and the only thing lok has to remember him by is an ancient jar. when that jar is accidentally broken, lok discovers a journal that discusses the mysterious titans. the jar also contained an amulet, although lok doesn't know what it is at the time. now lok is teaming up with the huntik foundation to find and bond with titans before the professor, defoe, grier, and the rest of the evil organization use them to take over the world.

using eathon lambert's journal, the team follows a series of clues in an attempt to find lok's father. however, the search reveals a mysterious connection between eathon and the professor as well as clues to uncover the fabled amulet of will, which is necessary for awakening lord casterwill's legendary titans.

**dante was originally called "brian vale" and dark grey hair, a black jacket and an reddish-brown jumper. his original jumper can still be seen in a number of the official series posters.

phoenix volcano is a large volcano located on an uninhabited indonesian island. it was the resting place of the ring of phoenix, the legendary titan of rebirth, and was protected by an anti-magic field generated by the lodestone. the interior design was based on that of the amulet of will, a symbol of the casterwill family.

== history ==
the blood spiral travelled into the centre of the volcano and began searching for the ring using ceramic rods. the huntik team, however, managed to destroy the lodestone, disabling the anti-magic field surrounding the area and enabling them to use their powers. [the dead magic island]

the huntik team entered the volcano through a lava tube, and, after launching a surprise attack on wind and shauna, the team deduced that the amulet would be in the leftmost pit, as the leftmost gem on the amulet of will was red. after a huge battle, sophie casterwill dived into the pit, overcoming her fear of the fire. the volcano subsequently erupted, forcing the others to flee. sophie then emerged from the volcano with phoenix, reborn from the ashes. [the phoenix's ashes]

hernán cortés' vault is a large underwater cave located deep in the sea of cortés, also known as the gulf of california. spanish conqueror hernán cortés buried all of his treasure here, along with the ring of umbra, the legendary titan of dimensions, which he had found in the yucatan. in addition to numerous deadly traps, he left his titan, conquistador, to guard the treasures.

== history ==
hernán cortés built the vault deep in the gulf ofto store his vast collection of treasures from his travels, including the ring of umbra. he left dozens of brutal traps around the vault and a guardian titan, conquistador surrounded by a massive force field. [the power of umbra]

following a clue from eathon lambert, dante vale found the entrance to the vault during a thunderstorm out in the sea of cortés. with help from metagolem, he entered the vault and used ignatius to defend himself from some arrows. he then discovered conquistador with the force field. meanwhile lok lambert, sophie casterwill and den fears recovered the pied pipe in hamelin cathedral. [gremlow infestation!]

after meeting in baja, california, the huntik team dived down to the vault where, following nostradamus' quatrain, they used the pied pipe to charm conquistador into disabling the barrier. however they were interrupted by wilder and his team, who had found the cave mapped in the organization's extensive data archive. they took them hostage before continuing into the vault, where dante set of one of the traps, causing a chain reaction and giving the team an opportunity to fight back. using kaioh the tracker, dante was able to find the ring from a selection of fake amulets before regrouping. however, the organization blocked the exit with rocks, trapping the huntik team with conquistador. at the moment, dante invoked umbra, teleporting them all to safety. [the power of umbra]

annette is a french huntik foundation researcher who works undercover as an assistant at the tower of nostradamus alongside billie and peter, as part of nasher's team. like peter, she does not display any seeker abilities, but nevertheless plays a vital role in studying nostradamus' tower.

== history ==
when wilder and the organization took an interest in nostradamus' observatory, annette, billie and peter monitored them and quickly made a plan to stop them. staying behind in case things went awry, annette then attempted to call for help on her holotome but was knocked unconscious by hoffman's rippleburst. despite being taken hostage, her emergency call alerted nasher, and dante vale and his team were sent to the tower to rescue them. peter then took annette and billie to the huntik foundation hospital. [the tower of nostradamus]

== personality ==
although she is not a seeker, annette appears to be brave and determined to help her teammates even when outnumbered. she is obedient and can be relied upon to do what she can in a dangerous situation. [the tower of nostradamus]

== abilities ==
like peter, annette is not a seeker and thus does not possess any magical abilities (hence why, when captured, wilder's men only gagged billie). nevertheless, annette was able to use a holotome effectively and send an emergency communication to huntik international hq, ultimately saving herself and her teammates. [the tower of nostradamus]

nostradamus' tomb is the resting place of the casterwill family seer, nostradamus. it is hidden deep beneath a forest of red-leaved trees in salon graveyard and can only be opened by stabbing the willblade into the ground. 

== history ==
nostradamus was buried in the tomb, but opted to keep his resting place a secret for risk of it being looted by grave robbers. [words from eathon]

on the longest night of the year, dante vale and his team, instructed by eathon lambert and a secret file on his holotome, travelled to salon graveyard to find nostradamus' last quatrain, their only clue being a "tree with red leaves". when they arrived, they were perplexed and frustrated to find a whole woodland of identical trees but when lok stumbled and the willblade landed in the foot a tree, the ground opened presenting a series of winding steps all leading to the tomb. it became clear that nostradamus had wanted the willblade's owner to have full access to his tomb. in the coffin, the team found the quatrain "into the spiral centre, the champion of casterwill will fly; only the fire of justice will cause the long night to die." the team were then attacked by marduk and his casterwill hunters but managed to teleport away to the spiral mark using umbra. [words from eathon]

sea freelancer is a krono-titan used by the mermen of atlantis and is the atlantean equivalent of the titan freelancer. instead of shiny steel, this titan's shell is made of resistant coral and wields an indestructible-looking spear stained with rust if it has laid at the bottom of the sea for a millenium. 

==history==
in an alternate version of events in lok's quest for the amulet of will, sea freelancer was invoked by the mermen in atlantis to fight against lok lambert's freelancer when the huntik team embarked on the test of prowess. realising the titan was just a copy created by the test, lok ordered his freelancer to attack sophie, thinking it would cause the sea freelancer to attack his master. this failed however and lok was forced to stop his freelancer from hurting her. lok then ordered his freelancer to attack him which caused the sea freelancer to also turn on his master, stabbing him, and causing them both to disappear into smoke. [the city of atlantis]

==abilities==
sea freelancer possesses similar abilities to his titan counterpart and is a battle-ready, defensive warrior, armed with a long, resistant spear. 

==trivia==
*in the italian gamebook, sea freelancer is called freelancer del mare.
*as the city of atlantis is a gamebook and based on the episode coming of age, sea freelancer's role in the test of prowess is exclusive to the book and is the result of an alternate turn of events based on the decisions made by the reader.

saint george was a valiant and noble seeker who was renowned throughout history for saving the princess silene from a great dragon with his lance, ascalon. his sword, containing his titan lindorm, was buried for centuries in silene, libya until it was eventually dug up by the organization. both the sword and his lance were later recovered by the huntik foundation. 

==history==
in english legend, saint george saved princess silene from being sacrificed to a fire breathing dragon. in facing the dragon, saint george did not kill it but merely wounded while princess silene used her girdle as a leash to tame the dragon. after his victory, his birth town was renamed georgiopolis in his honour. [the fire of georgiopolis]

defoe was ordered to deliver saint geroge's sword to a safehouse but instead lost it in a revenge attack on dante vale and his team. dante offered the sword to lok lambert who in turn bonded with lindorm, the titan inside. [the treasures of the argonauts]

on a quest to find saint george's spear, ascalon, the huntik team travelled to a shrine to him where they encountered a huge fire-breathing dragon which was, in fact, a magical trap. after they failed to stop it using breakspell, lok found a reference to the "girdle of the princess," which sophie recalled was how saint george originally defeated the dragon. instead of killing it, he merely wounded it while princess silene used her girdle as a leash to tame the dragon.
finding the girdle, cherit threw it to lok, who tried to use it as a leash on the dragon. failing, lok recalled that the original tamer was a princess so had sophie take over. the dragon then disappeared, allowing the lance of saint george to be reclaimed. [the fire of georgiopolis]

==abilities==
saint george was a highly skilled warrior and a powerful seeker. his skills lay in swordsmanship and he was armed with many powerful weapons, including his sword and his spear, ascalon
===bonded titans===
*lindorm

emi is a seeker working for the huntik foundation who carries out research at a university in naha, japan. emi's ancestors were seekers from the age of the samurai and she comes from a family of ninjas, so she is an expert in ninjitsu. den fears quickly developed a crush on her during their mission to find the titan kyojin in japan. 

== history==
as a young child, emi saw wilder approach attack her village but he was defeated by her father. [the guardian of yonaguni]

years later, emi came to dante vale's house in need of help, pursed by a shadow agent titan. she enlisted their help to find the island of yonaguni and its titan guardian, kyojin. as the team battled the organization, emi remembered wilder from her past and defeated him using the move that she watched her father do. after realising that part of the sunken city itself was the titan, lok lambert summoned kyojin, defeating the organization forces, and then gave kyojin's amulet to emi to thank her for saving them. [the guardian of yonaguni]

== abilities ==
raised in a family of ninjas, emi is a trained ninja and is extremely skilled in using different ninja weapons including a staff and a rope.

miss fitch helped to take dante vale prisoner after he was tricked by dr. benway into recovering the amulet of cerberus for him. she helped to sedate him before bundling him out of a van and prepared to execute him on benway's orders. however, dante used stoneglove to escape his bonds and miss fitch was knocked out by another prisoner, rahmas. [cerberus (comic)]

miss fitch assisted dr. benway in luring the huntik team into a trap in their base in prague by posing as irina blazek, one of the huntik foundation's best spies. after, lok and sophie were sent back in time by kronos, fitch was knocked out by a raypulse from zhalia moon. she was later arrested along with dr. benway and taken back to the huntik foundation. [the power of kronos]

== personality ==
miss fitch is a cold and ruthless individual, who willingly carried out the cruel orders of dr. benway. however, she was shown to be nervous when about to execute dante vale, as dante noticed her hand shaking, suggesting a lack of experience. [cerberus (comic)]

maddie blaustein, also known as kendra bancroft and adam seth blaustein, was an american voice actress, comic book writer and transgender rights activists who played the role of rassimov in season 1 of huntik: secrets & seekers, as well as the role of meowth in the pokémon anime series. 

blaustein was born in long island, new york on the 9th of october 1960. she was born intersex but assigned male at birth and transitioned to female. on december 11th 2008, she died of an untreated stomach virus in jersey city, new jersey, and later buried at the congregation b'nai israel cemetery. her work in season 1 of huntik was thus released posthumously, and marc diraison took over the role of rassimov in season 2.

unnamed foundation agent 001 is a seeker working for the huntik foundation. he is a trained field operative and often works with two other unnamed agents, 002 and 003. 

== history ==
this foundation agent was present at huntik foundation italian hq when klaus was released from king basilisk's stonegaze power. later, he and unnamed foundation agent 002 arrested klaus and took him into foundation custody. [the blood spiral]

this agent was sent to the castle of vlad dracul with agent 002 to try and subdue the wild antedeluvian, but to no avail. later, the pair's camp was ambushed by the blood spiral. the agent quickly summoned his freelancer titan, but they were both defeated and the agent knocked unconscious by a nullcurse blast. zhalia moon then took the spear of vlad the impaler from him, granting the spiral access to the castle. [lok's leadership]

the agent and the field operatives arrested rassimov outside the tomb of tutankhamun and drove him away to be taken into custody. however, their land rovers were later attacked by harrison fears and jericho, freeing rassimov and defeating the agents. [rassimov's secret]

this agent later travelled to the spiral mark with the rest of the huntik foundation and was seen fighting against the silent soldiers in the final battle. [lok and the betrayer] following the defeat of the betrayer, he and several other foundation members were stationed at the spiral mark as they tried to make sense of the data. [dante's return]

== abilities ==
like most foundation field operatives, this agent is trained in physical combat and can call on the standard foundation powers and titans such as freelancer.

*freelancer

the rotterdam orphanage was a children's home in rotterdam, netherlands where zhalia moon, den and harrison fears grew up. it was a miserable place with poor living conditions, and where systematic bullying and mistreatment was rife among the children who lived there. harrison described it as a "prison". it was run by its caretaker ms. shrodinger until it was taken over by the blood spiral in search of recruits. 

== history ==
zhalia moon was grew up here as a child but was eventually left for the streets before being found and raised by klaus, an organization seeker. [the vampire loses its fangs]

many years later, following a reunion with her adoptive father, klaus, and witnessing her one-time home at klaus' bookshop burn to the ground, zhalia returned to her old orphanage and noted it hadn't changed much. tantras and the blood spiral arrived in search of vulnerable orphans who they could recruit. after tying up ms. shrodinger, tantras began training the orphans, teaching them spells and giving them titans. bruno is a young orphan with blonde hair and a plump build who lived at the rotterdam orphanage with den and harrison fears. he was recruited by tantras and became a member of the blood spiral.

== history ==
bruno would regularly bully harrison fears with dirk and the other orphans, which often resulted in fights with den fears, who fought to protect his little brother and the other weaker kids at the orphanage. [den vs harrison]

when tantras and the blood spiral came to the orphanage in search of recruits, bruno and dirk were both given the titan harlekin. after being ordained with the mark of the spiral by rassimov, the orphans were sent to ambush lok lambert and sophie casterwill. they were forced to retreat however when dante vale arrived to back up his team. [den vs harrison] 

despite joining the blood spiral, bruno was the only orphan from the rotterdam orphanage who was not selected to be tutored by tantras. [boys will be seekers]

== personality ==
like the other orphans, bruno was a cowardly bully who constantly tormented harrison at any opportunity. however, his cowardice was exposed when he came face to with the fog monsters, hiding behind his harlekin titan. [s2e33] it is likely due to his cowardice that he was the only orphan, excluding den, not to be chosen as one of the students taught by tantras. [s2e36]

this orphan was a thug who picked on those weaker than him. he was, however, able to use basic powers as taught to him by tantras. [den vs harrison]

the clues left by lok's father, eathon lambert, in his diary, lead the huntik team down into the undergrounds of prague. lok and his group manage to unveil the myth of the golem and reach the amulet of metagolem. the organization takes them by surprise, but a new seeker, the mysterious and beautiful zhalia moon, intervenes to their rescue.

== synopsis ==
dante vale is given the assignment to search for the mysterious gar-ghoul titan, believed to be in rouen, france, while developing lok's summoning powers and his use with magical spells.

== plot ==
mysterious waterspouts and whirlpools on a river in france have been capsizing boats and almost drowning people. the huntik foundation believes a lost titan called gar-ghoul is awakening, and its powers are causing these attacks. dante vale, lok lambert, sophie casterwill, and zhalia moon go to france to investigate.

when the heroes reach the river, they are attacked by suits. after defeating the suits, the team takes a boat upriver and encounters the magical whirlpools, which cause them to crash. luckily, they find a hidden cave! inside, a stone gargoyle blasts them with jets of water that hit as hard as bullets. to make things worse, defoe’s team shows up and attacks them too! defoe uses the battle as a distraction to steal gar-ghoul’s amulet, but lok discovers a secret chamber that may be more valuable than gar-ghoul.

dante receives from guggenheim a new mission for the huntik foundation. the huntik team has to unveil the myth of the cave of the gargoyle by the seine river. zhalia frees peter, a guide from the foundation who has been put in jail by the organization.

french catacombs

defoe manages to sieze the titan, gar-ghoul, but lok finds an important secret passage.

== synopsis ==
the mystery of joan of arc being a former seeker leads the gang to notre dame where a stone gargoyle holds the key to the hidden catacombs entrance and to more titans.

== plot ==
having discovered a secret chamber, the heroes find notes and artifacts left by the famous french hero joan of arc. joan’s notes point them to the mysterious catacombs under paris, where a powerful magic ring is hidden. the heroes, dante vale, zhalia moon, lok lambert, and sophie casterwill find a hidden entrance to the catacombs within an abandoned church in paris, but defoe and his suits show up sent by the evil professor.

dante battles the suits to give his friends time to figure out how to open the secret door. they manage to get in and collapse the entrance before the suits can follow. lok gets caught in a trap but manages to find a way out. in the process, he discovers a new titan named springer. the heroes get the ring of arc. but it is cursed, and it knocks lok unconscious with horrible visions of the future. suits are on the way to capture them and to take the ring of arc.

== trivia ==
* the episode features foreshadowing: when passing through another mirror trap in the paris catacombs, it is stated in joan of arc's notes that only the pure of heart can pass. lok, dante, and sophie pass unchallenged but when zhalia attempts to pass there is a cave in.

kopesh is a blue, jackal-like hecto-titan. he has sharp, gold claws and has a curved, golden blade protruding from the top of its head. kopesh wears bandages, a tattered cape and teal clothing with gold trim.

== history ==
in ancient egypt, kopesh was said to fly into battle on a cloud of whirling dust. he would later exit the battlefield accompanied by the howls and screams of the vanquished. [huntik.com]

kopesh amulets were seen in the possession of two rassimov's suits along with that of unnamed titan 003 as they planned their attack on the amazons. later, kopesh was invoked by rassimov in the turkish wilderness on a mission to recover the ring of the legendary titan of body, behemoth. kopesh, teamed with thornment, attacked dante vale's caliban and lok lambert's lindorm, but caliban defeated kopesh by hurling thornment at kopesh. [ladies' choice]

kopesh was later invoked by rassimov to defend against lok lambert and to fight against his freelancer. after freelancer was sent back to his amulet by hopeshatter, kopesh was defeated by lok's new titan, baselaird. [coming of age]

kopesh again was invoked within king solomon's mines in the struggle for the ring of tao. kopesh defeated montehue's tolivane and attacked tersly's venadek. after a heated conflict, kopesh was defeated by tao, who bonded with lok. [to be together]

while rassimov was secretly searching for the necklace of tutankhamun in the valley of the kings, egypt, kopesh's bond with rassimov was broken by dante's sorrowbond spell, and his amulet was taken into custody by huntik foundation agents. [rassimov's secret]

== abilities ==
kopesh is a mage titan of the highest order. conjuring swarms of locusts to consume his enemies or blasts of acidic black sludge to trip them up, kopesh possesses a wide variety of powerful combat options, in addition to that, kopesh can fly. he is the perfect partner in battle for thornment.

== trivia ==
* kopesh's summoning command is "cleave them".
* kopesh's name is based on the khopesh, a sickle sword used by egyptians in battle, which kopesh bears on top of his head.
* kopesh's appearance is based on anubis whereas anubian, whose name is based off anubis, is represented as a scarab.

[ladies' choice]

kopesh was later invoked by rassimov to defend against lok lambert and to fight against his freelancer. after freelancer was sent back to his amulet by hopeshatter, kopesh was defeated by lok's new titan, baselaird. [coming of age]

kopesh again was invoked within king solomon's mines in the struggle for the ring of tao. kopesh defeated montehue's tolivane and attacked tersly's venadek. after a heated conflict, kopesh was defeated by tao, who bonded with lok. [to be together]

while rassimov was secretly searching for the necklace of tutankhamun in the valley of the kings, egypt, kopesh's bond with rassimov was broken by dante's sorrowbond spell, and his amulet was taken into custody by huntik foundation agents. [rassimov's secret]
kopesh is a mage titan of the highest order. conjuring swarms of locusts to consume his enemies or blasts of acidic black sludge to trip them up, kopesh possesses a wide variety of powerful combat options, in addition to that, kopesh can fly. he is the perfect partner in battle for thornment.

dark pharaoh is a mysterious four-eyed titan. he levitates across the battlefield, striking fear into the hearts of his enemies. this titan has no arms, but that doesn't mean it doesn't pack a powerful punch, so to speak.

==history==
dark pharaoh is a blood spiral brotherhood titan that was in the possession of rassimov. [the golden asp]

rassimov later gave dark pharaoh to one of his suits. the suit invoked the titan in an ambush to the huntik team in the midst of a sandstorm. dante vale invoked solwing in response, making dark pharaoh shoot one of its spheres toward dante's titan, but missed. shortly after, dark pharaoh shot at a turned-away caliban, and incapacitated the titan for a short period of time. dante cast touchram at the dark titan and sent it back to its amulet. [the golden asp]

the same suit invoked dark pharaoh to participate in the large battle in king solomon's mines. dark pharaoh fought feyone but was unable to hurt sophie's titan, being sent back to its amulet shortly after by tao, at the command of lok.[to be together]

a dark pharaoh titan was in the possession of omeed, an organization operative. [tcg:lgs-044]

a casterwill hunter invoked a dark pharaoh titan to attack powerbonded caliban and ironsquire. ultimately, dark pharaoh and ironsquire defeated each other. [the casterwill connection]

a casterwill hunter invoked dark pharaoh to attack lok lambert and powerbonded kipperin. dark pharaoh then fought powerbonded sabriel and sophie casterwill. [the dead magic island]

==abilities==
dark pharaoh can pull air into his ethereal body through the nose-like structure on his face; however, most seekers believe he pulls more than air from his enemies. many believe he can consume courage, strength, and power, as well as happiness. dark pharaoh's sandsweep ability lets him glide through the air and fire balls of sand at enemies.

caliban ocean warrior is a krono-titan used by the mermen of atlantis and is the atlantian counterpart of caliban. a golden masked warrior, caliban ocean warrior is the fiercest known warrior of atlantis. instead of a mane of hair, this aquatic warrior sports seaweed which grows from his head.

== history ==
a close cousin of caliban, caliban ocean warrior is often thought to be a product of casterwill magic, created to defend their coastal and sub-oceanic strongholds. in reality, caliban ocean warrior is an entirely original, unaltered titan, who happens to be a powerful warrior titan in such environments. for this reason, they have been collected by casterwill elders for so many centuries. [huntik.com]

the mermen of atlantis invoked three caliban ocean warrior titans during dante vale's test of skill in response to dante's invoking caliban. after dante's metagolem was countered with three coralgolem titans, the mermen explained that they each were able to invoke an equivalent titan to whatever dante summoned. dante's caliban was then defeated by two caliban ocean warrior titans. seeing an opportunity, dante invoked behemoth as legendary titans have no equivalents. the mermen and their titans were defeated when they attempted to do the impossible and invoke an atlantian equivalent to behemoth. [coming of age]

== abilities ==
caliban ocean warrior has many similar abilities to its close cousin, caliban. unpredictable in battle, caliban ocean warrior sports a large, golden harpoon as well as sleek, finned armor. though sacrificing some of the attack power of caliban, the ocean warrior variety possesses heightened defensive abilities. like caliban with the seekers of the rest of the world, caliban ocean warrior's power found these titans in the hand of those who influenced the course of history, namely the casterwill family.

== gallery ==

==trivia==
* despite one of the mermen saying that they had the power to invoke "equivalent" titans to those dante invokes, caliban ocean warrior's stats (6/6) differ from those of caliban (8/4).

speedboats are a type of engine-powered watercraft used by the huntik foundation and the organization for water-based missions. the foundation's speedboats are brown with white stripes while the organization's speedboats are grey with blue stripes. 

== history ==
dante vale and his team used a small speedboat to travel across the seine river in search of the cave of the gargoyle. however they were soon surrounded by gar-ghoul's powerful whirlpools, forcing them to jump to safety as dante crashed the boat into the rocks, destroying it. [into the river of secrets]

in the stavropolous river, the huntik team used another speedboat of the same model as they searched for the argo. [the treasures of the argonauts] 

wilder and his team used two speedboats to travel to avalon, following the huntik team in their blue pontoon boat. [knight of the willblade]

grier's suits would their speedboats to transport supplies from the greek coast to sutos island. one day, the huntik accompanied them in the huntik foundation superyacht so that they could meet with grier and ask him for help. [an ally from the organization]

venice preparatory academy is a prestigious private school established in an ancient abbey in venice, italy. it is the school that lok lambert and sophie casterwill both attended along with their rival, ford.

== history ==
while attending lok sat behind sophie in history the year that the series begins. the year before that he sat behind her in math, and the year before in science. she never noticed him in either of the three classes. lok followed her out of the school to ask for her help on an upcoming test. sophie immediately refused before making a bet that if he could solve her crossword puzzle in less than two minutes then she would help. [a seeker is born] dante picked up lok and sophie after completing their history exam and completing their school year. [the casterwill client]

after the fall of the professor, lok and sophie were scheduled to return to the academy the next day, having effectively missed their summer vacation while on missions for the huntik foundation. [the mission]

following a history class in which lok had fallen asleep, he and sophie were contacted by dante to meet him at the airport. [doorway to huntik] following the re-emergence of the organization under wilder, they were forced to stop attending the school and began receiving home tuition by leblanche. [cave of the casterwills]

the organization uses a number of different vehicles for its missions, with many of them stored in their bases all around the globe. 
== black sedans ==
the most common vehicle of choice for the organization, these cars are used to transport operatives to and from their missions. they are often used for surveillance and espionage, with suits keeping tabs on enemy seekers from afar. 
=== trivia ===
*the black sedans are based on the chrysler 300c touring models.

== choppers ==
combat choppers are large blue helicopters that are used by the organization for aerial combat. they are armed to the teeth with powerful missiles. two of these choppers attacked the huntik team's jet in vienna, austria but were brought down by metagolem and king basilisk respectively. [the bookshop hunter] wilder sent a combat chopper to destroy the huntik team but failed and the chopper exploded. [the tower of nostradamus]

== stealth vessel ==
a large stealth watercraft was used by wilder and his team to travel to the coast of england undetected as they followed the huntik team on their mission to the crystal caves to find the location of avalon. [cave of the casterwills] 

== speedboats ==
speedboats are used for water travel. wilder and his team used these to travel to avalon. grier's suits also use these to bring supplies from the greek mainland to sutos island. [an ally from the organization]

== white automobile ==
a white automobile was used to personally transport wilder to the road of alchemists and, later, to take lok lambert, sophie casterwill and cherit back to organization central. it was destroyed when lok summoned powerbonded baselaird inside it, blowing it apart and sending its driver flying. [chasing void]

the organization sedans are the most common vehicle of choice for the organization, being used for transportation, surveillance and espionage. these black cars are commonly driven by suits to escort their superiors to and from missions, or to spy on enemy seekers from afar. 

== history ==
black sedans are frequently used by the suits all over the globe.

a grey sedan was used to transport defoe and grier prior to their return to prague as they followed the huntik team in their quest to find jodis lore's notes. [the casterwill client]

a white sedan was used to personally transport wilder to the road of alchemists and, later, to take lok lambert, sophie casterwill and cherit back to organization central. it was destroyed when lok summoned powerbonded baselaird inside it, blowing it apart and sending its driver flying. [chasing void]

== design ==
the cars consist of a conventional four-door sedan body with a fixed roof and a separate trunk compartment. the exterior design is characterized by a low-profile silhouette and blacked out windows, giving it an unremarkable civilian appearance that allows them to blend in inconspicuously with their surroundings and assist the organization in spying on enemies. 

=== variants ===
* black sedan – the standard and most frequently seen variant, used by organization agents all over the globe. 
* grey sedan - a grey sedan was used defoe and grier prior to their journey to prague in pursuit of the huntik team. [the casterwill client]
* white sedan – a unique white variant was used by wilder and his team in prague. the car was destroyed when lok lambert summoned powerbonded baselaird from inside the vehicle. [chasing void]

lok lambert's dormitory was where lok resided while attending venice preparation academy, which was located only a few blocks away. due to lok's lifestyle, the dorm was constantly messy with remnants of puzzles that lok had completed lying on his desk. a high shelf ran around the entire room, upon which lok has kept his unopened text books and various artifacts, some collected by his missing father, eathon lambert. unbeknownst to lok, eathon had hidden his journal and kipperin's amulet inside one of the artifacts, leading to the dormitory becoming the unexpected resting place of one of the organization's most sought-after artifacts and the titan that would become his vessel into the seeker world. 

== history ==
it was here that lok became a seeker, discovered his father's journal, made friends with sophie casterwill and was first attacked by the organization, all of which happened within a few seconds of each other. [s1e01] following the organization's attack, lok's dorm was considered to be too unsafe for him to live and he moved into dante vale's house. [s1e02]

the abandoned church in paris was built with a secret passage underneath the bell tower leading to the paris catacombs. the church could be seen from atop the cathedral of notre dame.

== history ==
using hints from joan of arc's notes that they had retrieved in the cave of the gargoyle, the huntik foundation team found the abandoned church by spotting it from the top of the cathedral of notre dame.

the church's bell tower had sunlight streaming down to the floor over the secret entrance into the paris catacombs. a series of mirrors would reflect sunlight at a certain angle to trigger the mechanism. sophie casterwill used these mirrors to reflect a raypulse spell and opened the passage to the catacombs, while defoe and his suits embushed the team. after the passage was opened, they retreated in the caverns by destroying the entrance. youtube is an american video-sharing website headquartered in san bruno, california and founded in 2005. on 27th october 2023, rainbow s.p.a. launched the official youtube channel for the huntik series under the name huntik secrets & seekers and the handle @huntikofficial. the channel began uploading full episodes of the series in hd quality, beginning with the first episode, "a seeker is born". 

== history and timeline ==
each episode was initially uploaded with multi-language audio features, with viewers able to select the audio language of their choice from english, french, german, turkish, spanish, portuguese and russian; however, not every episode has these multi-language audio features, with a lot of them having their audio exclusively in english and, later, french, german, dutch, italian and portuguese. 

the channel later switched to uploading just episodes with the dub of just one language, alternating the uploads of the two seasons between two languages, with the exception of english (first one to be uploaded) and dutch, where both seasons in the respective language were uploaded right after one another. the episode uploads were often separated by 2 days, but with several exceptions. 

on april 16, 2026 it was announced here that merzigo would partner with rainbow to "expand the digital performance of more than 60 of rainbow’s multi-language youtube channels, including [...] huntik: secrets & seekers". a few days later the channel saw a resurgence after more than 9 months without uploads, as well as a change in the style of the title and description of its videos, also now starting to upload shorts. ever since, the channel has uploaded one video every day at 15:00 utc+0 (with the exception of the april 21st compilation video, being uploaded at around 17:00 utc+0).

below is a timeline of the languages and respective seasons being uploaded to the channel.
* 27th october 2023: season 1 and season 2 in english
* 7th may 2024: season 1 in french
* 2nd june 2024: season 1 in german
* 16th august 2024: season 2 in french
* 30th september 2024: season 2 in german
* 15th november 2024: season 1 and season 2 in dutch
* 14th february 2025: season 1 in italian
* 7th april 2025: season 1 in portuguese
* 23rd may 2025: season 2 in italian
* 22nd april 2025, 15:00 utc+0: reupload of season 1 in italian, 22 hours after uploading a 20 minute compilation of the first two episodes

== previous channels ==
huntik: secrets & seekers had previously made its official debut on the platform on the 6th february 2009, under the channel name huntikguggenheim. the channel, launched by upper deck, was designed to tie in with the huntik trading card game and consisted of a number of exclusive videos named dante's huntik tcg tips in which dante vale gives his advice on the best tactics for using different cards. the channel's final video was uploaded on 5th june 2009, called huntik store championships: the professor recruits you! in which the professor explains information of latest huntik tcg competition.

a number of official videos including the huntik tcg tutorial and numerous toy adverts were uploaded on upper deck's international youtube channel in 2009. however, the channel was not solely dedicated to huntik and featured videos from other properties as well. [huntik tcg tutorial]

on 15th may 2012, an official channel was created for huntik by rainbow, named huntiksecretsseekers. however, the channel only featured one upload, the episode knight of the willblade, which since been removed for unknown reasons. this was the last known official huntik channel until october 2023 when rainbow launched its brand new huntikofficial channel. 

==trivia==
*all the full episodes on the 2023 official channel were uploaded in a 16:9 aspect ratio, compared to the series' original 4:3 format.
*the dutch dub of the episode "coming of age" has been made private, despite it initially being uploaded normally on 20th december 2024.
*the channel's most viewed video is the episode "a seeker is born" with audio tracks available in multiple languages, uploaded on 30th october 2023. it stands at over 1 million views as of april 2026.
*the first episode to be uploaded to the channel was the first episode of the show, "a seeker is born", but it was deleted days later and re-uploaded with multi-language audio features. this means that the second episode, "the casterwill client", appears as the very first video on the channel.

*huntikguggenheim channel [https://www.youtube.com/@huntikguggenheim]

the elder rue guardian is the casterwill family elder over curses and secrets. as the head of his house, he leads the other four rue guardians.

== history ==
when the blue star was activated, the elder rue guardian and his house were among the representatives of the casterwill family who met at the fortress of iron will. like focauld casterwill, the elder opposed the presence of lok lambert for not being a member of the family and voted against open confrontation with the blood spiral. [sophie on trial]

during the blood spiral's assault on the fortress of iron will, the rue guardians worked with focauld casterwill an ancient incantation, simultaneously invoking coralgolem, feyone, and icarus amulets within the stronghold. [the spiral war]

==personality==
the rue guardian leads a mysterious and mostly silent order. though lok lambert perceived him as potentially dark, sophie casterwill presumed that, by his familial association, he had good intentions. [sophie on trial]

==abilities==
the rue guardian holds the secret knowledge of the fortress of iron will and the amulets hidden within. together with the rest of his house, the rue guardians are capable of summoning an army of titans from within the fortress to their aid. [s2e40]

jodis lore was a seeker who controlled an amulet of metagolem. he hid the amulet in prague, czech republic, in the golem's attic behind an enchanted door.

== history ==
jodis lore magically enchanted the golem's attic on the road of alchemists so that only his key would be able to open it. [the casterwill client] he then hid the key in his secret room below prague central cemetery. [words of truth, heart of lies] he also left a set of notes documenting his exploration of the lost tomb of nefertiti. [all work and no pay]

jodis lore's notes on the golem were once found by eathon lambert and were then documented in his journal. his son, lok lambert, later found these notes in the journal and provided jodis lore's information to the huntik foundation [the casterwill client]
==trivia==
*jodis lore is based on judah loew, the rabbi who is said to have created the real golem of prague out of clay from the banks of the vltava river.

a holotome is a specialized green-hued tome used by seekers in the huntik foundation. it combines technology and the magic of the spirit world, huntik. it acts like a magic-based computer to store and recall information based on vocal commands. like a computer, they also have the ability to connect to such utilities as e-mail and internet browsing. many of the additional capabilities of the holotome are essential in planning missions.

==communication==
the holotome also allows communication between other holotomes and similar devices, showing holograms of the faces of those communicating or a simple image when communicating via computer or television set. missions are transmitted and received via holotime in this manner, and mission details and goals appear on a mission card for the recipient.

==mapping==

a holotome possesses a limited scanning range, but its ability to store three-dimensional maps and other information to be recalled later. larger maps of buildings, passageways, and dungeons may also be compiled from previous information and retain even minute details that are picked up. [into the river of secrets]

==profiles==

holotomes also store information on all known titans and powers. a holotome can display three-dimensional holograms of titans and contains stat information, titan type, and abilities. new titans may be added to a holotome's database by scanning the titan or its amulet.

a reliquary is a magical chest used to contain cursed artifacts and dangerous amulets.

== history ==
a reliquary was used by the huntik foundation to contain the ring of arc after zhalia's gareon delivered it to the cathedral of notre dame. [divide and conquer]

another reliquary, held by unnamed foundation agent 003, was used to contain rassimov's amulets after he was arrested by the huntik foundation. another was used by lady s. to keep the gold scarabese separate from the others. [rassimov's secret]

huntik:page:26806:
the mud trap is a magical trap set up by jodis lore beneath his tomb in prague central cemetery. it was designed to protect his study, which contained the key for his attic where his titan, metagolem, was hidden. the trap consists of a pool of viscous, mud-like substances capable of forming arms that restrain anyone who falls into it, while also preventing the use of magic. it was activated if someone stepped on any clay other than the lighter-drying clay from the vltava river that was used to create the golem.

== history ==
an overconfident lok lambert fell into jodis lore's mud trap upon a rushed attempt to invoke freelancer against defoe and grier during the team's the golem of prague mission. this caused the trap to also consume sophie casterwill and zhalia moon. lok attempted to summon freelancer a second time, but the trap's arms prevented him and held his head under the water. later, dante vale freed them from the trap after tricking defoe and taking care of the suits sent to "dispose" of the huntik team. [words of truth, heart of lies]

== abilities ==
jodis lore's mud trap is made of a viscous, mud-like substance that can heavily restrain the individuals stuck inside. furthermore, the arms it can create can help in hindering that the victim use their magic, namely titans, by holding their victim's head beneath the mud.[words of truth, heart of lies]

the venice huntik library was built by the huntik foundation to house a portion of their books having to do with seekers, titans, and magic.

== history ==
defoe realized that the huntik group would research the journal, so he had his group of suits find the largest foundation-run library in venice. this was so that he could locate the team and then retrieve the book, not to mention to defeat dante. dante vale, lok lambert, sophie casterwill, santiago, and cherit go there to research the amulet of will and they ended up being led to metagolem and jodis lore. defoe, grier, and a plethora of suits attacked them here, only to be defeated. but, in the battle, sophie dropped a book that also led the organization to metagolem as well. [the casterwill client]

macro polo airport is an airport located in venice, italy.

==history==
dante vale, sophie casterwill, cherit, and lok lambert took a flight at marco polo airport for prague, czech republic, in search of information on the amulet of will. santiago was initially opposed to sophie travelling abroad, but he allowed dante to take her with him after he took a raypulse that was intended for her at the venice huntik library. [the casterwill client]

sophie tried to buy plane tickets for egypt at the airport, but her cards kept getting declined. she was later informed that the organization had blocked all her funds. this led sophie and lok to take part-time jobs to try and pay for the tickets, but dante bought them out of his own pocket for the sake of the mission. [all work and no pay]

huntik:page:26896:
bigfoot is a mysterious wild titan that resides in a snowy mountain range. its appearance is that of a large muscular ape-like creature covered in white fur with large hands and feet while its face is decorated with meso-american tribal markings. 

== history ==
bigfoot roams the snowy mountains, and inspired the myths of the yeti and the abominable snowman in asian mythology. [tcg:sas-168]

the huntik team were given a difficult mission to track down the bigfoot and capture it. 
[tcg:sas-156]

== abilities ==
with its large hands and feet, bigfoot can move across the icy terrain at incredible speeds. its special ability allows it to avoid defeat in combat by escaping from the scene. it also possesses sharp teeth and claws. [tcg:sas-168]

== trivia ==
*bigfoot shares its name with the bigfoot, a forest dwelling creature from north american folklore. its appearance is based off the yeti from asian mythology, a white furred creature associated with snowy, mountainous regions.

bull is a dark-blue taurine titan dressed in chitinous, beetle-like armor. glowing with blue energy, its armor and three silver horns give it a cybernetic, futuristic appearance. as its name bluntly suggests, bull titans are wild elemental forces of primal instinct - chaotic, unruly, and untiring.

== history ==
bull titans are commonly found in pamplona, spain. [tcg:sas-150]

a herd of wild bulls once ran riot during pamplona's famous festival, the running of the bulls, and attacked the bull fighters. the huntik team were given a difficult mission to corral them in order to subdue them. [tcg:sas-150]

== abilities ==
bull titans can charge at opponents with immense speed and impale their enemies with their sharp horns. its "adrenaline surge" ability lets it channel a sudden burst of overwhelming energy, preventing it from tiring and giving it the momentum to take out a target. [tcg:sas-175]

the ghostly bear is a mysterious spectral titan that resides in an abandoned mine. it appears as a phantasmic glowing green bear dressed in wooden geometric armor and decorated with tribal carvings. 

== history ==
like the bear titan breaker, the ghostly bear is tied to the native americans cultures, where the bear was seen as a protector and a bridge between the earthly and spiritual realms.

the ghostly bear guarded a mine shaft in a secluded mine, which made many believe it to be haunted. when the huntik team investigated, they needed to have a consultation with the ghostly bear in order to escape. [tcg:sas-153]

== abilities ==
the ghostly bear's illusory appearance is enough to scare away intruders, giving the mine its haunted reputation. its "mystic consultation" ability allows seekers to come face to face with it and negotiate for their freedom. [tcg:sas-177]

miniatures - also known as 3d miniatures - is a line of collectible titan minifigures and amulets based on season 1 of huntik: secrets & seekers. the line was originally distributed by tridimensional in italy in individual blind bags and sold at italian newsagents. it was subsequently distributed in other european countries by panini and by upper deck in the uk and us. the amulet models could be worn as necklaces, and could also act as display stands for their corresponding titan. 

== release == 
the first wave of the miniatures line was released in italy in february 2009 and consisted of draco-titans and krono-titans, packaged in blind bags. each blind bag came with a corresponding playing card as part of a game that the collectors could play. a second wave of blind bags, consisting of litho-titans and yama-titans, was released in italy september 2009. 

in 2010, a selection of 16 miniatures from the first wave were released in the uk and us by upper deck. the figures were packaged in blister packs of four, with one figure remaining a mystery. the uk 4-packs did not contain the tridimensional cards with the figures, possibly to avoid confusion with upper deck's huntik trading card game. 

in 2011, the line was succeeded by another range of minifigures based on season 2 of the show, this time manufactured and distributed by giochi preziosi, the new toy master for the series. these were the same size and fully compatible with the original range.

rassimov's files are files contained in a dossier with information on rassimov and his weaknesses. they were kept and put together by simon judeau in a hidden safe on his room inside his castle. according to grier and dante vale, the professor suspected rassimov's betrayal of the organization, explaining why he would want to keep tabs on him and store the information. after acquiring the files, the huntik team made use of the information inside them to elaborate a plan to capture rassimov.

== history ==
when the huntik team came to sutos island to ask grier's help in defeating the blood spiral, he said he could assist them in raiding the professor's castle to potentially get information on the spiral's leader, rassimov. grier and dante agreed that the professor was no fool and must have been at least partially aware of rassimov's betrayal of the organization, and was probably keeping files on him. upon getting to the castle, wilder revealed that he also wanted the files, but to blackmail the spirals to work for him instead of defeating them. as the team out powered him and hoffman, lok lambert and den fears retrieved the files from within a hidden safe in the professor's room. [an ally from the organization]

after metz received the files, the foundation was able to work out a battle plan to capture rassimov given the information contained inside them, part of the eye of the storm mission. the mission was initially successful as the team ambushed rassimov by the tomb of tutankhamun, countering his every move with coordinated attacks, which resulted in him being restrained and taken away in a huntik foundation vehicle. however, disaster struck when harrison fears freed rassimov, who invoked legion, a legendary titan hidden inside his body. the team managed to escape, but only after severe damage was already done. [rassimov's secret]

the casterwill townhouse is where sophie casterwill, santiago and leblanche live in venice, italy.

==layout==
the townhouse features a tea room, several bedrooms, a balcony, a china room, and a study room.

== history ==
sophie casterwill took lok lambert and dante vale to stay in her townhouse after they fled from dante's house in order to escape defoe, grier, and the suits. lok and dante continued to stay there for some time as dante's house and lok's dormitory were under surveillance by the organization. [the casterwill client]

after sophie's credit card was declined at the marco polo airport, the team gathered at the casterwill townhouse to find a way to conduct their mission in egypt. lok and sophie decided to make money with part time jobs to be able to pay the plane tickets and give a salary to dante. after repeated failures, dante joined them at the townhouse and let them know he had gathered money with private detective gigs and had bought plane tickets for all of them. [all work and no pay]

lok and cherit were fencing in the townhouse's china room while sophie was trying to master the spell findshape. they ended up breaking a vase which enraged sophie, and were promptly kicked out of the house. but the event suddenly allowed sophie to master the spell, and she was able to repair both the broken vase and eathon lambert's journal. [the unseen guide]

the atlantis guardian is an enchantment left by casterwill seekers to protect the casterwill compound located in the center of atlantis, as well as the amulet of will, contained inside the building. he is a self-thinking magical trap that also introduces the tests of bravery, prowess, intelligence and nobility that must be passed to enter the compound.

== history ==
dante vale, lok lambert, sophie casterwill and zhalia moon encountered the guardian when trying to enter into the center building of the atlantis city, in their search for the amulet of will. he respectively introduced each member of the team to the tests of bravery, prowess, intelligence and nobility. upon them passing the tests, he started following lok's wishes of when to open and close the magical gate to the compound, assisting lok in his fight against rassimov. the atlantis guardian also told lok that he hasn't opened the gate in more than ten thousand years, indicating that his dad didn't reach that far. later, he led the team to the lowest chamber of the building, containing the amulet of will. he also explained the 500-year war against the nullifiers through a painting depicting lord casterwill in the process. [coming of age]

== personality ==
despite not being a human, the atlantis guardian appears to act exactly like one in many ways. he could sense when zhalia was feeling uneasy before her test of nobility, and seemed genuinely sorry when he discovered that lok's father hadn't made it far enough to pass the gate. he also appeared surprised when dante passed the test of prowess by tricking the mermen into trying to replicate the power of a legendary titan. he generally interacts with those trying to enter the compound in a formal manner, calling sophie "lady casterwill" and zhalia moon "young miss". [coming of age]

== abilities ==
the atlantis guardian is not a seeker, but in actuality a magical trap with the power to open the gate of the casterwill compound of the city of atlantis by the click of his fingers, preventing anyone from entering the compound. this gate could send a titan back to their amulet if they closed on one, as seen with anubian. the guardian appears to follow the orders of whoever passed the tests on whether to open or close the gate. he also had the power to create sentient beings such as mermen, which he inserted into the test of prowess. he possesses deep knowledge in casterwill history, particularly on the war against the nullifiers. [coming of age]
