paris, france

lok and the huntik team have found joan of arc's hiding place and follow her notes to find the powerful ring of the arc. the professor, evil leader of the organization, is on their trail, thanks to defoe, his henchman. a race against the clock to find the ring starts. the huntik team wins but they find out that the ring is cursed and the organization is getting closer and closer.

==synopsis==
dante vale, lok lambert, sophie casterwill, and zhalia moon must navigate the catacombs and get the cursed ring to a huntik safehouse before thirty minutes pass or the organization will manage to take control of the ring for evil purposes. while attempting to escape, lok finds clues similar to those is in his father's journal.

== plot ==
sophie binds the ring of arc's curse with a banebound spell, but the spell will only last about thirty minutes. the team has to get it to a huntik foundation specialist before the curse can harm anyone else unfortunately, defoe has called on every suit in paris to block the exits from the catacombs so that he'll be sure to get the prize! zhalia provides fake copies of the ring using her disguise kit, and the group splits up having a ring each. doing so improves their chances of escaping with the real ring. while they each make their way, lok finds a case with some archaeology tools while another locked case that springer opens is found to have some kind of map.

even with all their efforts, one by one, they're all captured. but all four members of dante's group are revealed to have carried only fake rings. then, dante reveals that the real ring of arc was given to gareon, who sneaked out of the catacombs invisibly. defoe retreats, and, back at organization headquarters, the mysterious rassimov tells him that the professor is furious. defoe has beens suspended from his duties and is lucky to have not been "terminated" by the professor yet. in defoe's secret laboratory, he swears vengeance on dante vale in a fit of rage.

== trivia ==
*lok and cherit discover the words "liberté, égalité, fraternité" ("liberty, equality, brotherhood"), france's national motto which found its origins in the french revolution.
*the episode features a double foreshadowing: 
**while casting banebound on the ring, sophie suffers traumatic visions of past and future events. those include include a scene of zhalia punching her, which would occur in the episode "the vampire loses its fangs", and a scene of sabriel's death, which would occur in the episode "the mission".
**sophie's visions are unknowingly inflicted on her by arc, the legendary titan contained inside the ring, the existence of which will only be discovered in season 2's episode "the legendary titan of fate".

the huntik action figures are a range of fully articulated figures based on season 1 of huntik: secrets & seekers. they were manufactured by big bocca and released by upper deck in december 2009, being sold in the uk, us and across europe. the range consisted of three lines, the seeker figures, the titan figures and the titan deluxe figures. 

== development and unreleased figures ==
upper deck's huntik toy line was developed based on the early episodes of season 1 of the television series. the range consisted of three waves, the 6" seeker figures, the 6" titan figures and the larger titan deluxe figures which were 8"-9" in size. the line began rolling out at the end of 2009, being sold in the uk, us and in italy and europe. 

several figures that were planned and designed for the line were ultimately cancelled and never mass produced. the most notable of these was the sophie casterwill action figure which never made it past the prototype stage, making her the only original main character not to have a figure released. a fully completed suit prototype modelled on mr. koskin was also produced, but, again, never went into mass production. nevertheless, both figures were still advertised on the back of the seeker figures packaging. 

for the titan figures, a fully completed figure of freelancer was produced, but never went into mass production. it was nevertheless advertised on the back of the titan figures packaging. it would have included lance and shield accessories and a cut-out amulet. an ammit heart-eater figure was also fully sculpted and painted but never mass produced. this figure was never advertised or listed on product packaging, suggesting that several more figures were planned for additional waves of the line that were based on some of the later episodes of the first season. 

upper deck would later discontinue its huntik merchandise the following year, and while no official explanation was ever given for this, it can be attributed to the toy line's release coinciding with the company's growing financial difficulties and eventual bankruptancy. 

in 2011, a new line of lights & sounds action figures was released by giochi preziosi, the new toy master, for season 2. these figures were of the same scale as the upper deck figures and thus served as a spiritual successor to the original 2009 line.

upper deck's huntik toy line was developed based on the early episodes of season 1 of the television series. the range consisted of three waves, the 6" seeker figures, the 6" titan figures and the larger titan deluxe figures which were 8"-9" in size. the line began rolling out at the end of 2009, being sold in the uk, us and in italy and europe. 

several figures that were planned and designed for the line were ultimately cancelled and never mass produced. the most notable of these was the sophie casterwill action figure which never made it past the prototype stage, making her the only original main character not to have a figure released. a fully completed suit prototype modelled on mr. koskin was also produced, but, again, never went into mass production. nevertheless, both figures were still advertised on the back of the seeker figures packaging. 

for the titan figures, a fully completed figure of freelancer was produced, but never went into mass production. it was nevertheless advertised on the back of the titan figures packaging. it would have included lance and shield accessories and a cut-out amulet. an ammit heart-eater figure was also fully sculpted and painted but never mass produced. this figure was never advertised or listed on product packaging, suggesting that several more figures were planned for additional waves of the line that were based on some of the later episodes of the first season. 

upper deck would later discontinue its huntik merchandise the following year, and while no official explanation was ever given for this, it can be attributed to the toy line's release coinciding with the company's growing financial difficulties and eventual bankruptancy. 

in 2011, a new line of lights & sounds action figures was released by giochi preziosi, the new toy master, for season 2. these figures were of the same scale as the upper deck figures and thus served as a spiritual successor to the original 2009 line.

the lights & sounds action figures are a line of fully articulated figures produced by giochi preziosi in 2011, based on season 2 of huntik: secrets & seekers. the line was made up of three electronic powerbonded titan figures which all featured unique lights and sound effects activated by inserting an amulet into its back. 

== development ==
when giochi preziosi took over from upper deck in 2011 as the master toy licensor of the huntik series, they began producing a range of products for the second season. for the lights & sound figures, each figure has a motion sensor and will make the lights and sounds if moved. each titan can pronounce its name and produce lights in different ways. 

the figures were a spiritual successor to the season 1 action figures released by upper deck and are the same size and scale, allowing them to be compatible with each other.

the titan amulet launchers are a line of spring loaded launcher toys released released by giochi preziosi in 2011, based on season 2 of huntik: secrets & seekers. they are centered on being wearable amulet devices that physically launch small titan figures. 

== design ==
each titan amulet launcher is shaped like a titan amulet and opens on a hinge. inside sits a compact titan figurine, posed in a seated or braced position. when the activation switch or button is pressed, the amulet springs open and propels the titan forward, simulating the summoning of a titan from the amulet seen in the tv series. a molded clip on the back allows the launcher to be attached to a belt or waistband for role-play, combining portable play with interactive action features.

the organization stealth ship is a large, silver maritime vessel used by the organization to transport operatives for missions across open water. 

== history ==
the stealth ship was used by wilder and his men to travel to the coast of england undetected as they followed the huntik team on their mission to the crystal caves to find the location of avalon. it was stationed near the cliffs, as wilder and stack plotted to attack the huntik team. [cave of the casterwills]

wilder's team later used the stealth ship in japan, travelling across the ocean in preparation for them diving down to find the underwater city of yonaguni. [the guardian of yonaguni]

== design ==
the stealth ship has an angular geometric design, with flat surfaces, and a minimal superstructure to allow it go undetected by radar and sonar. the vessel sits low in the water and lacks exposed railings or equipment, giving it a discreet and utilitarian appearance. its visual design is consistent with the other advanced vehicles used by the organization.

== general questions ==
: q: do i start with 5 cards in my opening hand or 6?
:: a: the starting hand size is 5. there was a typo on the seeker training manual.

: q: on my turn can i bring a hero into play and then move the hero and declare a combat?
:: a: no. on your turn, you may take only one of the following actions:
:# play a hero from your hand onto the mission map (remember: only 1 major hero per round).
:# move one of your ready heroes already on the mission map (if you move into a zone with an enemy hero, you may start a combat).
:# use and exhaust an exhaust or free action power written on one of your heroes on the mission map.
:# play an exhaust or free action card from your hand.
:# pass, by telling your opponent you do not want to make any plays.

: q: at the end of my turn i have a lot of cards in my hand. do i need to discard down to a certain number?
:: a: no. there is no maximum hand size.

: q: are major heroes unique?
:: a: no. there is no uniqueness in huntik. you could have up to 3 copies of the same major hero (such as dante vale) in play, and your opponent could also have up to 3 copies of that same hero.

: q: what happens when i have no more cards in my deck?
:: a: you simply stop being able to draw cards. you do not lose the game for having no cards left.

: q: at the start of the round (after round 1), what happens first?
:: a: at the start of each round (after round 1), both players perform the following steps in order:
:# unstun any stunned heroes and obstacles.
:# ready all exhausted cards.
:# draw 2 cards.
:# resolve “start of the round” effects.

: q: if both players have heroes in the same zone, can the turn player move forward?
:: a: no. enemy heroes block movement. a hero cannot move forward past a zone containing an enemy hero unless it has unblockable.

: q: if player a has a hero in zone 5 and player b plays a hero into zone 1 (player a’s zone 5), can player b start a combat that turn?
:: a: no. player b must wait until her next turn, then move her hero 0 zones, exhaust it, and declare combat.

: q: is picking up an object considered the player’s action for the turn?
:: a: yes. picking up an object is a free action, and once an object is picked up, that completes the player’s turn.

: q: avoidance — if avoidance is played and later in the round a new hero enters play, is that hero unblockable?
:: a: yes. avoidance affects all friendly heroes for the entire round, even heroes that were not in play when avoidance was activated.

== card-specific questions ==

: q: if i played caliban and have no cards in hand at the end of the round, do i still draw before resolving his effect?
:: a: yes. you draw cards before “start of the round” effects activate. caliban’s effect (“at the start of each round, discard a card or eliminate me”) resolves after drawing cards.

: q: on the mission retrieve vlad’s amulets, is discarding a major hero to pay antedeluvian’s mercenary power my action for the turn?
:: a: yes. it is a free action.

: q: antedeluvian has the always on power undying and cannot be ko’d. if he would normally be ko’d in combat, is he stunned instead?
:: a: no. the undying power prevents antedeluvian from being ko’d entirely. he survives the combat and is neither ko’d nor stunned.

mechanical megataur is a bull simulator amusement ride based on huntik: secrets & seekers, located at the magicland theme park (formerly known as rainbow magicland). the attraction consists of a large mechanical model of megataur that wildly moves about when ridden. it was designed by the company show games and opened in 2015. it one of three huntik-themed attractions at the theme park, along with the huntik 5d and yucatan/huntik spillwater rides. 

== design == 
the model was hand-crafted by the company show games, and designed to resemble the titan megataur, as he appeated in the tv series. the simulator is equipped with advanced safety features, including a rope sensor that requires the operator to pull it to start, an inflatable sensor that stops the ride if pressure is incorrect, and a door sensor.

the prague central cemetery is located in prague, czech republic, and was a primary location of the mission, the golem of prague. the ancient seeker, jodis lore, had a secret study here containing the key to the golem's attic on the road of alchemists.

== history ==
dante vale, lok lambert, and sophie casterwill were assigned to search prague central cemetery and were joined by zhalia moon.

at the cemetery, the team investigated the tomb of jodis lore. by rubbing clay on the tombstone and printing the symbol for 'truth' on the clay, a secret passageway was opened into jodis lore's secret base.

inside, the team found a room with a trapped floor made of two types of clay: a light native clay from the vltava river and a darker imported clay. when the organization showed up, lok inadvertently stepped on a patch of dark clay, activating enchanted pits of clay with magical hands that restrained and pulled down the trespassers.

with the huntik team incapacitated, defoe's kreutalk entered the secret study and retrieved jodis lore's key to the golem's attic and notes from the nearby study. however, zhalia was able to create a copy thanks to an imprint left by the key on the table. [words of truth, heart of lies].

while they stayed on the island, zhalia studied the illusion magic taught by the tablet and was able to learn thoughtspecter. [like father, unlike son]

geoffrey crayon is an elderly resident of the town of sleepy hollow who discovered his seeker powers by chance after finding the amulet of headless hessian near his town. 

== history ==
geoffrey discovered the abandoned amulet of headless hessian by chance on the old battlefield near sleepy hollow and tried to use the titan to ward off developers and buyers from turning the battlefield into houses. however, he could not control it and, despite not wanting to hurt anyone, his titan began causing havoc and attacking people at night, leading to police reports of a headless horseman terrorising the town. 

the case led to the huntik foundation and the organization coming to the town to investigate and ensure the seeker world was not exposed. ford and gregor attempted to convince geoffrey to join the organization and give them the titan, but geoffrey refused. lok lambert and sophie casterwill eventually managed to convince geoffrey to stop using the titan and help them stop the organization. by leaving headless hessian's sword for gregor to use and lok dropping the titans' helmet on his head, they succesfully framed him for the attacks, leaving him to be arrested by the town's police. after using his headless hessian to save lok from ford and his frostanna, geoffrey then gave headless hessian's amulet to dante, confident that he would find a better use for the titan. [the headless horseman]

== personality ==
geoffrey was a kind man who was patriotic and proud of his town and its history. in attempting to protect the old battlefield, he accidentally caused his newly found titan run riot, but never intended to harm anybody. {source|the headless horseman}}

== abilities ==
as a rare case of a seeker realising his powers extremely late in life, geoffrey does not possess any skills in spell casting and struggled to control his headless hessian titan. {source|the headless horseman}}
===bonded titans===

ignatius is a titan based on the element of fire. it is similar to a moving body of lava which is always ablaze. it can get incredibly hot, and produce great amounts of light. both dante vale and kiel possess an ignatius amulet.

== history ==
ignatius titans are incredibly common in chile, as they commonly appear around the volcanoes, but are rare to see outside of chile. apparently, when a weak seeker tried to summon an ignatius, the seeker lost control, and the ignatius rampaged. it took three water-based titans to extinguish the flames and defeat the ignatius. [huntik.com]

=== dante's ignatius ===
dante acquired an ignatius amulet while on an expedition to chile. [huntik.com]

dante brought ignatius specially on a mission to iceland, where it was used to melt ymir's ice creature army. dante later used it together with lok's kipperin to make a ring of fire in the air in order to help form the rainbow bridge to thor's temple. [the legacy of thor]

while infiltrating klaus' bookshop, dante called upon ignatius again. this time, ignatius was used to burn away a swarm of mutant flying spiders created by klaus, while dante and his team were protected by the spell chillskin. [the bookshop hunter]

ignatius was summoned yet again for a fight against the professor due to being immune to araknos' mind control. it, with the aid of zhalia moon, tried to keep araknos under control; however, when tao managed to overpower the titans attacking it, it was able to send ignatius back to its amulet. [the mission]

whilst exploring cortés' vault with metagolem, dante invoked ignatius to defend him from hernán cortés' traps. [gremlow infestation!]

upon arriving at the castle of vlad dracul, dante summoned ignatius to stop tantras from gaining the power of the heart of vlad dracul. by using copykind, dante used ignatius' burn ability to distract tantras and defeat powerbonded antedeluvian. [lok's leadership] 

=== kiel's ignatius ===
another ignatius titan was used by kiel when attempting to steal the secrets of the casterwill family from focauld casterwill. it fought against leblanche's albion before being sent by his amulet by an energy wave from the huntik foundation jet's power amplifier. [the casterwill connection]

== abilities ==
ignatius are capable of creating and controlling fire, and are always ablaze. this grants them immunity, or a certain protection from some attacks. he also has a considerable physical strength. he can breathe fire, which is capable of destroying hoards of small insects [the bookshop hunter]. being made of fire, he is also immune to araknos' mind controlling webs. [the mission]

== design history ==
ignatius' original concept was a stout titan composed entirely of molten rock with an orange and red glow through his cooler stone shell. because ignatius was not intended to be an aggressive titan, he was given a more rotund, softer appearance in order to look less mean. [huntik.com]

ignatius.jpg|ignatius

== trivia ==
* his summoning commands are "burn," "invoke," and "incinerate."
* ignatius is based on the latin word ignitus which means "to set on fire."
* in episode 24, "the secret of two generations," caliban's icon and amulet were erroneously depicted when dante invokes ignatius.

fireblade is a ninja-like yama-titan who uses its stealth and fiery abilities in battle.

== history ==
a fireblade used its acrobatic skills to jump over an allied brahe titan during a skirmish. [sas-031]

== abilities ==
fireblade is a very skilled martial artist, knowing fighting styles of the ninja and being incredibly acrobatic. in addition to that he also wields two very sharp blades. his body is comprised of flames so he can eject flames at will.

== design history ==
fireblade initially was designed as a smoke-themed ninja. due to the similarities to shinobi in the rough sketch, the original design was scrapped to redesign this titan as a fire-themed ninja. fireblade then was given red clothing, fiery eyes, and flames on his sword. as a ninja, he was designed to be fast and acrobatic instead of having raw power. archwarder resembles a plant with a giant, wilted, bloomed flower and three strong roots as legs. it is the ultimate defense against the legendary titans, as this plant-based titan is able to counter even the legendary titans' unique abilities and to level the playing field for archwarder's seeker.

==history ==
archwarder's amulet was given to rassimov by the professor ahead of his plan to attack dante vale's house. rassimov then invoked him during the battle between the professor, dante, and lok lambert, in order to disrupt tao and behemoth, making them impossible to invoke. [the secret of two generations] when the team raided the professor's castle, rassimov pretended to lose in combat against dante vale so that the amulet of archwarder could be picked up by dante. [the divine comedy]

in line with rassimov's intentions, archwarder was then used by dante against overlos to allow the puppeteer ability of dendras to overpower the professor's control of the titan of immortality. these actions led to the defeat of the professor as well as a weakening in the influence and power of the organization. [the mission]

during a later battle in klaus' laboratory upon the discovery of the amulet of the nullifier, void, dante used archwarder to disrupt the blood spiral titan shakrit. however, the newly-returned rassimov callously used darkvoid to destroy archwarder and his amulet. [the blood spiral]

== abilities ==
 loses control of overlos as the surge of energy hits the amulet of will]]

[lgs-094]. his disruption pulse ability makes opposing seekers lose control of high powered titans. the more powerful the opposing titan, the more susceptible it is to the ability. this can be manifested as an energy wave emitting in all directions, making it so when it comes into contact with the amulet of a titan, the titan and its amulet to surge with energy and for the seeker to lose its control [the mission]; however, the surge of energy can also be more focused and be targeted at either the titan itself [the blood spiral] or its amulet (preventing the titan from being summoned in the first place) [the secret of two generations], emerging either through archwarder's hands or mouth.

paris, france 

down in the french catacombs, lok and the huntik team have the ring of the arc, a powerful but cursed magic object. they have thirty minutes to take it to a hideout of the huntik foundation, and the organization has blocked all the exits. when there seems to be no more hope, dante comes up with the idea to fluster defoe and his suits with fake rings in order to put them off the scent.

== synopsis ==
the huntik foundation team is sent on a mission to gain control of mjolnir, a mystical weapon once used by thor, an ancient seeker. however, the organization is believed to have spies among the guardians of thor. they must seek additional help from tersly, a foundation researcher, and montehue, the number two foundation seeker under dante vale himself.

== plot ==
guggenheim gives the team a mission to find the hammer of thor, the norse god of thunder, hidden somewhere in iceland. dante takes them to see tersley, a seeker who has information about the hammer, and then they fly to iceland, where it is very cold. they receive word that the hammer is guarded by a small cult of people who still worship the norse gods. not only that, but the organization has infiltrated the cult.

as the team approaches the old temple where the hammer is hidden, the cultists summon ymir, a giant titan made of ice, and send him to attack them. dante uses his ignatius titan to hold off ymir until the others can temporary trap the giant. after they trap ymir, the group proceeds to the temple, where they team up with tersley and his boss montehue, who is also looking for the hammer. expecting a fight with the temple’s cultists, the team is confused when the cultists welcome them inside. however, the cultists suddenly lock the door behind them.

mjolnir was initially wielded by the seeker thor. it made him so powerful that he was worshiped as a god. it was made of pure lightning, according to norse mythology. tersly theorized that it was used by lord casterwill in the ancient war against the nullifiers.

mjolnir was finally uncovered by montehue upon winning a contest with dante vale to be the first to reach it. a few moments after montehue grasped it, the hammer was much heavier than it should have been. finally setting aside their rivalry, dante and montehue together managed to spin and throw mjolnir into the chest of ymir to instantly defeat the powerful titan. [two powers become one] 

on the longest night of the year, mjolnir was borrowed from hq by momax and was later used by him and montehue together to defeat wind and shakrit. [dante's return]

spidertouch is a spell that allows the casting seeker to cling to any surface, regardless of the material that it is made of. when it is cast, a sticky, web-like substance extends out of the fingertips of the caster and connects with whatever the seeker is trying to cling to. spidertouch can also allow the seeker to shoot out a web to either entangle an opponent or create a web to keep the seeker from falling. these abilities make this spell handy for grappling and immobilizing.

== history ==
dante vale used spidertouch to cling onto ymir during the mission the hammer of thor, making the giant titan fall into a nearby canyon. [the legacy of thor] inside a ship belonging to atlanta sunk in the stavropolous river, dante vale used this spell once again to grab the sword of saint george from defoe's hands, with which he was holding sophie casterwill hostage. [the treasures of the argonauts]

in the outskirts of vienna, austria, dante vale used spidertouch with the help of hyperstride to grab onto an organization helicopter trying to stop them from entering klaus' bookshop. with the spell's help, dante is able to stay firmly gripped to the helicopter and invoke metagolem, bringing it down. [the bookshop hunter]

at some point, leblanche used spidertouch to restrain two suits. [tcg:sas-114]

lok lambert used the spell to fight off a pair of thugs when looking for den fears in the streets of venice, restraining one of them to a nearby log. [boys will be seekers] it was later used by lok to save himself from falling from a narrow bridge, part of the trial of courage inside the fortress of iron will. [sophie on trial]

guggenheim used this spell in conjunction with ironhand to break apart a wooden plank from the ceiling of the hamelin cathedral, falling onto several gremlow titans. [gremlow infestation!]

dante vale and den fears both used an orange aura spidertouch spell to restrain shauna during a surprise attack inside the phoenix volcano. [the phoenix's ashes] den later used the spell once again to stop cherit from eating a loaf of bread den wanted to eat during the team's rest at the lambert house. [back home]

== trivia ==
* lok lambert's use of spidertouch in episode 36, "boys will be seekers" is an allusion to spider-man.

* when dante vale and den fears use the spell in the episode "the phoenix's ashes", its aura is orange instead of the usual blue.

bristlebind is a spell that causes a number of thorny vines to grow out of the ground and then wrap around an opposing target. these vines not only cause damage due to the thorns but also restrict movement. it is manifested initially as a beam of red energy on the seeker's hand, which then produces the vines. the vines can either be projected directly from the beam or from a surface with which the beam makes contact.

== history ==
bristlebind was used by dante vale to bind the legs of ymir in search of the temple of thor. the giant titan tumbled but was able to get up after a few seconds, giving the huntik team some time to get away from it. [the legacy of thor]

dante vale used the spell in an attempt to slow down grier when they were fighting one-on-one in sutos island. [like father, unlike son]

on the huntik team's way to the golden asp, lok lambert used bristlebind in combination with zhalia moon's darkfog spell to flip an organization car who was following them multiple times. darkfog made it so the driver couldn't see the incoming vines. [the golden asp]

marduk also used this spell to ensnare dante vale's metagolem in mexico during the search for the ring of quetzalcoatl. metagolem struggled for a short moment, but he was quickly able to break the vines and take out an harlekin titan attacking him. [the titan in the temple of sun]

lane used bristlebind to restrain one of many silent soldiers in a massive war against the blood spirals by the fortress of iron will.[the spiral war]

this spell was used by dante vale in conjunction with stopglue to heavily detain hoffman when the two were fighting in the professor's castle. [an ally from the organization]

scarlet byrne used bristlebind to bind the legs of a firbolg titan the huntik team encountered when exploring tír na nóg. this allowed sophie casterwill and kaioh the tracker to freely strike the titan, taking him out. [back home]

ymir the frost giant is a colossal litho-titan similar metagolem. ymir is used by the guardians of thor to protect the temple of thor and thor's mystic hammer, mjolnir. the guardians use the incantation of asgard in order to invoke him from his amulet and to control him.

== history ==
ymir inspired the norse legend of the first frost giant, also known as aurgelmir, whose name meant "gravel-yeller" due to his rough voice. said to be older than the world itself, he was the father of all other frost giants which were formed from his own body. according to the legend, ymir fought against odin, the father of thor, before the earth's creation. ymir later came back while odin was in the odin sleep and fought against thor. [wikipedia:ymir]

the titan, ymir, later was invoked by the guardians of thor to attack dante vale and his team. ymir summoned an army of ice creatures and frost minions. his ice creatures were defeated by dante vale's ignatius while ymir, himself, was sent plummeting off of the cliff by a combined effort by lok lambert and sophie casterwill. ymir's frost minions were later defeated on the rainbow bridge by dante's team, who were joined by montehue and his assistant, tersly. [the legacy of thor] ymir later returned to the temple, but quickly was defeated by dante and montehue using mjolnir. [two powers become one]

== abilities ==
ymir has a base attack of 6 and a defense of 5. he is capable of creating an army of ice creatures and frost minions to fight at his side. even if the enemy is able to get past this army, ymir himself is both very durable and very powerful. however, due to his size, ymir is also slow and clumsy much like the metagolem titans. [the legacy of thor]

== design history ==
ymir was based on the first frost giant in norse mythology, who was said to create the other frost giants from his own body. his power was designed after that of the glacier, slow yet unstoppable, and uses the power of ice. the icicles and stalactites were designed in the shape of a crown to symbolize ymir's being the king of the frost giants. [huntik.com]

ice creatures are goblins of ice who serve ymir, the king of the frost giants. along with the frost minion titans, ymir is capable of summoning an army of these titans to do battle. they are so cold that, when defeated, they explode in a shower of ice crystals.

== history ==
the vikings believed in beings known as frost giants and their king named aurgelmir, or ymir for short. in norse mythology, the frost giants fought alongside ymir against thor's father, odin, before the creation of the world. thor later had to fight off ymir in order to protect the realm of asgard while his father was in the odin sleep.

when dante vale's team investigated the temple of thor, ymir was summoned by the guardians of thor to create an army of ice creatures and frost minions to deter the progress of the huntik foundation. the ice creatures were defeated by dante's ignatius. [the legacy of thor]

== abilities ==
though comparatively weak on their own, the ice creatures' power lies in their numbers. summoned by ymir, a whole army of ice creatures may be created at once to overwhelm the opponent. the terrestrial ice creatures tend to be invoked alongside the aerial frost minion titans for almost complete coverage of the terrain.

venadek is an odd little titan. researchers at the huntik foundation are still unsure as to whether these titans are to be considered rats, goblins, lizards, scorpions, or some chimera of them all. despite their size, venadek titans are fierce in battle as well as loyal to their seekers.

== history ==
much of the history of venadek is currently known. one is used by tersly to support montehue in battle whenever tersly is scared into a corner. venadek was summoned by tersly on the rainbow bridge in order to defend against ymir's ice creatures. [the legacy of thor]

terly used venadek outside king solomon's mines to help fight against the three colossi guardians, ashtoreth, milcom and chemosh, now under the control of the professor. venadek assisted sophie casterwill's icarus in stunning milcom before helping caliban defeat him. venadek later fought against the organization outside the vault of tao, the legendary titan of spirit. he defended sophie from an enforcer but was later seen backed into a corner by kopesh and enforcer. [to be together]

on the island of the phoenix, tersly invoked venadek in a desperate attempt to scare off a lioness after the anti-magic field of the loadstone was finally lifted. [the dead magic island]

a venadek titan is also known to be in the possession of the organization seeker and "sand snake", omeed. [lgs-023]

== abilities ==
venadek is capable of ranged attacks and quick blows, and this titan can pounce into the air with great speed. his blades grown from his arms can slice through thick material ranging from ice [the legacy of thor] to tree trunks. [the dead magic island] he is also capable of firing energy beams from his eyes. [to be together] his scorpion-like tail also packs a punch.

* venadek's summoning commands are "help", come out and fight", "help us" and "help me". it typically consists of tersly calling the titan's name multiple times in a panicked voice.
* venadek's appearance may be based on the manticore due to its scorpion tail. its name may come from the word venadik, which is turkish for venice.

montehue is the huntik foundation's second highest ranked seeker. he is also a close friend of dante vale's having formed their friendship through a rivalry. montehue's assistant, tersly, tends to accompany montehue on missions.

== history ==
 in retrieving mjolnir]]
montehue, a devoted student of the history of war, was a treasure hunter, and he learned of his seeker abilities when he and dante raced to get an artifact in death valley. during the race, dante gave him a tolivane amulet as a way of keeping things fair by sneaking it into his jacket pocket. as soon as his hand touched the amulet, montehue discovered the world of seekers. [two powers become one]

montehue accompanied dante on the mission to the temple of thor in iceland to recover mjolnir, the hammer of thor, despite dante's wishes. [the legacy of thor] inside the temple, montehue saved lok lambert as the main room collapsed. he then told lok of his and dante's history and how they were friends through competition. montehue managed to best dante and win the prized hammer, mjolnir, but, after listening to lok, decided to set aside his rivalry in order to work with dante and use the hammer to defeat ymir. after escaping with the hammer, montehue was given the amulet of fenris by dante, who figured that montehue's character was very close to that of the titan's ancient seeker, thor. [two powers become one]

montehue later came to dante's rescue outside king solomon's mines, saving him from chemosh. after working together to defeat the three colossi, he and tersly joined the team as they ventured into the mines to retrieve the ring of the legendary titan of spirit, tao, from within king solomon's mines. montehue helped dante and metagolem make a way through the trapped mines before bravely holding off the organization while the team tried to enter the vault. after escaping from the professor, montehue battled alongside the team before lok succeeded to invoke tao. [to be together]

shortly after the fall of the professor, montehue took part in congratulating dante and his team on the victory as well as celebrating a major victory for the huntik foundation. [the mission]

montehue and tersly later assisted dante's team on their mission to find the legendary titan, phoenix. he fought beside dante against the casterwill hunters before journeying into a labyrinth and destroying an anti-magic lodestone. [the dead magic island] he later held off the blood spiral forces to give dante's team time to make their way into the phoenix volcano and retrieve the legendary ring. [the phoenix's ashes]
]]
on the longest night of year, montehue joined a call between the huntik foundation council and dante's team to plan their offensive on the spiral mark. [words from eathon] he later joined metz on the scramjets to the blood spiral base. [the spiral mark] montehue was left devastated when the betrayer revealed that dante was dead but, inspired by the words of lok lambert, he joined the foundation and casterwill family in their final battle against the spirals. during the battle, he met scarlet byrne who appeared to make quite the impression on him. [lok and the betrayer] upon seeing wind and shakrit demolishing the scramjets, montehue climbed aboard and worked with momax to launch mjolnir into the shakrit, defeating it and its seeker. after the defeat of the betrayer, montehue was seen celebrating the victory with the rest of the foundation and casterwill members. one month later, montehue returned to spiral mark as he and clements tried to make sense of the data. however, unbeknownst to him, the mark began to flash, calling out across the galaxy to something far away. [dante's return]

== personality ==

montehue is fiercely competitive, showing as such in his incredible confidence, viewing almost everything as a competition. he is however, honorable, jovial, very kindhearted and dependable despite coming second to dante vale in skill as a seeker. his courage, also, is second to none, risking his life to save others and never hesitating to act when needed. [two powers become one] [dante's return] he and dante admire one another's skills greatly and make an exceptional team when fighting side by side. [the dead magic island] his value for dante as a friend was seen in his tearful reaction to news of his death. [lok and the betrayer] montehue also enjoys fighting as shown when he and tersly were fighting a group of silent soldiers. he also seems happy that his assistant doesn't fight because that leaves more enemies for himself. [the phoenix's ashes] as a student of the history of war, montehue has a passion for collecting historical artifacts for his museum collection. [to be together] 

== abilities ==
]]
montehue is incredibly strong, utilizing two battle axes as his primary weapons in combat. his physical strength is great enough that he sometimes has difficulty controlling it and sometimes hurts others without meaning to do so. he also uses his seeker abilities to cast spells which enhance his physical characteristics, such as the powerful dragonfist. unlike some other seekers, montehue rarely relies on his titans in combat as he tends to prefer to fight with his own strength. however, his ability to master the wild fenris has deeply impressed the team, showing that he is strong-willed and has great ability as a seeker.

===spells utilized===

* dragonfist
* featherdrop
* hyperstride

hoplite is a centaur-like titan possessing the body and legs of a lion. these armored warriors, though relatively weak on their own, gain power when working together as an army. they are closely related to the lion-like gladiator titan, bellona.

== history ==
the hoplite titan is like the centaur of greek mythology, except it has a lion's body instead of that of a horse. ancient greek hoplite soldiers used swords, shields, and spears to defeat their enemies. like this titan, greek hoplites grouped together in battle so that their shields could overlap and thus create a stronger defense. around the same era, an army of hoplite titans had been used by jason, who led the argonauts. allegedly, he was able to summon this army with his dragon's teeth.

in modern times, jason's logbook was used to locate the sunken ship, the argo, off the coast of sutos island. there, zhalia moon uncovered several hoplite amulets protected by a magical puzzle. upon returning to find lok lambert and sophie casterwill fighting against a coalition of suits and sutos citizens, zhalia gave both of her teammates a hoplite amulet so that they could stand their ground, and later on the team used these titans for their easy summoning and for their great teamwork powers. [like father, unlike son]

lok later invoked his hoplite in klaus' bookshop to fight klaus, that invoked nighlurker. the two titans fought until dante, and later sophie, invoked their own hoplite titans to help defeat nighlurker, taking advantage of hoplite's teamwork ability. [the bookshop hunter]

lok, while fighting for cavalier's amulet on his own, again used his hoplite in the mausoleum of sir lancelot in response to rassimov's thornment. hoplite was quickly made imobile by thornment and sent back to its amulet. [memory lane]

both lok lambert and sophie casterwill summoned, in addition to many other titans, their hoplite titans to fight agaisnt the professor and the three legendary titans in the professor's castle. the two hoplite fought behemoth along with freelancer but were quickly overpowered by the much stronger legendary titan, and got sent back to their amulets. in the same episode, zhalia moon used her hoplite alongside gareon to fight the two undergolem titans summoned by eathon the dog to guard the castle; zhalia's titans were eventually sent back to their amulets. [the mission]

one hoplite titan, along with a freelancer and an ironsquire titan, were somehow summoned by the ring of arc from nearby amulets at the cathedral of notre dame. the three rogue titans attacked clements. metz, who was on a call with him at the time of the incident, is worried about the sudden lack of response from clements, and calls the huntik team to investigate the issue. upon arrival, lok tried to handle hoplite on his own with the use of the willblade, but was unsuccessful; lok then summons baselaird to fight freelancer and hoplite. lok's titan is succeseful in defeating freelancer, and so cherit delivers the final blow on hoplite, sending it back to its amulet. [the legendary titan of fate]

== abilities ==

though relatively weak titans on their own with low offensive and defensive powers, hoplites gain strength as they work together. they also have great skill with a sword and are good defensive titans. one hoplite alone was able to hand for moments a nighlurker titan, and one hoplite is a soldier, two is an army. hoplite titans are also quite fast on their feet. these titans have claws that are great for gripping the ground.

== design history ==
the hoplite titans were based on the hoplites, citizen soldiers of ancient greece who were armed with swords, spears, and shields. due to their cooperative fighting style, the hoplite titans likewise were designed to be best suited for combat as a team. though originally designed as humanoid soldiers, animalistic traits including a lion's mane were added to make hoplite more unique. the lion was chosen due to greek myths involving the powerful animal.

hoplite icon.jpg|hoplite's icon
hoplite.jpg|hoplite

== trivia ==
* hoplite's summoning commands are: "go," "invoke," and "join them."
* hoplite’s name is comes from the hoplite, a greek spearman whose title was derived from the hoplon shields which they bore. the hoplon, or aspis, was a round wooden shield with a thin layer of bronze around the edges.

enfluxion is a titan whose body is made up entirely of water. unlike undine, enfluxion has a much more unearthly visage and possesses tendrils of water for arms. her amulet is in the possession of sophie casterwill after being given to her as a gift from teien casterwill.

== history ==
throughout the world, the enfluxion and undine titans have inspired the many myths and legends about water-spirits which appear in the mythologies of cultures throughout the world.

enfluxion was given to sophie casterwill by teien casterwill to help fight against kiel and his fire-based titans and spells. sophie first invoked her outside the pyramid of the sun in mexico where she fought against vulcana but was defeated. [the titan in the temple of sun]

sophie invoked enfluxion in cortés' vault to defend kaioh the tracker from shadow agent and hold him in a state of flux. she was defeated after attempting to defeat the mighty conquistador left to guard the vault. [the power of umbra]

during the battle between the casterwill family, blood spiral and huntik foundation at the blood spiral base, sophie invoked enfluxion to defend her and lok lambert from the entourage of silent soldiers. she was defeated however by the betrayer's titan,demigorgan who had been posing as eathon lambert's holotome. [lok and the betrayer]

== abilities ==
 from vulcana's fire attacks|177x177px]]
enfluxion has the ability to control water and change her shape. her offensive attack is using her arms as water cannons while she can also create a wall of water to shield her and her allies, a defensive ability that was strong enough to initially protect sophie casterwill from vulcana, until she found a good angle to target enfluxion directly, sending her back to her amulet. [the titan in the temple of sun] the shield was unable to withstand demigoran's energy blast. [lok and the betrayer] by firing blasts of water, enfluxion was also able to knock back a shadow agent and, for a short period of time, distract a conquistador [the power of umbra].

== design history ==
enfluxion's initial design began as a gaia-titan composed of water with her arms being tendrils of water, and she was originally named "ethereal". her rough sketch was drawn with curved lines to represent the flow of water. in order to help distinguish her from the similar design of lunar's elemental form, enfluxion was given legs that go past the knee and was sketched to more obviously be the actual body of the titan. lunar's elemental form, by contrast, is a humanoid aura surrounding a fairy-like titan. enfluxion's final art was given a transparent body to reflect her watery nature and was given a lighter cyan color to contrast lunar's more purple and white color. [huntik.com/secret files] following her card release on sas-053, enfluxion was introduced in season 2 of the show with an overhauled design, and given the amulet of a krono-titan instead of a gaia-titan as well as a new icon. [the titan in the temple of sun] in her new design, enfluxion's form was no longer transparent, with her face becoming more elemental and less human, and her lower body now surrounded by a swirling vortex of water. [the titan in the temple of sun]

the temple of thor is a building dedicated to the ancient seeker, thor. thor's hammer, mjolnir, was kept here and guarded by the guardians of thor prior prior to being retrieved by dante vale, tersly, lok lambert, montehue, zhalia moon, and sophie casterwill. the only way to get to the temple, aside from flying, is to utilize the rainbow bridge. the temple is laced with magic and kept the wild titan, fenris, constantly invoked for thousands of years.

upon entering the temple, there is a large dome chamber with two additional passages. down one path there is a sealed door which leads to a forbidden potion located underneath the temple. this path leads directly to the stone snake chamber. upon entering the this chamber the titan fenris is released on whoever entered. the stone snake chamber has a door, which leads to the mjolnir chamber. the only way to open it is by moving the snake to form an infinity symbol, a figure eight, with its tail in its moth. past this chamber is a chamber containing the rope of gleipnir, the only thing capable of defeating the wild fenris.

the second passage leads to the stone snake chamber as well, but through a series of smaller chambers and hallways.

the chamber which contained mjolnir has a large stone pillar in the center, with the hammer mjolnir on it. surrounding the pillar were dozens of floating rocks with lightning bolts striking them at random. to reach the hammer, dante and montehue had to climb the rocks and avoid the lightning. thundercut is an offensive spell. it creates a purple aura of electric energy, which can be used on close contact or fired from the distance. upon contact, the target suffers significant pain from the electric discharge, and may be paralyzed. 

it is an ancient power and the sole favored spell of the guardians of thor.

unnamed suit 026 used the spell at point blank range on dante vale in new grange passage tomb. despite him being in serious pain, zhalia moon was hesitant to intervene and dante was saved by sabriel. [home turf]

unnamed suit 029 started casting the spell while fighting against dante vale in the train, but dante dodged it. [the vampire loses its fangs]

in atlantis, the mermen used this spell on dante vale during his test. rassimov later used it to inflict paralyzing pain to lok lambert and knock him to the ground. [coming of age]

after discovering that zhalia was a spy, tantras knocked her out then started casting thundercut to finish her off, but her powerbonding with gareon stopped him. [sophie on trial]

black scarabese is a hecto-titan closely related to the gold scarabese. these small beetle titans might seem harmless at first, but they are used in the field to gather intelligence. together with gold scarabese, they can form the powerful anubian.

== history ==
the black scarabese titans, along with gold scarabese, were used by rassimov to spy on dante vale and his team. later, his four black scarabese titans joined with the gold scarabese to form anubian. [coming of age]

rassimov summoned the scarabese titans to summon anubian. however, cherit was able to delay them by preventing the gold scarabese from reaching the others. when rassimov hit cherit with a raypulse, the scarabese joined, and anubian was invoked. when baselaird defeated anubian, the scarabese crawled back to rassimov. [coming of age]

in the dreamworld created by arc, the legendary titan of fate, sophie casterwill encountered spiral demon, a hybrid of the marauder titan and lower body of the black scarabese. [the legendary titan of fate]

the black scarabese were unbonded from rassimov by dante's sorrowbond power and recovered by the huntik foundation. dante told lady s. and the other huntik foundation operatives that the scarabese has to kept separate from each other. [rassimov's secret]

== abilities ==
these small beetle titans might seem harmless at first, but the harm they inflict is not physical, it's informational. while the black-colored scarabese stalk their seeker's enemy, the seeker can place the golden scarabese over his or her eye to see whatever the swarm of spy beetles sees. from there, setting up an ambush is child's play. fenris is a powerful wolf-like titan, the only known specimen of which once roamed through the caves under the temple of thor. this wild and animalistic titan was later used by montehue, becoming among his choice titans in the fight against evil seeker groups. many seekers think fenris and wolf knight were behind the legends of werewolves.

== history ==
fenris was once the titan of thor himself and was left to guard the restricted caves beneath the temple of thor long after his seeker's death. with the magic of thor's temple keeping fenris invoked through the centuries, he remained active and rabid for thousands of years into the modern age. [two powers become one]

while both the huntik foundation and the organization were trying to find mjolnir, the hammer of thor, the wild titan, fenris, was also discovered past the door of infinity. virtually invulnerable to attacks due to the magic of the temple, fenris attempted to attack dante vale's team, but he eventually tied up with the rope of gleipnir using some help from springer. as the magical rope could not be broken, fenris was constricted and eventually send back to his amulet. dante picked up the amulet and gave it to montehue after the mission, believing fenris would bond readily to a seeker with a character close to that of thor. [two powers become one]

during the mission to acquire the ring of tao, montehue summoned fenris to fight the three colossi outside king solomon's mines. fenris teamed up with lok's lindorm to defeat ashtoreth. later, in the mines, fenris battled against dominator. when dominator's spikes became lodged in fenris, his ability caused fenris to temporarily revert to his berserk state and refuse to listen to montehue. [to be together]

fenris was later used by montehue in indonesia to fight against a silent soldier's shadow kuolit. fenris proved to be faster than the shadow kuolit, who attempted to slice him, but the shadows from shadow kuolit's body injured the wolf titan. [the dead magic island] the following day, fenris helped montehue fight numerous blood spiral forces and later witnessed sophie casterwill rising from the lava of a volcano with phoenix, the legendary titan of rebirth. [the phoenix's ashes]

fenris fought in the battle at the blood spiral base. he saved scarlet byrne from a nighlurker titan before being floored himself by a marauder. he was then saved when the marauder was picked up and defeated by scarlet's firbolg titan. [lok and the betrayer]

== abilities ==
unlike other titans, fenris was able to draw his power from the walls of thor's temple in order to remain active and rabid, for centuries. the guardians of thor feared fenris' immense strength, speed, and wild nature. his senses are as keen as those of a wolf. his claws are razor sharp, and his jaws are strong enough to crush bones and masticate flesh. all of this, combined with his ferocious predatory nature, makes him a very dangerous titan to encounter, as he will attack anything, with an unprovoked viciousness similar to a rabid animal.

fenris concept art.png|fenris's concept art

==trivia==
*fenris' summoning command is "take them out"
*fenris is based on fenrir, a giant wolf from norse mythology.

tolivane are small, fairy-like titans somewhat resembling moles. although their base stats are relatively low, their "defense" ability allows them to survive attacks which would normally send them back to their amulets.

== history ==
tolivane were strange fairy-like creatures of european folklore that were helpful to good people and wicked when serving evil folk.

=== montehue's tolivane ===
a tolivane amulet was once in the possession of dante vale and was given to montehue in their youth. [two powers become one]

tolivane was invoked by montehue in the temple of thor to hold off the guardians of thor in order to allow montuehue and dante time to utilize mjolnir to defeat ymir. [two powers become one]

in ethiopia, tolivane was invoked to defend montehue against ashtoreth. later, inside king solomon's mines, tolivane was invoked to defend against the the organization's forces. after absorbing a suit's poisonfang attack, tolivane was defeated by rassimov's kopesh. [to be together]

=== hubbs' tolivane ===
another tolivane amulet is in the possession of a suit named charlene hubbs. she used her tolivane to obtain food at a restaurant, thus frightening the other customers. [oal-066]

== abilities ==
tolivane is able to roll and bounce like a ball at top speed. although he doesn't possess any weapons or attacking abilities, tolivane can withstand more attacks than his appearance would suggest before he returns to his amulet. with his defense ability, he can use his stocky body as a magical sheild and absorb high intensity energy beams. rings are powerful artifacts which have the same abilities as amulets. like amulets, they contain titans and allow them to pass between earth and the spirit world of huntik. much more powerful titans are contained within rings than in normal amulets, and all known rings shown contain a legendary titan.

==history==
in ancient history, lord casterwill forged the amulets and rings to contain the energy of the titans to battle the nullifiers, finally defeating them after a 500 year ordeal. at some point after this conflict, the rings were sealed away so that only powerful seekers would be able to uncover these powerful artifacts.

having been hidden for thousands of years along with the amulets, the rings of the legendary titans have been considered an unobtainable prize by generations of seekers. the huntik foundation struggled against the organization and later the blood spiral for these rings.

once the ring of araknos was disturbed by simon judeau, the titans contained within both rings and amulets began to awaken with increasing frequency. under the title of "the professor," simon formed the organization in order to seek out the rings of the legendary titans in the hopes of gaining world domination and a cure for the curse of the legendary titans in a single blow. though the huntik foundation uncovered the rings of both behemoth and tao, they were taken by the professor who lied to dante vale about also wanting to cure metz. [the divine comedy]

after the rings of araknos, behemoth, and tao were sent back to the spirit world upon lok lambert's command to overlos, a new group of rings were uncovered with the return of the blood spiral brotherhood. these rings, once owned by lord casterwill and given to his children, were said to be the only means of defending the earth against the revival of the nullifiers. [the mission]

once the ring of araknos was disturbed by simon judeau, the titans contained within both rings and amulets began to awaken with increasing frequency. under the title of "the professor," simon formed the organization in order to seek out the rings of the legendary titans in the hopes of gaining world domination and a cure for the curse of the legendary titans in a single blow. though the huntik foundation uncovered the rings of both behemoth and tao, they were taken by the professor who lied to dante vale about also wanting to cure metz. [the divine comedy]

after the rings of araknos, behemoth, and tao were sent back to the spirit world upon lok lambert's command to overlos, a new group of rings were uncovered with the return of the blood spiral brotherhood. these rings, once owned by lord casterwill and given to his children, were said to be the only means of defending the earth against the revival of the nullifiers. [the mission]

king basilisk is a titan of legends as the greatest among basilisks. a normal basilisk's breath is toxic, and its gaze has the ability to turn others into stone. the same is true of king basilisk. its stonegaze ability can turn others into stone, although the king basilisk also possesses the ability to undo these effects at will.

==  history ==
king basilisk inspired myths of the basilisks throughout greece, rome, europe, africa, and south america. according to the ancient romans, it was a lizard-like creature that could kill at a distance. [huntik.com]

king basilisk's amulet came to rest at basilisk house, within a network of ancient catacombs in present-day vienna, austria, hidden behind a basilisk statue which was protected by a petrification trap. after being awoken by the new age of seekers, his amulet was acquired by zhalia moon once the trap was deactivated by lok lambert and sophie casterwill during a confrontation between the huntik foundation and the organization, though bonding proved difficult. afterwards, the titan was used to help defeat defoe and his men, though the attack took longer than usual to charge. [absent heroes]

while on a mission on sutos island, king basilisk was used in the recovery of jason's logbook and hoplite titans. [like father, unlike son] later upon entering austria, king basilisk was used to take out an organization helicopter. [the bookshop hunter] as zhalia's loyalties to the team and to dante vale were put to the test, king basilisk was invoked to use his stonegaze to turn klaus to stone. [the vampire loses its fangs]

after zhalia returned to the huntik team after a leave of absence, king basilisk was used to petrify several of rassimov's suits in atlantis to deal a major blow to his forces within the organization. [coming of age] while in the central desert of ethiopia after the ring of tao, king basilisk was used to defend against the colossi guarding king solomon's mines. [to be together]

while under attack from shauna and wind following a confrontation with the professor, king basilisk was used to defend but was unable to prevent the amulet of will and eathon lambert's journal from being taken. [the secret of two generations] upon going to the professor's castle, king basilisk was invoked during a quarrel between zhalia and sophie over dante's decision to hand his legendary titans over to the professor. [the divine comedy] when under attack by the professor's undergolems, king basilisk again was invoked to permit sophie and lok to enter the invocation chamber, though king basilisk was defeated in the process. [the mission]

after the defeat of the professor and during the search for the willblade, king basilisk's stonegaze was used in an attempt to stop wilder's men, but divine mirror kagami was used by wilder to reflect the attack and to petrify both king basilisk and dante. with king basilisk then sent back to his amulet by hoffman's redcap, leblanche allowed king basilisk to be reinvoked, through newlife, to bring back dante. [knight of the willblade]

under attack from lucas casterwill and his team while investigating the casterwill library in paris, france, king basilisk was hidden by zhalia's thoughtspecter, along with gar-ghoul and kilthane, in order to halt the offensive without risking damages. [chasing void] as both teams formed an alliance to recover the amulet of void from the organization, king basilisk was called upon by zhalia in order to reanimate klaus to gain intel. [the blood spiral] with the new threat of the blood spiral and their recent acolytes, king basilisk was summoned to battle jericho and to protect the amulet of vigilante. [den vs harrison]

with zhalia being sent to infiltrate the blood spiral, she kept king basilisk's amulet but did not summon him against the huntik foundation. [lok's leadership] during the battle against the betrayer, zhalia's need to remain incognito was overshadowed, and she invoked king basilisk to protect the rest of dante's team from demigorgan, the betrayer's legendary titan. however, king basilisk was quickly defeated. [lok and the betrayer]

==abilities ==
king basilisk has an attack power of 5 and a defense power of 3. his venomous breath can be used during close combat, [huntik.com] as well has his sharp claws which can send easily send jericho back to its amulet. [den vs harrison] thanks to his flight abilities, king basilisk can be used for physical aerial attacks. [the bookshop hunter] his dread stare ability is able to eliminate opposing titans, sending them back to their amulets. [sas-010] his other ability, stonegaze, can incapacitate enemies by turning them into stone. [absent heroes] reverting king basilisk's stonegaze is possible by using king basilisk to revert the process. however, king basilisk can, himself, be turned to stone if his gaze is reflected back on him. [knight of the willblade]

== design history ==
king basilisk originally was designed to look like a lizard-man with a warrior's stature. over time, he was re-designed to be less human and more monstrous. the design finally arrived at a serpentine, lizard-like beast. he is dangerous yet intelligent, fit to be the king of basilisks. [huntik.com/secret files]

terrapede is a titan related to mindrone, enforcer, and gigadrone, and his primary power rests in his single enormous eye. able to traverse challenging terrain with his powerful spike legs and blast enemies with energy from his eye, terrapede is not to be trifled with. this titan is awarded to up-and-coming organization operatives after they have shown promise in battle against the huntik foundation.

==history ==
terrapede was used by one of the professor's stronghold suits. it defeated feyone abruptly by grabbing her with two of its legs and blasting her with his eye power. it attempted to attack a vulnerable, unconscious sophie but was held off by lok's freelancer. before it could cause any more damage, terrapede was defeated by kilthane who ultimately stabbed terrapede in the back. [the divine comedy]

==abilities ==
terrapede is able to fire powerful blasts from its eye, similar to mindrone, enforcer and gigadrone titans. its many legs allow it to move with great speed or to grab its foes in order to immobilize them. it can also cling to any surface. it is also extremely maneuverable, especially in tight spaces, more so than most other titans of its size, due to its long body.

coralgolem is the favored defender of casterwill coastal and sub-oceanic strongholds; the family of seekers will do anything to add another rare coralgolem to their collection. the mermen seekers also summoned coralgolems to counter dante vale's use of metagolem in the test of prowess to enter atlantis.

== history ==
three coralgolems were summoned by the mermen in atlantis when dante invoked metagolem. one of the coralgolems slammed into metagolem, sending him back to his amulet. caliban was able to cut one of the coralgolems' hands off, but he was sent back to his amulet by the spears of the caliban ocean warrior titans. dante then invoked the legendary titan of body, behemoth. the mermen attempted to copy behemoth, but failed because there is no equivalent to a legendary titan. the mermen and their titans were defeated as a result. [coming of age]

one coralgolem was invoked by nimue casterwill, along with undine, as sophie's challenge to gain the amulet of sorcerel. sophie managed to evade all of their attacks, even causing coralgolem to be hit with one of undine's whirlpools. coralgolem attacked sophie again as she attempted to bond with sorcerel from afar, but she again dodged it. as coralgolem attempted a final blow, sophie managed to powerbond with sabriel, who had been thought to be lost. both opposing titans were sent back to their amulets, with sophie gaining the amulet of sorcerel from the challenge. [cave of the casterwills]

another coralgolem was invoked by focauld casterwill and the rue guardians from statues within the fortress of iron will, as were several feyone and icarus titans, as the casterwills' defense system against the oncoming blood spiral army. [the spiral war]

== abilities ==
coralgolem titans, like metagolem, are extremely durable titans. their physical size provides them with great strength, although it renders their movements slow. when used together as a team, these powerful colossi are able to hold back almost all but the most calculated of assaults.

shakrit is an enormous, serpentine swara-titan. due to its size and dexterity, shakrit is used both for combat and transportation. gliding through the air as an eel glides through water, shakrit quickly leaves the blood spiral's destruction in its wake at wind's command.

== history ==
shakrit was used by shauna and wind to steal eathon's journal and the rings of the legendary titans from dante vale's huntik team. shakrit easily defeated king basilisk before being temporarily subdued by caliban who grabbed his mouth keeping it shut. shakrit shook caliban off and flew off into the night with the two seekers. [the secret of two generations]

shakrit was used again by wind when the blood spiral raided klaus' lab in search of the amulet of void. after being temporarily disrupted by archwarder, shakrit took off with rassimov, wind and shauna and set fire to klaus's lab after his master's group recovered void. [the blood spiral]

shakrit fought wildly against sabriel, baselaird, and cherit when the two seeker groups sought the amulet of phoenix. after a fierce fight with den and cursed archer, it was defeated by lok who was powered up with baselaird's powerbonded energy. [the phoenix's ashes]

in the battle against the forces of the betrayer, shakrit attacked the huntik foundation's scramjets and caused them great damage. although on the upper hand, shakrit was defeated when montehue and momax sent mjolnir flying through him. [dante's return]

== abilities ==
shakrit is powerful enough to defeat weaker titans in a single bite. [the secret of two generations] this titan can also fly with great speed and agility. like many dragons, shakrit is also able to breathe fire. [tcg:oal-025] due to its powerful muscles and dexterity, shakrit is able to use its tail as a formidable weapon. [the phoenix's ashes]

* shakrit's appearance is based on the amphiptere, a wyvern-like creature of european heraldry.

huntik:page:3006:
dendras is a masked puppeteer titan who controls twin marionettes, one which controls the power of fire and one which controls the power of ice. this titan was passed on from simon judeau to eathon lambert before their respective disappearances and was later recovered by his son, lok lambert.

==history ==
dendras was initially used by simon judeau in his adventures with metz and eathon lambert. after simon fell under the curse of the legendary titans, the amulet of dendras was left for eathon to claim. [the secret of two generations].

dendras was invoked, along with jirwolf, by eathon lambert to fend off against the organization which had formed under simon, now donning the alias of the professor, on the way to atlantis. [coming of age]

after eathon's disappearance, dendras' amulet was claimed by the professor and was kept in his castle. eathon's son, lok lambert, later reclaimed this titan from the professor's castle. dendras was then used, together with baselaird, to take control of overlos, the legendary titan of immortality. this was possible because overlos was weakened by archwarder. then lok banished both overlos and the other legendary titans into huntik, the spirit world. [the mission]

lok invoked dendras to fight against wilder whilst trying to recover the willblade in the ruins of avalon. using bubblelift, lok and dendras were able to take control of incubane. however, wilder then invoked a new titan, divine mirror kagami, which reflected dendras' ability against him, thus giving wilder control over him. after a defeated lok grabbed the willblade, dendras attacked him alongside wilder, incubane and kagami. lok then invoked pendragon, the legendary titan of champions, who broke wilder's control, returning dendras to lok's side. [knight of the willblade]

dendras was invoked in the cave of medusa during a surprise attack on the blood spiral seeker kiel in a plan coordinated by zhalia moon. lok then used bubblelift to enable dendras to successfully neutralize kiel's titan, vulcana. dendras was later defeated however by a nullcurse from marduk, kiel's right hand man. [zhalia's mission]

dendras was used in hamelin cathedral to fight again the swarms of gremlow titans. he was called back his amulet by lok who decided it be best to abandon the building for the time being. [gremlow infestation!]

being one of lok's quickest titans, dendras was invoked alonside sophie casterwill's feyone to fight against legion at the blood spiral base. after eventually being grabbed by legion, dendras was temporarily absorbed and his amulet broken with legion even gaining his ability to shoot fire and ice. luckily, lok was able to destroy legion's amulet with the willblade, saving dendras and repairing his amulet. [the spiral mark]

==abilities ==
's incubane against him|191x191px]]
dendras is a powerful and unusual titan whose powers resemble those of a puppet master. with a pair of magical dragons at the ends of his two marionette strings, dendras can take control of enemy titans and turn them on their allies. the blue dragon is capable of ice attacks and the red dragon is capable of fire attacks. with baselaird, he can use his strings to take control of enemy titans. [the mission] the power also works in coordination with the spell bubblelift. [knight of the willblade] [zhalia's mission] dendras is also extremely fast, able to glide through the air and dodge enemy attacks with great speed. [knight of the willblade] he is one of the quickest titans in lok's possession. [the spiral mark]

pan is a gaia-titan resembling a faun or satyr. he has the hindquarters, ears and horns of a goat and the torso, arms, and head of a man.

== history ==
in greek mythology, pan appeared as the god of shepherds, nature, hunting, and rustic music. pan brought to the greeks the panpipes, or syrinx, which this titan is commonly seen holding. [tcg:sas-066]

pan is now used on the side of good. [tcg:sas-066]

== abilities ==
pan is capable of utilizing his panpipes to create illusions of animals to dazzle and trick the enemy.

== design history ==
=== rough sketch ===
pan is a satyr with a flute that can make illusions. in the rough sketch, pan is in the foreground and strange creatures are starting to appear because of the magic of the flute that he’s playing. pan is a gaia-titan and is part goat, so we asked the artist to make the illusion-creatures animals instead of people.

=== pencil sketch ===
here, you can see that pan is wearing a simple greek toga with geometric patterns along the hem. the illusion-creatures created by pan’s music are animals; you can see a wolf, goat, and some birds starting to take shape. the extra detail needed on the illusions means the artist chose not to draw the background trees from the rough sketch—otherwise it would be hard to tell the illusions from the background. planning ahead for the colored final art, we asked the artist to make sure the illusions looked like illusions so you didn’t think pan hung around with a bunch of real wild animals.

=== final art ===
pan is a gaia-titan, and they are usually green and brown, so we decided to make him green all over. his illusion-animals look like they’re made out of energy so that you know they’re created from magic and not just regular animals. pan looks like he’s playing a happy tune, as if he loves music just for the fun of playing. [huntik.com]

icarus are humanoid krono-titans who possess bird-like wings instead of arms. icarus titans are commonly used by casterwill family members alongside feyone, and one appears in the arsenal of sophie casterwill.

== history ==
the mythical greek inventor daedalus named his son, icarus, after this flying titan. daedalus created artificial wings out of feathers and wax, which he and his son used to escape from the evil king minos. [huntik.com]

a large number of icarus titans are under the control of the casterwill family, and had been assimilated by legion. [rassimov's secret] icarus titans were also some of the favored defenders of the fortress of iron will, a casterwill meeting place. [the spiral war]

=== sophie's icarus ===
sophie casterwill invoked her icarus in basilisk house to fight against the organization but he was defeated by defoe's kreutalk. [absent heroes] in thessalonica, greece, in the operation to recover the sunken shipwreck, icarus threaded the rope through the eye of caliban's dagger. later, sophe invoked him to fight the organization forces but he was defeated by two suits' raypulse blasts. [the treasures of the argonauts]

sophie later invoked icarus to escape from a group of casterwill hunters who she was leading into an ambush. [the phoenix's ashes]

=== mallory's icarus ===
mallory used his icarus alongside white's feyone to attack the huntik team as they tried to land on the shores of the crystal caves. he was defeated by boulder thrown by dante vale's metagolem. [cave of the casterwills] 

===other icarus ===
defoe possessed the amulet of an icarus, though he never used it against the huntik team. [the treasures of the argonauts]

at some point in time, the icarus of an unknown seeker had been absorbed by legion, the legendary titan of war. legion used icarus' blinding bolts ability against the huntik team in egypt. [rassimov's secret] at the spiral mark, legion used the ability once again against lok and sophie. when lok shattered legion's amulet and legion was destroyed, icarus and the thousands of other absorbed titans returned to huntik, the spirit world. [the spiral mark]

==abilities ==
icarus is able to fire lightning bolts from his wings, and can generate blue energy spheres as well. he can shoot laser rays from his eyes. his wings allow him flight and he is one of the fastest flying titans. icarus is able to hold the weight of a human to temporarily allow them flight, even while being silent, making him a deadly foe. [memory lane] icarus's stats are low, but he is a sharpshooter and has fantastic abilities at long range. [the vampire loses its fangs] his considerable accuracy means he can thread a needle with ease. [the treasures of the argonauts]

==gallery==

icarus amulet.jpg|icarus' amulet
icarus icon.jpg|icarus' icon
icarus 2.jpg|icarus

==trivia==
* icarus' summoning commands are "take flight," "air support," "fly," and "fly swiftly."
* icarus is based on icarus, the young man who flew too close to the sun with wax wings in greek mythology.
* at the end of "the treasures of the argonauts," an icarus amulet can be seen among defoe's amulets that dante vale used the sorrowbond spell on.
