the blood spiral are a cult of evil seekers whose purpose is to serve the will of the betrayer, the sworn ancestral enemy of the casterwill family, and to erase all life by bringing the nullifiers back to earth. the group have a long history of tradition and ritual, using dark, ancient magic and titans, and with every member bearing a tattoo of the sigil of the spiral mark, the original beacon that first summoned the nullifiers. commanded by the diabolical rassimov and his blooded circle, the spirals are considered by many seekers to be the most dangerous force on earth. 

== history ==
the blood spiral brotherhood was founded by the betrayer, who betrayed his best friend, lord casterwill, and became mortal enemies with his family when he attempted to perform a dark ritual on the spiral mark, summoning void to reactivate the mark and use it as a beacon to call back the nullifiers to earth. he was defeated by lord casterwill's children however, leaving the blood spiral brotherhood mortal enemies with the casterwill family and sworn on revenge. [chasing void] 
throughout the generations, the blood spiral remained hidden, hunting down and eliminating whole branches of the casterwill family. [chasing void] one of their young hunters, the pyromaniac kiel, succeeded in setting the paris casterwill house aflame, killing the parents of sophie casterwill and separating her from her big brother, lucas. [the titan in the temple of sun]

at some point in time, rassimov began working for the organization, in order to cripple them from the inside. he rose through their ranks to become one of the professor's most senior operatives before setting up his downfall to the huntik team by giving the amulet of archwarder to dante vale. [the divine comedy] with this titan, the huntik foundation was able to weaken the legendary titan of immortality, overlos, defeat the professor and send his legendary titans back to the spirit world, successfully removing the professor as a threat to the blood spiral's goals. [the mission]

after the fall of the professor, the blood spiral brotherhood emerged from the shadows of history and revealed themselves to both the huntik foundation and the organization alike at klaus' bookshop. there they recovered the amulet of the evil void in order to resurrect the rest of the nullifiers and left the destruction in their wake. [the blood spiral]

== base ==
the only known base of the blood spiral is the blood spiral base, located in a desert region of the siberian plateau where there are known to be training rooms, the betrayer´s throne room and the spiral mark. [words from eathon]

== members ==
see also the list of blood spiral members

the blood spiral is run by rassimov, who carries out the orders of the incorporeal betrayer. rassimov is a terribly powerful seeker and later died when he tried to obtain the power of the red comet. at almost rassimov's level are shauna and the silent wind. under them is also tantras, who recruits new minions to serve the will of the spiral and who also trains these recruits along with training most of their powerful seekers like harrison and kiel to destroy the casterwills.

the casterwill hunters are higher versions of the silent soldiers, being a more powerful and a greater threat to the huntik foundation. they serve kiel and marduk, and will do anything to capture and destroy one more member of the blood spiral's hated enemies, the casterwill family.

upon entry into the blood spiral, a spiral mark is placed on the member. these marks connect the group and can grant power to the spiral member. they can also be used to signal the members or inflict pain to the member. [dante's return]

the basic class of blood spiral members are the silent soldiers. much like the organization's suits, the silent soldiers do the bidding of the spiral and are the bulk of their members. harrison fears was inducted into the order along with his brother, den fears, although the latter defected to the huntik foundation. zhalia moon, who had grown up in the same orphanage as the fears brothers, joined the silent soldier ranks as a double agent in order to protect harrison. many of the members are scouted from vulnerable and damaged backgrounds such as orphanages, with the spiral taking advantage of the darkness and pain of individuals to tempt them with ideas of power and self-worth. 

== abilities ==
the blood spiral brotherhood mainly relies on dark and ancient magic. spells that are shown in the series include darkvoid, darkwave, bladewave, cutrace and hopeshatter. they also use dark incantations including underfear and newfury to increase the negative emotions in a targeted seeker, namely new recruits

like their spells, their titans also revolve around dark powers, including ancient hecto-titans. the blood spiral's foot soldiers, the silent soldiers, primarily use titans that draw power from dark emotions like rage and fear including harlekin and marauder.

the curse of the legendary titans is an incredibly powerful and deadly curse that was placed on the rings of the legendary titans by lord casterwill and that causes those who disturb them without the amulet of will to be struck by an incurable ailment. this ailment targets the very will of its victims, and this cannot be combatted even through magic.

== history ==
in ancient times, lord casterwill guarded the rings of his personal legendary titans with this curse, and by protecting the rings he effectively protected overlos as well. 

when the ring of araknos was disturbed by a young simon judeau, he was afflicted by the curse and hospitalized. in order to circumvent the curse, he made a pact with araknos, binding their life forces together. 

later, when the ring of behemoth was disturbed by metz, he similarly was afflicted and hospitalized under the care of lady s. as the curse protecting the ring of behemoth was already activated, dante vale was able to use the ring without falling victim to the curse even though he wasn't wearing the amulet of will. [ladies' choice]

when lok lambert found the ring of tao in king solomon's mines, he was able to acquire the ring without invoking the curse due to his wearing the amulet of will. [to be together]

huntik:page:3297:
nordrake is a blue and white flying litho-titan that resembles an ice-dragon, held in reserve by the professor for his final confrontations against the huntik foundation. nordrake, along with the destructive dominator, is one of the professor's most powerful and favored titans, besides araknos.

==history==
nordrake was an ice-dragon titan primarily used by ancient seekers in northern europe. a nordrake amulet was acquired by a young simon judeau and became one of his first titans along with dendras. simon was wearing nordrake's amulet round his neck when he and eathon lambert first met metz in his teens. [the secret of two generations]

during a confrontation on a roof between the professor and dante vale's team, dante invoked ignatius to overcome araknos' ability to control his titans. as a countermeasure, the professor invoked nordrake, whose ice abilities overpowered ignatius and send him back to his amulet. [the secret of two generations]

when dante's team prepared for their final confrontation against the professor, nordrake was studied on zhalia moon's teknonomicon as one of the prime obstacles between them and the professor's legendary titans. [the divine comedy] during this confrontation, nordrake was summoned along with dominator in response to an attack by sophie casterwill and her only remaining titan, sabriel. due to the effects of dominator's spikes ability and the barrage by nordrake's ice blasts, sabriel's amulet was destroyed. as the rest of the team arrived and the professor prepared to attack, zhalia's gar-ghoul managed to attack nordrake with a torrent of water. with nordrake finally being defeated, ignatius could then be used by dante against araknos. [the mission]

==abilities==
nordrake can breathe ice and cold air to freeze anything with its ice blasts. being a dragon, nordrake can also fly through the air with great prowess. it possesses razor sharp claws and teeth, as well as a strong tail that can be used as a club.

==gallery==

nordrake_concept_art.png|nordrake's concept art

*nordrake's name originates from the words drake, a type of dragon, and nord, the german word for north, a region commonly associated with being cold.
*in the huntik trading card game, the card nordrake: the professor's icy titan incorrectly classifies nordrake as a draco-titan.
*his command is "serve me"
*in the fourth season of winx club, another series created by iginio straffi, the wizard duman can transform into a multicolored version of nordrake.

thornment, one of several mummy-like hecto-titans, inspired the mythology of ancient egypt. within her wraps, thornment is a mass of living, thorny vines, which she is able to expertly control as extensions of her own being. whether whipping, slicing, tying, or tripping, thornment is a powerful foe. one thornment was the primary titan of rassimov.

== history ==
thornment was a powerful titan used by ancient egyptian pharaohs. to her enemies, thornment was a deadly foe as hidden within her linen wraps was a mass of living, purple, thorny vines. [huntik.com]

=== rassimov's thornment ===
rassimov possessed a thornment amulet and used this titan in his missions for the organization against the huntik foundation. 

in the mausoleum of sir lancelot, rassimov used thornment to save dante vale from some ghost traps. later on, thornment fought and defeated lok lambert's hoplite. [memory lane]

while searching for the legendary titan of body, behemoth, thornment was invoked alongside kopesh to attack dante's caliban. thornment was defeated when caliban swung her into kopesh. [ladies' choice]

at the temple of poseidon, thornment attacked caliban but was overpowered and defeated. [the unseen guide] rassimov later invoked thornment in atlantis alongside kopesh to attack lok's lindorm. thornment attacked baselaird with her vines but, after being dragged into the crossfire, was defeated by a misfired hopeshatter blast from rassimov. [coming of age]

thornment fought and defeated caliban in the professor's castle. she chased dante but was defeated by dante's touchram power. [the divine comedy]

rassimov used thornment to entangle one of klaus' suits at the tomb of nefertiti while searching for the necklace of tutankhamun in the valley of the kings, egypt. later, thornment's bond with rassimov was broken by dante vale's sorrowbond spell, and her amulet was taken into custody by huntik foundation agents. [rassimov's secret]

=== rahmas' thornment ===
one of rassimov's former agents, rahmas invoked a thornment titan to fight and defeat lok's freelancer while searching for the amulet of cerberus. sophie casterwill's sabriel then attacked and defeated thornment by throwing a sword at her. [cerberus (comic)]

== abilities ==
]]
thornment has the ability to slice, grab, coil, whip, stab and trip enemies with her thorny vines. this makes her a dangerous enemy and useful for setting up ambushes. she has been seen fighting power houses like caliban and sabriel and even outmatched them on some occasions. however, she is generally easy to take out, being sent back to her amulet after a single touchram spell from dante vale (albeit after fighting caliban for a while).

cavalier is a powerful armored titan who belonged to sir lancelot. a fighter, through and through, his armor is enchanted, his blades burn eternally, and his passion for battle is unmatched. 

== history ==
cavalier was amongst the strongest titans in medieval england and would only bond with noble, worthy, loyal men. belonging to the casterwill family for generations, he was used by sir lancelot, head of one of the main branch families. as the noblest of all king arthur's knights, cavalier took on aspects of his seeker, most notably his pure heart. eventually, lancelot hid cavalier's amulet in paris, france in his mausoleum along with his secret books and scrolls. [memory lane]

both the huntik foundation and the organization became aware of cavalier's amulet and went to the mausoleum recover it. after overcoming many traps and obstacles, lok lambert and dante vale reached the room where cavalier's amulet kept along with numerous ancient casterwill tomes. however they were ambushed by rassimov who went and reached the amulet. despite summoning the titan, the worthy titan refused to bond with rassimov who declared that if he could not have the power then no one would. rassimov then used darkvoid to callously destroy cavalier along with the entirety of lancelot's books and scrolls. [memory lane] 

sophie later studied cavalier on the cypherdex and deduced that it was no surprise that cavalier would not bond with an evil man like rassimov, while dante hauntingly confirmed to guggenheim that, without a doubt, cavalier had been destroyed by rassimov's devastating power. [memory lane]

== abilities ==
cavalier has the ability of flight and can use flaming swords in battle. as a powerful brawler titan with a noble heart, cavalier only bonds with a worthy and pure hearted seeker and fiercely resits evil. his fighting prowess and victories are legendary among seekers.

== gallery ==

cavalier amulet.jpg|cavalier's amulet
cavalier icon.jpg|cavalier's icon
cavalier 2.jpg|cavalier

== trivia ==
* cavalier's summoning command is "your speed and might are mine to command, valiant warrior. come forth, cavalier."

* cavalier's name is derived from the french word for knight, which is fitting since sir lancelot of the lake was one of the knights of the round table. appropriately, some of the oldest mentions of sir lancelot in arthurian legend were from france.

stopglue is a spell that creates a stream of a sticky, glue-like substance. as such, this spell can be used to render enemies or objects immobile without actually causing damage.

== history ==
this spell was discovered by cherit on a scroll in the secret laboratory under klaus' bookshop. after dante vale read this scroll, dante used stopglue to imprison unnamed suit 027's enforcer and unnamed suit 028's bonelasher. shortly after, the spell was used to impede klaus' brahe and then to secure a bookcase to block the team's escape. [the bookshop hunter]

inside the hamelin cathedral, upon getting swarmed my gremlow's special ability, lok lambert, sophie casterwill and den fears decide to leave the cathedral to think of a solution to defeat the titan. to stop the massive flow of gremlow copies from breaking open the door, sophie used stopglue to seal the entrance. [gremlow infestation!]

dante used the spell on grand façade's feet while fighting wilder inside hermán cortés' vault. this allowed caliban to strike grand façade's unprotected back, sending the titan back to his amulet. [the power of umbra] 

several stopglue spells were cast by both sophie and dante as part of an elaborate trap to neutralize the casterwill hunters guarding the entrance to the phoenix volcano. den also hid the stopglue spells with hidesight so the trap wouldn't be spotted. four casterwill hunters ended up getting stuck on the glue-like substance. noticing the soldiers were freeing themselves from the trap, den and sophie used several augerfrost spells to harden the glue. [the phoenix's ashes]

dante used stopglue in conjunction with bristlebind to immobilize hoffman while fighting with him on the the professor's castle. [an ally from the organization]

== international names ==

sekhmet is a hecto-titan with the body of a purple-furred lioness. her garb is similar to that of egyptian royalty. she uses her two scimitars to protect her seeker, whether a pharaoh or an organization operative.

== history ==
in ancient history, sekhmet inspired the myths of the egyptian goddess, sekhmet, a warrior goddess of vengeance, divine punishment, fire, and healing. she was a very powerful protector of the pharaoh. [wikipedia:sekhmet] a collection of sekhmet amulets came into possession of the organization and were distributed to their egyptian operatives under klaus. [all work and no pay]

=== suit 031's sekhmet ===

huntik:page:3356:
ammit heart-eater is a hecto-titan that resembles a blue-skinned crocodile, dressed in golden armor and a teal robe. her sharp teeth make her a fearsome titan and is thus often called upon by members of the organization in battle.

== history ==
in ancient history, ammit heart-eater inspired the egyptian mythology surrounding ammit, a crocodile goddess that devoured the hearts of people whose hearts were heavier than the feather of truth in the afterlife. she instilled a heightened fear of the nile crocodiles that would attack egyptians and their boats. [huntik.com/secret files]

at one point, eathon lambert faced one or multiple ammit heart-eater titans, noting on his journal that it is better to run away then to face their teeth.  [tcg:oal-050]

=== suit 030's ammit heart-eater ===
ammit heart-eater later became one of the more powerful titans owned by the organization. their amulets were given to many of the high-ranking suits, including an archaeologist working for klaus. at a dig for the lost tomb of nefertiti, ammit was invoked to attack dante vale's team but was defeated by caliban. [all work and no pay] the titan again was invoked within the tomb. it was fought icarus and caliban before being stunned by a double touchram from zhalia moon and dante. [the sceptre deception]

=== klaus' ammit heart-eater ===
in klaus' bookshop, klaus invoked his ammit heart-eater to attack dante vale but was tussled by metagolem. after klaus's nighlurker attacked metagolem, ammit was able to defeat him with a tail swipe. it then fought lok lambert's freelancer before being defeated. [the bookshop hunter]

=== suit 042's ammit heart-eater ===
one of rassimov's suits invoked ammit heart-eater in an alleyway in paris, france where it fought alongside jokoul against both lok and dante's freelancers. another ammit heart-eater was later defeated by the traps in the mausoleum of sir lancelot. [memory lane]

this suit later summoned ammit heart-eater in king solomon's mines where it was defeated by dante's caliban. [to be together]

=== suit 040's ammit heart-eater===
ammit was invoked by one of rassimov's suits in turkey alongside bonelasher but both were swiftly defeated by lok's lindorm. [ladies' choice]

this suit later invoked ammit heart-eater down in atlantis. [coming of age]

=== rassimov's ammit heart-eater ===
one amulet was also present in the arsenal of rassimov, and he treated her like a pet and would not hesitate to summon her to fight against the huntik foundation. [tcg:sas-025]

rassimov summoned ammit heart-eater against dante vale on the bridge of the professor's castle. she was knocked off the bridge by caliban and left unconscious before waking up and delaying lok, sophie and zhalia from joining dante. [the divine comedy]

ammit was later unbonded from rassimov by dante's sorrowbond and locked away in a box with his other titans and taken back to the huntik foundation. [rassimov's secret]

=== suit 025's ammit heart-eater ===
one of klaus' suits attempted to invoke ammit heart-eater against harrison fears outside the tomb of nefertiti but he was completely ensnared by rassimov's thornment. [rassimov's secret]
== abilities ==
ammit can bite and crush her enemies with her razor sharp teeth and powerful jaws as well as use her hefty tail to smash enemies. she can easily destroy a car [tcg:oal-050] and has been shown to be strong enough to hold her own in a tussle with the powerful metagolem before defeating him with assistance. [the sceptre deception]

== gallery ==

ammit heart-eater icon.jpg|ammit's icon
ammit heart-eater.jpg|ammit heart-eater

== trivia ==
*ammit's summoning commands is "shred them".
*ammit is based off ammit, the devourer of the dead, who was also a crocodile, that ate hearts of the ones whose hearts were heavier than a feather, which is where the "heart-eater" part of the title comes from.

huntik:page:3366:
vienna, austria

while dante and zhalia are dealing with personal matters, lok, sophie, and cherit are free to explore the city of vienna. the three of them find a building with some statues representing the mythical basilisk. they find out that the organization suits are plotting something fishy and follow them down an underground labyrinth. zhalia's intervention, in the end, will be decisive for our heros.

== synopsis ==
the huntik team travel to greece, on a quest to find the legendary argo of jason and the argonauts. it's not long however before they end up in a final confrontation with defoe, who is set on revenge.

== plot ==
sophie casterwill is teaching lok lambert some martial arts; guggenheim contacts dante vale for a new mission. they must go the port of velo, greece, and locate the argo which is an old greek magical ship captained by jason. there they must retrieve jason's logbook and also his titans, the hoplites. naturally dante accepts the mission and the team make their way airplane.

defoe is in silene, libya, on a mission for the organization, and he must return with the sword of saint george. the sword contains the titan, lindorm.

defoe is contacted by one of his spies informing him of dante and the team are on the island. to grier's chagrin, who wants to continue, defoe aborts the mission and flies immediately to greece.

the team find a long cave on the stavropolous river, a scan with a holotome reveals a place big enough to hide a boat. cherit remains outside to watch out for any trouble, the team don suits and make ready to dive down to view the ship. the seekers with their powers and aided by their titans manage to haul the ship to the surface only to be faced with defoe; perfectly timing his arrival as usual. grier show concern over the possibility of loosing the titan they are expected to handover.

a fight ensues with defoe's team surrounding the ship, and he gains the upper-hand, mainly due to dante's team's using so many powers while bringing the sunken ship up to the surface. dante manages to get the sword of st. george from defoe and take control of the situation after promising to hand him over to grier if they back off which he agrees. defoe tries to order his men to stop dante and the others, but instead is dragged off by grier. while being dragged off, defoe still tries to remind grier who is boss but his orders fall on deaf ears. afterwards, dante gives the sword of st. george, containing the titan lindorm, and lok bonds with the titan.

dante and the rest of the team check out the ship and discover a secret compartment with jason's log book in it. along with the book is a map with directions to the argo which turns out to be somewhere in the aegean sea.

zhalia moon is given the responsibility of taking all the amulets from defoe to a nearby foundation safe house, though she secretly keeps the amulet gar-ghoul for herself. meanwhile in organization central, grier hands over defoe to rassimov. defoe breaks down onto the floor saying it wasn't his fault. grier leaves the room emotionless.

== trivia ==
* there is an icarus amulet among the titans taken from defoe, which has never been used by him on-screen.
* lok and dante surface rapidly from a depth of 30m or more with no effects. normally divers would suffer from decompression sickness (dcs), also called the bends. they might also suffer from nitrogen narcosis. however, it is possible they used magic to prevent this.

huntik:page:3371:
velos, greece

the huntik team launches into a new mission: finding mythical argo, jason and the argonauts' ship.

stavropolous river

dante and the others use their powers and titans to make the sunken wreck resurface, but this weakens them. defoe and grier ambush the huntik team, but our heros manage to defeat them and find jason's logbook.

== synopsis ==
while resting and relaxing in greece, the seekers await further instructions from guggenheim. they don't have to wait to long before guggenheim sends them off on their next mission. they must use the map they recovered from the wreck and go out to sea. to do this they are given one of the most up to date foundation boats in order to complete their mission. the heroes follow the journey of the argo, finding it to be as eventful as the original myth.

== plot ==
on route to the aegean sea, a vine appears all over the ship. the ship's engine suffers damage, and the team have to make repairs. the island they land at is called madea, which is also the name of the woman who leader.

grier in his new position awaits orders form organization central. defoe, plots to steal the amulets from the organization, but is discovered by grier who deals with him then orders the suits off to the aegean.

madea and the other women help dante by offering herbs to help metz, sophie discovers one of them used to serve the casterwills, showing her a library of secrets, that and lok is told about a man carrying a book and puzzle.

all this becomes suspicious to zhalia moon who uses the holotome to try to discover what is really going on. it turns out that the whole thing is an illusionary trap. she discovers the source of the illusions and the team begin to realize the deception. dante attacks madea and eventually finds the amulet, however, he is unsure of the risk of bonding with it. for safety he sends it to the huntik foundation for analysis.

at the same time, the professor orders grier to dispose of defoe. grier is given a troop of suits and returns to sutos (which is in a civil war), his home in the in the aegean sea.

stormshield is a defensive spell. it creates a purple shield around the caster to repulse and redirect offensive spells. it is favored by members of the blood spiral.

== history ==
stormshield was used by rassimov at the temple of poseidon to defend himself against a joint attack from sabriel and lindorm. [the unseen guide]

captain caine used the spell while fighting lok lambert and sophie casterwill in the underwater city of ys. [the lost city of casterwill]

in venice, italy, tantras used the spell to redirect dante vale's touchram, destroying the shutter of a nearby window. [boys will be seekers]

harrison fears used the spell outside the tomb of nefertiti to deflect a raypulse from one of klaus' suits. [rassimov's secret]

during the fight against the betrayer, harrison used the spell to try to protect zhalia moon against the betrayer's shocklash. [dante's return]

ropetrick is a spell used to manipulate pieces of rope and is manifested through a yellow aura. this spell is highly versatile and can be used for tying knots, binding enemies, or saving falling allies.

== history ==
this spell was used by eathon lambert to help simon judeau save metz from falling into a pool of liquid hot magma. [the divine comedy]

his son, lok lambert used this to distract an enforcer [the golden asp]

dante vale used ropetrick in for solwing to tie up a group of defeated silent soldiers. [sophie on trial]

lok later used the spell to tie up wind in the phoenix volcano. [the phoenix's ashes].

antedeluvian is a vampiric draco-titan twisted by his master, vlad tepes, also known as dracula. the titan and seeker pair planted the seeds of the transylvanian dracula myths. from his massive, bat-like wings to his pale blue skin, enormous strength, and energy-draining bite, antedeluvian is perhaps the one creature more terrifying than the mythological vampire which he inspired.

== history ==
antedeluvian previously belonged to vlad tepes, a very evil seeker, and his amulet was contained in vlad's spear, before eventually becoming separated. the huntik team deduced that vlad may have put a spell on his titans to keep them invoked. [the vampire loses its fangs]

years later, antedeluvian attacked lok lambert, sophie casterwill and cherit while they ventured through the castle of vlad dracul. after defeating icarus, antedeluvian pursued the trio but in vain as they escaped through an alcove. [the vampire loses its fangs]

after some time, antedeluvian became a more wild and uncontrollable with the foundation agents stationed at vlad's castle struggling to subdue him. metz asked lok, having experience with controlling wild titans like lindorm, to see if he could subdue him and lead the mission vampire hunter. however, unbeknownst to them, the blood spiral had taken an interest in the heart of vlad dracul and harrison fears had already bonded with antedeluvian, who then became powerbonded. [lok's leadership]

harrison later invoked powerbonded antedeluvian whilst tantras embarked on a ritual to obtain the power of vlad dracul which almost devastating consequences for the huntik team. having grown considerably in strength, antedeluvian defeated powerbonded lindorm in one hit before gaining his ability. with his power further intensified from two marauder titans through harrison's bloodrank, he then went on to overpower powerbonded sabriel and kaioh the tracker and fought against powerbonded sorcerel. when dante vale arrived with ignatius, antedeluvian was defeated by the pair with dante using his new copykind power to utilize ignatius' burn ability. [lok's leadership]

harrison summoned powerbonded antedeluvian against his brother den fears during their final battle at the blood spiral base. after being hit by a dragonfist, antedeluvian recovered and defeated cursed archer with his life drain ability. however, when den powerbonded with vigilante, the two merged using his cindercloak ability and defeated antedeluvian. [lok and the betrayer]

== abilities ==
]]
fighting against antedeluvian is like fighting against a vampire of legend. he can use his power drain ability to drain energy from ally or enemy titans and use it to become more powerful. thanks to his flight ability, he can dodge attacks with great agility. antedeluvian also has the ability to transform into mist for escape or for ambush thanks to his vaporeal ability. [the vampire loses its fangs] he is also incredibly strong like the vampires of legend. all of this makes this fearsome titan a very dangerous opponent.

== powerbonding ==
's staff (right hand) after taking him out|175x175px]]
upon powerbonding, antedeluvian gains golden armor, taloned wings, a flexible blade and bat-like mask. like other powerbonded titans his size increased; from being equal in height to icarus, to being larger than powerbonded sabriel and kaioh. his original power drain ability has been strengthened into energy drain which allows powerbonded antedeluvian to gain the energy and abilities of enemy titans that he hits, allowing to incorporate lindorm's spinning attack into his sword, or grab and make use of other titans' weapons. [lok's leadership] his other abilities include:

*lifedrain - drains a titan of all their energy. [lok's leadership]
*swooping strike - enables him to dive forcefully through the air at his opponent whilst wielding his blade. [lok and the betrayer]

== design history ==
antedeluvian was based upon the classic features of legendary vampires down to his menacing eyes. he was given bat-like wings due to numerous legends about vampires turning into bats and vice-versa. based upon vlad tepes, the historical nobleman who inspired bram stroker's dracula, antedeluvian was given a sword and armor. [huntik.com]

== trivia ==

* antedeluvian's appearance is based on a vampire, with some cues coming from count dracula and vlad tepes.
* antedeluvian's name has often been misspelled as antideluvian, notably in the videos section of huntik.com and on his giochi preziosi card.

ariel is a protective, loyal gaia-titan with a mastery over the wind and storms. able to create vortexes of energy from his hands and tornadoes that travel hundreds of kilometers, ariel is one of the primary titans of dante vale, having been given to him by his mentor, metz.

== history ==
ariel, also known as uriel, was an archangel found primarily in judeo-christian mysticism and in the apocrypha. generally presented as an authority over the earth and its elements, ariel has also been called an angel of healing, wrath, and creation. 

ariel was the primary titan of metz when he was younger and first starting out as a huntik foundation seeker. metz used ariel on his numerous adventures with eathon lambert and simon judeau. [the secret of two generations]

metz eventually gave ariel's amulet to dante vale to help him against the professor. during their final battle, dante invoked ariel alongside caliban and ignatius to stop the professor from using the legendary titan of immortality, overlos. ariel helped gar-ghoul keep tao occupied before catching caliban after he was thrown through the air by behemoth. however, tao recovered and sent ariel back to his amulet. [the mission]

in the paris catacombs, dante used ariel to help him defeat arc, the legendary titan of fate. ariel turned into a whirlwind and circled arc to temporarily distract her before flying dante a few meters up such that he could finish off arc with his spells from above. [the legendary titan of fate]

ariel was invoked by dante during the battle at the fortress of iron will. while dante fought kiel, ariel fought with vulcana but was eventually defeated. [the spiral war]

in egypt, ariel was used by dante outside the tomb of tutankhamun on the team's mission the eye of the storm to capture rassimov. ariel erased the team's footprints before creating a powerful storm that disorientate both rassimov and harrison fears. later that day, ariel became powerbonded to dante, saving him from rassimov. after burying rassimov in sand with his hyperstrike ability, dante told powerbonded ariel to get the team to safety while he led legion, the titan of war, away with the necklace of tutankhamun. however, when solwing independently led the blood spiral away with the necklace, powerbonded ariel held dante back and reminded him to help his friends. [rassimov's secret]

== abilities ==
]]
ariel uses nature and wind-based attacks to attack enemies at a distance, and in doing so, has been known to conjure up leaf storms to distract and disorient any threats. [huntik.com] ariel can fly at great speed and become a circular whirlwind to dazzle his enemies. [the legendary titan of fate] he can also fire tornado blasts from his hands that heavily knockback and damage those hit [the spiral war], and is strong enough to carry people [the legendary titan of fate] and titans such as caliban [the mission], allowing seekers to attack from above. his mastery of the elements, particularly the wind, means he is able to erase footprints in sand by creating controlled small-scale tornados, or completely disorient and hinder the vision of multiple people with a larger tornado [rassimov's secret]. ariel also has good overall awareness of his surroundings when fighting and can quickly aid allies when they are in need of help. [the mission] however, he is not very durable and will get sent back to his amulet after hit by a single of vulcana's fireballs. [the spiral war]

==powerbonding==
 charges at rassimov with hyperstrike]]
when the bond with dante became stronger, ariel became powerbonded, gaining a larger cape, with vines and branches extending out from his body. he is now able to create more offensive tornadoes with increased range and magnitude. 

*hyperstrike - this ability allows ariel to create whirlwinds around his seeker's legs while also creating a tornado underneath himself, enabling them to levitate through the air at speed whilst creating violent tornadoes that repel anything in their path. these are powerful enough to bury enemy seekers in a sand dune. [rassimov's secret]

ariel's telepathic link with dante also strengthened considerably, allowing him to advise dante and hold him back from going after rassimov, instead reminding him to get his team to safety. [rassimov's secret]

baselaird is a krono-titan inherited by lok lambert from his father, eathon lambert, and appears as a warrior of the sun. though his base stats are relatively low, baselaird quickly became one of lok's primary titans. with baselaird's large shield and powerful curved sword, this golden-armored titan is not one to be trifled with.

== history ==
baselaird was one of eathon lambert's strongest titans and was later recovered by his son, lok lambert, at the temple of poseidon near the entrance to atlantis after the team solved a riddle, left to him by his dad using a box only lok could see. lok later invoked it after sensing his name through the bond. [the unseen guide] later, in atlantis, baselaird was summoned by a raging lok in his one-on-one fight against rassimov. he helped defeat thornment and fought against sekhmet. he then tackled anubian to the casterwill compound's entrance, which the atlantis guardian closed at lok's orders, instantly sending anubian back to its amulet. [coming of age]

on the team's way to the golden asp, lok again summoned baselaird after being grabbed by unnamed suit 040's bonelasher. he quickly sent the suit's titan back to its amulet by stomping on it after a poor attempt from bonelasher to slash baselaird's shield. [the golden asp]

in the ambush to recover the legendary titans from the team, this titan was invoked by lok to fight off shauna and her titans in the streets of venice. however, he was swiftly paralyzed by her dervish. [the secret of two generations]

baselaird was used to launch dendras' marionettes torwards overlos in the final battle against the professor, making lok be able to control overlos after archwarder disrupted the professor's control of the legendary titan. [the mission] 

lok became powerbonded with baselaird during a mission of great personal importance to him, summoning him to fight against the organization outside the nexus in peru. lok ordered him to use sword strike against a gigadrone titan and also defeat hoffman's myrmidon, making wilder and his group retreat. [doorway to huntik]

inside the secret chamber of the tower of nostradamus, lok summoned powerbonded baselaird to fight the organization. in response, wilder invoked incubane and the two titans fought until hoffman hit lok with poisonfang, making powerbonded baselaird briefly fall to his knees; ultimately, both titans sent each other to their respective amulets. [the tower of nostradamus]

cherit managed to sneak powerbonded baselaird's amulet inside the organization vehicle lok and sophie casterwill were trapped in, and the titan was invoked to break open the car from the inside. unnamed suit 055 later fired a raypulse against baselaird's shield, who responded by sending him flying by striking him with his shield. [chasing void] 

lok again used powerbonded baselaird inside klaus' bookshop to fight off the organization in the search for void's amulet. he took out a redcap titan with his shooting slash ability after a long struggle, then swiftly sent a gigadrone titan back to its amulet as the team started heading to the underground laboratory. [the blood spiral]

powerbonded baselaird was summoned by lok to fight off the three titans invoked by arc next to the cathedral of notre dame after he struggled to do so with the willblade. he helped lok defeat ironsquire by shattering part of his shield and also took out freelancer. later on, lok attempted to again invoke baselaird inside arc's dream to fight multiple harlekins after his freelancer turned into a harlekin titan; however, summoning baselaird only made another one appear. [the legendary titan of fate]

on medusa's island, powerbonded baselaird was used to battle kiel and the casterwill hunters. he fought multiple harlekins and later kiel's vulcana. after a long struggle, baselaird grabbed vulcana's fiery body with his hand, taking her out but also being sent back to his amulet in the process. [zhalia's mission]

this titan was again invoked by lok in the phoenix volcano in an ambush against shauna and wind. he grabbed wind so that lok could restrain him with ropetrick. after the two blood spiral seekers freed themselves, powerbonded baselaird fought the powerful shakrit, without much success; later, he defeated ash by throwing her torwards a lava pool and briefly struggled against lilith the queen. in order to finally defeat shakrit, lok used baselaird's focus blade ability so that baselaird could lend him his powerbonded energy. [the phoenix's ashes]

powerbonded baselaird was again summoned to help dante vale and grier against the two undergolem titans invoked by eathon the dog in the professor's castle. in the long battle that followed, he took out the two undergolems as well as hoffman's doberman. after lok managed to retrieve rassimov's files from the castle, he called baselaird back to his amulet. [an ally from the organization]

as the team waited for information on the spiral mark's location, lok invoked powerbonded baselaird to fight psikofen by nostradamus' tomb. after a tense standoff between the titans, baselaird waited for psikofen to charge before defeating him. lok then called him back to his amulet. [words from eathon] at the spiral mark, baselaird was again summoned to hold off legion but was overpowered by the legendary titan. he was nearly permanently absorobed but lok ordered him to return to his amulet just in time. [the spiral mark] later, during the battle between the foundation, casterwills and the blood spiral, lok invoked baselaird to fight off two marauders; after defeating the two titans, lok called him back to his amulet. [lok and the betrayer]

== abilities ==
 with the aid of his shield]]
a favored titan of the legendary seeker eathon lambert, baselaird is among the purest brawler titans. he possesses no magical attacks, but rather is totally reliant on his sword and large shield, as well as his raw strength and martial arts ability. he's seen without his sword sometimes, when he's syncronizes with dendras to control opposing titans. [the mission] he is also an agile and strong titan, being able to take out titans such as bonelasher just by stomping on them, [the golden asp] as well as dragging anubian through the ground a large distance just by tackling it. [coming of age] 

==powerbonding==
 from vulcana's fire]]
when the bond with his seeker became stronger, baselaird became stronger as well as changing significantly in appearance. where his armor was originally mostly brown and covered a majority of his body, golden armor now predominantly covers his torso with a long red cape attached to it, and a portion of his legs with golden boots while some skin can be seen on his arms and legs. his helmet - where it once showed his eyes along with five small spikes, changed to have three long, curved spikes protruding from it, now concealing his eyes. he became able to communicate with his seeker via telepathy and respond to his commands. baselaird's shield and sword both became considerably larger in size. in contrast, his sword became attatched to his arm, which can make him vunerable in case it gets stuck. [lok and the betrayer] his powerbonding abilities include:
*double aggression - enhances his combat skills when facing off two or more enemies. [the legendary titan of fate] [zhalia's mission] 
*focus blade - allows baselaird to lend all of his energy to his seeker so as to enhance their offensive strikes. [the phoenix's ashes]
*leading charge - enables him to charge at an enemy at speed from a distance. [the phoenix's ashes] [the spiral mark]
* absorbs baselaird's powerbonded energy using focus blade]]shooting slash - fires a powerful ray of energy directly from his sword [the tower of nostradamus] [the blood spiral] or by striking the ground with it. [the legendary titan of fate] alternatively, it can swipes an enemy with his sword with additional power. [the phoenix's ashes] [lok and the betrayer]
*sword strike - baselaird swipes an enemy with his sword. [doorway to huntik]
*total defense - uses his shield to completely cover himself from incoming attacks. [the tower of nostradamus] [zhalia's mission]

inside the secret chamber of the tower of nostradamus, lok summoned powerbonded baselaird to fight the organization. in response, wilder invoked incubane and the two titans fought until hoffman hit lok with poisonfang, making powerbonded baselaird briefly fall to his knees; ultimately, both titans sent each other to their respective amulets. [the tower of nostradamus]

cherit managed to sneak powerbonded baselaird's amulet inside the organization vehicle lok and sophie casterwill were trapped in, and the titan was invoked to break open the car from the inside. unnamed suit 055 later fired a raypulse against baselaird's shield, who responded by sending him flying by striking him with his shield. [chasing void] 

lok again used powerbonded baselaird inside klaus' bookshop to fight off the organization in the search for void's amulet. he took out a redcap titan with his shooting slash ability after a long struggle, then swiftly sent a gigadrone titan back to its amulet as the team started heading to the underground laboratory. [the blood spiral]

powerbonded baselaird was summoned by lok to fight off the three titans invoked by arc next to the cathedral of notre dame after he struggled to do so with the willblade. he helped lok defeat ironsquire by shattering part of his shield and also took out freelancer. later on, lok attempted to again invoke baselaird inside arc's dream to fight multiple harlekins after his freelancer turned into a harlekin titan; however, summoning baselaird only made another one appear. [the legendary titan of fate]

on medusa's island, powerbonded baselaird was used to battle kiel and the casterwill hunters. he fought multiple harlekins and later kiel's vulcana. after a long struggle, baselaird grabbed vulcana's fiery body with his hand, taking her out but also being sent back to his amulet in the process. [zhalia's mission]

this titan was again invoked by lok in the phoenix volcano in an ambush against shauna and wind. he grabbed wind so that lok could restrain him with ropetrick. after the two blood spiral seekers freed themselves, powerbonded baselaird fought the powerful shakrit, without much success; later, he defeated ash by throwing her torwards a lava pool and briefly struggled against lilith the queen. in order to finally defeat shakrit, lok used baselaird's focus blade ability so that baselaird could lend him his powerbonded energy. [the phoenix's ashes]

powerbonded baselaird was again summoned to help dante vale and grier against the two undergolem titans invoked by eathon the dog in the professor's castle. in the long battle that followed, he took out the two undergolems as well as hoffman's doberman. after lok managed to retrieve rassimov's files from the castle, he called baselaird back to his amulet. [an ally from the organization]

as the team waited for information on the spiral mark's location, lok invoked powerbonded baselaird to fight psikofen by nostradamus' tomb. after a tense standoff between the titans, baselaird waited for psikofen to charge before defeating him. lok then called him back to his amulet. [words from eathon] at the spiral mark, baselaird was again summoned to hold off legion but was overpowered by the legendary titan. he was nearly permanently absorobed but lok ordered him to return to his amulet just in time. [the spiral mark] later, during the battle between the foundation, casterwills and the blood spiral, lok invoked baselaird to fight off two marauders; after defeating the two titans, lok called him back to his amulet. [lok and the betrayer]
with the aid of his shield]]
a favored titan of the legendary seeker eathon lambert, baselaird is among the purest brawler titans. he possesses no magical attacks, but rather is totally reliant on his sword and large shield, as well as his raw strength and martial arts ability. he's seen without his sword sometimes, when he's syncronizes with dendras to control opposing titans. [the mission] he is also an agile and strong titan, being able to take out titans such as bonelasher just by stomping on them, [the golden asp] as well as dragging anubian through the ground a large distance just by tackling it. [coming of age]
from vulcana's fire]]
when the bond with his seeker became stronger, baselaird became stronger as well as changing significantly in appearance. where his armor was originally mostly brown and covered a majority of his body, golden armor now predominantly covers his torso with a long red cape attached to it, and a portion of his legs with golden boots while some skin can be seen on his arms and legs. his helmet - where it once showed his eyes along with five small spikes, changed to have three long, curved spikes protruding from it, now concealing his eyes. he became able to communicate with his seeker via telepathy and respond to his commands. baselaird's shield and sword both became considerably larger in size. in contrast, his sword became attatched to his arm, which can make him vunerable in case it gets stuck. [lok and the betrayer] his powerbonding abilities include:
*double aggression - enhances his combat skills when facing off two or more enemies. [the legendary titan of fate] [zhalia's mission] 
*focus blade - allows baselaird to lend all of his energy to his seeker so as to enhance their offensive strikes. [the phoenix's ashes]
*leading charge - enables him to charge at an enemy at speed from a distance. [the phoenix's ashes] [the spiral mark]
* absorbs baselaird's powerbonded energy using focus blade]]shooting slash - fires a powerful ray of energy directly from his sword [the tower of nostradamus] [the blood spiral] or by striking the ground with it. [the legendary titan of fate] alternatively, it can swipes an enemy with his sword with additional power. [the phoenix's ashes] [lok and the betrayer]
*sword strike - baselaird swipes an enemy with his sword. [doorway to huntik]
*total defense - uses his shield to completely cover himself from incoming attacks. [the tower of nostradamus] [zhalia's mission]

brahe is a large, golem-like titan whose massive body is covered in ancient runes. rumor within the organization states that the mad scientist, klaus, experimentally created brahe from a metagolem titan. brahe is also related to the coralgolem, undergolem, and chaingolem titans.

== history ==
seekers theorize that brahe has been created as one of the scientific and magical experiments of klaus to modify and "improve" a metagolem titan, possibly through the runes covering its body. [huntik.com]

klaus invoked brahe in the valley of the kings, egypt, to outnumber dante vale's team. the huntik team, who were outnumbered, retreated without engaging against brahe. [all work and no pay]

klaus later invoked brahe in his laboratory when dante's team found klaus' whereabouts. brahe fought against metagolem, but brahe was initially overwhelmed. klaus then used the strikemode spell to power brahe up, making him much stronger than metagolem. dante used stopglue on brahe to prevent him from sending metagolem back to his amulet, though klaus freed brahe by using hexkill. he then threw rocks at lok, who was flying with kipperin. brahe then fought against sabriel, though sabriel was able to dodge his attacks. brahe proved ineffective as dante's team ultimately left with the spear of vlad the impaler, the item that they were after.[the bookshop hunter]

klaus invoked brahe for the last time on the rooftop of the castle of vlad dracul when his spy, zhalia moon, betrayed him. brahe again fought against dante vale's metagolem. metagolem jumped onto brahe, which caused both titans to fall of the roof. [the vampire loses its fangs]

== abilities ==
like metagolem, brahe is made of durable stone. as a large titan, his strength comes at the expense of speed, rendering brahe less able to dodge oncoming attacks. however, with a punch that can send most weaker titans back to their amulets, this exchange may prove useful in battle. in addition to his bulk physique, brahe is also able to fire rocks from his hand with great force.

== design history ==
brahe was named after tycho brahe, an astronomer and alchemist from denmark during the 1500's. brahe's seeker, klaus, is likewise a scientist and alchemist, contrasting brahe's characteristics of being very strong but dumb. at age twenty, tycho brahe lost part of his nose in a sword-duel. though he used a piece of skin-colored metal to replace his nose, the titan, brahe, possesses no nose at all, even though the pieces of metal covering his shoulders could refer to that.

bulreguard is a dog-like gaia-titan that resembles a brown-furred bulldog wearing a spiked collar and celtic-inspired clothing with red, black, and yellow designs. as man's best friend in the world of titans, bulreguard titans are often used outside of battle as companions for seekers. their keen senses and friendly demeanor make them valuable when adventuring.

== history ==
bulreguard was invoked by guggenheim when warning dante vale against the perilous mission of accepting the professor's invitation. though guggenheim feared so much for dante and his team that fighting him was an option, bulreguard simply greeted dante by licking him. it was eventually agreed that dante's team would follow their plan, although without foundation support. [the divine comedy]

bulreguard once stole an uncovered bone from montehue during a huntik foundation dig. [tcg:sas-033]

bulreguard later was invoked to assist alongside dante's team in fighting against the multiplying gremlow titans infesting the hamelin cathedral. using his speak ability, bulreguard was able to temporarily hold the swarming gremlow at bay. [gremlow infestation!]

== abilities ==
bulreguard has a base attack power of 0 and a defense power of 0, both of which increase based on mission zone. [oal-033] his speak ability can be used to intimidate and hold off encroaching opponents. [gremlow infestation!] the enhanced senses and morale-boosting of bulreguard are often used by seekers when going on adventures to keep on the right track. [huntik.com/secret files]

* bulreguard's ability to speak is based on the command for dogs.
* dogs, like cats, are very good at hunting rats, so using a canine titan to hunt rat titans was a good decision on guggenheim's part.

chemosh the colossus is one of the three massive colossi set up by the queen of sheba to guard king solomon's mines against invaders.

== history ==
chemosh, along with ashtoreth and milcom, was left by the queen of sheba to guard the golden asp, the entrance to king solomon's mines, the resting place of the legendary titan of spirit, tao. the three titans lay dormant in the form of statues for many years. [the golden asp]

the three colossi were awoken after cherit pressed the eye of the golden asp which had been found by dante vale, lok lambert, sophie casterwill. [the golden asp]

after the organization arrived, the professor hypnotized the colossi using his ring of araknos, sending the guardians to attack ​dante vale and his team. after punching caliban, chemosh knocked zhalia moon to the ground. dante attempted to save her but chemosh's attack was stopped by an axe from montehue. he was then defeated by dante, montehue and king basilisk working together. [to be together]

== abilities ==
chemosh is strong and packs a powerful punch, enough to knock back caliban and throw zhalia to the ground. however he is not very agile due to his size. [to be together]

dervish is a quadrupedal swara-titan with an insectoid abdomen and a bestial head with four horns. its body is covered in dangerous, barbed spines from head to toe, and even blocking his strikes can be fatal.

== history ==
===shauna's dervish===
dervish was invoked by shauna, together with ash, when the blood spiral attacked the huntik team to gain eathon lambert's journal, the amulet of will, and the rings of the legendary titans. dervish used its paralyze ability to paralyze sabriel so that ash could send sabriel back to her amulet. dervish later hit baselaird in the back and lok lambert in the belly. the defeat of the huntik team allowed shauna to claim the amulet of will and eathon's journal, but she was unable to locate the rings. [the secret of two generations]

in rotterdam, dervish was invoked by shauna, again alongside ash, to attack dante vale. however, the two titans were defeated by powerbonded caliban. [den vs harrison]

=== suits' dervish ===
diaz's suits invoked a dervish titan alongside redcap and bonelasher whilst making their escape after kidnapping cherit, but they were quickly chased off by the titans of the huntik team. [the bulls of pamplona]

== abilities ==
dervish can use its paralyze ability to breath a green mist that can temporarily paralyze enemy titans and seekers. [the secret of two generations] combined with the spines on its body and offensive zap ray, dervish can eliminate its targets with relative ease. [oal-020] being a great help in combat by assisting it's seeker by paralyzing it's opponent, be it both seeker or titan, easily weakening them for it's allies to finish them off. [the secret of two generations]

dominator is one of the professor's most powerful and choice titans alongside nordrake and araknos. it is a fierce titan with large, spiked fists and an ability that can revert a titan to its unbonded archetype.

== history ==
when the professor, rassimov, and a group of suits arrived at the door to the legendary titan, tao, the professor, not wanting anything to go wrong thanks to his lackeys, invoked dominator to ambush anyone to come near the titan. the first two to appear while the professor and his men were trying to open the door were two of his own suits. once montehue, and later dante vale's team, arrived, dominator fought against montehue's fenris and zhalia's kilthane. after rassimov defeated kilthane, dominator attacked sabriel, whose speed prevented her from being hit. dominator was eventually sent back to its amulet by tao. [to be together]

when the professor later attempted to summon overlos through a ritual involving tao, araknos, and behemoth, dominator assisted in killing sabriel by using his spikes special ability, forcing her to refuse to return to her amulet and to use her last powers to protect sophie casterwill. sabriel and her amulet began to crumble to pieces, and she was finished off by the professor. [the mission]

the apparent destruction of sabriel later showed the power of powerbonding to be able to even overcome the destruction of a titan's amulet when powerbonded sabriel was summoned from sophie casterwill's hand. [cave of the casterwills]

== abilities ==
equipped with a pair of spiked, wrecking-ball fists, and very strong muscles, dominator packs a very swift direct strike that is more powerful than almost any titan. his armor, tactics, and ferocious rage combine to make him a furious opponent. it's only his somewhat bulky shape that gives smaller titans a chance, though that is still rarely enough to defeat dominator as he is surprisingly fast. his ocular apparatus is hypersensitive and endowed with an exceptional sight, he's able to capture movements even in the least illuminated of conditions. 

his spikes can cause any titan hit by them to act as their core archetypes and no longer listen to their own seekers. this ability caused fenris to rampage as he had before bonding to montehue and was also key in the events leading to the initial 'killing' of sabriel.

*dominator's summoning command is "serve me".

impet, a twisted, darker brother of cherit, is a small, nimble titan with dark blue skin. adept at hiding and sneaking up on his target, he possesses the ability to enhance his allies or curse his enemies. impet amulets are in the possession of multiple organization agents.

== history ==
impet titans inspired the myths of imps, troublesome, demonic, or fairy-like creatures known to be talented pranksters with a knack for sneaking quietly. [huntik.com] some say that impet is cherit's ancestor, and that he was once a cheerful gargoyle, but later turned to the forces of evil. since then, impet has changed beyond recognition: his skin has darkened and wrinkled, his ears have drooped sadly, and his wings have disappeared. by performing a magical dance, his energy is concentrated and a fiery blast will burst from his mouth. [huntik magazine]

=== suit 043's impet ===
impet was invoked alongside mindrone by unnamed suit 043 in the mausoleum of sir lancelot to attack dante vale and lok lambert but was defeated.

=== other impets ===
later, one of rassimov's suits invoked impet to attack dante and sophie but was caught in a bubblelift power and defeated by sabriel. [memory lane]

in turkey, impet was invoked by one of rassimov's suits to attack the huntik team. he attempted to blast lok but was defeated by cherit. [ladies' choice]

at the temple of poseidon, impet was invoked by one of rassimov's suits. he fired an unsuccessful energy blast at lok before backing up due to a raypulse from sophie. [the unseen guide]

== abilities ==
impet is able to fire an energy blast from his mouth. he is also able to hover in the air and is extremely nimble, able to hide from his enemies and then launch a surprise attack.

== gallery ==

impet amulet.jpg|impet's amulet
impet icon.jpg|impet's icon
impet.jpg|impet

==trivia==
* impet's summoning command is "attack" and "sabotage them."
* in episodes 19 and 20, impet's amulet had a different design, resembling that of a krono-titan and being gold with a white gem.
* in episode 42 - "the power of umbra", wilder refers to cherit as an "imp", vaguely referencing his relation to impet and the imp legends. 
* impet's appearance is based off the original form of the nightmare gargoyle from winx, another series created by iginio straffi. the final form of said monster was used as the design for unnamed titan 006.

milcom the colossus is one of the three massive colossi set up by the queen of sheba to guard king solomon's mines against invaders.

== history ==
milcom, along with ashtoreth and chemosh, was left by the queen of sheba to guard the golden asp, the entrance to king solomon's mines, the resting place of the legendary titan of spirit, tao. the three titans lay dormant in the form of statues for many years. [the golden asp]

the three colossi were awoken after cherit pressed the eye of the golden asp which had been found by dante vale, lok lambert, sophie casterwill. [the golden asp]

after the organization arrived, the professor hypnotized the colossi using his ring of araknos, sending the guardians to attack ​dante vale and his team. after punching lindorm, milcom was tripped over caliban and stunned by lok, sophie, icarus and venadek. he was then defeated by caliban and venadek together. [to be together]

== abilities ==
milcom is strong and powerful, able to wield a large staff to knock back his enemies. milcom's "colossal stride" ability allows him to run at great speed and cover great distance, despite his bulky size. [to be together] he also has the distinction of being the strongest, offensively, of the three colossi.

cypherdex, the original model for tomes used by different seeker groups today]]
a tome combines technology and the magical secrets of the huntik world. essentially, it is a computer that displays information using a holographic 3-d display that works on voice commands. it also is capable of producing a physical card.

tomes can store information on all known titans, as well unknown titans and their abilities, the information of which can be displayed in the form of a card. additionally, it can send and receive e-mail as well as browse the internet. a tome is capable of communicating with other tomes or similar devices, showing a hologram of the communicating person's face. this is how missions are generally received and transmitted. tomes' rendering of an area in state-of-the-art 3-d holographic imaging brings to life otherwise unseen or poorly visible places, but with a limited range. they are also used as a display when short and long range tracking devices are used.

tomes are the key to the success of all master seekers, even evil ones. they are themed according to their owner's faction.

==types of tomes==
* cypherdex: used by the casterwill family
* holotome: used by the huntik foundation
* teknonomicon: used by the organization
* loreslave: used by the blood spiral

== trivia ==
* the word "tome" refers to a book or volume of a work.
* at the beginning of each episode following the first, a holotome is displayed during the recap of the previous episode.

shauna is a member of the blood spiral and part of the blooded circle that answers directly to rassimov. alongside her silent partner, wind, she is one of the powerful and deadly seekers in the blood spiral. she particularly has an axe to grind against the casterwill family, desiring to destroy sophie casterwill.

== history ==
shauna and her brother, rassimov, have had family disputes with the casterwill family spawning from the centuries-long conflict between the casterwills and the blood spiral. shauna and wind were called by rassimov to ambush dante vale's team to obtain the amulet of will and eathon lambert's journal for him to give to the professor. after knocking out sophie casterwill who she reluctantly left breathing, she overpowered lok lambert, taking their prize. [the secret of two generations] she was later waiting in a dark hall for rassimov when purposely fell into one of his own traps. [the divine comedy]

shauna returned with wind and the blood spiral at klaus' bookshop to recover void. she attacked the huntik foundation and organization and defeated stack with ease. after seeing lok has obtained the amulet, she snatched from him and left with the spirals. [the blood spiral] shauna and wind took part helping tantras in recruiting new members for the brotherhood. they later fought dante vale on the erasmus bridge but were incapacitated by his stopglue power. [den vs harrison] 
]]
wind and shauna later attempted to recover the ring of phoenix from phoenix volcano, however they were delayed by the anti-magic field of the lodestone. [the dead magic island] after dante's team destroyed the lodestone, they launched a surprise attack on wind and shauna using their newly restored powers. shuana was taken captive but managed to escape using her fireport spell. after a tumultuous battle, shauna attempted to finish off sophie but was stopped when she dived into the lava, causing the volcano to erupt. shauna and wind hastily made their escape. [the phoenix's ashes]

on the longest night of the year, shauna brutally punished harrison fears for speaking during an audience with the betrayer. she later grew suspicious of zhalia moon who attempted to pass on the details of the spiral mark location to dante vale. [words from eathon] although surprised by her brother´s betrayal and death, she fought against the huntik foundation and the casterwill family when they reached the spiral mark. [the spiral mark] during the final battle, she defeated white and mallory with ease but was defeated when vivian casterwill summoned mythras. [lok and the betrayer]

== personality ==

she is not one to be described as "delicate." shauna is angry, bitter, and determined. she will get the job done. however, her determination is sometimes clouded by personal issues. she often has trouble fighting the urge to stamp out sophie casterwill, as opposed to following her objective. this was demonstrated right from the moment she was introduced in the secret of two generations she was shown to have trouble controlling her temper when her brother told her and wind that there would be a casterwill among the enemy.

shauna respects her brother's wishes albeit with some reluctance. if it were not for him, she would be completely feral. her loyalty to the blood spiral is stronger than her bond with her brother, she callously remarked following her brother's death, after he revealed his true motives, "serve[d] him right". [the spiral mark] she also seems to have some respect for her partner wind although it is unclear whether she has the same feelings he seems to have for her. [the phoenix's ashes]

== abilities ==
]]
shauna is extremely fast, very strong, and quick of mind. as a member of the blood spiral brotherhood, she has access to a multitude of the powerful blood spiral spells such as newfury, a spell she seems to favor. [the blood spiral] among her titans, shauna can call on ash to attack the opponent and evade attacks while the strongest titan in her possession is lilith the queen. [the phoenix's ashes] she easily defeated the combined efforts of lok lambert and sophie casterwill, and according to lok, shauna is even faster than rassimov. [the secret of two generations]

wind is the silent and powerful partner of shauna and one of the deadliest members of the blood spiral. despite the fact that he is mute, he is still capable of using magic, allowing him to act as a silent assassin. the deadly duo travel on wind's sole colossal flying titan, shakrit.

== history ==
little is known of wind's background and early history, and nobody, not even his blood spiral brothers and sisters, know what he hides under his mask. [tcg:oal-031] he was revealed as a member of the blood spiral core group, the blooded circle, an elite of master seekers who command and control the spirals only under the orders of rassimov and the betrayer, himself. [zhalia's mission]

undergolem is a golem-like litho-titan that is even larger and stronger than the already agility-challenged metagolem, but also slower. his face and head is protected by a yellow helmet, while an arm-band covers each of his wrists. 

== history ==

=== the professor's undergolems ===
the professor gained possession of at least two undergolems which he attached to the collar of his dog, eathon. [the secret of two generations]

using araknos, the professor hardwired a response to invoke the two undergolem titans into eathon the dog as a trap for dante vale's team and other intruders. [the mission]

during the raid on the professor's castle, when lok lambert and sophie casterwill were going to fight the professor, two undergolem titans hiding as statues attacked the remaining seekers, dante vale and zhalia moon. zhalia invoked king basilisk to fight, but the two colossi easily sent king basilisk back to its amulet. zhalia then invoked gareon and hoplite, who were likewise be sent back to their amulets. when dante eventually came back to consciousness and invoked caliban and metagolem, his two titans were able to defeat both undergolem titans. [the mission]

when grier led the huntik team to the professor's castle to obtain rassimov's file, eathon the dog, under the care of hoffman, who is now serving wilder, invoked his two undergolem titans. they fought alongside doberman against powerbonded baselaird and megataur. one undergolem was defeated by baselaird while the other overpowered and defeated megataur. the remaining undergolem titan attacked baselaird but was thrown back and defeated. [an ally from the organization]

=== unknown undergolem ===
on the side of good, an undergolem titan was used to fight a breaker titan. [oal-017]

==abilities==
undergolem can phase into a stone form, which restricts his movement, but it also renders him virtually invulnerable. according to sophie casterwill, undergolem is a very powerful titan being that he can fight for hours without getting tired and becomes more powerful the longer he fights. [oal-017]

== history ==
fan dancer titans inspired the japanese martial art of tessenjutsu based on her use of razor-sharp fans as weapons, much like geisha. unlike kabuki, fan dancer titans fell into the hands of evil seekers. [sas-030]

fan dancer fights with her sharp war fans and with her agility. she is skilled in the martial art of tessenjutsu. [sas-030]

ponderous is a brontosaurus-like litho-titan so big and slow that it takes a long time to summon him. nobody has ever seen him start a fight, but this titan often ends them.

== history ==
ponderous titans were behind the legend of the loch ness monster. though made of stone, ponderous loves swimming in scottish lakes something he loves. [tcg:sas-016]

== abilities ==
ponderous can bury itself underground and shoot out of the ground with ease. in addition to its colossal size, it is also a powerful swimmer.

== design history ==
=== rough sketch ===
ah, dinosaurs. big and slow, but really tough. if real dinosaurs were tough, how much tougher would one be if it were made of stone? probably like ponderous! this picture is a simple concept: a seeker is summoning ponderous, and he appears out of the ground (just like metagolem!). we wanted ponderous to look like a brontosaurus and not just a fat-bodied snake, so we asked the artist to make sure ponderous’s front legs are showing in the later sketches.

=== pencil sketch ===
two details you notice right away are that the seeker is santiago and that ponderous has rough-rocky skin that sometimes breaks off in big chunks. you can see his front legs, and together with the shape of his head he really looks like a brontosaurus. we’re almost ready to move on to the color version, but he just needs one more touch to show he’s a titan and not some long-lost dinosaur: decoration. we ask the artist to put a stylized stripe around his neck and shoulders.

=== final art ===
ponderous is now a nice rocky brown color, busting out of the grayish ground (is that cement?). he has some cool gold tribal zigzags on his body, and his eyes glow red like hot lava. santiago stands calmly in front of him, ready to tell him the plan. [huntik.com]

ponderous (pencil sketch).jpg|pencil sketch
ponderous.jpg|final art

== gallery ==

ponderous profile.png|ponderous

== trivia ==
* ponderous is based on the english word "ponderous" which refers to something which is slow or clumsy due to immense weight.

iron monkey is an red-skinned yama-titan that resembles the redcap titans. bearing red samurai armor and packing a powerful punch, this monkey-like titan makes up what redcap lacks in both offense and defense. if his sucker-covered tongue were not enough to strike fear into his enemies, his frenzied attacks will do the trick. iron monkey is used by hector, a tomb raider for the organization.

== abilities ==
iron monkey is capable of dishing out frenzied attacks, but they come at the cost of an allied titan's energy. with 6 attack and 6 defense, this titan's frenzied attacks can be powerful and lasting.

== design history ==
iron monkey's rough sketch was originally drawn portraying an armored titan with sharp claws, long teeth, and a long tongue covered in suckers comparable to an octopus' tentacle. his pencil sketch was changed to a side view to show more of his body and was noted as resembling an armored redcap on coffee. his armor was made to be much more detailed, an his eyes were given something resembling sunglasses. the only stylistic change to his final art was the addition of horns on his helmet. his skin was colored pale red with his armor being a fierce, brilliant red to portray his aggressive and dangerous nature. a serene background much like a japanese countryside was added for contrast. hippolyta is the young queen of the amazons who wore the ring of behemoth as a necklace given to her by her mother. hippolyta's mother is the wife of metz. 

== history ==
before her mother died, hippolyta was given the ring of behemoth which she wore around her neck. [ladies' choice]

when rassimov sent his suits to attack the amazons whilst on the hunt for behemoth, hippolyta summoned forest queen diana and solwing to defend them, however they were defeated along with the amazon forces. they were saved by dante vale, lok lambert and sophie casterwill. after informing them that she could help them find what they were looking for, hippolyta was then challenged by zhalia moon for leadership. after losing, she handed over the symbol of queenship and the ring her mother gave her. this was then given to dante who invoked behemoth, the legendary titan of body, defeating the organization and saving the amazon village. hippolyta then helped them recover her mother's keepsakes, including a photo of her mother's wedding to metz. [ladies' choice]

despite her young age, hippolyta is brave enough to stand her ground and defend her people as seen when fighting against the organization and also participate in a ritual duel against zhalia. she is also honourable, as when she lost, she didn't hesitate to give zhalia what she asked for.

eathon is the professor's dog, whom he named after eathon lambert. though initially suspected that the dog might be the seeker, eathon lambert, who had been converted into a dog by the professor's magic, this information is later shown to be incorrect. after the professor's defeat, hoffman took custody of the dog.

== history ==
during the professor's attempt to summon overlos, the titan of immortality, eathon was left to summon his two undergolem titans in order to keep the huntik team occupied. after finally defeating the titans, dante called him by name to stop him from warning the professor. [the mission]

eathon led hoffman to the chu-goku mount where he found the hidden amulet of divine mirror kagami. [knight of the willblade]

when grier helped the huntik team to access the castle in order to find the professor's files on rassimov, eathon the dog summoned his two undergolem titans again to stop them. [an ally from the organization] 

==personality==
using the powers of araknos, the legendary titan of mind, the professor rewrote the mind of his dog, giving him the ability to invoke titans and making the dog be extremely loyal him. despite the fact that araknos and the professor are no longer around, eathon the dog retains his ability to summon his undergolem titans as a triggered response to the castle being threatened. [an ally from the organization]

==abilities==
as the professor rewrote the very framework of this dog's mind with araknos, eathon does not have to worry about whether his bark is worse than his bite. he is bonded to two undergolem titans and has the ability to find hidden amulets such as that of divine mirror kagami. [knight of the willblade]
