huntik:page:3549:
vienna, austria

klaus has managed to lay his hands on the powerful sceptre of nefertiti, but dante has put a tracking device on it in order to locate klaus in his secret base. the huntik team follows klaus and sneaks into a bookshop despite the lethal traps disseminated by klaus. dante and the huntik team manage to recover the mythical spear of vlad, but zhalia is in klaus' hands.

== synopsis ==
the huntik team travel to romania to recover the titans of the evil vlad dracul. however, klaus is one step ahead and orders zhalia, to eliminate the whole team for the good - but can she go through with it?

== plot ==

an eventful train journey

dante visits his sick mentor, metz, but his condition is getting worse. later, lok and sophie notice he is not himself, even forgetting to wear his socks before leaving for the mission. on a southern romania steam train, dante explains to the team that their mission is to infiltrate the castle of the infamous vlad dracul (vlad the impaler) who was one of the most evil seekers in history. his castle hides a collection of powerful, dark titans, including the vampiric antedeluvian and, because vlad’s ancient magical spells keep these titans continuously invoked within the castle, the team must retrieve vlad's titan amulets before klaus and the organization claim them. meanwhile, klaus locates the castle using his new power, neverlost, and promises the professor more titans. 

zhalia is grappling with her inner turmoil, secretly haunted by her allegiance to klaus and her growing bond with the huntik team. dante asks if she is okay but she responds by asking him about metz. the pair move closer, and dante begins to open up about his feelings for her before they are interrupted by a suit attack on the train. the team spring into action and fight off the suits and their titans before arriving at the castle. 

entering the castle

dante uses the spear of vlad the impaler recovered in their previous mission as a key, and the team enters the castle. using the holotome, dante scans the layout and identifies three main sectors: the main area, tower level, and basements. to cover ground quickly, dante splits the team up: he will take the upper towers, zhalia takes the main halls, and lok, sophie, and cherit will explore the dangerous basement levels. sophie is reluctant as she is suspicious of zhalia but dante insists he needs them split in these teams for his plan to work. 

a flashback reveals zhalia's origins: as a street orphan stealing food, she was recruited by klaus, who promised her power and status in exchange for acting as a double agent to infiltrate the huntik foundation. zhalia meets with klaus in the throne room and receives her orders to eliminate the team for good. 

the dungeons

while searching the subterranean dungeons, lok and sophie are attacked by antedeluvian who defeats sophie's icarus. lok notices details on a wall tapestry and uncovers a secret passage in an alcove, allowing him, sophie and cherit a means to escape vlad's titan oncoming titan just in time.

lok and sophie enter a dungeon area which has a deep pit filled with sharp stakes. cherit flies down and retrieves a bag from inside a skull; it contains vlad's amulets. however, touching the pouch triggers an enchanted skull-shaped trap which flies at them. zhalia arrives and tells them that the trap hones in on the seeker carrying the strongest amulets. to protect the group, lok devises a plan to leave all their amulets behind under the protection of cherit and freelancer, disarming the trap's tracking system. however, taking advantage of lok having stashed his amulets away, zhalia reveals her true colors as an organization double agent. she disables lok with an augerfrost and locks cherit in the dungeon. 

sophie summons sabriel, revealing she didn't fall for zhalia's tricks and two engage in a one-on-one battle. sophie invokes feyone and icarus while zhalia summons kilthane. as the titans fight, zhalia uses her dark organization powers to overpower sophie and prepare a final blow with venomhand. desperate to stop her, lok throws himself in front of sophie, directly into the line of fire, and taking the hit to save her.

zhalia's choice

deep in the castle, the genetically enhanced suits attack dante, who jumps out onto the tower rooftops summoning caliban and solwing. as more and more suits attack, dante fends them off but he is increasingly outnumbered. klaus hits him with poisonfang, knocking him to the ground. as he towers over dante, zhalia arrives with vlad's amulets, delivering them to klaus. satisfied, klaus orders zalia to finish off dante off. a shocked dante tries to get through to her, which triggers a deep emotional shift in zhalia. she realizes that unlike klaus, who viewed her as a tool for power, lok and dante genuinely cared for her and trusted her as a true member of their team. zhalia switches sides and blasts the nearby suits, giving dante time to use everfight and recover. she takes out the suits while dante fights klaus who invokes brahe. dante responds with metagolem, and the two giant titans drag each off the roof into the valley below. klaus overpowers dante and tries to finish him but is hit in the back by zhalia. no longer klaus' puppet, she invokes king basilisk whose petrifying gaze turns klaus to stone. 

conclusion & farewell

back at dante's house, lok and sophie are safe - zhalia wasn't able to go through with it, and instead had tied them up. although dante, lok, cherit and sophie fully forgive zhalia for her betrayal and invite her to stay with the huntik foundation, zhalia expresses deep remorse for her betrayal. unable to forgive herself and needing find her own way and earn her redemption, she says goodbye to the team and departs into the night. lok is adamant that zhalia remains a part of the team and will eventually return one day. 

== trivia ==
*on the train fight, dante, after pushing an organization suit out of a window, says: "no ticket". this is a reference to indiana jones and the last crusade.

paris, france

on the trail of legendary lancelot, the huntik team finds out he was the leader of one of the most important branches of the ancient casterwill family.

lancelot mausoleum

lok and dante pass a series of tests that lead them to a showdown against diabolical rassimov, who had been following them. dante discovers a secret inscription revealing a casterwill power able to fix lok's father's precious diary.

== synopsis ==
the huntik team, under metz' guidance, journeys to turkey to recover the ring of behemoth from the amazons. after a series of mistaken intentions, the team find themselves pitted against the amazons. however, the appearance of rassimov and his men means that the team must intervene. during the conflict, a mysterious figure appears to invoke an ancient rite for leadership of the tribe.

== plot ==
; encountering the amazons
the bedridden metz gives dante vale a key and a map of the coasts of turkey. he, lok lambert, sophie casterwill, and cherit fly to a forest in turkey, where they believe that the legendary titan of body, behemoth, is guarded by a tribe of amazons.

as they arrive, they are intercepted by a group of amazons. dante tells the others not to use their titans, because they didn't know how the amazons would react. sophie, while trying to defend herself, uses honorguard, revealing her powers as a seeker. the amazons immediately stop, surprised. the second in command deduces that dante and lok are her servants. lok begins to protest, but dante covers his mouth, saying that they are indeed sophie's servants.

; mistaken intentions
the amazons lead the team to their fortress, where the foundation members learn the story of hippolyta and her mother. in an attempt to learn about the mechanism hidden in the statue of forest queen diana, lok is caught by one of the amazons, who calls the others, leading the amazons to believe that they are there for evil reasons.

the amazons then keep dante, lok, and cherit captive in a cage hanging on a tree, with sophie bound with numerous green ropes and gagged with a white cloth in another cage.

; vying for power
dante's team returns back to the village, where rassimov and a team of suits already are in battle with the amazons. meanwhile, a mysterious hooded woman appears, and performs the ritual of the amazons, subsequently demanding a combat with hippolyta for the leadership of the tribe. after an easy win and gaining the legendary titan of body, behemoth, this woman reveals herself to be zhalia moon and gives the ring to dante vale. upon behemoth's invocation, rassimov and his suits abort the mission.

; metz's past
in thanks, hippolyta then shows the foundation team a trunk, which is unlocked with metz's key. inside were a wedding photo of metz and hippolyta's mother outside the notre dame cathedral and a wedding dress.

the mission completed, dante's team return to metz's rural estate in germany to give him the picture, giving him a boost to his willpower. zhalia reveals herself as a spy to metz, who decides to accept her as an official foundation member. finally, metz begins to tell lok about knowing eathon lambert.

isle of madea, aegean sea

the huntik team is shipwrecked, but they land on an island inhabited by women who are willing to help them. one girl gives lok a puzzle which belonged to her father. another one has got access to a library of secrets of the casterwills and shows it to sophie, while a third girl has the herbs dante needs for healing a friend. zhalia only has suspicions, and she finds out that the whole island is a magical trap.

== synopsis ==
leaving madea island, dante and the huntik team come off course to stop grier and his suits from invading sutos island. however, the locals do not wish to be free of the organization or grier, who is revealed to be the island's rightful prince. meanwhile, zhalia investigates the argo which was sunk in the island's bay and finds the chest of hoplite amulets.

== plot ==
at an island, lok tries to control lindorm, but he barely forces it back into its amulet with help from zhalia. nearby on the isle of sutos, cruel warlords battle for leadership, but grier shows up with helicopters and declares the island under the control of the organization.

the heroes reach sutos and find the organization in charge. lok, sophie, and cherit distract the locals so that zhalia can look for the sunken argo while dante can take care of grier. during the battles on the island, lok gets angry enough to summon lindorm, who quickly knocks out a bunch of suits, but the people of sutos arrive and angrily attack lindorm. lok sends his new titan back to its amulet before anyone gets hurt. zhalia shows up with the hoplites, titans once owned by jason. the heroes confront grier, who explains that he is there to bring order to his home island.

years ago, grier’s father, zan-sutos, was ruler of sutos island. he was killed by group of rioters when he abandoned his rule. since then, the island has suffered from civil war because of the warlords. dante’s team realizes that despite being part of the organization, grier isn’t a bad person. he’s only trying to help his people.

as a temporary truce, grier lets them leave as the organization did not even know about the hoplite titans which were hidden on the island and grier and dante part as friends.

== trivia ==
*the title of this episode is a spoof on the well-known english phrase "like father, like son". the original phrase is actually said by the professor in episode 24 - "the secret of two generations" in reference to lok lambert and his father, eathon.
*this episode makes up the sixth and final chapter of the app game, huntik: titan defence.

bellona is a krono-titan resembling a fierce lion adorned with the armor of an ancient roman gladiator. the defensive bellona titans are also related to the offensive hoplite titans.

== history ==
bellona titans were favorites of many seekers in ancient rome due to the defensive manner in which the titans fought in combat.

== abilities ==
bellona titans are primarily defensive titans who wear armor and who bear a large shield to protect themselves or other titans behind their lines. bellona titans also wield a small sword, but are less skilled in offensive combat.

== gallery ==

bellona icon.jpg|bellona's icon

== trivia ==
* bellona's name comes from that of the roman goddess of war, bellona, which is derived from the latin word bellum, meaning "war." bellona's name and appearance may also be a play on the finnish jellona, a humorous word for "lion."

rassimov uses the spell to defeat freelancer whilst fighting lok in atlantis. [coming of age]

it was later used by kiel in medusa's cave to defeat and escape metagolem. [zhalia's mission]

gybolg: force of nature is a very average titan who is not too strong but not too weak. when he starts a fight his atk rivals the of caliban, dante's titan but his def remains low enough for many titans to still be able to defeat him. gybolg is a titan that fights best on the front line where his berserker power can come into play. a perfect replacement is caliban: superb warrior, whose attack is always 8, has 1 def more than gybolg, has the forceful ability as well as the possibility to play him from your hand in zone 2 and all without bad costs! caliban: dante's titan is also a good replacement, with 8 attack and 6 defense but each round you have to discard a card or else you must eliminate him.

soulburn is a casterwill spell which lets allows the caster to burn up an amount of life force in order to regain energy for spells. it is dangerous, as the spell can cost the caster's life, so soulburn is rarely used.

== history ==
sophie casterwill used soulburn just after her sabriel's amulet was destroyed while fighting the professor while trying to prevent him from summoning overlos, the legendary titan of immortality. [the mission]

nimue casterwill later used this spell during the blood spiral attack on the fortress of iron will in order to cast the powerful sacroblade spell, even when doing so cost her her life. in light of nimue's sacrifice, sophie then used the spell in order to defeat kiel with powerbonded sorcerel and to drive back the spirals. [the spiral war]

while exploring tír na nóg, sophie was about to use the spell as a last resort against the firbolg and dullahan titans so that she would be able to invoke phoenix. she was stopped at the last moment by lok lambert, who had returned from the inter-dimensional world, and dante vale. [back home]

sutos is a desert island located in the aegean sea. it was the place where grier was born and his father, zan-sutos, was the king. it is unique for being open to the world of seekers and titans, with seekers even using their powers openly. it was also the spot where jason sank his ship, the argo, for good. 

== history ==
sutos was once ruled by zan-sutos, where he was renowned as a wise and just leader. however, he eventually came to believe that his leadership was costing the people their freedom. he bravely gave up his own power so that his people could be free. unfortunately, he was murdered by rioters. instead of his son, grier, the rightful heir, becoming ruler, zan-sutos was soon succeeded by zan-gason, with grier going into exile. subsequently, sutos fell into an endless onslaught of civil war. [like father, unlike son]

grier eventually joined the organization and always vowed to return with his goal being to one day bring order and peace to sutos.

eventually, with the backing of his personal organization army, grier returned to sutos, bringing it under organization control and ending the civil war. the governor of sutos gave grier the royal fighting titan of sutos, megataur which he used to battle against dante in a tense showdown. however, he explained to the huntk team that he had returned to bring order and peace to the people after years of war between local warlords for power. the huntik team, realising that his intentions were honourable, made peace with grier, leaving him to rule of sutos in peace. [s1e12]

the castle of vlad dracul was once the home of vlad dracul, also known as vlad the impaler, one of the evil seekers in history. it was here that the wild titan, antedeluvian, haunted as well as where the heart of vlad dracul was hidden. many traps were left to protect the artifacts and secrets of vlad dracul.

==history==
to enter the castle, the spear of vlad the impaler, which once contained antedeluvian's amulet, had to be inserted into a molded wound on a statue at the castle's gate. the inside of the castle was found to be full of magical traps and secret passages.

most of vlad dracul's amulets were hidden in a bag behind layers of traps, and the bag's rope was sealed with a spell securing the amulets from the hands of good seekers. vlad's final and most powerful titan, the powerful and wild antedeluvian, continued to inhabit the castle after his seeker's death. [the vampire loses its fangs] it later became powerbonded to harrison fears.

the spire of the castle contained a throne room housing a powerful and evil artifact, heart of vlad dracul, which had been hidden under the throne. the power of vlad dracul was contained in this artifact and was later sought after by tantras of the blood spiral. [lok's leadership]

temple of poseidon, greece

lok, dante, sophie and zhalia manage to pass four tests, and get into the casterwill residence in atlantis. lok finds out that his father didn't manage to get there and he might never find him. when the organization attacks, lok unleashes all his anger against the agents, defeating rassimov. sophie reveals her feelings for lok, and the huntik team gets the amulet of will.

== synopsis ==
with the amulet of will now in their possession, the gang decides to decipher additional clues from eathon's journal containing the location of the final two legendary titans. the next legendary titan is located in ethopia, africa, and this time the professor will personally attend to the issue.

== plot ==
back at home, none of the team is able to bond with the amulet of will. they translate a page from the journal and reveal a clue that says king solomon was the last seeker to have the legendary titan of spirit. his treasures are locked in the mines of ophir that once belonged to queen sheba. the heroes travel to ethiopia, and a friendly guide, otto, takes them to the desert to find queen sheba’s tomb.

meanwhile, the professor and rassimov pursue them personally, for they know the stakes are high and it is critical that dante’s team do not get their hands on another legendary titan.

on their way to the tomb, the heroes evade suits and angry villagers but are caught in a desert sandstorm. suits attack during the sandstorm, and zhalia and otto are separated from the team. in their desert search for zhalia, lok, sophie, and dante stumble upon a tomb with a giant snake-shaped entrance. they accidentally activate its guardian titans, the three colossi. zhalia and otto are captured by the professor, and he uses his mind-control ring to force the guide to do his bidding. he then turns the ring to zhalia who screams in agony. 

== trivia ==
*lok's hatred of spiders from "the bookshop hunter" is referenced as he asks otto if there will be any poisonous spiders in the desert, to which the latter humorously replies, "i thought we were looking for snakes!".
*this marks the first time (out of a total of five times) an episode's title is said by a character in that same episode.

county of kerry, ireland

lok invites the huntik team to his mother, sandra's, for a holiday, but kathy, lok's sister, knows nothing about the huntik foundation, and they have to keep her in the dark about their powers as seekers.

newgrange tombs

the huntik team helps scarlet, a childhood friend of lok, and an agent for the huntik foundation, recover the missing titan, gybolg, before the organization.

== synopsis ==
the clues the team found in prague, czech republic, are finally returned and lead the team to the tomb of nefertiti in egypt. the organization decides to make things a little more interesting by eliminating all record of sophie casterwill, including her funds, meaning the gang must find jobs to raise funds and make it to egypt.

== plot ==
the team has returned from ireland and recieve a package from the huntik foundation; they have decoded jodis lore's notes which point them to the tomb of nefertiti. the professor is furious that our heroes keep defeating the organization, and orders rassimov to stop him for good. in order to stop our heroes rassimov uses the organization's connections to wipe sophie's bank records and makes them nonexistent. when the team discovers this they are unable to afford a trip to egypt. zhalia leaves lok and sophie to deal with the problem on their own. 

to raise the money for the trip lok, sophie, leblanche, and santiago get part-time jobs. there first job is working for a hotel but they are soon fired after an altercation with alisa clairmont and her dog. their next job is at a cafe but are again fired after lok used boltflare to heat a rude customer's coffee after he complained that he ordered it hot. their last job is at a fast food restaurant, but are fired again after getting into a fight with a group of suits who had come in to mock them. back at the casterwill townhouse, dante shows up with plane tickets revealing that he has been working several small cases as p.i. to get the money for the trip. 

the team arrive in egypt and reach the lost tomb of nefertiti only to discover it is already being excavated by a group from the organization lead by klaus. the two group fight and just when the team think they've won klaus invokes brahe, forcing our heroes to retreat. at organization central, the professor is furious at rassimov because his actions have revealed to the huntik foundation their influence into the world's bank, and uses a power from his ring to teach rassimov to some obedience.

the second season of huntik: secrets & seekers was first broadcast in italy on september 17th, 2011 on rai due. it premiered in the uk on april 16th, 2012 on the citv network. it premiered in the us on nicktoons on april 21st, 2013. this season follows lok's quest to decipher the quatrains of nostradamus and prevent the end of the world, as sophie uncovers the truth about the casterwill family as she fights to lead them against a dangerous new enemy, the blood spiral. 

== production ==
the american company viacom became a co-owner of rainbow s.p.a. ahead of the second season's premiere in 2011. it premiered on september 17, 2011, on rai 2 in italy, on april 16, 2012, on citv in the uk, and april 21, 2013, on nicktoons in the us. the final episode aired in italy on december 11, 2011, in the uk on may 30, 2012. broadcasting in the us ended on june 30, 2013, with episodes 38 to 52 not being released in the us until the huntik aired on netflix on october 15th, 2015.

the second season saw some changes to the voice cast. matt caplan (credited as drew aaron) took over the role of lok lambert from yuri lowenthal while marc diraison took over the role of rassimov following the passing of maddie blaustein.

== plot ==
with the defeat of the professor, a new menace has arrived. rassimov has become stronger, and a new organization has formed under wilder. having trained since their last battle with the professor, lok lambert, dante vale, sophie casterwill, and zhalia moon must now face this new menace. to help with their adventures, a new seeker, den fears, is recruited to face off against the blood spiral brotherhood. in addition to this new member, the powerbond has been unleashed, transforming the team's titans to be stronger than ever before.

having discovered eathon lambert's holotome, the huntik foundation begins to investigate the holotome's riddles concerning the prophecies of the ancient seeker, nostradamus. the truth about the casterwill family becomes revealed bit by bit, beginning with the discovery of a legendary sword, the willblade.

atlantis is a legendary sunken city submerged beneath the waters of greece. historically constructed by the ancient atlanteans under the guidance of the casterwill family, the city serves as a heavily fortified sanctuary and the ultimate resting place of the legendary amulet of will. the city is structurally protected from the crushing deep-sea environment by a massive, ancient magical atmospheric bubble. this perimeter barrier keeps the city completely dry and allows human seekers to breathe normally. the primary entryway to the sunken continent is hidden on the surface, concealed beneath the ruins of the temple of poseidon.

== history ==
in the modern era, the puzzle required to unlock the final vault mechanism inside the lower levels of the compound was successfully recovered by the legendary seeker eathon lambert. [s1e15] eathon journeyed to atlantis where he singehandedly fought a huge battle with the professor's personal guard. however he never made it to the casterwill compound. [s1e21]

ten years later, eathon's son lok lambert brought the puzzle back to atlantis. he and the huntik team took on the trials of atlantis and managed to pass four tests. shortly after, the city was breached by the organization, and lok used his authorized master command over the atlantis guardian to ambush rassimov and his team of suits, weaponizing the facility's defenses in a defensive rage after discovering his father had never safely arrived at the sanctuary. following the battle, by successfully inserting the key and decoding the central altar puzzle, lok manged to retrieve the amulet of will. [s1e21]

== layout and architecture ==
the design of atlantis relies heavily on sacred geometry dedicated to the greek god of the sea. the layout consists of two primary zones:
* the six temples: the city features a strict radial defensive architecture. four distinct temples anchor the four cardinal corners of the city, while a fifth temple sits directly behind the central casterwill stronghold. the ruined temple of poseidon on the surface acts as the sixth and final anchor point.
* the casterwill compound: one of the last intact bastions of the first seeker's bloodline, this compound holds ancient archives and the main vault chamber. the entire complex is shielded by an autonomous defensive enchantment that restricts entry strictly to those who prove their worth.

== the trials of atlantis ==
to bypass the magical ward sealing the casterwill compound, an intruder or seeker must successfully overcome four consecutive elemental and psychological tests designed to filter out the unworthy.

=== the trial of bravery ===
* challenger: lok lambert
* the test: the seeker must deliberately walk through a roaring, intense wall of mystical flames. 
* outcome: passed. the fire behaves as an illusion that inflicts absolutely no physical harm, provided the challenger maintains unwavering resolve and shows zero fear.

=== the trial of prowess ===
* challenger: dante vale
* the test: a martial combat trial requiring the seeker to defeat three aquatic mermen gladiators. the chamber is heavily enchanted with a direct mimicry hex: whenever the challenger invokes a titan, the chamber automatically manifests an atlantean counterpart of identical power (such as matching metagolem with a coralgolem, or caliban with caliban ocean warrior).
* outcome: passed. dante bypassed the mirror mechanic by invoking behemoth, the legendary titan of body. because legendary titans possess no equivalent, the chamber failed to generate a counterpart and their attempt backfired - badly.

=== the trial of intelligence ===
* challenger: sophie casterwill
* the test: a riddle of architectural history demanding the exact number of temples built by the atlanteans to honor poseidon.
* outcome: passed. sophie correctly answered "six" — deducing that the total included the four corner city temples, the inner compound temple, and the ruined terrestrial surface temple.

=== the trial of nobility ===
* challenger: zhalia moon
* the test: a spiritual and psychological evaluation forcing the challenger to demonstrate genuine inner integrity and absolute self-honesty.
* outcome: passed. zhalia successfully broke the trial by openly admitting her past deceptive crimes and confronting her deepest personal guilt.

the sword of saint george is a double-edged sword which was once used by saint george and held his titan lindorm, before the sword was buried in silene, libya.

== history ==
saint george used the sword to seal the amulet of lindorm before the sword was buried in silene, libya.

it remained there until it was unearthed by defoe and grier on behalf of the organization. defoe was meant to transport the titan to organization central, prague, but instead took the sword with him to greece, where dante vale was spotted, under the excuse they were having trouble unearthing it.

defoe used the sword in his assault on dante's team, against orders as pointed out from grier. after the team surfaced a ship once used in the argonaut fleet, defoe entered the ship and slashed the sword against dante while using poisonfang, gar-ghoul and mindrone. during the fight, the sword was used to block a rebounded poisonfang.

as dante proved too strong, defoe used the sword to threaten sophie casterwill, forcing dante to stand down. after a sneak attack from lok lambert, knocking defoe off balance, dante grabbed the sword with spidertouch and now held defoe hostage, forcing grier and the organization to retreat.

the sword was then given to lok, who bonded with its titan lindorm after some effort. the bonding caused the sword's color to fade, probably as an effect of losing its titan, and it turned grey before lok dropped it. [the treasures of the argonauts]

* like the sword of saint george, the willblade was used to seal titans. in that case, the titans were pendragon and quetzalcoatl.

acidheart is a spell used to knock someone someone out by targeting the heart. this spell manifests as a spherical aura on the hand which emits a wavelike stream of green energy.

== history ==
at some point, acidheart was used by klaus against dante vale so that klaus could return to his experiments for the organization. [sas-127]

acidheart was used by rassimov to attack lok lambert during the huntik foundation's assault on the professor's castle, effectively cutting rassimov's opposition down to just dante vale. [the divine comedy]

in the hunt for the willblade in avalon, wilder targeted lok with acidheart, but the spell was reflected with armorbrand. after lok acquired the willblade, wilder again tried to hit lok with acidheart, but the spell was negated by the willblade. [knight of the willblade]

acidheart was used point-blank by tantras when he deduced that zhalia moon was a spy. [sophie on trial]

during the assault on the fortress of iron will, a casterwill hunter used the spell on leblanche, injuring him. later, tantras again used this spell to attack sophie casterwill and to buy time for kiel. [the spiral war]

== trivia ==
* acidheart debuted in "the divine comedy" with a translucent violet aura and was nearly identical to drybite. the coloration of acidheart was changed for every subsequent appearance.
* in "chasing void", wilder casting acidheart in the previous episode re-appears as a flashback, though neither lok nor cherit witnessed it.

the professor's castle, prague

the amulet of will and lok's father's diary are in the professor's hands. in order to get them back, the huntik team decides to face him once and for all in his private hideout. but the professor's diabolical mind has no limits. after an arduous fight, he persuades dante to turn his back on his friends and give him the three legendary titans.

== synopsis ==
with dante in a shocked and vulnerable state after being tricked by the professor, lok leads the team into a final battle with the professor as they try and prevent him from invoking the legendary titan of immortality. but sacrifices have to be made...

==plot==
the legendary titans

inside the professor's castle, lok expresses his frustrations at dante for giving the professor tao and behemoth, but dante is in a state of complete shock and can't react. the team decide to go on without him and plan to stall the ritual to invoke the legendary titan of immortality by distracting the legendary titans. however, zhalia decides to stay with dante as he's completely vulnerable to any threats, and sure enough, two statues in the room turn into undergolem titans, and zhalia is left to fight them and protect dante while lok, sophie and cherit go after the professor.
's titans are off to face behemoth]]
in the invocation room, the professor summons behemoth, tao and araknos and begins the ritual to awaken the legendary titan from the amulet of will. shortly after, the team arrives and the professor reveals that invoking the legendary titan of immortality, though indeed will cure metz, will also serve to give him immortality to dominate the world. lok and sophie decide to invoke their titans as araknos is busy with the ritual to control them, and start fighting the professor, also interrupting his ritual. simon orders the legendary titans to attack them and focus their strength on lok. despite their best efforts, it's not long before most of lok and sophie's titans are overpowered by the legendary titans. tao then sends lok flying through the wall, and cherit is able to catch him. 

in the meanwhile, zhalia is still fighting the undergolems and notices that seemingly no seeker is there to control them. sophie is then off to fight the professor by herself, and is able to invoke icarus and sabriel after using newlife on their amulets. araknos is still able to control them with its webs; however, to the professor's surprise, sophie invokes albion, who is immune to mind control and is able to free icarus and sabriel from the webs. simon then sends behemoth and tao after her. to his annoyance, sophie and her titans are able to further stall both legendary titans for the time being.

more than just a titan

lok then regains consciousness inside of the professor's personal room, as cherit had barely enough energy to drop him off through the window. lok finds his dad's old holotome in a desk, alongside the amulet of dendras, who is able to gain control of enemy titans with the aid of baselaird. back in the invocation room, sophie is too weak to use any more powers, and sabriel is her last titan remaining. the professor doesn't want to waste any more time and restarts the ritual. sophie orders sabriel to attack simon but he invokes nordrake and dominator. zhalia is still struggling against the enemy titans while dante is unconscious and is out of power to call any more titans of her own. still in the professor's room, lok has worked out a plan involving dendras and baselaird to hopefully save the day.
 breaks down as sabriel's amulet fades into dust]]
sophie and sabriel struggle against the professor's titans as the latter is hit with dominator's spikes, causing her to ignore orders and keep fighting, gradually taking hits and deteriorating while not being sent back to her amulet. sabriel decides to attack the professor directly, who strikes her with a sequence of spells that make sabriel disappear, her amulet being destroyed, seemingly for good. sophie is angered after her titan-friend is permanently destroyed, and uses soulburn to gain energy to keep fighting at the cost of some of her life force.

eathon lambert's fate

in the meanwhile, zhalia is completely out of titans and starts saying her goodbyes to dante as the two undergolems move closer. however, dante suddenly wakes up and invokes a spare caliban to fight off the enemies. sophie again takes on the professor and his titans and is soon launched out of the hole lok made when he was thrown against the wall, only to be caught by him with the use of kipperin. they fly back to the invocation room and lok starts to inquiry simon about his father's whereabouts, just as dante invokes metagolem to finish off the two enemy titans. afterwards, he and zhalia find a dog named eathon who, via a trained response set by araknos, invoked the undergolems. the two then start heading to the invocation room. 
 corners eathon ten years in the past]]
the professor answers lok's questions and explains how he chased eathon lambert for years before finally cornering him by a waterfall in south america ten years ago; he continues by saying eathon knew he could make him say anything he wanted with araknos' ring, and that eathon did not want to give up the information on the amulet of will; however, they were interrupted by the completion of the ritual to prepare the amulet of will to be used right before the professor revealed what eathon decided to do at the waterfall. lok sees that he need to stop him from getting to the amulet of will, but he's quickly overpowered by the three legendary titans who are now free to fight back. he is then saved by dante's metagolem, who joins the fight alongside zhalia. 

the plan to save the world
's plan comes to fruition at the last second as he's able to control overlos]]
lok states that he has a plan to the team as the professor invokes overlos, the legendary titan of will. lok then invokes dendras and baselaird while dante also invokes his respective titans, with zhalia invoking gar-ghoul, as she had taken the amulet for herself instead of giving it to a huntik foundation hq. the team and their titans work in unison to distract the professor's titans right as baselaird joins forces with dendras to control overlos before the professor can request immortality for himself. however, overlos is seemingly immune to dendras' ability, making dante invoke archwarder to successfully disrupt simon's control of the legendary titan of immortality. lok, now having control of overlos with dendras, commands it to open a portal to the spirit world and take the remaining legendary titans with it. overlos does as ordered, but not before araknos webs the professor to also drag him to huntik. despite lok and dante's best efforts to save him, simon judeau does get taken to the spirit world as the portal closes up.

two days later, the huntik team is back at dante's house and are surprised by clapping from various friends, including the newly cured metz, congratulating them for defeating the professor. the team praise lok while he wonders about his father's fate, hoping to find him. nevertheless, summer vacation is almost over, and school starts next monday for lok and sophie.

==trivia==
*the original italian of this episode is "e' nato un cercatore" (a seeker is born in italian) which is the name of the first episode of the series in english.
*after giving his caliban amulet to the professor in the episode prior, dante reveals in this episode that he, in fact, always possessed two caliban titans. this is much more clear-cut in the italian dub where dante says this outright, while in the english dub he states "good thing i always carry a spare".

the golden asp was large structure carved as a serpent and served as the entrance to king solomon's mines. the golden asp was guarded by the three titan colossi: ashtoreth, chemosh, and milcom. pressing the eye of the serpent would open the doors but would also wake the colossi.

== history ==
king solomon left all his treasure inside the mines and his love, the queen of sheba left three collosi to guard the structure. [the golden asp] at some point in history, cherit visited the location. [the golden asp]

the huntik team found a sketch of the serpent in eathon lambert's journal. with help from otto, they ventured into the ethiopian desert and, thanks to cherit's familiarity with the location found the burial marker, pointing them towards the golden asp. however, when cherit touched the eye of the serpent, the three colossi awoke and began to attack them. [the golden asp] working with montehue and tersly, the huntik team were able to defeat the three colossi and enter the mines. [to be together]

lucas casterwill is the older brother of sophie casterwill. he became orphaned at a young age when his parents were killed due to a massive fire at their mansion in paris caused by kiel, a member of the blood spiral.

==history==

lucas grew up looking out for his younger sister, but were separated when their parents' house was burnt down by kiel and his casterwill hunters. sophie was rescued by her bodyguard santiago but lucas was believed to be dead. however, he had, in fact, survived. [chasing void]

lucas casterwill kept his existence secret, leading his sister, sophie casterwill, to believe he had died in the fire just as he, himself, had believed her to be dead prior to her joining the huntik foundation. a year after finding out she was still alive, lucas and his team, dellix and lane, attacked her and the huntik team in the casterwill library in paris, in a bid to stop them pursuing the family's secrets, for her own safety. he revealed his identity before revealing that his team needed to recover the evil amulet of void. [chasing void] 

at the casterwill meeting at the fortress of iron will, lucas was against fighting openly against the blood spiral brotherhood. when sophie challenged, he tested her with the trial of courage, a dangerous quest that he himself had failed. [sophie on trial] when sophie returned with the legendary titan of bravery, mythras, lucas remained skeptical. his views changed when he saw her hold her own in the battle with kiel and give mythras to vivian casterwill. he then decided to put his faith in her as the leader of the family. [the spiral war]

on the longest night of the year, lucas travelled with his team to the spiral mark in the scramjets. [the spiral mark] as the battle ensued against the blood spiral, lucas was badly injured by wind. [lok and the betrayer] after being revived by lady s. with her everheal power, lucas joined sandra lambert in the final battle against the betrayer. however, he became petrified by the betrayer's shadowlock power for a remainder of the conflict. after the betrayer's defeat, he was released and seen celebrating with the rest of the casterwills and the foundation. [dante's return] 

==personality==

lucas is proud of his heritage, and very sure of his own power, much like his younger sister. he thinks himself to be more powerful than sophie, and tends to be sharp towards her, treating her like a child, although it is unclear whether he actually is more powerful than her. though his strict behavior comes more from worry for her safety than from coldness. however, he doesn't know how best to protect her. during sophie's trial, when focauld asked him why he told his sister of the test while he didn't believe in her succeeding in it, he explained that he hopes that when she fails, she will see his point and agree to back off from the fight. he is more of a talker, or rationalist and opposses the idea of open war with spirals believing that the best way to save the family lies in staying in hiding. he usually prefers to stay away from fights, but he can be persuaded to help, which is shown in "chasing void" when after zhalia's speech he joins in with huntik team, and in "spiral war" when he reluctantly follows dellix and lane, joining others in fight against spiral army, though he states he'll never forgive his friends for that. he seems reluctant to leave his team to fight alone. eventually he agrees to join in the fight after seeing his sister hold her own. he then admits he was wrong and he swears his loyalty to her, showing beyond a shadow of a doubt that he was not too proud to acknowledge when he is wrong and when someone shows their worth. he's also not too proud to ask and beg, given that he had begged his sister to go into hiding after she safely got back from klaus's lab. [the blood spiral] he is above all a noble and reliable person.

==abilities==
]]
as a member of the casterwill family, lucas has access to powerful casterwill magic. his abilities also allow him access to powerful titans, although he was unable to pass the trial of courage and bond with the legendary titan of valour, mythras. [sophie on trial] despite his hesitance to engage in direct fighting, due to having witnessed the pure destruction and chaos caused by the blood spiral, he is a highly skilled and capable fighter with a strong strategic nous and leadership skills. [the spiral war] [dante's return] one of his preferred combat moves includes using both sunlock and kindlestrike at the same time, allowing him to both restrict and finish off his opponents. [chasing void] [lok and the betrayer]

===spells utilized===

* hyperstride
* kindlestrike
* sunlock

den fears is a courageous young orphan and the older brother of harrison fears. forced to join the blood spiral with his brother, den quickly saw through their cruel ideals and walked away, joining the huntik foundation and pitting himself against harrison, who stayed with the spirals. den subsequently joined dante's team as a replacement for zhalia moon when she left to infiltrate the blood spiral, his troubled past giving him an edge in mastering dark and sinister titans, notably his signature swordsman, vigilante. yet a rookie in the seeker world, den, like lok lambert before him, has quickly become an accomplished seeker and one of the foundation's main agents. 

==history==
, vigilante]]
den never knew his parents, and was raised with his brother, harrison, in an orphanage in rotterdam, netherlands, the same orphanage where zhalia moon had lived years earlier. den would often protect his brother from bullies around the orphanage, unknowingly using his latent seeker abilities. when the blood spiral took interest in the orphanage, tantras began to teach the orphans to become his silent soldiers. den showed remarkable potential, initially catching the eye of tantras, but he failed to bond with the marauder amulet as he refused to give in to his darker emotions and become a bully to others. this aggravated tantras, and as the brothers debated about joining the spiral, zhalia appeared with a warning. [den vs harrison]

after magically being marked with the symbol of the spiral by rassimov, den decided against this life, refusing to hurt people for no good reason. however, harrison decided to remain with tantras, and bitterly resented den for, from his perspective, abandoning him. as den joined zhalia, a conflict between the blood spiral and the huntik foundation erupted on the erasmus bridge, during which den managed to bond with the amulet of vigilante which lok lambert had dropped. after the battle, den went to dante's house with dante vale's team. [den vs harrison]

welcomed into the huntik foundation, den began training at huntik foundation italian hq, but would take time out to play with lok and cherit, at one time playing a large scale game of chess. [the legendary titan of fate] 
 gives his freelancer to den]]
after long periods of intense concentration and training under the guidance of clease, den soon grew bored and frustrated at his lack of improvement. after accidentally wrecking the hq library, den was asked by lok, sophie and dante to join their team, having been recommended by zhalia herself to replace her to which he happily agreed. however, overwhelmed by the responsibility, den ran away, determined to find harrison by himself. after being attacked by his former fellow orphans, now official students of the blood spiral, he was rescued by lok, cherit and powerbonded kipperin. upon realizing the spirals were after den, lok gave him his freelancer amulet stating they would be a good match. after meeting the tantras and his students for a confrontation, den took on his brother, considerably more powerful and brutal, and with cherit and freelancer's help was able to defeat him. den nearly took harrison to the huntik foundation, but zhalia moon used a darksleep on den to prevent such an occurrence and earn tantras' trust. now part of the team, den returned to studying now with lok helping him. [boys will be seekers]

over time, a growth in experience shaped den to become both braver and stronger. his first adventure outside the city in mexico saw him get kidnapped by kiel and marduk, however he did not let this break his confidence and helped cherit and lok activate the blue star. [the titan in the temple of sun] the huntik foundation council were also impressed with his bravery and gave him a new titan, cursed archer, which he used whilst assisting dante in the great rift valley, africa. [sophie on trial] his fortitude showed immensely when he joined dante and lok in taking on an entire army of blood spiral soldiers whilst defending the fortress of iron will. [the spiral war]

 and kaioh the tracker in hernán cortés's vault]]
whilst staying in baja california, mexico, den befriended a native american seeker named teeg who gave him the amulet of kaioh the tracker. den later used kaioh in hernán cortés' vault, which proved vital in finding the ring of umbra the shadow jaguar. [the power of umbra]

brought closer by their numerous adventures together, den grew to look up to lok as a brother as compared to harrison, who he now considered an illusion of his past self. [an ally from the organization] den took to the experience of feeling part of a family when staying at the lambert house, with sandra lambert growing very fond of him. whilst in ireland, den found the amulet of dullahan the headless knight in the ruins of tír na nóg. [back home]

on the longest night of the year, den and the huntik team travelled to nostradamus' tomb where they found the last quatrain. experiencing great pain from his tattoo, den warned the team that they were almost out of time. after a battle with marduk and his men, den and the team were teleported by umbra to the spiral mark. [words from eathon] determined to find his brother once and for all, den thanked the team for everything before bidding them farewell and using camoforge to become invisible and enter the blood spiral base. [the spiral mark]

upon finding harrison, a fierce battle ensued between the two, with den powerbonding with vigilante. however, cave-in resulted in them being rescued by zhalia moon and kilthane, who brought them to safety. after witnessing zhalia at the mercy of the betrayer, harrison realized he was fighting on the wrong side and used powermark on kilthane to revive den, whom he begged for help. back together, they joined forces to attack the betrayer. [lok and the betrayer] den helped the newly reunited huntik team defeat the betrayer and witnessed dante's return from the ashes. after the defeat of the blood spiral, he was seen reunited with harrison and, later, standing with the team in the rain forest with lok as their new team leader. [dante's return]

==personality==

den is very playful and likes to think highly of himself, often boasting about his deeds. [back home] however, he is very protective of people he cares for. he is fearless and will fight to the end with his enemies. den doesn't hold a grudge against the world for being an orphan, as his younger brother harrison does. he often defends the weak ones. [den vs harrison] den has also shown himself to be a fast learner and someone who wants to use his newly found powers to help others in need. [boys will be seekers] it is for this reason that he idolizes lok, who has taken him under his wing as a teacher and older brother. den's loyalty towards led him to risk his own safety to save him from hoffman's trapcage power in the vault of cortes [the power of umbra] and he tried to encourage lok when he became devoid of hope during the final battle. [dante's return] for den, lok is the ideal super hero and hopes to follow in his footsteps and one day be his equal. [an ally from the organization]

den is also a big eater, often keen to find a place to get food. [sophie on trial] [gremlow infestation!] he thoroughly enjoyed the home cooking of both teeg [the power of umbra] and sandra lambert. [back home] he develops a crush on emi, a foundation seeker, and tries to impress her, but admits he has a lot to learn about how to talk to girls. [the guardian of yonaguni]

==abilities==
, vigilante]]
den discovered his seeker powers whilst defending his brother from bullies at his orphanage. [den vs harrison] he is a fast learner and quite athletic, always willing to try new moves in combat. [the casterwill connection] den's strong dark side allows him to bond with sinister titans like vigilante and cursed archer, thus making him valuable to the team whilst his resistance to evil is clear through how he failed to bond with marauder, whose amulet he was given by tantras.

januseea the gatekeeper is a masked meso-titan with exceptional inter-dimensional capabilities. her appearance is that of a crossed-legged humanoid figure, surrounded by floating blue orbs capable of redirecting attacks. januseea's amulet is in the possession of zhalia moon.

==history ==
zhalia obtained the amulet of januseea the gatekeeper sometime after the defeat of the professor and prior to the discovery of the nexus in peru. on the mission fate of the father, dante vale stated that titans sensitive to seeker energy like januseea would be most appropriate. zhalia used januseea to create a link to the spirit world via the nexus in the waterfall cave to form a projection of eathon lambert. after the nexus exploded, she teleported to dante's side and protected him against hoffman. [doorway to huntik]

januseea was used by zhalia again in klaus' bookshop to fight wilder's gigadrone. she reflected gigadrone's blasts and pushed it into some bookshelves but it managed to recover and defeat her. [the blood spiral]

==abilities ==
highly sensitive to seeker energy, januseea the gatekeeper possesses the ability to track one's energy, absorb an attack and release at the caster, and create an energy link between a human and their possession to create astral projection of that person, as with eathon lambert and his holotome. she is also able to teleport short distances. [doorway to huntik]

==gallery==

janusea amulet.jpg|januseea the gatekeeper's amulet
januseea icon.jpg|januseea the gatekeeper's icon
janusea.jpg|januseea without her orbs

==trivia==
*her summoning command is "open the door between dimensions."
*januseea is named after janus, the roman god of doorways, gates and choices.

== international names ==

harlekin are the principle titans used by the silent soldiers of the blood spiral. according to tantras, fear is necessary to bond with harlekin in contrast to the rage which is necessary to bond with marauder. within the blood spiral, harlekin and marauder are like the redcap and mindrone titans of the organization.

==history ==
when both the casterwill family and the organization set their eyes on the amulet of void, harlekin titans were used when the blood spiral burst in to seize the nullifier. when dante vale powerbonded with caliban, harlekin tried to attack the newly empowered titan but powerbonded caliban instead threw harlekin into marauder, his sharp claws sending him back his amulet. harlekin was then defeated by caliban's sword.[the blood spiral]

when tantras was attempting to recruit several orphans for the blood spiral, he tested their potential as seekers. when harrison fears summoned marauder, the other two boys were terrified. tantras then gave the frightened boys harlekin amulets, telling the boys to use their fear to invoke harlekin. the boys later used their harlekin titans to attack lok and sophie. after fighting sorcerel, one harlekin was defeated by lok while the other, having defeated vigilante, was defeated by powerbonded caliban. [den vs harrison]

in the dreamworld created by arc, the legendary titan of fate, lok was attacked by multiple harlekins after cherit and all his amulets turned into the titan. after a moment of realisation from eathon lambert, lok invoked pendragon, the legendary titan of champions and together, with the willblade, defeated the harlekins and escaped the dream. [the legendary titan of fate]

two harlekin titans were invoked by the casterwill hunters in the cave of medusa to rescue kiel from the huntik foundation. they were fought off by powerbonded baselaird using his double aggression ability before defeating them both. [zhalia's mission]

harlekin was invoked on the streets of venice by the same blue-haired orphan recruit to attack the huntik team. after a fierce fight against powerbonded lindorm, harlekin was defeated by lok and lindorm's spinnerslash ability. [boys will be seekers]

harlekin was invoked by one of kiel's silent soldiers on a clifftop in mexico. it attacked dante's metagolem, but was knocked back by a large root before being punched and defeated. [the titan in the temple of sun]

harlekin was invoked alongside midnight rook in the great rift valley to attack dante and den. after fighting against dante's solwing, it was defeated by den's new titan, cursed archer. [sophie on trial] numerous harlekin titans fought against the casterwill family and huntik foundation during the spiral siege on the fortress of iron will. many attacked and were defeated by templar, the titan of lucas casterwill. [the spiral war]

harlekin was invoked by a casterwill hunter to pursue lok on the anti-magic island of the phoenix. however the pair were led right into a trap where they were buried in logs released by dante's elf king oberon. harlekin, now angry, attempted to escape but was defeated by oberon. [the phoenix's ashes]

during a nightmare, lok was attacked by numerous harlekin titans outside the site of tír na nóg. after trying to save his father, eathon, with the willblade, lok fell through a portal in the ground, something which later happened in reality. [back home]

after being overpowered by den and powerbonded vigilante during their final battle, harrison desperately yelled at zhalia to invoke her harlekin titan to which she responded by invoking kilthane. harlekin was later invoked by a silent soldier amongst the fierce clash between the blood spiral, casterwill family and huntik foundation factions at the spiral mark. [lok and the betrayer]

==abilities ==
harlekin attacks using its sharp claws, and it appears to be fairly strong and fairly agile. like marauder, harlekin draws power on its seeker's negative emotions, being fuelled by fear. it is also able to jump from place to place quickly. [boys will be seekers]

* the command for summoning harlekin is "embrace madness."
* harlekin is based on the harlequin which was a type of court jester common in medieval england.

vigilante is an assassin-like draco-titan whose face and body are covered by a flowing cloak. vigilante once belonged to an evil seeker, would therefore only bond to someone with a strong dark side, and that is why, after his amulet came into the possession of the huntik foundation, vigilante became the primary titan of the orphan, den fears.

==history==
metz believed that vigilante was originally used by a very evil seeker and thus would easily bond to a seeker with a strong dark side. [den vs harrison]

lok lambert and sophie casterwill were tasked to deliver vigilante's amulet to huntik foundation dutch hq. however they were intercepted by the blood spiral and lok ended up dropping the amulet during a battle on the erasmus bridge. den fears then fought harrison fears for the amulet, and the titan sensed and ended up bonding with den to become his first and primary titan. vigilante then fought against harlekin, but with den choked and beaten by harrison and unable to concentrate, vigilante was sent back to his amulet. [den vs harrison]

den used vigilante during the huntik team's attempt to rescue focauld casterwill from kiel and marduk in the cloisters. he was, however, defeated by marduk's cerberus. [the casterwill connection]

in hamelin, den invoked vigilante to help sophie casterwill against two suits. charged up with a power boost from cherit, vigilante fought and defeated shadow agent. [gremlow infestation!]

den attempted to invoke vigilante against wilder in the professor's castle but wilder kicked the amulet out of his hand. [an ally from the organization]

at the blood spiral base, after faltering during his final battle with his brother, harrison, den sensed vigilante becoming powerbonded, reminding him that him not to let his friends down. after invoking powerbonded vigilante, den merged with him using his new cindercloak ability and fought and defeated powerbonded antedeluvian. before he could defeat harrison however, vigilante was disrupted by falling rocks and sent back to his amulet. like an assassin, vigilante attacks with great speed. he fights using a unique dual wielding technique - with a sword in one hand and a dagger in the other. combining these offensive skills with his agility, vigilante excels in taking out enemies swiftly and methodically.

vigilante became powerbonded with den during his final battle with his brother, harrison. using his new cindercloak ability, den was able to merge with vigilante in a similar fashion to how lok lambert merges with powerbonded kipperin. powerbonded vigilante can then separate himself from his seeker in order to provide protection, such as when he used this ability to protect den when the ruins of the spiral mark started to collapse. together, den and vigilante's sword strikes are powerful enough to defeat powerbonded antedeluvian.[lok and the betrayer] powerbonded vigilante's other new abilities include:

*counterattack - swiftly strikes an enemy after defending their attack. [the guardian of yonaguni]
* cross defense - crosses his two swords to block an attack. [the guardian of yonaguni]

umbra the shadow jaguar is the legendary titan of dimensions. as such, umbra has the ability of teleportation. this black jaguar titan bears orange and cream armor to protect his body.

== history ==
umbra was one of the titans of casterwill's first son. this titan was found by hernán cortés. his amulet remained in cortés' tomb, guarded by another titan, conquistador, and a magic barrier. [gremlow infestation!] the pied piper of hamelin's magic flute was used to control the guardian titan, which then deactivated the barrier. later, umbra bonded with dante vale. umbra's power was then used to escape from being crushed by conquistador. [the power of umbra]

his teleportation power was only able to be used a few times, so dante used copykind to be able to use umbra's power again to reach the castle of vlad dracul without weakening the titan. [lok's leadership]

umbra later transported lok, sophie, dante, and den to the spiral mark to stop the nullifiers. [words from eathon] umbra then played a small, but crucial, role in preventing the return of the nullifiers by transporting dante and phoenix up to the red comet. [the spiral mark] after stopping the red comet, a weakened umbra teleported back to the spiral mark and jumped on the betrayer, saving the huntik team. with the last of his energy, he transported back dante's ashes, endowed with the ability of phoenix, before collapsing and permanently fading away.[dante's return]

== abilities ==
 and phoenix to the upper atmosphere]]

[lok's leadership] he is able to teleport himself effortlessly and without weakening. umbra's attacks are very fast and, thanks to his powers, may come from multiple directions. [rassimov's secret]

sorcerel is a magic-orientated draco-titan who specializes in spell casting, ranging from offensive magical blasts to defensive force barriers. with her golden helmet and long flowing pink hair, her appearance resembles that of an ancient sorceress. once a favored titan of the casterwill family seer, nostradamus, sorcerel is now a primary titan of sophie casterwill alongside her combat-focused titan sister, sabriel.

== history ==
according to casterwill family legend, sorcerel came to earth with her twin titan, sabriel. [cave of the casterwills]

in the 17th century, sorcerel was used by the casterwill seer, michel de notre dame, better known as nostradamus. due to the close bond between sorcerel and her seeker, she became a powerbonded titan. [the power of kronos] when lok lambert and sophie casterwill were sent back in time to the 17th century by the legendary titan of time, kronos, they were attacked by viktor casterwill and michel, who invoked powerbonded sorcerel. after fighting against powerbonded baselaird, the two titans defeated one another. [the power of kronos]

sorcerel's amulet was eventually laid to rest in the crystal caves. [cave of the casterwills]

sophie was tasked with obtaining sorcerel's amulet from the crystal caves by nimue casterwill as a test of her allegiance to the casterwill family. after being worn down by nimue's undine and coralgolem titans, sophie was succeeded in passing the test thanks to the return of sorcerel's sister, sabriel, now in powerbonded form. sophie was then able to invoke sorcerel who swiftly defeated coralgolem. [cave of the casterwills]

sophie invoked sorcerel in the casterwill library in france to fight against lucas casterwill's team. after defeating lucas's feyone, sorcerel was defeated by lane's wildwood druid. [chasing void] on the erasmus bridge in rotterdam, sophie called on sorcerel to fight two harlekin titans summoned by tantras's orphan recruits. [den vs harrison] sophie used sorcerel to assist powerbonded baselaird against freelancer, ironsquire, and hoplite titans that had been possessed by arc, the legendary titan of fate. after lok used the willblade to destroy ironsquire's shield, sorcerel was able to defeat it with a magical blast before being called back to her amulet. [the legendary titan of fate]

sophie invoked sorcerel to fight alongside lok's ironsquire against magical fear creatures whilst on a test to find mythras, the legendary titan of valor. due to being outnumbered, sorcerel was defeated. [sophie on trial]

when sophie casterwill was fighting against kiel, she powerbonded with sorcerel, thus regaining her strength to fight kiel. the newly empowered sorcerel fought off the attacks of kiel and his titans, vulcana, and balenpyre. after defeating vulcana, sorcerel was defeated defending sophie from kiel's enderflame power. [the spiral war]

powerbonded sorcerel was invoked by sophie in the castle of vlad dracul to fight against harrison fears' significantly strengthened powerbonded antedeluvian. after forming the triple truth shield with powerbonded sabriel, this was hindered when sabriel was sent back to her amulet by harrison's drybite power. after dante's ignatius defeated antedeluvian, sorcerel was called back to her amulet. [lok's leadership]

== abilities ==
sorcerel, like the name implies, has powers oriented towards magic and not the martial arts like her twin titan sabriel. sorcerel can create magical barriers and utilize strong magical blasts which are strong enough to send a coralgolem back to its amulet with only two hits. [cave of the casterwills] sorcerel is also capable of flight, unlike sabriel. [den vs harrison]

== powerbonding ==
sorcerel powerbonded with sophie during her final battle with kiel. her appearance changed subtly, gaining a golden trim on her robe and a decorative golden headdress. she gained stronger magical blasts and force fields, and some new abilities:

*honorforce - creates a reflective magical barrier to return attacks back to the enemy. this ability is proven strong enough to return three high-powered attacks from kiel, vulcana and balenpyre all at once. [the spiral war] 

when used together with sabriel and sophie, they can activate the triple truth shield, a defensive barrier that protects all three of them and knocks back enemy forces. [lok's leadership]

== gallery ==

sorcerel amulet.jpg|sorcerel's amulet
sorcerel icon.jpg|sorcerel's icon
sorcerel.jpg|sorcerel
sorcerel pb icon.jpg|powerbonded sorcerel's icon
sorcerel pb.jpg|powerbonded sorcerel

==trivia==
*the summoning command for sorcerel is "join us."

*sorcerel's name is a corruption of the english word "sorcerer," which is a term for a spell caster.

marauder is one of the principle titans used by the silent soldiers of the blood spiral. marauder's body is enveloped in a dark cloak and his face is covered by a strange mask. marauder and harlekin are together used like the redcap and mindrone titans used by the organization. like harlekin, marauder draws power on its seeker's negative emotions, especially rage. he is related to another titan known as psikofen.

== history ==
several marauder and harlekin titans were invoked by the silent soldiers during the battle for the amulet of void in klaus's lab. one marauder titan defeated powerbonded sabriel. another marauder titan attacked lok lambert but was defeated by the willblade. a marauder titan attacked powerbonded caliban but was defeated when caliban used harlekin's claws to hit marauder. [the blood spiral]

while recruiting orphans in rotterdam, tantras gave harrison fears a marauder amulet, stating that rage was necessary to bond with marauder and using underfear to help him focus his emotions. harrison then invoked marauder. when the other two orphans invoked their harlekin titans, which tantras had given them, marauder wrestled a harlekin to the ground. later harrison used marauder to defeat a fog monster which tantras had summoned. [den vs harrison]

in the dreamworld created by arc, the legendary titan of fate, sophie casterwill encountered mutated hybrids of the upper body of marauder and the the lower body of the black scarabese. sophie witnessed vast armies of these spiral demons attacking her family before she stamped over them, causing an imbalance within the dream. [the legendary titan of fate]

numerous marauder titans were used in the battle outside the fortress of iron will. one marauder was seen wrestling templar when nimue casterwill sacrificed herself. [the spiral war]

two marauder titans were used to guard tantras as he attempted to harness the power of the heart of vlad dracul. the pair were later sacrificed by harrison fears, using bloodrank, to power up powerbonded antedeluvian against the huntik team's titans. [lok's leadership]

several marauder titans were used in the battle at the spiral mark at the blood spiral base. one marauder attacked fenris only to be defeated by firbolg. two marauder titans later fought powerbonded baselaird. after a heated confrontation, baselaird defeated the two of them. [lok and the betrayer]

== abilities ==
marauder can run extremely fast and recover swiftly from attacks. this ability allows him to chaotically storm through the battle field with his arm blades slashing down enemies. marauder is skilled at using the blades in sword combat, able to hold his own against powerbonded baselaird. [lok and the betrayer] these blades can shoot lightning bolts when held in close in contact, powerful enough to defeat powerbonded sabriel. [the blood spiral] his special ability perfect vision gives him an edge in combat, enabling him to spot an incoming enemy from afar and plan a subsequent attack.

marauder toy card.jpg|marauder

== trivia ==
*marauder's summoning command is "bring chaos!"
*the word "marauder" refers to someone who attacks in search of treasure to steal or raid. this origin may explain marauder being so rabid.

the silent soldiers are the lowest level minions of blood spiral as initiates into the group. they each wear a mask, and hooded gray uniforms with red trim, which designate them as being below kiel's trained team of casterwill hunters. they regularly appear in large groups, each educated to strictly follow the blood spiral's laws and to view the world simply as prey for the nullifiers, who would feast on mankind's souls.

== history ==

a large group of silent soldiers, led by rassimov, wind and shauna, ambushed both the huntik foundation and the organization in klaus' bookshop whilst on the search for the amulet of void. they invoked harlekin and marauder and went about defeating the suits and fighting the huntik team. after shauna took the amulet from lok lambert, the group left, completely destroying the lab in the process. [the blood spiral]

in rotterdam, two silent soldiers attacked lok and sophie with a marauder titan but were sent on their way. morethe same day, tantras started recruiting a new order of silent soldiers from the orphanage where zhalia moon had once lived. harrison fears and the other boys became silent soldiers, while den fears ran away and joined the huntik foundation. [den vs harrison] 

tantras' orphan recruits soon begun intensive training at the blood spiral base before going after den fears in venice, italy for turning his back on the spirals. they fought the huntik team but were defeated. tantras almost sacrificed two of the orphans whilst attacking dante vale. [boys will be seekers]

a single silent soldier attacked focauld casterwill at the cloisters but was taken prisoner. he was then interrogated by teien casterwill using oathmaker but, being brainwashed, provided no new information. the soldier was later freed by kiel and marduk and fought the huntik team before they escaped, with focauld. [the casterwill connection]

a group of silent soldiers traveled to teotihuacan, mexico to stop the huntik team from activating the blue star. after invoking harlekin, the soldiers pursued the huntik team down the cliff at top speed. [the titan in the temple of sun]
s carry the silent soldiers into battle]]
hundreds of silent soldiers traveled to the great rift valley, africa as part of the spiral army. a small group spied on dante vale and den fears with their midnight rook. they were then defeated after a fight. [sophie on trial] the silent soldiers fought the casterwill family during the attack on the fortress of iron will. many groups were carried into battle by bazela's insect fliers but were defeated with the army eventually retreating when focauld casterwill and the rue guardians summoned the guardian titans of the fortress of iron will. [the spiral war]

silent soldiers traveled with tantras and harrison fears to the castle of vlad dracul where they took out two huntik foundation agents. one fought and overpowered den fears but was defeated by powerbonded lindorm. [lok's leadership] 

several silent soldiers fought the huntik team on phoenix's island and were held off by montehue and tersly. [the phoenix's ashes] four silent soldiers attacked two of grier's suits on the greek coast but were sent on their way by the huntik team. [an ally from the organization] 

during the final battle, the silent soldier fought the casterwill family and huntik foundation until the defeat of the betrayer. [lok and the betrayer][dante's return]

== personality ==

essentially brainwashed, the silent soldiers do nothing but follow orders from the betrayer's corpse, filling a similar role in the blood spiral as the suits in the organization. however unlike the suits, the silent soldiers are completely and utterly destructive, relishing in the chaos and pain they can unleash. merciless and cruel, the silent soldiers won't hesitate to hurt anyone to achieve the betrayer's goals.

== abilities ==
]]
silent soldiers are trained fight hand-to-hand and use basic blood spiral spells such as nullcurse, with their powers entirely consisting basic offensive powers. their primary titans, harlekin and marauder, draw power from their seeker's dark emotions such as fear and rage respectively. the fanatics' strengths lie in their sheer numbers and crazed dedication to the spiral cause.

* augerfrost [boys will be seekers]
* cutrace [boys will be seekers]
* newfury [den vs harrison]
* nullcurse [the blood spiral]
* poisonfang [sophie on trial]
* raypulse [the casterwill connection]

ironsquire is an amber and steel-blue robotic titan that is closely related to freelancer. bearing a large shield, ironsquire specializes in defense. this titan is used by members of the huntik foundation, notably lok lambert and clements.

==history ==
===clements' ironsquire===
clements' ironsquire was possessed and controlled by arc, along with his other titans, freelancer and hoplite. after initially defeating lok's freelancer, ironsquire fought against powerbonded baselaird who chipped his shield. lok then used the willblade on the chip to destroy ironsquire's shield rendering him defenseless to be defeated by sophie casterwill's sorcerel. [the legendary titan of fate]

===lok's ironsquire===
lok lambert invoked his ironsquire on the roof of the cloisters, usa, to fight against a pair of casterwill hunters where he was attacked by midnight rook. ironsquire then fought against dark pharaoh, with the two titans eventually defeating each other after colliding at full speed. [the casterwill connection]

lok summoned ironsquire in the vault of the fortress of iron will to fight alongside sophie's sorcerel against the fear monsters generated by the trial of courage. after fending off a number of the creatures, ironsquire was defeated. [sophie on trial]

lok later used ironsquire during the war against the blood spiral at the foot of iron will where he saved dante vale from a group of silent soldiers. [the spiral war]

lok invoked ironsquire on the longest night of the year to fight against psikofen in the wreckage of the huntik foundation jet. after being disarmed of his shield, ironsquire was entrapped along with sophie's kelpie in psikofen's chains before cherit defeated the blood spiral titan. [words from eathon]

==abilities ==
ironsquire is a mighty knight, specializing in the defense of his seekers. he is especially useful for defending against multiple opponents. his giant shield is used to block high even power attacks such as overslam and kindlestrike.
