tantras was one of the core members of the blood spiral and its blooded circle alongside wind and shauna and ranked under only rassimov. his task was to recruit and train new members for the blood spiral brotherhood, and he was sometimes sent on special missions. he both raised and trained the fanatic kiel, and later became a parental figure for harrison fears.

== history ==
 students]]
tantras was a member of the blooded circle within the blood spiral. he raised and trained his pupil, kiel, to be the best among the casterwill hunters. a full servant of chaos, tantras is a master seeker who devotes all his time to teach his students the way of the blood spiral.

in rotterdam, tantras started recruiting a new order of silent soldiers from the orphanage where zhalia moon had once lived. harrison fears and the other boys became silent soldiers, while den fears ran away and joined the huntik foundation. tantras then had his students attack lok lambert and sophie casterwill whilst he fought zhalia moon with his titan, jericho. after losing the battle, tantras welcomed harrison into the order. [den vs harrison]

tantras sent his hunter, kiel, to medusa's island to oversee stack on his promise to deliver the blood spiral the coveted titan, medusa as proof of his allegiance. [zhalia's mission] after stack was exposed as a spy, tantras callously killed him in front of his students as an example of what happened to those who crossed them. he later led his students to find den fears to take revenge on him abandoning the order. he fought against dante vale but chose to retreat after seeing the power of powerbonded lindorm. he then appointed zhalia moon as harrison's bodyguard. [boys will be seekers]

on the journey to the fortress of iron will, tantras caught zhalia informing dante vale of the spiral's movements via logosbook. having already suspected that she was a spy, he attempted to eliminate her but his memory was wiped by zhalia's newly powerbonded gareon. [sophie on trial] during the siege on the casterwill family, tantras used bazela's hive to spawn bazela's insect to carry his forces to the top of the cliff. tantras told kiel to fulfil his destiny and invoke his ultimate titan, efreet king, whilst he was detained by leblanche. after focauld and the rue guardian activated the fortress' defenses, tantras ordered the army to retreat. [the spiral war]

after taking over the castle of vlad dracul, tantras tried to use the power of the heart of vlad dracul to activate the spiral mark himself. despite nearly succeeding, he was foiled by dante vale and ignatius and the heart of vlad dracul drained tantras of all his powers. [lok's leadership] he was left in a weakened and bedridden state, and because of that he left both his most powerful titans, jericho and bazela's hive, and his place in the blooded circle to harrison fears. [rassimov's secret]

== personality ==
, his strongest student]]
tantras is the typical crazed fanatic. he strongly believes in the blood spiral's ideals and would do anything to bring chaos to the world. he is cruel and merciless, prepared to kill spies in front of his students so as to set an example, as seen when he murdered stack [boys will be seekers] and attempted to kill zhalia moon after discovering she was a spy. [sophie on trial] he treated his minions like his tools, even opting to sacrifice them in order to kill dante vale. [boys will be seekers] tantras, however, is too blinded by his ideology to care about small failures and even, himself, did not discover the journal of zhalia moon until late in the game. he possesses great pride in himself and the spiral, believing that chaos will ultimately triumph over the world. when he is unable to win fairly, he uses his trickery to achieve his goals. however, like klaus did with zhalia, tantras showed a certain amount of kindness to harrison fears, treating him with respect and some fondness. this was shown when he approved of harrison's decision to take his place in the blooded circle, and when he gave the boy his titans. [rassimov's secret]

== abilities ==
]]
tantras possesses a vast repertoire of dark powers and, despite his age, was capable of holding his own against dante vale in battle. he uses his staff both in direct combat and channel his spells. his knowledge of the dark forces make him a tutor of the highest order, training kiel and, later, harrison fears to become extremely powerful seekers under his guidance. in addition to being a great fighter, he can also sense the feelings of his men. all this, combined with his insanely destructive resolve make tantras a formidable enemy. he knows he doesn't have enough strength for a physical fight, so he focuses on strategy and his powers. [the guardian of yonaguni]

the betrayer was an immensely powerful and evil seeker who was responsible for inaugurating the blood spiral. once the best friend of lord casterwill, he betrayed the former's sons and daughters by allying himself with nullifiers with the intent to erase all life on earth. for years, his spirit gave orders to rassimov to be carried out by his chaotic followers, before finally resurrecting as a corpse in the build-up to his plan to once again attempt to activate the spiral mark and end all of civilization. 

== history ==
 at the spiral mark on the longest night of the year]]
the man now known only as the betrayer was once the best friend and a trusted ally of lord casterwill. after the 500-year war against the nullifiers and casterwill's subsequent death, the sons and daughters of casterwill were betrayed. the betrayer allied himself with the nullifiers, using the amulet of void at the spiral mark as a part of a dark ritual, performed on the longest night of the year, to bring the nullifiers back to earth. [chasing void] using the necklace of tutankhamun created from glass found within a comet associated with void's amulet, the betrayer sought to control the nullifiers for his own agenda. [rassimov's secret] the betrayer also created his own personal army, the blood spiral brotherhood. [the blood spiral] he was opposed by the casterwills, and the spiral mark again was sealed while the red comet was visible in the sky. he henceforth became known in the casterwill records simply as "the betrayer" for these actions. [chasing void]

after death, the betrayer's corpse remained on a throne in the blood spiral base. [zhalia's mission]. his spirit lived on, running the now weakened blood spiral through rassimov. [the titan in the temple of sun] during the confrontation between the huntik foundation and the professor, the betrayer disguised demigorgan, the legendary titan of betrayal, as eathon lambert's holotome and had rassimov plant it to be found by lok lambert. through this "holotome," the betrayer was able to lead the foundation to do his bidding. [lok and the betrayer] [dante's return]

in preparation for his return, the betrayer sent his army of blood spirals on missions. he had the amulet of void to be able to summon the nullifiers yet again. [the blood spiral] he sent an army of silent soldiers and casterwill hunters to eliminate the casterwill family, a plan which failed. [the spiral war] he also sent rassimov to recover the necklace of tutankhamun to be able to control the nullifiers. [rassimov's secret] the betrayer's final mission for the blood spiral, opening the spiral mark, was delivered by the spirit of the betrayer, himself. [words from eathon]

with the activation of the spiral mark at the hand of lok lambert, the betrayer used the power of demigorgan to defeat multiple foundation titans, including pendragon. he also used his shadowlock spell to fully immobilize harrison fears, lucas casterwill, and sandra lambert. the betrayer attempted to use this spell against dante vale, nearly claiming him as well. the betrayer was finally defeated when cherit blasted the spiral symbol on his back, which was then stabbed through with the willblade. this marked an end to his ritual and his shadowlock victims were released. despite the betrayer's defeat however, the spiral mark appeared to remain active with its light flickering like a heartbeat and visible as a beacon far across space. [dante's return]

== personality ==

as his title suggests, the betrayer was the epitome of evil and deceit. his backstabbing nature manifested in his actions, attacking his enemies from behind and always using deception to trick his foes. his insane desire for chaos and destruction were his driving force in his attempts to call down the nullifiers and wipe out civilization. [dante's return] he was immensely calculating, having designed his plans eons before taking place, and would use anything to his advantage, including the death of dante vale, which he played to his advantage to weaken the spirits of the huntik foundation. he was revealed to have impersonated eathon lambert, exploiting lok's faith and trust in his dad, and using his good intentions to sow the seeds for the end of the world. [lok and the betrayer] as the best friend of lord casterwill, it can be assumed there were some good qualities in him at some point in the past, but all that remains is a monster. [the spiral mark]

== abilities ==
]]
the betrayer is an exceedingly strong seeker, having defeated dante vale in battle and nearly rendering him immobile with the shadowlock spell. his overall usage of spells is extremely powerful, with his shocklash spell is able to send jericho back to his amulet instantly and briefly incapacitating zhalia. he can also fly. [dante's return] 

however, his one known weak spot is the mark of the blood spiral under his cloak, which allows him to revive but when targeted it can kill him for good. as the leader of the blood spiral brotherhood, he may also have access to most of their spells. the betrayer's personal and primary titan is demigorgan, the legendary titan of betrayal. [dante's return]

== history ==
stack and mr. wilder observed the huntik team at the organization central through the cameras and planned to get rid of dante vale and his team. later at the south american forest, peru, stack attempted to ambush the huntik team with his primary titan, dark dryad, but failed. later at the nexus, stack fought against zhalia moon but retreated along with the organization, by using his dark dryad titan to conceal their exit, when lok lambert managed to powerbond with baselaird. efreet king is a devastating fire-based litho-titan that resembles a horned djinn-like demon whose body is composed of rock and flame. the ultimate destructive titan belonging to kiel, efreet king is one of the few known standard titans that can fight toe-to-toe with the legendary titans.

==history==
efreet king was invoked outside the fortress of iron will by a completely depleted kiel, defeated by sophie casterwill, who passed out after summoning him. efreet king fought and defeated the legendary titan, mythras, by using blasting him with the fire from its eyes. it then advanced on an unconscious sophie but was interrupted by lok lambert and powerbonded kipperin who tried to fight him with the willblade. lok's attacks had little effect on efreet king, but he was suddenly defeated by the spirit-like form of pendragon, summoned as the casterwill family performed an ancient ritual from within the stronghold in the cave. [the spiral war]

==abilities==
described by tantras as kiel's ultimate titan, efreet king is powerful enough to run rampage, even with no conscious seeker to control him. [s2e40] like kiel's other fire-based titans, efreet king can shoot fire from its mouth and eyes. the immense size and power of his flame blasts are powerful enough to overpower the blasts of a legendary titan, mythras, and defeat it. efreet king's rock like armor is also invulnerable to attacks and was able to remain unscathed when he was attacked with the willblade. [s2e40] if lok lambert and powerbonded kipperin had not distracted it, this titan would likely have killed the battle-worn sophie. it was only defeated by a direct blast from a spectral version of pendragon. [s2e40]

==gallery==

efreet king amulet.jpg|efreet king's amulet
efreet king icon.jpg|efreet king's icon
efreet king 2.jpg|efreet king

== trivia ==
* efreet king's summoning command is "come."
* efreet king is based on the ifrit, a creature from middle eastern mythology akin to a djinn or genie. 
* in the official youtube description blurb for the episode "the spiral war," efreet king is mistakenly referred to as "king salamander." this was likely an early production working name.

jericho the head of monks is a powerful flying hecto-titan whose appearance is that of a large skeleton abbot made up of long, protruding bones. jericho was the primary titan of tantras, a senior member of the blood spiral brotherhood, before his amulet was passed on to harrison fears.
==history==
tantras invoked jericho on the erasmus bridge in rotterdam to assist his orphan recruits in attacking the huntik team. jericho swooped and knocked down zhalia moon and, after absorbing an energy blast from cherit, fought and was defeated by zhalia's king basilisk. [den vs harrison]

at the blood spiral base, tantras used jericho whilst training harrison fears. after fighting against harrison's hitokiri, jericho was called back to his amulet at the end of the sparring session. [boys will be seekers]

after losing all his power to the heart of vlad dracul, tantras gave jericho's amulet to harrison alongside bazela's hive. harrison later invoked jericho in egypt to ambush vehicles of a team of huntik foundation operatives and free their prisoner, rassimov. when the huntik team arrived, jericho was pinned down by umbra the shadow jaguar and defeated by dante vale. [rassimov's secret]

jericho was summoned by harrison when he and den were facing off against the betrayer where he fought against the legendary titan of betrayal, demigorgan, alongside dullahan. after harrison ran to protect a weak zhalia moon, about to take an attack from the betrayer, jericho rushed in front of harrison and took the blow instead, sending jericho back to its amulet. [dante's return]

==abilities==

jericho is an extremely powerful titan. in addition to flying quickly through the air, jericho can swoop down and impale his enemies on the massive spikes on his body, or even use them as direct weapons. [den vs harrison] jericho can also absorb energy attacks, such as cherit's energy charge, making him be difficult to defeat. despite this, the betrayer's shocklash spell was able to take him out. [boys will be seekers]

==gallery==

jericho amulet.jpg|jericho's amulet

jericho.jpg|jericho

== trivia ==
* his summoning command is "corrupt everything".
* jericho is based on the biblical city of jericho, whose walls were said to be almost indestructible. his appearance, specifically his hat and robe, is based on that of a head monk.
* jericho was referred to as as "jericho: head of monks" and "jericho the skeleton monk" in his concept art.

hoffman is a high-level member of the organization who served under mr. wilder and previously under the professor himself. he may be old, hoffman is an experienced seeker with a strong resoluteness and sets the example for younger members of the organization to follow.

== history ==
hoffman was a high ranking official and loyal follower of the professor. after the professor's defeat, he became a joined the team of mr. mr. wilder and supported him in his campaign to become the new leader of the organization. [doorway to huntik]

hoffman was with mr. wilder and stack at the south american forest in peru. he fought dante vale outside the waterfall cave that hid the nexus but retreated with mr. wilder
when myrmidon was defeated. [doorway to huntik]

at tower of nostradamus, hoffman defeated the three huntik operatives stationed there, first billie and peter, and right after that annette while she was dialing for help. when dante's team arrived, hoffman fought against lok lambert and sophie casterwill but was thrown out of the tower by the enchanted sentry triclops titans. [the tower of nostradamus]

hoffman then was sent to the chu goku mount, japan, with eathon the dog to find the amulet of divine mirror kagami. he took the amulet to avalon and fought against dante, who was turned to stone when kagami's ability reflected the stonegaze ability of king basilisk. when zhalia moon reversed the ability and returned dante to normal, hoffman retreated with stack. [knight of the willblade]

hoffman was with mr. wilder's team when lok, sophie and cherit were captured. he left with mr. wilder, leaving stack and the remaining team with the mission of escorting lok, sophie and cherit to organization hq. [chasing void]

hoffman, alongside mr. wilder and stack, ambushed the huntik team in klaus' laboratory. he fought against lok and sophie, but was defeated through the aid of cherit before the organization was ambushed by the blood spiral. [the blood spiral]

he and mr. wilder observed stack attempting to infiltrate the blood spiral on medusa island. when dante's team arrived, hoffman summoned myrmidon to fight alongside a suit's venomaster against dante's caliban. meanwhile, hoffman fought against sophie and sabriel but, upon defeat, retreated with mr. wilder, leaving stack behind. [zhalia's mission]

at the vault of hernán cortés, hoffman and mr. wilder set few new traps for dante and his team, capturing den fears in a trapcage spell. hoffman fought den, lok, and sophie, but retreated when dante obtained the ring of umbra the shadow jaguar, trapping the huntik foundation in the cave with conquistador. [the power of umbra]

when the huntik team went looking for rassimov's secret files in the professor's castle, hoffman and mr. wilder were at that base. hoffman and eathon the dog fought against dante and grier, but he was eventually subdued and defeated. afterwards, hoffman was left to guard the castle when grier took mr. wilder hostage and took control of the organization. [an ally from the organization]

== personality ==

as a loyal member of the organization, hoffman took orders from his superiors without hesitation. due to this loyalty, he was well-liked by the professor and thoroughly despised traitors. [doorway to huntik] shunning cowardice, he values resolution and determination. [knight of the willblade] due to his strong resolve, hoffman can be stubborn when it comes to him making up his mind. [an ally from the organization] however, unlike the lower suits, hoffman can weigh the odds of a confrontation and knows when it is more rational to avoid the direct approach. [knight of the willblade] he also is not a believer in superstition. [the tower of nostradamus] hoffman possesses knowledge of history. [the power of umbra] 

hoffman has an extreme loyalty and respect for the professor as shown when he took custody of eathon the dog and when he tried to stop the huntik foundation from entering the professor's castle. [knight of the willblade] [an ally from the organization] he would not take any disresepct that the professor needed lies to control anyone, defending him stating that the man had absolute power. [chasing void]

== abilities ==
]]
despite being old, hoffman is a formidable seeker. in addition to basic organization abilities, hoffman is capable of using the earthband and rockforce spells. he possesses a roster of standard issue organization titans, joined by the more unique doberman and myrmidon. he also seems to be quite skillful and strong as he was able to hold his own even against a powerful seeker like dante vale. [an ally from the organization]

dark dryad is a krono-titan with green skin and golden armor who specializes in nature-based attacks with her control over roots and vines. dark dryad is the primary titan of stack, a member of the organization.

==history==
dark dryad was used to sabotage the huntik team's mission but failed to capture them by the waterfall containing the nexus. she later was used to fight elf king oberon, immobilizing him with her roots for myrmidon to finish him off. after wilder's team were defeated, she created a forest of vines so that lok lambert's powerbonded baselaird could not follow them and that zhalia moon could not track them. wildwood druid is a humanoid gaia-titan who has the appearance of a walking tree with roots for legs, similar to gybolg. a number of branches grow from her back, and she wears red and gold celtic vestments. wildwood druid is the principal titan belonging to lane.

==history==
wildwood druid was used by lane in the casterwill library during lucas casterwill's attack on the huntik team, who were trying do research on the willblade. wildwood druid used her roots to immobilize sorcerel and defeated her using her energy spores. she also attacked sophie casterwill but was met with an energy blast from cherit, setting her on fire. she then used her roots to entangle zhalia moon but these were disrupted by her venomhand power. [chasing void]

wildwood druid was later invoked by lane to fight against the organization suits whilst rescuing sophie, cherit and lok lambert. she used her toxic spores to defeat gigadrone. [chasing void]

==abilities==

wildwood druid is able to control leaves and roots, using her roots to immobilize her enemies. she can control these roots to grow from spots in the ground and capture her target much like the ability of dark dryad. she is also capable of releasing with toxic spores that can prove lethal to titans like sorcerel and gigadrone. for seekers, the only way to counter these spores is by holding one's breath. lane is one of the members of lucas casterwill's team along with dellix. although more calm and subdued than her teammates, lane won't hesitate to stand up for what she thinks is right and help out her fellow seekers in battle. 

==history==
lane served as a guardian of the casterwill library in paris, france, alongside dellix. the two of them permitted sophie casterwill to enter, without their intervention, upon seeing her enter the enchanted doorway which would only permit a member of the casterwill family to pass. [memory lane]

along with lucas and dellix, lane later attacked the huntik team when they returned to the library looking for information on the willblade. summoning her wildwood druid titan, lane and her team appeared to have the upper hand but this changed when zhalia revealed her titans hidden by her thoughtspecter power. lane revealed that they were searching for the location of an evil amulet, void. lane later helped to rescue lok and sophie, and fought off the organization suits. [chasing void]

lane was present at the meeting of the casterwill family at the fortress of iron will. [sophie on trial] when a huge blood spiral army attacked, lane and dellix joined the foundation and the casterwills in their fight. they clashed with lucas who wanted to figure out a way to escape, but lane ultimately convinced lucas to join them and help dante's team. [the spiral war]

lane travelled with lucas and dellix to the spiral mark on a scramjet driven by scarlet byrne. [the spiral mark] during the final battle against the blood spiral, lane was injured and rendered unconscious by a psikofen titan. [lok and the betrayer] she regained consciousness however and was seen celebrating with the rest of the foundation and casterwills following the defeat of the betrayer. [dante's return]

==personality==

lane is obedient to lucas, but can and will stand her ground when she thinks he is wrong. however, she is more meek than dellix, and less likely to speak out if she thinks lucas is wrong. she seems to get sad when lucas makes harsh decisions, but also has some faith in him and knows that he will change his mind seeing that the way he refused to go is correct. she and dellix have some influence on lucas' behaviour, and she may also be close to lucas due to her backward glance as she and dellix ran off to go and fight. [the spiral war] she was also vocal in her initial mistrust of zhalia moon, unaware that zhalia was listening. [chasing void]

==abilities==
lane seems to prefer far-ranged combat styles such as using titans and spells as opposed to using martial arts or physical strength. her sole titan, wildwood druid, seems to represent a spirituality with nature-based powers and traditions. [chasing void]
===spells utilized===

* bristlebind
* hyperstride
* kindlestrike

dellix is one of the members of lucas casterwill's team along with lane. a loyal defender of the casterwill family and skilled swordsman, dellix won't hesitate to help his brothers and sisters in battle even if it means disobeying his superior.

==history==
dellix was a guardian of the casterwill library in france along with lane. [memory lane]

dellix returned when lucas casterwill came out of hiding as part of lucas' team. they launched an attack on the huntik team at the casterwill library, overpowering them and ordering them to surrender. however, zhalia moon turned off her thoughtspecter illusions to unveil her titans and dellix was stopped by gar-ghoul. lucas then revealed himself to be the brother of sophie casterwill. lucas' team soon revealed they were on a mission to find the amulet of void. [chasing void]

==personality==
before any action, dellix often asks lucas what he thinks and seeks his approval. however, when lucas' decision doesn't match his own, he often manifests it and does what he believes is right. he is extremely loyal to the casterwill family, calling them brothers and sisters. he can't stand the thought of them suffering and engages in battles to protect them. he is quite impulsive and lets his heart tell him what is right. it contrasts with lucas' stark and prudent behavior. [the spiral war] he seems to be close to lane, as they're often seen together.

==abilities==
dellix is an excellent swordsman who tends to rely on his physical strength rather than spells or titans. he does however favor the spell lightedge, which he uses to his enhance his sword's offensive power.

===spells utilized ===

*hyperstride
*lightedge

undine the water spirit is a krono-titan whose body is made up of water, the medium through which she can make attacks and conjure whirlpools. she was the primary titan of nimue casterwill, the former lady of the lake.

==history==
throughout the world, the undine and enfluxion titans inspired the many myths and legends about water-spirits which appear in the mythologies of cultures throughout the world.

undine was the primary titan of nimue casterwill, the casterwill elder of the house of blade makers, who resided in the crystal caves. [cave of the casterwills]

undine was used by nimue alongside coralgolem to test sophie casterwill in her quest to bond with the titan sorcerel. despite initially overpowering her, the tables turned when sophie was reunited with sabriel through the medium of powerbonding. undine was then swiftly defeated by sabriel. [cave of the casterwills]

undine was invoked by nimue to protect the huntik team as they travelled to avalon via speedboat. after the boat was ambushed by dark dryad, undine was able to free the team by blasting the expanding roots. after a quick scuffle in the water, undine was defeated by a strike from dark dryad's vines. [knight of the willblade]

undine's amulet was seen worn around nimue's neck during the casterwill family meeting at the fortress of iron will. [sophie on trial] it was still present around her neck when nimue sacrificed herself to save the family and defeat the blood spiral forces. [the spiral war]

==abilities==
undine can transform her body in water, swim fast enough to follow a ship, and use the water to attack and conjure whirlpools to distract and tire her opponents. she can cause great waves and she is very useful against fire-based titans.

== trivia ==
* undine's summoning command is "protect this ship!". 
* undine and enfluxion are both based on ondine, a water spirit who is among the four elemental mythical creatures.

the fortress of iron will is a casterwill family stronghold located in the great rift valley of africa. the casterwill elders meet here to discuss the family's decisive moves. the stronghold houses many icarus and feyone titans, and a single coralgolem titan, within its statues as a weapon to defend the stronghold, when activated through a long ritual. the deep networks of the fortress also houses many paintings, including one of cherit and lord casterwill.

== history ==
iron will was the resting place of the ring of the legendary titan of valor, mythras, the prize of the test of courage, designed by the strongest rue guardians, deep within the fortress, in which a noble could make a claim for leadership of the elders. they left multiple fear monsters to guard the prize. [sophie on trial]

after being called together by the blue star, the casterwill family met here to debate how to respond to the blood spiral threat. in order to lead the family against the spirals, sophie casterwill embarked and completed on the trial of courage, obtaining the ring of mythras. [sophie on trial]

with the location of the stronghold given to the blood spiral army by the betrayer, a huge army, lead by tantras and kiel, advanced on the fortress. a huge battle ensued between the groups, with the lady of the lake, nimue casterwill sacrificed herself to buy sophie time to find the strength she needed to defeat kiel. focauld casterwill and the rue guardians succeeded in activating the defenses and the spiral army were forced to retreat from the forthcoming army of feyone, icarus and coralgolem titans. [the spiral war]

bazela's hive is a grotesque, insectoid swara-titan that possesses five large, red eyes. from its tail, it is able to summon a swarm of smaller bazela's insect titans. bazela's hive was one of most powerful titans of the blood spiral seeker, tantras, and was passed on to harrison fears before falling into the hands of the betrayer.

==history==
tantras invoked bazela's hive right before the blood spiral attack on the fortress of iron will, releasing hundreds of insect fliers to carry the silent soldiers and casterwill hunters into battle. after scanning bazela's hive on the holotome from afar, dante vale determined a plan to take out the mother titan. after taking out twenty silent soldiers single-handedly, dante defeated bazela's hive with help from zhalia moon [the spiral war]

after losing all his power to the heart of vlad dracul, tantras gave bazela's hive's amulet to harrison along with jericho. harrison later used the insect flyers to take him and rassimov to the tomb of nefertiti and later the tomb of tutankhamun.[rassimov's secret]

later, during the final confrontation between den and and harrison, den knocked bazela's hive's amulet out of harrison's hand to prevent the titan from being summoned. the amulet fell to the throne of the betrayer, who took the amulet and invoked bazela's hive to spawn myriads of fliers to provide his forces with a means of flight and prevent the huntik foundation's aircraft from approaching the spiral mark. [lok and the betrayer]

==abilities==

for what bazela's hive lacks in attack strength, it makes up for in defensive power. instead of attacking directly, bazela's hive uses its spawn insect fliers ability to release multiple smaller bazela's insect titans from its tail. these bazela's insects can then fly into battle and be used as aggressive flying mounts for members of the blood spiral. [the spiral war]

huntik:page:4635:
phoenix is the legendary titan of rebirth. her ring was hidden on a volcanic indonesian island in the lava of phoenix volcano, protected by the anti-magic field of the lodestone.

==history==
phoenix was the titan of lord casterwill's younger daughter. over the years, this titan inspired the legends of the mythical phoenix, a bird that dies before being reborn from ash. her ring was eventually laid to rest inside the leftmost lava pit of the phoenix volcano, as the leftmost gem of the amulet of will is red, which in turn was protected by an anti-magic field generated from the lodestone. [the dead magic island] [the phoenix's ashes]

during the casterwill family meeting at the fortress of iron will. teien casterwill revealed that find the spiral mark, they would require the help of umbra and phoenix. lok lambert discovered a recording of eathon lambert on his old holotome, giving him clues from nostradamus' quatrains. [the power of umbra]

the huntik team, joined by montehue and tersly, tracked down phoenix, journeying underground and destroying the lodestone and its stone golem guardians. [the dead magic island] using this to their advantage, the team then launched a surprise attack on wind and shauna inside the volcano. after a frenetic battle, sophie casterwill managed to find phoenix's ring by diving into the lava, mastering her fear of fire and being granted total fire immunity. the team then watched as phoenix rose from the flames. they later scanned phoenix on the cypherdex at the casterwill townhouse. [the phoenix's ashes]

during the battle for the professor's dossier, sophie invoked phoenix to spectacularly defeat incubane, after he set fire to a tapestry, vowing to teach him "a thing or two about fire". [an ally from the organization]

sophie attempted to invoke phoenix during the team's battle against legion, the legendary titan of war, but was stopped by dante, warning it would be a disaster if legion absorbed a legendary titan. [rassimov's secret]

after being overpowered by the firbolg and dullahan titans at tír na nóg, sophie planned to sacrifice her life energy with soulburn to invoke phoenix, despite dante warning it was too dangerous. luckily, lok arrived, having bonded with pendragon. [back home]

on the longest night of the year, the team found nostramus' final quatrain, instructing them to fly phoenix, "the fire of justice" into the center of the spiral mark. [words from eathon] at the spiral mark, sophie invoked phoenix who, defeating herds of silent soldiers, flew above the mark while lok then drove the willblade into the center. however, the betrayer revealed it to be a trick and that lok had now set the red comet on course to collide with earth and bring down the nullifiers. in order to save everyone, dante decided to take out the comet himself, to which sophie instructed he take phoenix with him as she can fly in the upper atmosphere. phoenix was then teleported with umbra and dante into space where, dante and maelstrom drained the comet, sacrificing himself in the process. [the spiral mark]

the betrayer later revealed himself to have been impersonating eathon through his holotome, which was in fact demigorgan. he admitted he led the team to phoenix as they would not have to made it to the mark without her. [lok and the betrayer]

during the final battle against the betrayer, dante's ashes were brought back by umbra with his final breath. to everyone's disbelief, dante then returned to life from the ashes, revealing he had used copykind at the last second to mimic phoenix's abilities, notably her ability to rise from the ashes. [dante's return]
==abilities==
phoenix possesses the ability to conjure a giant wall of flames, protecting her seeker. she also has the ability to resurrect herself from the ashes after death. dante vale used copykind to duplicate this ability to return from the dead. [dante's return] in addition to being able to fly, she can carry others with her in the upper atmosphere. [the spiral mark]

==gallery==

phoenix ring.jpg|phoenix's ring
phoenix icon.jpg|phoenix's icon
phoenix.jpg|phoenix

==trivia==
* her summoning command is: "rise"
* the phoenix commonly appears both in the mythologies of various cultures and in modern fantasy.

cerberus is a three-headed, dog-like titan who has flames for fur along with sharp teeth that can rip enemies apart and claws that are sharp enough to pin enemies down, making it a very dangerous titan. cerberus amulets are in the possession of marduk and rahmas.

==history==
cerberus inspired the greco-roman myth of a three-headed dog that was said to guard the gates to the underworld, preventing the sprits of the dead from returning to the living world. [cerberus (comic)]

=== rahmas's cerberus ===
the huntik team and organization both went after a cerberus amulet. the missing dante vale was tricked into recovering the amulet for dr. benway, who took the amulet from him and took him prisoner. he then summoned cerberus in the gates of hell to attack lok lambert, sophie casterwill, zhalia moon, and kilthane. however, dante teamed up with the recently double-crossed organization agent, rahmas, to defeat benway's forces. dante then took cerberus's amulet but was unable to bond with it, due to being a hero and a "boy scout" as rahmas put it. dante reluctantly gave the amulet to rahmas who bonded with the titan, in exchange for him calling cerberus back from obliterating the team. rahmas then left with the titan. [cerberus (comic)]

=== marduk's cerberus ===
another cerberus titan was bonded to marduk, a member of the blood spiral. cerberus was used by marduk to fight albion and vigilante during an attempt to force casterwill family knowledge from focauld casterwill. cerberus overpowered the two titans, but was defeated by a daring strike organized by sophie casterwill. [the casterwill connection]

marduk again invoked cerberus to fight against the casterwill family during the attack on the fortress of iron will. here, cerberus attacked sentinel and defeated him but was defeated when nimue casterwill used the combined powers of soulburn and sacroblade. [the spiral war]

==abilities==
 while two of its heads tear him apart]]
cerberus has three heads with powerful jaws, sharp teeth and claws. this titan is capable of moving at great speed to attack. its bites can cause tremendous amounts of damage, as when it took out vigilante and albion in multiple bites. cerberus is also quite resistant to attacks, as when it was stabbed in the chest by vigilante with no effect. [the casterwill connection] it can also fires blasts of flames from its mouth to take down enemies. [cerberus (comic)]

huntik:page:4648:
marduk is a member of the blood spiral and serves as kiel's tracker. whereas kiel brings the firepower, marduk brings the stealth to their operations. his blood spiral mark is located on his right shoulder and is normally covered by his shirt, further assisting his going unnoticed.

== history ==
marduk was with kiel when he burned down the house of sophie and lucas casterwill, killing their parents. [the spiral war]

marduk rescued kiel when he called for his casterwill hunters in medusa's cave and attempted to stop the huntik foundation team from retrieving medusa's amulet. [zhalia's mission]

upon the blood spiral ascertaining the location of focauld casterwill, marduk and kiel went after focauld's knowledge of the casterwill family. the huntik team, however, intervened and saved focauld's knowledgelock crystal from falling into the hands of the spiral. [the casterwill connection]

marduk later tried to stop den fears and lok lambert from activating the blue star while kiel attempted to take on dante vale and sophie casterwill. their attempts, however, failed. [the titan in the temple of sun]

tantras asked him about the location of the casterwills. [sophie on trial] shortly thereafter, marduk fought alongside the blood spiral in the assault on the fortress of iron will. he gave chase to santiago and fought with him, but later retreated when given the order by tantras. [the spiral war]

marduk took the place of kiel in the blooded circle, and spoke with shauna, wind, and rassimov after the huntik team retrieved rassimov's secret files from his tenure within the organization. [an ally from the organization]

with the longest night of the year nearly at hand, marduk was commanded by rassimov to stop the huntik team, after receiving orders from the betrayer himself. he tracked the huntik team down to nostradamus' tomb and ambushed them, invoking his psikofen and helinx titans. he then fought against dante and lok, but lok was able to use the willblade to defeat him. the huntik team then teleported to the spiral mark using umbra, leaving a seething marduk behind. [words from eathon]

== personality ==

marduk is an obedient follower. he is very observant and confident in his abilities. as a tracker, he also is calm and patient, as when one of the casterwill hunters told him to charge and destroy the huntik team, marduk ordered him to wait until they were in a corner so that they would be unable to escape. [words from eathon]

== abilities ==
]]
as kiel's chief tracker, marduk possesses outstanding tracking and agility abilities, being able to locate his targets with ease. his tracking abilities even permit him to seek out people who are in hiding, as when he tracked down the whereabouts of focauld casterwill. [the casterwill connection] as a seeker, most of his abilities revolve around tracking and pyrotechnics, while the majority of his titans are based on animals. he commonly uses his midnight rook titan to locate his targets and his cerberus titan to attack his enemies.

=== spells utilized ===

* augerfrost
* bristlebind
* cutrace
* doublespell
* firestorm
* fireswarm
* thornstaff
* nullcurse

=== bonded titans ===

clements is a researcher working for the huntik foundation at his station in a secret foundation base located within the cathedral of notre dame. he was taken hostage by the legendary titan of fate, arc, but was rescued by the huntik team.

==history ==
clements' research within the cathedral of notre dame has led to him coming into the possession of the amulets of several titans including freelancer, hoplite, and ironsquire. [the legendary titan of fate] he was later given charge over safeguarding and researching the ring of arc. [divide and conquer] when the ring was taken out of the reliquary for study and became active, clements became trapped in a dreamlike state until dante vale's huntik team was able to free him. [the legendary titan of fate]

clements later joined the huntik foundation at the spiral mark during the final battle as part of the research team alongside billie and nasher. he analysed the spiral energy while the others fought the blood spiral. [lok and the betrayer] following the defeat of the betrayer, clements, montehue and several other foundation agents were stationed at the spiral mark to make sense of the data. unbeknownst to them, the mark appeared to still be active and shone out across space to signal the return of the nullifiers. [dante's return]

== abilities ==
clements is a highly skilled researcher whose specialty lies in the study of ancient relics and magical artefacts. he was not shown to possess any fighting skills, however his research has led him to come into the possession of several amulets.

galen is a native kumeyaay huntik foundation archaeologist based in baja california, mexico. he and his brother, teeg, are both experts on the famous conqueror, hernán cortés.

== history ==
a native seeker, galen and his brother grew up in baja california, mexico and eventually became allies of the huntik foundation. galen trained with his brother in new york city with the foundation, but stood out as they had learnt their powers through their ancient traditions. [the power of umbra]

galen and teeg helped dante vale find the entrance to hernán cortés' vault using their extensive charts and records [gremlow infestation!]

galen and teeg later hosted dante vale and his team in yucatan, and helped them to find the ring of the legendary titan of dimensions, umbra. [the power of umbra]

== personality ==
galen is a studious academic and dedicated to his research on umbra, the titan of dimensions. compared to his more adventurous brother, galen is more scholarly and serious. he and teeg were very kind hosts to the huntik team and he was concerned about their safety when their mission was taking longer than expected. [the power of umbra]

== abilities ==
galen is an expert on history, particularly that of hernán cortés. his research and knowledge of the yucatan is second to none and was invaluable to huntik team in their quest to recover the ring of umbra.

huntik:page:4661:
teeg is a native kumeyaay huntik foundation seeker based in baja california, mexico. as an archaeologist, he and his brother, galen, are experts on hernán cortés.

== history ==
a native seeker, teeg and galen grew up in baja california, mexico and eventually became allies of the huntik foundation. he trained with his brother in new york city with the foundation, but stood out as they had learnt their powers through their ancient traditions. [the power of umbra]

teeg and galen, helped dante vale find hernán cortés' vault using galen's maps and records. [gremlow infestation!] the pair later hosted his team as they prepared for their mission to recover the ring of umbra. teeg gave the amulet of kaioh the tracker to den fears after telling him he could relate to his experience of being new to the world of seekers. [the power of umbra]

== personality ==
teeg is friendly with a sense of humour, joking to dante that he will be in big trouble if he hadn't returned with his cook book. he is also quite insightful, picking up just from the team's behavior that den is new to the group. he relates to this, telling den him and his brother stuck out like sore thumbs when they first joined the foundation. [the power of umbra] he is more laid-back and adventurous than his scholarly brother, and, aside from being a passionate cook, teeg enjoys listening to music.

== abilities ==
teeg possesses seeker abilities and is known to have made use of the titan, kaioh the tracker. in addition to being a seeker, teeg is an adept cook.

venice, italy: sophie casterwill's house

the organization has blocked sophie's accounts, and she can't finance the huntik team in the search for the amulet of will anymore, but dante manages to get the tickets to leave anyway.

valley of the kings, egypt

the huntik team must enter the tomb of nefertiti in order to discover the organization's mysterious plans.

==synopsis==
the team takes on a mission that guggenheim makes official: the tomb of nefertiti . they retrieve the map, but zhalia moon plays them right into the organization's hands. will the organization get the sceptre - which is the key to conquering the world?

==plot==
dante vale comes up with a plan to gain access to the tomb of nefertiti; while dante and sophie set the site's explosive sack to blow, lok and zhalia manage to steal a map of the tomb. zhalia tells lok about her childhood as an orphan living on the streets until a man, klaus, gave her a chance to escape that life. zhalia recieves secret orders from klaus just before the team enters the tomb. after enter the tomb the team encounters a trap but are able to escape thanks to springer; and lok finds a hidden passage detailed in his father's journal. the organization ambushes are heroes and they are forced to split up; following the hidden passage lok find a room with a message from his father on the wall, that lets him find his father's puzzle in a secret compartment. the team regroup at the sceptre's chamber and make their way pass a mathmatical trap and attain the sceptre of nefertiti. as they are leaving the tomb the are confronted by klaus and his men and a fight breaks out; dante throws the sceptre into the water so the team can escape but klaus retrieves the sceptre. back at their camp, dante reveals he placed a tracker on the sceptre so they can track klaus back to his lair.

==trivia==
*this is the only episode of season 1 that does not see any new titans introduced.

huntik:page:4693:
valley of the kings, egypt

the huntik team enters the tomb of nefertiti in order to recover the ancient sceptre of nefertiti before the organization. contacted by ruthless klaus, zhalia moon hinders the huntik team's mission and leads dante, sophie, and lok into a series of ambushes till klaus manages to get the scepter from them. is there no longer any hope for our heros' mission?

== synopsis ==
following klaus back to vienna, the team close in on his base but it is rigged with traps. dante devises a surprise of his own while sophie begins to suspect that there is a traitor amongst them.

== plot ==
using the tracker that dante vale placed on the sceptre of nefertiti, the team follows klaus to vienna. dante explains that their mission is to attain bottle of djinn from klaus. at his bookshop, klaus uses his teknonomicon to scan the power neverlost before destroying the scepter.

outside of vienna, austria, the team's jet is confronted to a pair of the organization's combat choppers, but lok lambert has a plan. while sophie casterwill takes the controls, dante vale and zhalia moon jump to the choppers and use the weight of metagolem and king basilisk to bring them down.

the team reaches klaus' bookshop and have to deal with klaus' mutant spiders to reach the secret underground levels. sophie and zhalia take the first level while dante, lok, and cherit take the second. while sophie deals with a booby-trapped filing cabinet, zhalia alerts klaus. the girls find the file on the bottle of djinn but are surprised to find that the bottle has no magical powers. dante, lok, and cherit reach klaus' lab, and cherit finds a scroll with instructions for the power, stopglue.

the boys reach klaus' vault room, but klaus already has the bottle. dante immobilizes brahe with stopglue but is poisoned by klaus' lastedge. dante uses everfight to heal, but the poison has apparently caused him to lose his sight. just as it seem the team has lost, dante reveals he never lost his sight and takes the spear of vlad the impaler, revealing it to be their true goal. the team manages to escape with the spear and return to venice. klaus calls zhalia, telling her that blowing her cover is no longer an issue and that now the whole team is her target.

== trivia ==
* lok is revealed to have a fear of spiders. this is later referred to again in the golden asp.
* in the original animatic for this episode included on the anime works season 1 dvds, sophie summons both sabriel and feyone to join the battle against klaus. in the final version, to fit the episode runtime, sabriel is invoked offscreen and feyone does not appear at all.

lilith the queen is a demonic hecto-titan who takes the form of an egyptian queen. her ten mummified legs and bat-like wings grant her speed both in the air and on the ground. she is the strongest titan in the possession of shauna.

== history ==
lilith the queen was invoked by shauna in phoenix's volcano after ash was defeated by being thrown into the lava by baselaird. lilith threw baselaird on the ground, but she was knocked back by lok lambert using the willblade. [the phoenix's ashes]

lilith again was invoked by shauna at the spiral mark to fight against powerbonded caliban. lilith ceased her attacks, as did caliban, when void was invoked. 
[the spiral mark]

== abilities ==
lilith is capable of fast flight, and her many legs offer her speed on the ground. she can use her long nails as weapons as well as make a long, javelin-like protrusion extend from her palm to be used as a weapon. [the phoenix's ashes]

grand façade is a defensive, blue-skinned meso-titan. his strong armor is impregnable, and long hair covers his one weak spot on his back. in contrast to his tribal-style armor, he wears a futuristic, red visor on his face. grand façade is used by mr. wilder as his secret weapon.

==history==
grand façade was invoked by mr. wilder in hernán cortés' vault to fight against dante vale's caliban for the ring of umbra, the legendary titan of dimensions. after a big fight, grand façade was defeated when dante trapped his legs using stopglue, allowing caliban to find and stab grand façade's unarmored back. [the power of umbra]

grand façade again was invoked by mr. wilder in the professor's castle in a fight for rassimov's secret files. after throwing cherit against a wall, he attempted to attack den fears before being hit by cherit's energy blast. he then tried to asphyxiate grier who responded by invoking powerbonded breaker. grand façade was then defeated when breaker used his crushing grip power on him. [an ally from the organization]

mr. wilder later invoked grand façade in yonaguni, whilst fighting the huntik team for the amulet of kyojin. lok tried to attack him with the willblade but grand façade deflected the attack, redirecting it at sophie and den, rendering them unconscious. he then joined myrmidon in fighting powerbonded pendragon. when lok managed to retrieve the amulet, he summoned kyojin, causing a huge whirlpool, knocking everyone backwards and sending grand façade and the organization underwater. [the guardian of yonaguni]

==abilities==
grand façade is almost entirely covered in invulnerable armor, the exception being on his back. this armor is powerful enough to completely negate the attacks of powerful titans on the tier of caliban. due to this armor, grand façade is able to wear out his opponents and then finish them off with ease. as grand façade possesses no weapons, he instead fights using his fists and strength for combat. his red visor can fire beams of light that can deflect incoming energy attacks including energy from the willblade. [the guardian of yonaguni]

==gallery==

grand facade amulet.jpg|grand façade's amulet

grand facade.jpg|grand façade

==trivia==
*grand façade's summoning command is "show them."
*the name "grand façade" uses the english variant spelling of the word "facade," making him the only titan whose official english name is spelt with an accent (a cedilla), as seen in huntik magazine. [hm18] 
**due to localized captioning guidelines that often ommit accents on letters, netflix subtitles spell grand façade's name without the cedilla as grand facade.

logosbook is a spell that allows the caster to communicate with another seeker using a book. one seeker writes in the book, and the message appears in the other book.

== history ==
logosbook was used by zhalia moon to enchant journals owned by herself and dante vale when she went undercover as a silent soldier initiate so she could inform him of the activities of the blood spiral. [zhalia's mission]

after den fears and lok lambert were attacked by tantras' students in the streets of venice, zhalia used logosbook to inform dante that the spirals were looking for den. later, dante gets a hunch and decides to check his book, reading zhalia's message and deciding to face tantras head-on. [boys will be seekers]

with the blood spiral army approaching the fortress of iron will, zhalia used the spell to inform dante. he shortly used logosbook himself to receive her message. [sophie on trial]

on the longest night of the year, zhalia used the spell to inform dante of the location of the spiral mark on the siberian plateau. [words from eathon]

with dante seemingly sacrificing himself to stop the impact of the red comet, he had written a message to zhalia using logosbook, saying "you can't get rid of me that easily". as all hope seemed lost in the fight against the betrayer, zhalia remembered dante decided to check her book, reading the message. this prompted umbra to teleport to her location, bringing back dante's ashes. this allowed him to revive after using copykind to mimic phoenix's ability to rise from the ashes. [dante's return]

==gallery==

s2e35 dante logosbook.png|zhalia showing dante the use of logosbook
s2e49 logosbook.png|zhalia drawing in her journal to help dante
s2e52 zhalia logosbook.png|zhalia getting a message from dante

== trivia ==
* zhalia has been using the same journal since season 1, where she often took notes while still an agent of the organization. however, it seems that it was not yet enchanted with logosbook, as zhalia sent information to klaus using her phone instead.

zhalia moon used venomhand in the castle of vlad dracul, almost killing lok lambert and sophie casterwill before she came to her senses. klaus later used the spell against dante vale, overpowering his dragonfist spell. [the vampire loses its fangs]

zhalia tried to use the spell against chemosh but he knocked her to the ground before she could use it. [to be together]

stack tried to hit shauna with venomhand in klaus' bookshop, but she easily dodged it. [the blood spiral]

tantras used venomhand to murder stack in the blood spiral base, teaching his students what the blood spiral does to spies. [boys will be seekers]

after recruiting help from grier, the huntik team returned to the professor's castle in order to recover organization files about rassimov. unable to ally with the new head of the organization, wilder, grier took wilder to sutos island and took control of the professor's castle as the new leader of the organization. midnight rook is a flying litho-titan with a grey head and breast, and wings as dark as its name suggests. this expeditious titan is deft at tracking and spying on its enemies, all the while retaining an unnerving solidarity and covertness. with razor-sharp talons and even sharper eyes, this titan is primarily used by marduk and the casterwill hunters of the blood spiral.

==history==
a midnight rook that was already invoked was called by the casterwill hunters to fight lok lambert's ironsquire and dante vale's caliban, but was defeated when caliban jumped on top of it. [the casterwill connection]

midnight rook was used by marduk to track down the huntik team on the way to the pyramid of the sun in teotihuacan, mexico. [the titan in the temple of sun]

midnight rook again was used by a group of silent soldiers to spy on den fears and dante outside the fortress of iron will. after being followed back to its master by dante's solwing, it then fought alongside harlekin but was shot down by den's new titan cursed archer. [sophie on trial]

marduk used midnight rook again to fight in the strike against the fortress of iron will. after assisting cerberus in defeating sentinel, midnight rook followed marduk up the cliffs to chase santiago. [the spiral war]

==abilities==
midnight rook is a master of spying and agility. the incredible speed of his matches that of solwing while his sharp claws and beak are extremely piercing. due to his size, midnight rook is an excellent titan for assisting in combat for the blood spirals, as well as making a great stalker. [the titan in the temple of sun][sophie on trial][the spiral war]

==gallery==

midnight rook amulet.jpg|midnight rook's amulet
midnight rook icon.jpg|midnight rook's icon
midnight rook.jpg|midnight rook

== trivia ==
* midnight rook is based on the rook, birds resembling the crow, generally believed to bring bad fortune. in celtic mythology, the rook, often interchangeable with the raven, is strongly associated with death and war, a reflection of its tendency to eat carrion, plenty of which was to be found in the aftermath of battle.

the blood spiral base is the main headquarters of the blood spiral, located in a desert region of the central siberian plateau, on top of the original site of the spiral mark. the location of the blood spiral base was unknown until zhalia moon infiltrated the blood spiral and was able to reveal the location to dante vale through a sketch using logosbook. 

== history ==
the blood spiral base was built upon the original site of the spiral mark, an magical sigil created by the nullifier scout, void, to signal his brethren to come to earth. [words from eathon] after the betrayer's attempts to bring back the nullifiers were thwarted by the children of lord casterwill, for centuries, the base become home to the blood spiral, where they waited in the shadows of history, slowly plotting their return. [the divine comedy] a portal leading to the base was set up in the professor's castle, through which rassimov went to escape the huntik team and fake his demise. he then reconvened with wind and shauna, having set up the downfall of the professor. [the divine comedy]

rassimov would regularly wait in the throne room to receive orders from the spirit of the betrayer. the blooded circle would also meet here to hear the betrayer's designs and discuss the spirals' next move. [zhalia's mission] while the expansive training room would be used by the spiral members to spar with each. tantras would also train his new recruits in this room. [boys will be seekers] 

on the longest night of the year, rassimov invoked void to activate the spiral mark, causing the ground of the base to break apart revealing the spiral mark beneath them. zhalia moon, who had infiltrated the blood spiral, was then able to reveal the location to dante vale in a sketch using logosbook. dante then used umbra to teleport himself and the rest of the team to the base to fight the spirals. [words from eathon] the huntik foundation and casterwill family alliance also travelled to the base in the scramjets and waged a huge final battle against the blood spiral. [the spiral mark] during the battle between harrison and den fears, the throne room completely broke apart, with the betrayer's throne rising up from the base and breaking out onto the surface. [lok and the betrayer] following the defeat of the betrayer, the spiral mark site and the surrounding base were kept under guard by the huntik foundation. [dante's return]

== rooms ==
*the throne room - the main area in the base where the corpse of the betrayer sits and gives orders directly to rassimov. the members of the blooded circle convene here to receive orders, discuss the betrayer's plans and devise the blood spiral's next moves. [zhalia's mission]
*training area - this is a large cave where tantras can train his new recruits and the silent soldiers can brutally spa against one another. [boys will be seekers]
*living quarters - the blood spiral members live in small dormitories with simple beds, lit by candlelight. [rassimov's secret]

legion is the dark legendary titan of war, whose power allows him to absorb other titans and use their powers at his own will. once the titan of the betrayer, he was given to rassimov and hidden deep within his body to be used as his secret weapon. 

==history==
legion once belonged to the betrayer and was used to fight against the casterwill family across many generations. throughout the ages, legion absorbed thousands of titans, including an icarus and a feyone titan. [rassimov's secret]

legion's amulet was eventually laid to rest in north africa until the modern age, when it was gifted to rassimov by the spirit of the betrayer. [rassimov's secret] on the betrayer's orders, rassimov stole the amulet from its resting place in north africa, while on a covert organization mission during his time as an undercover agent. he hid the amulet within his body to avoid detection. [legion amulet (gp card)]

some months after rassimov revealed his true allegiance to the blood spiral, the huntik foundation ambushed him in egypt, and dante vale used sorrowbond to take all of rassimov's titans, unaware that legion was hidden within rassimov's body. upon escaping foundation arrest, rassimov then revealed his secret and invoked legion. after sustaining multiple attacks from dante, umbra, lok lambert and the willblade, it quickly became clear that legion was no normal titan. after being knocked into the sand by powerbonded lindorm, legion recovered and, to everyone's horror, absorbed lindorm, destroying his amulet. he then defeated powerbonded kipperin as lok attempted to invoke pendragon. dante attempted to lead rassimov away with the necklace of tutankhamun but this was snatched by dante's solwing who sought to allow the team time to escape. legion then caught up with solwing and absorbed him, destroying his amulet much to dante's sadness. [rassimov's secret]

the team were still feeling distressed following legion's attack whilst recovering at lok's home in country kerry, ireland. dante, in particular, was still exhausted from the battle. [back home]

rassimov invoked legion again at the battle at the spiral mark where he fought lok's dendras and sophie's feyone. he used lindorm's spinnerslash ability to attack them. he fought against powerbonded baselaird, overpowering and almost absorbing him, forcing lok to call him back to his amulet. legion then partially absorbed dendras before attempting to absorb feyone. however, he was defeated by lok lambert who used the willblade to destroy legion's amulet, weakened due to holding the energy of thousands of extra titans absorbed through the years. with legion's destruction, all of the titans that he had absorbed over the ages were released back to the spirit world. [the spiral mark]

==abilities==
 is absorbed by legion]] 
legion is a titan of devastating power. despite his huge size, he can move extremely fast, sprinting across the battlefield. in combat, he uses his giant fists to punch his enemies or stomp on them with his feet. he is able withstand multiple attacks simultaneously from different angles without so much as weakening. sophie casterwill stated that she had never seen a titan able to endure so much damage all at once. [s2e47] 

legion's primary and most devastating power his titan absorption ability. once he has grabbed a titan in his hands, he can absorb them into his body, trapping them inside himself and destroying their amulet for good. he can then utilize any of the absorbed titans' abilities against his enemies for himself. when a titan has been absorbed, its amulet will completely disintegrate and the titan's icon will appear on legion's chest. [rassimov's secret] however, storing the energy of thousands of extra titans also made legion's amulet extremely vulnerable as amulets are only meant to balance the energy of one titan. lok was able to destroy it with the willblade, destroying legion and releasing all the absorbed titans to return to the spirit world. [the spiral mark] 

===titans absorbed===
*icarus (seeker unknown), ability blinding bolts
*feyone (seeker unknown), ability energy blasts
*lindorm (lok's), ability spinnerslash
*solwing (dante's)
*dendras (lok's, temporarily), ability fire and ice blasts

some months after rassimov revealed his true allegiance to the blood spiral, the huntik foundation ambushed him in egypt, and dante vale used sorrowbond to take all of rassimov's titans, unaware that legion was hidden within rassimov's body. upon escaping foundation arrest, rassimov then revealed his secret and invoked legion. after sustaining multiple attacks from dante, umbra, lok lambert and the willblade, it quickly became clear that legion was no normal titan. after being knocked into the sand by powerbonded lindorm, legion recovered and, to everyone's horror, absorbed lindorm, destroying his amulet. he then defeated powerbonded kipperin as lok attempted to invoke pendragon. dante attempted to lead rassimov away with the necklace of tutankhamun but this was snatched by dante's solwing who sought to allow the team time to escape. legion then caught up with solwing and absorbed him, destroying his amulet much to dante's sadness. [rassimov's secret]

the team were still feeling distressed following legion's attack whilst recovering at lok's home in country kerry, ireland. dante, in particular, was still exhausted from the battle. [back home]

rassimov invoked legion again at the battle at the spiral mark where he fought lok's dendras and sophie's feyone. he used lindorm's spinnerslash ability to attack them. he fought against powerbonded baselaird, overpowering and almost absorbing him, forcing lok to call him back to his amulet. legion then partially absorbed dendras before attempting to absorb feyone. however, he was defeated by lok lambert who used the willblade to destroy legion's amulet, weakened due to holding the energy of thousands of extra titans absorbed through the years. with legion's destruction, all of the titans that he had absorbed over the ages were released back to the spirit world. [the spiral mark]
is absorbed by legion]] 
legion is a titan of devastating power. despite his huge size, he can move extremely fast, sprinting across the battlefield. in combat, he uses his giant fists to punch his enemies or stomp on them with his feet. he is able withstand multiple attacks simultaneously from different angles without so much as weakening. sophie casterwill stated that she had never seen a titan able to endure so much damage all at once. [s2e47] 

legion's primary and most devastating power his titan absorption ability. once he has grabbed a titan in his hands, he can absorb them into his body, trapping them inside himself and destroying their amulet for good. he can then utilize any of the absorbed titans' abilities against his enemies for himself. when a titan has been absorbed, its amulet will completely disintegrate and the titan's icon will appear on legion's chest. [rassimov's secret] however, storing the energy of thousands of extra titans also made legion's amulet extremely vulnerable as amulets are only meant to balance the energy of one titan. lok was able to destroy it with the willblade, destroying legion and releasing all the absorbed titans to return to the spirit world. [the spiral mark]

the tomb of nefertiti is a burial site located in the valley of the kings, egypt. it once contained the sceptre of nefertiti, a magical artifact containing the power neverlost. it also contained the key of nefertiti which could unlock the tomb of tutankhamun. 

== history ==
at some point during his travels, eathon lambert explored the tomb and left a eathon lambert's puzzle for his son, lok lambert, to find through a series of riddles. [the sceptre deception]

the tomb of nefertiti had been remained for centuries until a team of organization archeologists, headed by klaus, uncovered it and turned it into a dig site, searching for the sceptre and other artifacts. when the huntik team arrived, they faced heavy opposition and were forced to retreat after being overpowered in a skirmish with klaus. [all work and no pay]

the team eventually distracted the organization long enough to enter the tomb where they fell into a dangerous trap after zhalia moon sabotaged the map. dante vale was locked in a pit filling with sand while the others were contained within magical cages. using solwing to help springer reach the release mechanism, the team managed to get free. lok ventured into a secret passage found by springer and eventually found an abandoned room in which the puzzle from his father had been safely stored away. the team eventually arrived at a large room with an unstable floor, covered in hieroglyph across which lay the sceptre of nefertiti. after narrowly overcoming the test, the team left with the sceptre but ran into klaus' forces. outnumbered from both sides, dante threw the sceptre into a pool of water and escaped with the team through a passage located behind the waterfall. [the sceptre deception]

some time later, rassimov came to the tomb with harrison fears and defeated the organization suits stationed here. he obtained the key of nefertiti required for opening the tomb of tutankhamun. [rassimov's secret]

the necklace of tutankhumun was an ancient magical artifact that could supposedly control the nullifiers.

== history ==
the necklace was made from a special green glass, formed when a meteor came to earth, heating the fine egyptian sand. the betrayer used this glass to make the necklace, which eventually came into the hands of tutankhamun. [rassimov's secret]

for many years, the necklace was left in the tomb of tutankhamun. rassimov and harrison fears attempted to access the tomb using the key of nefertiti but they were intercepted and rassimov taken prisoner by the huntik foundation. the huntik team then ventured into the tomb and recovered the necklace. lok lambert attempted to scan the artifact on his holotome but found not data and gave it to dante vale to look after. however, after rassimov escaped, the necklace was taken by dante's solwing in an attempt to give the team time to escape. solwing was tragically caught and absorbed by legion, the legendary titan of war and the necklace fell into rassimov's hands. [rassimov's secret]

travelling into space with void, rassimov attempted to use the necklace to control the red comet, but the necklace was destroyed and he consequently died, proving his theory wrong. [the spiral mark]

firbolg the fierce giant was one of the guardian titans of the magical floating castle of tír na nóg alongside dullahan the headless knight. his amulet is currently in the possession of scarlet byrne.

==history==
the fir bolg, or "bag men" were one of the first of the legendary races of celtic mythology. some legends say that the firbolg were enslaved, either by the other celtic groups, or by the greeks. [wikipedia:fir bolg]

firbolg and dullahan titans stood as guardians of tír na nóg where they attacked scarlet byrne, den fears, sophie casterwill and dante vale, and fought against powerbonded sabriel and kaioh the tracker. despite overpowering the team, firbolg was defeated when lok lambert returned from the inter-dimensional world and invoked pendragon, the legendary titan of champions. his amulet was then obtained by scarlet. [back home]

in the final battle against the blood spiral, firbolg saved fenris from a marauder titan. this impressed montehue lost for words as he has been telling scarlet how powerful fenris was. [lok and the betrayer]

==abilities==
firbold is a large and very strong titan. he can pick up smaller titans with ease and can crush them in his hands. firbolg once picked up a marauder and squeezed it so hard it returned to its amulet. this strength, coupled with his large size, make firbolg a very powerful titan. [lok and the betrayer]

dullahan the headless knight was one of the guardian titans of the magical floating castle of tír na nóg alongside firbolg the fierce giant. his amulet is currently in the possession of den fears.

==history==
dullahan titans appeared in irish mythology as fearsome fairies with a role similar to the grim reaper. they would either ride in a chariot driven by six black, headless horses or on top of a lone black horse. their shields, bearing the visage of a face, were interpreted to be the dullahans' heads. they became omens of death said to guide dying souls to their final resting places. [wikipedia:dullahan]

numerous dullahan and firbolg titans stood as guardians of tír na nóg where they attacked scarlet byrne, den fears, sophie casterwill and dante vale, and fought against powerbonded sabriel and kaioh the tracker. despire overpowering the team, dullahan was defeated when lok lambert returned from the inter-dimensional world and invoked pendragon, the legendary titan of champions. his amulet was then obtained by den. [back home]

den invoked dullahan in the tomb of nostradamus alongside dante's elf king oberon where they fought against marduk's psikofen and helinx titans. [words from eathon]

in the final battle against the betrayer, dullahan was invoked alongside harrison fears's jericho. he was defeated however by demigorgan, the titan of betrayal. [dante's return]

==abilities==

dullahan wields a spiked ball-and-chain mace as well as a head-shaped shield that can "breathe" fire through his flame burst ability. dullahan has been able to fight in physical combat with powerbonded sabriel, his disarm ability allowing him to take her swords from her. [back home] in addition, dullahan can throw his shield, almost like a frisbee, at an enemy to immobilize them, as he did to psikofen. [words from eathon]

the paris catacombs are a large network of underground tunnels that extend deep beneath the city of paris. joan of arc hid the ring of arc here where it remained for many centuries until it was recovered by the huntik foundation.

== history ==
the catacombs were originally rock quarries but were eventually turned into tombs where they buried their dead. [divide and conquer]

during the french revolution, some soldiers and an archeologist became trapped when they took refuge in the catacombs. their skeletons would later be found by lok lambert and cherit. [divide and conquer]

joan of arc hid the ring of arc, containing the legendary titan of fate, arc, within the tunnels and left the knights of arc's inner circle to guard it. [crawling the catacombs]

while on his quest to find the amulet of will, eathon lambert explored the catacombs, and hid his titan, springer, in a puzzle within a trapped alcove for his son, lok, to eventually find. [crawling the catacombs] [huntik.com]

following clues left by joan of arc, the huntik team entered the catacombs through a passage in the abandoned church in paris and fought the knights of arc's inner circle to recover the ring of arc. they made a plan to smuggle the cursed ring out of the catacombs via gareon, and evade defoe and his organization forces, and safely deliver it to the foundation safehouse at the cathedral of notre dame. [divide and conquer]

the ring of arc eventually broke free and kidnapped clements, trapping him in a dream state and retuning to the catacombs where it had resided for centuries. the huntik team ventured into the catacombs to rescue him, where they touched the ring and found themselves trapped in dreamworlds. lok and dante managed to escape and faced off against arc, now revealed as as the titan of fate, and defeated her. [s2e34]

tír na nóg is a magical castle floating over ireland. the castle is visible and physical only under the light of a full moon. the castle is guarded by firbolg and dullahan titans.

== history ==
tír na nóg finds itself in celtic legends as an otherworldly island existing beyond the western edges of the map that was home to the spirits. known among seekers as the phantom castle of ireland, the fairies which inhabit the floating castle are the titans known as firbolg and dullahan. [s2e48]

eathon lambert took his wife, sandra, on a moonlit picnic to the valley in county kerry, ireland to watch as tír na nóg appear in the moonlight. [s2e48]

it was later found by scarlet byrne, who was attacked by a rogue firbolg titan. gaining the help of lok lambert, who had been having recurring dreams of finding his father at such a place, she enlisted the help of the huntik foundation team to return. while exploring the castle, an area of the floor dematerialized, and lok and cherit fell into a weak point between dimensions. in this inter-dimensional world, he was able to speak to his father through a mirror into the spirit world, huntik. after returning through the power of umbra, lok invoked pendragon to defeat the dullahan and firbolg titans. their amulets secured, den fears bonded with one of the dullahan titans while scarlet bonded with a firbolg. [back home]

*tir na nóg is derived from the old irish tir inna n'oc, meaning "land of the young." it features prominently in the story of oisin and niamh in celtic mythology.
*in iginio straffi's other series, winx club, tir na nóg appears as the realm of the earth fairies.
