master storm is a master of martial arts who taught dante vale in his youth. the grandfather of lin storm and an old friend of metz, he lives in the taihang mountains of china.

== history ==
master storm taught dante vale in his youth, alongside lin storm, training them both intensely on a daily basis. he was good friends with metz whom the master called a "daredevil and a lady-killer". [lok's leadership]

many years later, dante returned to master storm, deeply troubled by arc's prophecy of his death and wanting to be ready to meet his fate head-on. master storm oversaw an intense training session, teaching dante new moves, before teaching him his strongest power, copykind, which allows a seekers to borrow the abilities of his titans. dante's lesson was interrupted by an urgent call from metz, leading him to invoke umbra. master storm was amazed to see a legendary titan before his eyes. dante then use copykind to use umbra's ability to teleport to the castle of vlad dracul. [lok's leadership]

== abilities ==
master storm is an incredibly powerful seeker whose training techniques are the most gruelling but also the most effective. his most powerful spell is copykind.

*copykind

lin storm is the granddaughter of master storm and a childhood friend of dante vales's, who lives in the taihang mountains of china.

==history==

lin was trained alongside dante vale in their childhood, by her grandfather. they would train intensely in the mountains everyday. [lok's leadership]

many years later, troubled by arc's prophecy, dante returned to the taihang mountains where lin, now grown up, attacked him, challenging him to a duel. with the pair evenly matched, lin complimented on his abilities, revealing her identity, and welcomed him back to see her grandfather. she later assisted master storm in giving dante an intense training session. as he rested, lin sensed something was on dante's mind and encouraged him to open up to her. however, dante apologised and told her he was worried about zhalia moon.

lin and dante later studied master storm's most powerful spell, copykind, before dante was interrupted by an urgent call from metz. dante then invoked umbra and teleported to the castle of vlad dracul using his new copykind power. [lok's leadership]

==personality==

although at first lin acted very suspiciously, tough and even violent, she later revealed herself to be rather friendly. nevertheless, she is still not a person to mess with, as during the fight she is extremely alert and is always ready to stand her ground. she is very proud of her origin and family and respects her grandfather. however, she also appreciates other strong people. she cares deeply about dante, who she appears to have feelings for, as she compliments him, encouraging him to open up and brings back memories from their childhood.

==abilities==

lin is an accomplished martial artist, able to hold her own against dante vale, as well as assist in his training. she is extremely fast and her spells are associated with knife-throwing, at which she excels.

===spells utilized===
* shadowknife

huntik:page:5035:
central desert, ethiopia

with a stratagem, zhalia manages to evade the professor and join the huntik team again. dante bumps into his old rival, montehue, accompanied by tersly. the professor gets to king solomon's mines before our heroes and adds his diabolical tricks to the traps in the mines. but in the end, lok will manage to bind himself with the legendary titan of the spirit.

== synopsis ==
the huntik team searches for information about simon judeau and the legendary titan araknos. after a discussion with metz, espionage in the organization headquarters, and research in the huntik foundation library, the team makes a critical discovery about the identity of the professor.

== plot ==
;metz country estate, germany
the team are assembled at metz's estate. lok explains that he was wearing the amulet of will when he recovered the ring of tao, which prompts metz to tell the group that the amulet of will is the key to breaking the curses of the legendary titans. dante asks if the amulet of will can be used to heal metz of his curse, but metz informs the group that the leading expert on the subject was a man called simon judeau an old friend of metz's, who took everything with him. metz then explains to lok about simon and eathon lambert. 

;mid late 1950's, venice, italy
metz recounts the time when he was a young seeker. as the organization didn't show themselves until 1959, he had no competition - until he met another seeker called simon judeau. metz's first impression of simon was that he was a bit helpless until he saw that he already had two amulets. he was also amazed when simon used everfight to heal himself and asked if simon could teach him the power. a young boy called eathon told him that it was no problem as simon had already taught him. eathon went everywhere with simon according to metz's account. 

the three of them journeyed around the world in search of titans for the huntik foundation. metz explains that he was the muscle of the group, simon was the brains and eathon was the intuition/luck. he also mentions that everything changed when they began searching for the legendary titan, araknos.

;organization hq
the professor gives rassimov the titan archwarder and explains that it has a disruption power that is most effective on stronger enemy titans. he states that he will attack dante's team while rassimov is to prevent them from using their legendary titans. rassimov is then to take the amulet of will. 

;back at dante's house
 keeps a bedridden simon company, sometime in 1958]]
sophie questions dante on the story metz told them. dante tells the team that after searching for a year, eathon, simon and metz found the underground temple that contained the legendary titan. there was an inscription on the door, warning that the legendary titans were sealed under a deadly curse and the only way to awaken them was to use casterwill's key. while eathon and metz felt that the temple was hallowed ground, simon went ahead and opened the doorway. dante explains that although simon found araknos, metz had to pull him out and take him back to venice for medical assistance. there was nothing that could be done for simon's condition and eathon then spent a year at the side of simon's hospital bed. eventually, the foundation's treatments healed simon enough for him to walk. simon became convinced that casterwill's key was a reference to the amulet of will, went in search of it and disappeared. 

;centuries-old conflict
rassimov summons shauna and wind, who appear on shakrit. he tells them to go to venice and search for dante and his team. he forbids them from killing sophie casterwill, which infuriates shauna. she is quickly put back in her place by rassimov, who reminds her that they will have their revenge on the casterwills soon enough. 

;secrets of the organisation
as the team studies araknos on the holotome, lok tells the team that his father made three trips. eathon went to prague, rotterdam and chicago but left no explanation in the journal as to why he visited these places. zhalia points out that those locations are all organization hotspots. dante explains the mission to the team. zhalia will go to rotterdam and then prague to infiltrate the organization bases there. lok, sophie and cherit are sent to the huntik foundation compound in venice to look for any information on the amulet of will. meanwhile, dante heads to new york. 

;organization central, prague
zhalia, having disguised herself as a suit, manages to gain access to a restricted area with a keycard she stole from a suit in rotterdam. she hacks into klaus' teknonomicon and finds a file that is password protected. in the middle of her search, she uses thoughtspecter to conceal herself from a passing suit. she reads the file which is about new year's eve, 1959.

;huntik foundation compound
after speaking with lok, clease realises that he is eathon's son and reveals that he saw simon and eathon having an argument. simon demanded that eathon joined him but eathon refused. simon then stormed out and wasn't seen since. shortly afterwards, clease is attacked by the professor and his two suits, alpha and beta.

;realizing the truth
back at dante's house, lok and sophie recount everything they have learned to dante. as they are talking, clease, who is under the professor's control, enters the house unnoticed to disable the defences. zhalia explains that one of the things she learned while with the organization was about was the group's history, which took shape over hundreds of years before it finally emerged in 1959. however, this history was all a lie as the organization was founded new year's, 1959 with only one member - the professor. the team quickly realise that the professor must have used the power of araknos to exert such far-reaching mind control - and that the professor is actually simon judeau.
 and araknos without their legendary titans]]
before they can do anything, the barrier around dante's house is suddenly broken. the team are attacked by an enforcer titan, forcing them to flee to the roof where they are confronted by the professor and araknos. dante and lok try to summon tao and behemoth, but are prevented from doing so by archwarder's disruption pulse ability, as the titan was invoked by rassimov unbeknownst to the heroes. the team summon caliban, lindorm, sabriel and kilthane but araknos shoots out webs that cause them to attack each other. dante then invokes ignatius, who is immune to araknos' attack. before he can incinerate the web created by araknos, the professor summons nordrake and ignatius is sent back to his amulet. dante tells sophie to deal with the suits and lok to deal with the professor. lok uses darkfog to distract the professor but is grabbed by him. dante launches himself at them but is caught by the professor's mind control power. lok, sophie, zhalia and cherit flee as the professor sends dante to hunt them down.

;sophie's townhouse
as the team try to regroup, leblanche gives sophie the titan albion. hearing an explosion outside, they head to the door only to be confronted by dante and caliban. dante reveals that he isn't under the professor's control thanks to zhalia's headcage spell, which she used while lok and sophie were distracting everyone. they head off to a huntik foundation safehouse.

;streets of venice
 team is left in shambles after shauna and wind's attack]]
as the team race through the streets, they are attacked by shauna and wind. zhalia summons king basilisk after dante is attacked, but shakrit defeats it with a single blow. shauna summons ash and dervish as she and sophie fight, while dante fights with wind. sophie is quickly defeated by shauna who then turns her attention to lok. he then summons baselaird who is paralyzed by dervish. shauna knocks lok down and uses sorrowbond to steal both the amulet of will and eathon's journal. lok hides tao's ring by wearing a pair of gloves. having got what they came for, shauna and wind retreat.

the team heads to the safe house while dante goes back to his house. he receives a message from the professor, who promises him the answers he's looking for if he brings the legendary titans.

venice, italy: sophie casterwill's house

lok's father's diary, now fixed thanks to sophie's power, leads the huntik team to greece looking for access to atlantis.

thessalonica, greece

avoiding the attacks launched by the ruthless rassimov and the organization, lok finds an old oracle who tells him that the access to atlantis is hidden among the ruins of the temple of poseidon.

== synopsis ==
the huntik team travels to atlantis on their quest for the amulet of will. lok starts to become stronger and show his true potential. the team finds atlantis, but four tests await them.

== plot ==
;council meeting
back at the huntik international hq in manhattan, new york, metz introduces the foundation's new seekers to the council members, who are surprised to have the son of eathon lambert fighting by their side. metz also reminds them that if the huntik foundation wants to win against the professor, then they must put their differences aside and work together.

;an historic battle
as the meeting takes place, the huntik team arrives at an underground passage in thessalonica, greece, that leads to a room covered with burns as an indication of a major battle. dante then uses his holotome to recreate the battle, showing a battle between eathon lambert and five of the professor's strongest operatives, who also disappeared a decade ago. eathon was initially cornered and overwhelmed by the attacks, until he invoked jirwolf and dendras to turn the tide in his favor; thought the outcome of the fight was left unclear. after viewing this battle, the team head toward a door with four different pairs of stone knobs, but lok picks the most obvious one, saying that they might not find the right answer by thinking too much.

meanwhile, rassimov and his suits, still in the temple of poseidon on the surface, try to uncover the secret passage. one of the suits tells rassimov that the key must be the book that lok had. rassimov shows him a page of eathon lambert's journal, given to him by the professor, which reveals the passage.

;journey to atlantis

after passing through the door, the huntik team find themselves on a cliff, surrounded by a bubble of oxygen. lok and cherit determine that it is indeed atlantis, and then they decide that they have to swim from there. while swimming, cherit is caught by a shark, but dante uses stoneglove to open the shark's mouth so zhalia moon can get cherit. when they reach the bubble surrounding atlantis, they fall to the ground as dante uses featherdrop to catch zhalia. lok tries to do the same, but he misjudges her landing which results in her landing on top of him.

;the four tests of casterwill
in atlantis, they reach a compound are confronted by the atlantis guardian, a self-thinking magical trap who tells them they match the four great virtues of casterwill by passing the tests of bravery, prowess, intelligence, and nobility. lok, confronted with bravery, has to pass through flames, knowing they are false. lok is determined to find his father and passes through the fire without any fear. faces the mermen]]
dante is then faced with the test of prowess and must battle three mermen seekers with powers of the casterwill family. when dante invokes caliban, the mermen each invoke a caliban ocean warrior titan. in response, dante invokes metagolem, but the mermen counter with three powerful coralgolem titans while telling dante that they can each invoke equivalent titans to any that he summons. after his titans get taken out, dante calls forth behemoth. the mermen attempt to invoke an equivalent titan, but an explosion is created as dante explains that there is no equivalent to the power of a legendary titan. though he passes the test, dante collapses from exhaustion due to invoking so many powerful titans in a short period of time.

sophie casterwill chooses the test of intelligence, forcing zhalia moon to take the final test. her sole question is how many temples the people of atlantis built. remembering that this is a test of intelligence, not memory, sophie recalls that while there were five built in atlantis, there was also a sixth temple on the surface, the temple of poseidon, built by the population of atlantis as a secret passage.

finally, zhalia is confronted with the test of nobility. she is initially unsure of herself, thanks to her past with the organization, but it is the very confession of this past that allows her to pass the test as the real test is of inner nobleness. in regretting everything she had done, she showed herself to have a pure heart.

;fight of will
having passed the tests, the atlantis guardian starts leading them toward the amulet of will. the guardian reveals that he has not opened the gates in more than ten thousands years, which gets lok to believe his father did not make it through the battle at the start. rassimov then interrupts the huntik team with a darkwave spell to pick up the amulet of will. lok is furious that he probably won't be able to find his father and channels his frustrations in fighting rassimov one-on-one. dante, unable to fight, tells sophie and zhalia to let lok take on rassimov while they fight his suits.

lok makes use of the atlantis guardian to open the gates at the perfect timing to strike an unsuspecting rassimov with lindorm, and the two seekers begin invoking their respective titans. rassimov eventually finds an opportunity to summon anubian, but lok is able to defeat it by ordering baselaird to tackle it into the compound's gate, telling the guardian to close it. despite lok showing a lot of resistance to rassimov's powers, the latter manages to eventually bring him to the ground. cherit then uses his energy charge to give lok enough strenght to send rassimov flying into a concrete wall. in the meanwhile, sophie and zhalia have mostly disposed of the suits and the organization is forced to retreat.

the team finally head to the lowest chamber of the compound, and the atlantis guardian explains the history of how lord casterwill brought the titans to earth to fight the nullifiers for five hundred years, only dying when they were defeated. lok is outside the compound, still very upset about his father not making it his far in his search for the amulet of will. sophie leaves to comfort and motivate lok to follow his father's footsteps, even if he probably won't be able to find him. lok then returns and solves the puzzle eathon left for him in the tomb of nefertiti to finally reveal the ancient amulet of will from the chamber, making the team stare at it in awe.

huntik:page:5037:
vlad's castle, romania

the huntik team searches vlad dracul's castle in order to lay hand on titans which once belonged to evil count vlad, but the team splits and klaus orders zhalia to get rid of its members one by one. when all hope seems lost, zhalia repents for her betrayal, leaving the organization for good and helping our heroes.

== plot ==
still recovering from zhalia's betrayal, the team go after the titan of sir lancelot, cavalier. while sophie and cherit investigate a library for clues about it while lok and dante start the quest for the titan. they pass many challenges but somehow feel that they're being helped. when they find the titan, they find that rassimov has been sent to collect the titan, and the team are horrified at rassimov's darkvoid ability.

== summary ==
an incredible battle is happening on a stormy mountaintop. clouds obscure the details, revealing only red lightning and purple energy. a small titan watches the battle between a strange evil shadow and the silhouette of a man with a glowing amulet. it is lord casterwill who is facing an evil creature, uttering the syllables "sen ten gon" before calling cherit to his side. the little titan has a moment of bravery and charges toward the great darkness.

the battle scene fades and changes to the present, where lok is trying to get cherit’s attention. guggenheim gives the team a mission to retrieve the lost treasures of sir lancelot, which may include a casterwill item, and may point them to the amulet of will!

over in prague, rassimov tells the professor his suits have located lancelot’s mausoleum and that he’ll deal with it personally. sophie goes to a huntik foundation library to research documents and discovers a secret library that only casterwills can enter! inside the secret library, she finds a book with a picture of an amulet—an amulet that cherit somehow recognizes as the amulet of will!

dante and lok, not knowing that rassimov is following them, enter lancelot’s mausoleum and are attacked by ghosts and magical traps. rassimov secretly helps them because he’s using them to get past the traps. when dante and lok reach the treasure room, rassimov attacks them (they got past all the traps, so he doesn’t need them anymore!). rassimov summons lancelot’s titan cavalier, but cavalier resists rassimov’s evil. angry at cavalier’s refusal to help him, rassimov casts a darkvoid spell that consumes all the magic in the room and destroys cavalier, which should be impossible! rassimov uses a power to vanish before dante can attack, but the heroes find a secret room with a new casterwill power — one that can repair lok’s father’s journal!

huntik:page:5040:
venice, italy

the huntik team finds out that the diabolical organization had its roots in the legendary titan of the mind. the professor himself created the organization very quickly by dominating the suits' minds. but when the mystery is unveiled, it's already too late. dante's house is under attack, and the organization seizes lok's father's diary and the amulet of will.

==synopsis==
having lost the journal and the amulet of will, the huntik team heads to prague to confront the professor on his home turf.

== plot ==
;the late 1950's in the ecuadorian jungle
the lost temple of tecobai was discovered by simon judeau, metz, and a young eathon lambert after following the advice of a native witchdoctor. the trio hurried across a bridge over a river of magma in order to evade hostile natives. eathon managed to get across before the bridge's support ropes snapped, and he sent a rope after the other two via ropetrick with simon catching metz.

;solo mission
dante vale received a phone call from lady s., relaying that metz may not have much time left and that the mission dante had been considering was a trap. the next morning, guggenheim pays what was supposed to be a surprise visit to dante's house with information for the team of dante, lok, sophie, zhalia, and cherit regarding the danger of agreeing to the professor's invitation. guggenheim summoned his titan, bulreguard, in an effort to prevent dante from continuing this perilous mission; however, bulreguard merely licked dante's face like a loyal dog. though still set on the mission, dante's team would be unable to receive foundation assistance. the team thus prepared for the meeting through training and research while the professor and rassimov made their own preparations.

;a trap-filled visit
upon arrival, the huntik team parachuted to the professor's castle to be confronted by rassimov's men and an illusion spell concealing perilous traps. lok, zhalia, and cherit created a diversion while sophie took out the illusion-creating anchor through breakspell. dante and rassimov fought head-to-head. by using a combination of firebrand and cutrace, rassimov ignited a prepared patch of gasoline, creating an explosion which dante barely evaded by jumping and grabbing onto the edge of a bridge-like walkway.

;clash of the titans
freelancer, kilthane, and feyone are invoked to help dante while jokoul, strix, and terrapede titans are summoned by the suits. the titans do battle as zhalia and one of the suits do battle, each using mindsight to predict each other's attacks. as dante lost his grip and began to fall, lok summoned kipperin to catch him. rassimov; however, then took out lok through an acidheart spell and released kipperin with drybite. both summoning their titans, caliban pursued rassimov with dante while ammit heart-eater detained the others.

;against rassimov
upon dante's catching up to rassimov, the evil seeker invoked his own titan, thornment, to distract caliban while rassimov triggered a spike trap throughout the room. caliban defeated by thornment, dante slipped into the next room in time to regain his strength through everfight and then defeat thornment. rassimov, not far behind, engages in hand-to-hand combat with dante but is caught mid-attack and hurled into what dante presumed was a portal-based trap. dropping an archwarder amulet, rassimov disappeared. upon researching archwarder with the holotome, the team decided to use archwarder's disruptor special ability against overlos to defeat the professor.

;the fourth faction
unknown to the huntik team, rassimov simply appeared on the other side of a portal with wind and shauna, saying that the professor's downfall was in place for the blood spiral to emerge on top.

;meeting with the professor
zhalia using headcage to protect against mental attacks, dante's team entered the central chamber of the castle to meet with the professor. removing a spell concealing his curse, the professor claimed to wish to heal not only himself, but metz as well. after leaving the huntik foundation, simon had committed himself to researching his curse and had found that the casterwill clan had sealed the legendary titans with a curse if the titans were invoked without overlos's amulet of will. he also had used araknos' power to create the organization to research a cure. having found a special ritual, the professor tricked dante into handing over his legendary titans, tao and behemoth  and caliban while sophie and zhalia battle over whether or not to stand by his decision. the three necessary titans in his possession, the professor disappears victorious.

== trivia ==
*the title of the episode refers to the divine comedy, a 14th-century epic poem by italian writer dante alighieri.
**the original italian title of the episode, "l'inferno di dante", refers to the first part of dante's divine comedy called the "inferno".
*story supervisor maurizio de angelis has stated that this is his favorite episode of the show.

upon dante's catching up to rassimov, the evil seeker invoked his own titan, thornment, to distract caliban while rassimov triggered a spike trap throughout the room. caliban defeated by thornment, dante slipped into the next room in time to regain his strength through everfight and then defeat thornment. rassimov, not far behind, engages in hand-to-hand combat with dante but is caught mid-attack and hurled into what dante presumed was a portal-based trap. dropping an archwarder amulet, rassimov disappeared. upon researching archwarder with the holotome, the team decided to use archwarder's disruptor special ability against overlos to defeat the professor.

;the fourth faction
unknown to the huntik team, rassimov simply appeared on the other side of a portal with wind and shauna, saying that the professor's downfall was in place for the blood spiral to emerge on top.

;meeting with the professor
zhalia using headcage to protect against mental attacks, dante's team entered the central chamber of the castle to meet with the professor. removing a spell concealing his curse, the professor claimed to wish to heal not only himself, but metz as well. after leaving the huntik foundation, simon had committed himself to researching his curse and had found that the casterwill clan had sealed the legendary titans with a curse if the titans were invoked without overlos's amulet of will. he also had used araknos' power to create the organization to research a cure. having found a special ritual, the professor tricked dante into handing over his legendary titans, tao and behemoth  and caliban while sophie and zhalia battle over whether or not to stand by his decision. the three necessary titans in his possession, the professor disappears victorious.
*the title of the episode refers to the divine comedy, a 14th-century epic poem by italian writer dante alighieri.
**the original italian title of the episode, "l'inferno di dante", refers to the first part of dante's divine comedy called the "inferno".
*story supervisor maurizio de angelis has stated that this is his favorite episode of the show.

psikofen is a mummy-like hecto-titan who, through the use of its deadly chains that come out of its hands, can ensnare enemies or violently tear through solid structures, making him a dangerous and formidable opponent. closely related to the titan marauder, psikofen is used by marduk and the casterwill hunters of the blood spiral.
==history ==
psikofen was invoked by a casterwill hunter in the salon airfield when the huntik team were ambushed just after landing their plane. after destroying the plane, psikofen battled against ironsquire and kelpie. though psikofen gained the edge in the battle, he began to slow down out of fatigue, which allowed cherit to defeat him with his energy charge. another psikofen was used by marduk to attack the team in nostradamus's tomb. he battled dullahan and elf king oberon and sabotaged the team's plans but, after a fierce fight, he was defeated by powerbonded baselaird. [words from eathon]

during the battle at the spiral mark, psikofen was invoked by a casterwill hunter to fight against the huntik foundation and casterwill family. psikofen was able to capture lane and render her unconscious before being sent back to its amulet when hit by montehue's flying axe. [lok and the betrayer]

==abilities ==
]]
psikofen's strength lies in its ability to use its chains as weapons, often targeting his enemies by the ankles so as to demobilize them before moving into finish them off; or even using them to pull away opponents' shields or defend itself against spells. the power psikofen has in controlling these chains mean he is strong enough to single-handedly destroy a plane and can capture enemies as strong as baselaird. it can also fire a laser from its forehead. despite his strength, psikofen lacks stamina, and will slow down as he gets tired from maneuvering his chains, something which lok lambert and cherit exploited, sending it back to its amulet with the latter's energy charge. psikofen is also limited by only having one chain in each arm (one with a sphere at the end and the other one with a piercing diamond-shaped end), meaning that if it tries to ensnare two enemies at once without finishing them off, it will be left vulnerable. its chains can be used against it if an opponent is able to grab them, making psikofen trip. [words from eathon]

the huntik foundation italian hq, formerly known as the huntik foundation compound, is the main base for the huntik foundation in venice, italy. it contains a large library and a training ring, used for teaching new seekers. klaus was kept in the basement here during his time as a statue.
== history ==
the compound was used by lok lambert and sophie casterwill to conduct research about the legendary titan, araknos. after meeting clease, they learnt that simon judeau had last been sighted at the compound madly shouting at eathon lambert to be his dog. [the secret of two generations]

the compound eventually became known as the official italian headquarters for the foundation. numerous operatives including metz gathered in the library where zhalia moon invoked king basilisk and turned klaus back from stone so that he could help them find void. [the blood spiral]

den fears was trained here under the guidance of clease. after getting increasingly frustrated at the constant studying and difficult exercises, den walked out but accidentally caused clease to knock down all the shelves of books, much to the sadness of sophie. den then helped to clean up the mess and resumed studying, following his being asked to join the huntik team. lok and den later studied here. [boys will be seekers]

organization central is the principal headquarters of the organization, located in prague, czech republic. the archives store an impressive array of information and arcane artifacts obtained since the organization's creation by simon judeau in 1959. the professor would often summon his subordinates to his office, located here, and berate them if they had failed in their missions. providing accommodation to hundreds of operatives, the hq also features numerous screen rooms and a highly advanced training gym.

== history ==
after falling victim to the curse of the legendary titans, simon judeau started the organization in 1959 using the mind control abilities of araknos in order to speed up his search for a cure. judeau also falsified the history of the organization, so as to make it seem as if the organization had been in existence for years when, in reality, it was a relatively new company. with the creation of the organization, judeau donned the alias of the professor. [the secret of two generations]

zhalia moon infiltrated organization central using the id of klaus, in order to find the whereabouts of simon judeau before discovering that the organization's history had been faked. [the secret of two generations]

after the fall of the professor, the organization weakened, with the huntik team launching a break-in to recover the last known location of eathon lambert. both wilder and stack were both alarmed by this as they surveyed the team from a cctv room and planned to take control of the organization by defeating the team who had torn it apart. [doorway to huntik]

* the camera in the training gym is out of service. zhalia speculates that rassimov deactivated it himself so that other agents won't find out that grier is a lot stronger than he is.

otto is a desert guide who lives in mek'ele in ethiopia. he is a good friend of zhalia moon, having worked as a guide for her while she was a member of the organization.

== history ==
otta served as a guide for zhalia during her missions for the organization and the pair became good friends. [the golden asp]

otto later served as a guide to the huntik team on their quest for the legendary titan of spirit, tao. after being separated in the ethiopian desert during a battle with some suits, he and zhalia were captured by rassimov. after falling victim to the professor and his mind-controlling ring of araknos, otto became a loyal undercover agent for the organization. [the golden asp] [to be together]

otto is friendly and kind, letting the huntik team stay in his house and showing off his fantastic cooking. he is also dependable in a crisis, helping the huntik team escape in his brother's car. he showed bravery in trying to help zhalia escape the suits in the desert but also slipped up whilst trying to lie to the professor that they did not know dante vale. madea island is an island located in an unknown location in the aegean sea at the center of the atlantic ocean. for many years it was home to the titan, madea, which is known for its illusions.

==history==
while navigating the , the huntik foundation team's cabin cruiser suffered an attack and they decided to rest. after the holotome designated madea island as the only suitable island nearby, the team came alongside it and met with madea and the various women inhabiting the island.

gradually, the team found themselves deep under the influence of the island's magic, each of them being assigned to an illusion tailored to their deepest desire. eventually, zhalia moon destroyed the obelisk originating all the illusions, while all the members slowly snapped out of their controlled state on their own. madea revealed her true identity as an ill-spirited titan, and she was defeated by dante vale. the team then found madea's amulet alongside a tablet owned by jason in the past, which would help them on their initial mission to find the argo.

demigorgan is the legendary titan of betrayal and is the personal titan of the betrayer. while its true appearance is that of a huge goat-dog hybrdi with orange armor and disproportionately large arms, demigorgan is able to alter its form at will to anything it has touched, at its seeker's demand. 

==history==
as part of a grand plan designed by the betrayer, demigorgan was disguised as eathon lambert's holotome and was planted by rassimov in the professor's castle for lok lambert to find. lok immediately recognised the holotome as eathon's from when he was a child and used it to a make plan of attack against the professor. [the mission]

when the huntik team discovered the nexus in peru and managed to contact eathon lambert in the spirit world, demigorgan, as eathon's holotome, spied on them, learning eathon's face and voice so as to impersonate him in the future. [doorway to huntik] demigorgan then began to display messages from eathon to lok and the team, giving them clues and leading them to the legendary titans umbra and phoenix, as the betrayer knew that the huntik team would not make it to the spiral mark without them. faking the last prophecies of nostradamus, the betrayer was able to trick lok into driving the willblade into the spiral mark, breaking the seal that lord casterwill had put in place and signalling the return of the nullifiers. [the spiral mark]

in the battle between the blood spiral and the casterwill-foundation alliance, demigorgan was invoked by the betrayer and was revealed to have been feeding information to the huntik foundation. when zhalia tried to save lok and sophie from demigorgan, it easily defeated her king basilisk. [lok and the betrayer] demigorgan fought against den and harrison fears and their respective titans, dullahan and jericho, easily defeating dullahan.

when lok lambert and sophie casterwill joined the fight, demigorgan created copies of the huntik team to send their titans back to their amulets and subsequently take on the forms of these titans. these clones were defeated by powerbonded pendragon, but a subsequent copy of the original champion of casterwill was able to subdue. however, demigorgan was defeated by an empowered lok, who destroyed its amulet for good by channeling quetzalcoatl's energy through the willblade. [dante's return]

==abilities==
demigorgan is a creature that is made of crackling energy that is able to transform as required into what suits the situation, including transforming into a fully functional holotome [lok and the betrayer], or briefly turning into dust and reappearing elsewhere to escape attacks. another ability allows demigorgan to subvert the seeker-titan bond by creating copies of a seeker or titan. these copies are then able to hypnotize seekers and titans alike through manipulation of the bond. in direct combat, demigorgan's primary method of attack is firing powerful energy blasts from its mouth, which can defeat titans as powerful as king basilisk; and with its physical strength, it can easily crush enemies with its fists. as a legendary titan, demigorgan is able to withstand a lot of damage before being sent back to his amulet, and can move fairly quickly despite its gargantuan size. [dante's return]

* demigorgan's name is derived from the demogorgon, a demonic and primordial entity occurring in christian literature from the middle ages. its visual design and abilities heavily echo the púca, a notorious, shape-shifting trickster spirit from celtic and irish folklore that frequently manifests as a dark-furred, formidable goat as one of its forms. its appearance may also have been inspired by the archetypal goat-demon, baphomet.

[the unseen guide]

rassimov later found his own way through the entrance with his men, using torn pages from the journal given to him by the professor. [coming of age]

bazela's insects are swara-titan fliers summoned by the bazela's hive titan. many bazela's insects may be deployed from a single mother titan to transport seekers across the globe or carry them into the heart of battle.

== history ==
bazela's insects were ridden by kiel, marduk, and two casterwill hunters. their destination was new york's cloisters to hunt out focauld casterwill. [the casterwill connection]

a large number of bazela's insects were used by tantras and the silent soldiers to attack the casterwill family at the fortress of iron will. [the spiral war]

they were later used by harrison fears and rassimov to retrieve the necklace of tutankhamun. after rassimov was taken prisoner, harrison sacrificed the energy of one of the insects using powermark. [rassimov's secret] 

after harrison lost the amulet of bazela's hive, the betrayer took the amulet, using the insect fliers to battle the huntik foundation and casterwill family. [lok and the betrayer] [dante's return]

the venice coffeehouse is a café located in venice, italy, which sells several types of coffee, alcoholic beverages, and cakes. lok lambert, sophie casterwill and cherit worked here for a short time as they were trying to earn money for plane tickets to egypt. [all work and no pay]

alisa clairmont is a rich and ill-mannered woman who visits venice, italy every year from france. she attempted to reserve a room in the venice hotel for her and her dog but became angry at sophie casterwill when she was politely told that the east penthouse was already occupied.

== history ==
when trying to reserve a room in the venice hotel, alisa clairmont's dog bit both lok lambert and leblanche. when leblanche voiced his complaints at the dog wounding him, alisa clairmont became angry and hit both leblanche and lok with her purse. upon trying to similarly strike at sophie, who tried to no avail to calm alisa clairmont down, santiago used a shadowpoint spell on her bag. this action resulted in a fight, leading to the huntik team being fired from the hotel. [all work and no pay]

== personality ==
alisa clairmont is extremely ill-mannered and self-important, especially towards people who she believes are less than her, such as hotel staff. she is also bad-tempered and aggressive, as seen in her habit of using her handbag to hit people. in contrast, she doted over her dog and pampered it as if it were a spoilt child. [all work and no pay]

lady s. is a nurse who works as a part of the huntik foundation. for a period of time, she worked as metz's nurse and was responsible for looking after him in metz's country estate in germany. following his recovery, she became an active field agent and joined the fight against the blood spirals.

==history==
lady s. took care of metz after he was put under a terrible curse due to his disturbing the ring of behemoth. [ladies' choice] she later broke her loyalty to metz, warning dante that guggenheim was coming to give him a lecture on metz' behalf, though she did so in good faith. [the divine comedy]

after metz's curse was broken, her station was changed. she later escorted rassimov after he was arrested in the valley of the kings, egypt. [rassimov's secret]

when the huntik foundation allied with the casterwill family to fight the betrayer and his blood spirals, lady s. was in a scramjet next to metz. during the fighting, she acted as a field medic, healing lucas casterwill and his team. [dante's return]

==personality==
lady s. was a caring nurse for metz. however, she thought the curse left him too delusional and that it would have been dangerous to believe his every word and to do what he asked. [ladies' choice] she knows dante vale well, as he often visited metz while he was bedridden. though she is not known to use offensive spells, she is a cool and level-headed woman who remains concentrated and focused on her job as a nurse even while on the battlefield. [dante's return]

==abilities==
lady s. is a professional nurse and knows how to treat her patients. as a seeker, she utilizes spells focused on healing wounds and injuries.

=== spells utilized ===
* everheal

zan-gason was a warlord and one of the leaders fighting for control of sutos island during its ten-year civil war. he served as sutos' ruler prior to the return of zan-grier, who demanded his rightful spot as the island's true prince.

==history==
zan-gason's reign took place during a violent civil war that had raged for ten years, with zan-tanos also demanding his spot as ruler. after easily getting past his defenses, grier overthrew him using dragonfist. [like father, unlike son]

== personality ==
zan-gason was a cruel and self-interested warlord who cared only for maintaining his power, with no care for making peace in the interests of the civilians of sutos. he was also cowardly, as he begged for his life once he saw grier easily defeat his men. [like father, unlike son]

zan-sutos was the former ruler of sutos island and the father of grier. 

== history ==
zan-sutos ruled all of sutos and was renowned as a wise and just leader. however, he eventually came to believe that his leadership was costing the people their freedom. he bravely gave up his own power so that his people could be free. unfortunately, he was murdered by rioters. instead of his son, grier, the rightful heir, becoming ruler, zan-sutos was soon succeeded by zan-gason.  [like father, unlike son]

grier eventually returned to sutos and, with the backing of the organization, seized control of the palace and returned to his rightful place as the prince. he told the story of his father to the huntik team, making them realise that while he may be from a rotten group, his intentions were honourable. [like father, unlike son]

as a member of the sutos island royalty, zan-sutos possessed the amulet of the powerful titan, megataur.

the amazons are a tribe of women who living in the tiwilderness, deep in the turkish forest. being warriors, they are no damsels in distress and can stand their ground to fight valiantly when attacked. they are currently led by the young queen, hippolyta, who inherited this title from her mother when she died. 

==history==
dante vale said that if the legends are historically accurate, greek legends of the civilization of amazon women originated from turkey. when metz found the ring of behemoth, he hid it in the amazon village in possession of his lover, the current queen. the ring was later given to hippolyta before dante's team recovered it. [s1e19]

==culture==
the amazons know about seekers and pay great respect toward them. devotion to their home village and customs are central to the amazons' way of life, and they will not permit anyone to break their rituals, even if it costs their lives to do so. anyone who refuses to pay respect to their rituals is likewise punished. at their temple, the amazons worship the forest queen, diana, as their deity. honor, strength, and courage are the most valued traits to the amazon tribe. [s1e19]

the tribe are naturally suspicious of strangers and refuse let them enter their territory. being highly suspicious of men in general, these female warriors do not trust men easily, even acting cautious when convinced such men are friendly. [s1e19]

==abilities==
the amazon are proficient in using various weapons not limited to spears, bows and blowguns. they also display great agility and strength, being more than a match for most male warriors.[s1e19]

jason was an ancient seeker from greece who featured prominently in greek mythology. he led a team known as the argonauts, a band of heroes and sailors.

== history ==
jason was an ancient greek hero and the leader of the argonauts and was said to have been married to a sorceress, madea. he was accompanied by the argonauts on a quest to colchis, modern day georgia, prior to the trojan war to find the golden fleece. [wikipedia:jason]

in the mission, jason and the argonauts, dante vale's team sought out to reach velos, greece, find the magical flagship argo, and retrieve jason's log book and his hoplite titans. [the treasures of the argonauts]

==abilities==
not much is known about jason's abilities, although it can be presumed that they were a major asset in his quests during ancient history. he owned a tablet that was able to teach the spell thoughtspecter, suggesting ties with his titan madea's illusory powers.

the mausoleum of sir lancelot is a large building containing sir lancelot's tomb and a hidden, underground sanctuary, where sir lancelot hid all of his treasures, including the holy grail, his titan, cavalier and books containing the casterwill family secrets. 

== history ==
sir lancelot, head of the one of the main branches of the casterwill family, hid his secrets inside the mausoleum in his hidden sanctuary. he filled it with paintings, books and treasures relating to his quest for the holy grail, along with the amulet of cavalier. to protect its secrets, he created a ghost trap with the form of his own image to guard it, along with numerous other traps and tests. [memory lane]

from their infiltration of the huntik foundation, the organization discovered the location of the mausoleum and sent a team of suits disguised as foundation researchers to find out how to enter it. when lok lambert and dante vale arrived and discovered the entrance to hidden passage where the statue of sir bors was pointing his sword, a skirmish ensued and the suits retreated while the pair entered the sanctuary. they managed to overcome lancelot's numerous traps but didn't realize that rassimov was helping them so that they could reach the treasure chamber. upon arriving, rassimov and his suits and attacked and rassimov obtained the amulet of cavalier. however, cavalier refused to bond with such an evil seeker and rassimov used darkvoid to destroy the room and everything in it, including cavalier himself. sophie and dante then found lok unconscious in another room where the inscription for the power findshape was inscribed on the wall. [memory lane]

== rooms and obstacles ==
*ghost trap - a ghostly version of sir lancelot, this would eliminate anyone who entered the hidden sanctuary
*path of trust - an army of ghostly knights that formed a walking path with their shields. anyone who tried to fly over would be taken out by their swords.
*the chamber of purity and sin - this room used multiple illusions to test a seeker's purity. to pass this room, one has to overcome the several temptations to prove their worth, including greed, gluttony and vengeance on a helpless enemy. a row of crossbow bolts would fire upon anyone who failed. 
*treasure chamber - this room contained all of lancelot's treasures, including numerous casterwill family books about the amulet of will and his titan cavalier

qwitonn was a crazed 1st century seeker known only as qwitonn. he became obsessed with jokoul titans, and he traveled the continent collecting every jokoul amulet he could find. as he grew older, qwitonn became a hermit living in the carpathian mountains. he was recorded as having twice visited a nearby village wearing his collection of jokoul amulets and little else.

==after death==
the jokoul titans were nearly forgotten after 2,000 years passed without a single discovery of a jokoul amulet. once a very common and sought-after titan, the sudden disappearance of seemingly every jokoul was a great mystery. the professor solved this mystery when he uncovered a cavern deep within the carpathian mountains containing dozens of active and angry jokoul titans. after a five-day battle with the horde of jokoul titans, the professor distributed their amulets among his most loyal suits. [huntik.com]

huntik: secrets & seekers is an italian-based animated series that was created and directed by iginio straffi. it was animated by rainbow s.p.a., a studio co-owned by straffi and viacom. both seasons were co-produced by rai fiction and the first was co-produced by big bocca productions. the visual designs, artwork, music, and story writing were all done at rainbow in italy while some scriptwriting and voicing were done in the united states. the series is an action-adventure comedy that follows the team of lok lambert, sophie casterwill, zhalia moon, and mentor dante vale around the globe in search of ancient amulets that can summon powerful beings known as titans in order to battle the forces of evil. the show features a variety of real-world historical locations, and one of straffi's goals for the show was to give viewers "the opportunity to learn about italian and european culture."

== production ==
the basic premise of the show was already laid out and publicized in october 2006, with the first season having a budget of approximately 8.62 million us dollars. the titular word "huntik" comes from a mix of the words "antique", to mean something "old, legendary and mysterious" and "hunting" [for treasures]. the second season was an investment of 10 million us dollars.

after creator iginio straffi drew the initial concepts of huntik, sean molyneaux, writer and story-supervisor of fellow-straffi creation winx club, met with straffi and upper deck producers to polish some details of the show's premise in the animation studio rainbow s.p.a. molyneaux, who was already familiar with upper deck personnel from his work on yugi-oh, was also specifically tasked with creating the "show bible", a "master document that covers the entire program: all the characters, all the development that will take place, all of the backstories, episode synopses and the plot–past, present and future." while the second one took almost a year and a half.the production of huntik was a considerable and exciting project, involving hundreds of professionals working for three full years, bringing together the best talent in the field of animation. the results truly seem to me to be worthy of the effort, but ultimately, that will be for you to judge. [translated from italian by original source]
- iginio straffi

creative director simone borselli stated that it took a year to understand what they wanted art-wise, and another year to define the characters, "from their clothes to their attitude". borselli added that he even had to "anticipate fashion trends", as the show would only come out at least two years later. some of the main characters' designs were inspired by actors: dante vale by johnny depp, zhalia moon by demi moore and sophie casterwill by gwyneth paltrow. to illustrate the backgrounds of the series, the artists studied photos and visual maps online.long before our time, humanity fought against an evil of unimaginable power. the darkness was broken only by the seekers, humans able to invoke legendary creatures, the titans, into their own plane of existence. with the titans executing their every order, the first seekers fought against the dark forces of the underworld and against themselves. centuries went by, and one by one, the titans were hidden; some were buried following grueling battles, while others were merely forgotten as time passed. the magical and powerful creatures lie hidden and dormant in the most remote parts of the universe, waiting to be awoken by a new group of seekers.

after centuries passed, the seekers divided themselves into groups in order to find traces and clues of past and extinct populations in order to reveal the mystery of the titans. one such division, the huntik foundation, travels in search of these answers - from the tip of south america to europe; from north america to the african terrains. only the most worthy of seekers are able to invoke the titans and benefit from their unbelievable powers. but there are those who plot in the shadows: the secretive organization, led by the professor, is another division of seekers and wants to possess the titans' powers for their own evil plans.

== reception ==
writing for common sense media, will wade praised the show's animation, action sequences, story and the titans' designs. however, he reveals negative opinions when some parts are looked at closer, highlighting the implausibility of certain aspects that is ultimately overlooked by most of the young target audience. wade gave an overall score of 3 out of 5 stars for huntik: secrets & seekers.

reviewing just the first five episodes contained on the first dvd of the australian/new zealand release, mark beresford of impulse gamer stated that "some of the music and animation shows sign of a non established franchise budget. [however,] the five episodes released on this disk are pretty addictive and will leave you wanting to get your hands on the rest of the series." the website's ultimate numerical review was of 6.5 out of 10.

more than 17 years after the original broadcast of huntik, sterling ulrich of cbr claimed the show was a "perfect 2-season gem", highlighting its original european aestehtic that seperates it from american and japanese shows of the same genre, but critizing some of the animation. huntik's animation was somewhat hit-or-miss; while certain scenes looked great, others were clearly victims of a limited budget. that problem only grew worse in the second season, which replaced much of the hand-drawn animation with cheaper flash animation. despite that, huntik's character and monster designs were always a highlight. music was one of the series' strengths as well. the intro theme, "huntik go," was a memorable rock piece that built up excitement for every episode. [...] even if it remains at just two seasons, huntik is a solid series that deserves more recognition. 
 - sterling ulrich, cbr

==season 1 ==

lok's father, eathon lambert, has been missing for ten years, and the only thing lok has to remember him by is an ancient jar. when that jar is accidentally broken, lok discovers a journal that discusses the mysterious titans. the jar also contained an amulet, although lok doesn't know what it is at the time. now lok is teaming up with the huntik foundation to find and bond with titans before the professor, defoe, grier, and the rest of the evil organization use them to take over the world.

using eathon lambert's journal, the team follows a series of clues in an attempt to find lok's father. however, the search reveals a mysterious connection between eathon and the professor as well as clues to uncover the fabled amulet of will, which is necessary for awakening lord casterwill's legendary titans.

==season 2 ==

with the defeat of the professor, a new menace has arrived. rassimov has become stronger, and a new organization has formed under wilder. having trained since their last battle with the professor, lok lambert, dante vale, sophie casterwill, and zhalia moon must now face this new menace. to help with their adventures, a new seeker, den fears, is recruited to face off against the blood spiral brotherhood. in addition to this new member, the power of powerbonding has been unleashed.

having discovered eathon lambert's holotome, the huntik foundation begins to investigate the holotome's riddles concerning the prophecies of the ancient seeker, nostradamus. the truth about the casterwill family becomes revealed bit by bit, beginning with the discovery of a legendary sword, the willblade.

another casterwill hunter used the spell on dante vale outside the pyramid of the sun, but he managed to overpower them. [the titan in the temple of sun]

harrison fears used the spell in his final battle against his brother den fears on a floating slab of rock. the spell forced the pair to jump to another rock. [lok and the betrayer]

michel de notre dame, better known as nostradamus, was an ancient casterwill family seer and one of the most powerful seekers in the family. he left many prophecies in the form of quatrains for the casterwills and the huntik foundation that would be key in preventing the return of the nullifiers.

== history ==
nostradamus spent many years working in his tower, as a base to conduct his work as a visionary dictating his prophecies of the future in the form of quatrains. he left many artifacts in his secret room including his scrying glass with three sentry triclops titans to guard it. [the tower of nostradamus] the accuracy of his prophecies led him to be branded a historical legend, however many accused him of being a fraud. [the tower of nostradamus]

nostradamus would have visions of a casterwill family traitor stealing the ring of kronos, the legendary titan of time and would travel to prague to warn the casterwill council there. [the power of kronos]

many years later, his tower was swept by the huntik foundation and converted into a museum. [the tower of nostradamus]

after stack informed wilder that the huntik foundation were investigating nostradamus' quatrains, wilder and his team planned to discover the tower's secrets. unbeknownst to them, peter, billie and annette were stationed there. after recognizing hoffman from their files, billie and peter tried to stop the organization team from accessing nostradamus' secret room. however, they failed and were taken captive. they were later rescued by dante vale's team who, after defeating the organization, recovered the scrying glass which translated the quatrains and pointed them in the direction of avalon. [the tower of nostradamus]

lok lambert and sophie casterwill encountered nostradamus in person when they were sent back in time by kronos and dr. benway. he and viktor casterwill questioned why they were attempting to take the ring of kronos from the astronomical clock of prague and pursued them. he summoned powerbonded sorcerel but tried to prevent viktor from harming cherit and sophie. however, he was overpowered by the corrupted viktor but was saved by lok and the willblade who knocked viktor out. after sophie explained the situation regarding kronos, nostradamus invoked kronos and sent them back home. it was only after returning home that they realised who michel de notre dame really was and lok was particularly frustrated as he had been so close to finding out the truth behind the quatrains. [the power of kronos].

on the longest night of the year, the huntik team traveled to nostradamus' tomb in salon graveyard where they found the final prophecies ordering them to fly the phoenix into the centre of the spiral mark and for the champion of casterwill to drive the willblade into the mark to destroy it. [words from eathon] the prophecy later turned out to have been faked by the betrayer and instead caused the red comet to change course for earth, bringing back the nullifiers in the process. [the spiral mark]

during the final battle against the betrayer, sophie used the cypherdex to find nostradamus' real prophecy that "the betrayer fears his own medicine", which helped the huntik team to defeat the betrayer by literally stabbing him in the back. [dante's return]

== personality ==
nostradamus was a good man who was completely dedicated to his role in protecting the casterwill family's secrets. he had extremely strong morals and refused to let viktor hurt sophie and cherit. [the power of kronos] 

== abilities ==
]]
nostradamus was renowned for his remarkable ability to tell the future, for which he would use a scrying glass. he also possessed all kinds of illusion powers, hiding his hidden observatory, scrying glass and sentry triclops titans in plain sight. [the tower of nostradamus] he was also an immensely powerful seeker as he was able to control the highly unstable legendary titan of time, kronos. [the power of kronos]

=== bonded titans ===
*kronos (hidden)
*sentry triclops x3
*sorcerel, powerbonded (left in the crystal caves)

frost minions are birdlike creatures made of ice who serve ymir, the king of the frost giants. along with the ice creature titans, ymir is capable of summoning an army of these titans to do battle.

== history ==
the vikings believed in beings known as frost giants and their king named aurgelmir, or ymir for short. in norse mythology, these frost giants fought alongside ymir against thor's father, odin, before the creation of the world. thor later had to fight off ymir in order to protect the realm of asgard while his father was in the odin sleep.

when dante vale's team investigated the temple of thor, ymir was summoned by the guardians of thor to create an army of ice creatures and frost minions to deter the progress of the huntik foundation. the frost minions were defeated on the rainbow bridge by ignatius with help from montehue and tersly's venadek. [the legacy of thor]

== abilities ==
though comparatively weak on their own, the frost minions' power lies in their numbers. summoned by ymir, a whole army of frost minions may be created at once to overwhelm the opponent. the aerial frost minions tend to be invoked alongside the terrestrial ice creature titans for almost complete coverage of the terrain.

pellinore is a krono-titan used by mallory, a casterwill guardian of nimue casterwill. donning a red cape, splintered golden armor and a shoulder plate over his left shoulder, pellinore is a skilled swordsman and hand to hand fighter. he is the brother of white's titan, palamedes.

== history ==
mallory invoked pellinore in the crystal caves to fight alongside white's palamedes him in a battle against lok lambert, dante vale, and zhalia moon. pellinore clashed with caliban in a sword fight but both decided to challenge each other with fists. pellinore was knocked out by a hefty punch from caliban but was rekindled by mallory's channelmight power. pellinore, powered up by the effects of this spell, charged at caliban, knocking him down, however caliban struck him in the face with a crystal. pellinore eventually defeated caliban and surrounded the team but when the differences were resolved following the arrival of nimue and sophie casterwill, pellinore was returned to his amulet. [cave of the casterwills]

pellinore is a strong warrior, a professional mixed fighter with improvised weapons. his favored weapon is the sword that he controls with great power and skill. however he is also highly skilled in hand to hand combat, being able to hold his own against the mighty caliban. huntik:page:6959:
the professor's castle, czech republic

after overcoming many difficult obstacles, the huntik team, composed by lok, dante, sophie, zhalia, and cherit, found the ancient amulet of will and two of the three legendary titans. they stormed the professor's castle to challenge the professor for the final one. together, they defeated the evil organization and learned the last known location of lok's father from the professor.

==synopsis ==
lok and the team travel to the south american waterfall where eathon lambert was last seen. there they discover both a new threat and a new source of clues.

==plot==
;organization central
the huntik team infiltrate organization central, the organization's main base, to look for information about eathon lambert. zhalia goes to the terminal while dante, lok, and sophie hold off the suits. while the huntik team do battle, wilder, the new leader of the organization, along with stack are alerted to and observe the fighting. wilder decides to confront the team that defeated the professor in order to secure his place at the top of the organization. zhalia manages to locate the file on eathon lambert and his whereabouts. using gareon, she joins the rest of the team in escaping.

;the mission
while at school, dante contacts lok and sophie to say that the huntik foundation council and zhalia have worked out from the organization's file that eathon lambert's last known whereabout was in south america. they then fly to peru and look for the waterfall told by the professor where eathon lambert disappeared while fighting the professor.

;a new organization
upon arriving and parachuting down, they are attacked by wilder, stack, hoffman, and their suits. their parachutes torn, dante and sophie use featherdrop and bubblelift spells, respectively. sophie's bubble burst by a poisonfang spell, zhalia and lok hasten their descents to join the rest of the team on the ground.

the organization suits summon venomaster and gigadrone titans. lok summons kipperin to find that the bond between the two has increased substantially to unlock the powerbonding ability. caliban and raijin the thunderbolt are also summoned, by dante and lok respectively, to do battle. meanwhile, sophie, zhalia, and gareon are in their own battle against the suits. by this time, sophie and zhalia are able to fight in synch with each other. all the while, wilder and stack watch from a distance, planning to destroy the huntik team so that they can take over the organization.

;the nexus
the team reaches the waterfall where eathon disappeared years ago, and sophie senses a strong seeker energy inside. as they approach, vine tendrils emerge from the cliff face, the result of dark dryad, an organization titan belonging to stack. cherit confirming a cave behind the waterfall, the team free themselves from the vines and use their spells to enter the cave unscathed. inside, they find a nexus, a door to the spirit world of the titans: huntik.

according to sophie, this was one of the places where lord casterwill and his followers first created the amulets. lok then speculates that his father used the nexus to escape the professor by entering huntik. sophie uses findshape to repair the nexus while zhalia uses januseea the gatekeeper to open the nexus through eathon's holotome.

;confrontation with the organization
the organization members, summoning more gigadrone titans, attack, trying to make the cavern cave in on itself. dante and zhalia go to investigate, with sophie being sent to help lok. sophie thinks this is because she no longer has her powerful titan, sabriel, after the professor destroyed her. confronting wilder, dante summons elf king oberon while zhalia summons gar-ghoul. myrmidon is summoned by hoffman while wilder helps to take out gar-ghoul by using a weakenshade spell, myrmidon then finishes gar-ghoul off by sending it back to his amulet.

;another clue
while the battle takes place outside, eathon explains that he entered the world of titans to prevent the consequences of a threat to the whole world: the blood spiral brotherhood. sophie is then said to be a direct descendent of lord casterwill himself. the nexus being weakened by the battle outside, sophie continues, to little avail, to use the findshape spell to repair the nexus. the powers raging out of control, eathon instructs lok to seek out the casterwill seer, nostradamus. before vanishing, eathon directs lok to the prophecies saved on his old holotome in order to combat the spiral. the nexus now destroyed, lok and sophie join the others.

the organization and the huntik team facing off, mymidon also takes out elf king oberon with the help of dark dryad, lok summons powerbonded baselaird to even the odds. powerbonded baselaird takes out myrmiron, so the organization members leave with dark dryad concealing their exit.

;a new mission
back at dante's house in venice, italy, zhalia manages to hack through the file so sophie can translate the prophecies. these prophecies are thought to be riddles for a mission against the spiral.

huntik:page:6963:
peru, south american forest

the huntik team is finally able to contact lok's father, eathon lambert through a nexus with the titan world of huntik. eathon tells lok about a new evil force called the blood spiral, one that only the casterwill family can face. he leaves the team clues in the form of prophecies by the casterwill seer, nostradamus.

== synopsis ==
the huntik team must regain control of nostradamus' tower after wilder and his team come looking to uncover its secrets. eathon contacts lok and tells him he must find the willblade, and nostradamus' scrying glass will be vital in sending them in the right direction.

== plot ==
;a museum job
the organization, easily locating the tower of nostradamus in salon, france, seek out a scrying glass said to show him the future in the building now converted into a museum run by the huntik foundation. instead of breaking in and causing a ruckus, wilder simply buys tickets so they can snoop around. already suspicious, the attendant at the desk, a huntik operative named billie , looks through files on known organization members and comes across the file for hoffman.

as the organization members go on their way through the museum, she reveals this to the other huntik operatives working in the museum, annette and peter. while they are discussing this, the organization members destroy their cameras. peter and billie, who summons melee artist, go to stop wilder and his men, only to be defeated. as annette tries to dial for help, hoffman uses a rippleburst spell to thwart her attempts.

;mission to salon
at the huntik international hq in manhattan, new york, to discuss future plans pertaining to the organization, the distress call is received from the operatives in salon, france. dante's team is contacted by metz and assigned this mission, the seer's tower. while flying to france, a hologram of eathon lambert appears on the lambert holotome, who directs him to seek the path of the willblade after finding nostradamus' scrying glass in his observatory. as the communication breaks up, hostile aircraft are picked up by the plane's radar. organization suits launch seeker missiles fueled by the targetfind spell, but zhalia uses her thoughtspecter illusions to evade.

;the seer's observatory
inside nostradamus' tower, wilder's men find the door to the observatory. not heeding the warning written above the door, they enter. unperceived by them, the casterwill symbol appears as a voice calls out doom upon wilder and the organization. the men keep searching for the magical scrying glass, not seeing the objects of magic right under their noses.

the huntik team arrives, noticing peter motioning towards the front door from where he is being held captive. using a combination of magic, zhalia's mastery of disguise, and springer, the team is able to free peter and the other two operatives. they arrive at the door, noticing wilder's men being oblivious to the three sentry triclops titans in the room. according to zhalia, they are nearly impervious to damage due to their precognitive dodge ability.

;through the scrying glass
as wilder is about to uncover the scrying glass' chest, sophie casterwill uses a bubblelift spell to try to secure it. feyone and powerbonded baselaird are summoned to assist in the combat as wilder summons his own titan, incubane, but feyone is defeated by a rippleburst spell cast by hoffman. meanwhile, both baselaird and incubane are sent back to their amulets due to lok's being weakened by a poisonfang spell cast by hoffman again. faking a near defeat, the huntik team manage to trick wilder and stack into launching shadowknife spells toward the sentry triclops titans. the titans, becoming activated, hurl the invaders out, all the while remaining invisible to all but the huntik team.

the scrying glass secured, lok projects the quatrain prophecies on the wall. by standing in the moonlight and looking through the glass, lok is able to read a single quatrain leading to king arthur's island, avalon. a message saying, "good luck, lok," is also found accompanying the glass in the chest.

on the island of kings to the north,

burning lamps call the dragon's breath.

a sword saves the future queen,

but the red eye will shine on the world.

== trivia ==
*in the italian version, annette is addressed by peter with her name, but in the english dub she is not. in contrast, billie is not referred to by name in the italian version, but is so in the english dub.
*in the italian version, sophie struck wilder's face during the battle at the tower, however in the english citv version this was censored out. this was noted by wilder in their next encounter at avalon, in "knight of the willblade", despite the english version's censoring. however, neither the english netflix release nor the english upload on the official youtube channel censor the slap.
*metz incorrectly addresses higgans as momax during the huntik foundation council meeting.

as wilder is about to uncover the scrying glass' chest, sophie casterwill uses a bubblelift spell to try to secure it. feyone and powerbonded baselaird are summoned to assist in the combat as wilder summons his own titan, incubane, but feyone is defeated by a rippleburst spell cast by hoffman. meanwhile, both baselaird and incubane are sent back to their amulets due to lok's being weakened by a poisonfang spell cast by hoffman again. faking a near defeat, the huntik team manage to trick wilder and stack into launching shadowknife spells toward the sentry triclops titans. the titans, becoming activated, hurl the invaders out, all the while remaining invisible to all but the huntik team.

the scrying glass secured, lok projects the quatrain prophecies on the wall. by standing in the moonlight and looking through the glass, lok is able to read a single quatrain leading to king arthur's island, avalon. a message saying, "good luck, lok," is also found accompanying the glass in the chest.

a sword saves the future queen,
