huntik:page:6979:
salon, france

a new organization team led by the charismatic wilder takes over the tower of nostradamus. dante, lok, and the huntik team manage to stop them with some help from nostradamus' predictions. on the way, a message from lok's father and clues from the ancient seer point the way to avalon and the magic willblade.

== synopsis ==
the huntik team are joined by leblanche as they travel to england to begin their search for the legendary island of avalon. sophie and leblanche are separated and meet nimue, a casterwill elder, while the others are locked in combat with her bodyguards. sophie must earn nimue’s trust to stop the fighting.

== plot ==
;home schooling
leblanche is seen teaching lok and sophie about the renaissance. lok, however, is on his father's holotome, looking at his titan's stats. leblanche wakes him from this trance, and he drops the holotome. sophie and cherit laugh as lok goes into a fighting position. leblanche lectures him on why he should be listening. dante vale enters and sophie and lok run to him as leblanche. dante informs them that there were studies on avalon. lok remembers when his father contacted him on his holotome. sophie recalls that in all books about avalon, there was something linked to lord casterwill. the holotome sets the mission - 'the mist of avalon'. leblanche protests to go with them so that he can continue teching them.

;getting to england
leblanche shivers in the corner of the ship, regretting his decision. sophie and lok are already in their diving suits. dante stops the boat, saying that they have to swim from there on. leblanche complains that he doesn't have a wetsuit, but lok just tells him he can teach them about the renaissance on the way there. leblanche is on a surfboard and falls off quickly. he gets back up, however. the others have motor-powered machines.

upon reaching the shore, they are attacked by enemy seekers with a feyone and icarus. lok uses raypulse against them. dante uses touchram and sophie uses raypulse. feyone attacks leblanche as he dives into the water. leblanche then clambers back on. lok is attacked with several enemy spells. he uses hyperstride to get onto the shore. dante tells everyone to take cover. zhalia and sophie join lok on the shore. feyone tries to attack dante, but he manages to get onto the beach. leblanche falls onto the sand, unconscious. zhalia summons kilthane to defend them against the two titans. sophie gets angered and jumps up to them and uses doublespell. however, she is blasted into the sea. dante summons metagolem to clear their exit. metagolem demolishes the cliff and throws rocks at the titans. a cave is cleared, in which they take cover.

;in the cave
the team discusses how the seekers knew they were coming and how they had such power. zhalia goes out to look for a way out. sophie doubts herself, saying that she was useless to the team. she recalls how sabriel was destroyed. leblanche reassures her. both him and lok offer to protect her. sophie, however, wants to protect herself. a blue glow emanates from her hand. sophie tells of the legend of avalon. zhalia finds tracks and returns to the cave. dante takes lok and zhalia to follow the tracks, leaving sophie to protect the cave. sophie notices the blue power in her hand. nimue and vivian casterwill are seen in a blue cave. the crystals are flashing blue, which nimue explains as the power of lord casterwill. nimue calls to open the way for the casterwill of which the crystals are detecting. sophie sees a magical gate opening. she wakes up leblanche and she travels through the gate, leaving leblanche to defend the cave.

;cave of the casterwills

dante and lok are seen following zhalia to the tracks. they arrive at the blue cave. dante realises it is a trap. they are attacked by the casterwill warriors, white and mallory. sophie sees a huge blue crystal which emanates a power that keeps trying to capture her. she falls to the ground and is nearly captured. she is saved by leblanche. he summons both albion and sentinel. she enters a vision in which she is revealed to be a direct descendant of lord casterwill himself. nimue lets sophie and leblanche enter. nimue and viviane greet them.

back at the trap, lok is attacked by nimue's guardians and their titans, pellinore and palamedes. lok and dante summon lindorm and caliban to protect themselves. zhalia also summons gareon, who uses his invisibility to fade away. zhalia uses poisonfang against the two seekers. sophie protests and asks nimue to call off the attack. nimue sends her into a test to retrieve sorcerel, sabriel's sister. as she is attacked by enemy titans on the way to sorcerel, she manages to summon sabriel, who has now powerbonded with sophie. meanwhile, lindorm defeats palamedes; however, mallory uses newlife to re-summon the titan. gareon is then defeated as the team takes cover. sabriel buys time for sophie as she bonds with sorcerel. she manages to summon sorcerel. the sisters are reunited. lok calls off lindorm and caliban is defeated. the casterwills circle them, but sophie and nimue call them off. nimue says that she will tell them all she knows about avalon.

shadowlock is a high level restrictive spell, only been known to be used by the betrayer. a purple aura is shot from the user's fingers. it then emanates into a victim's back, surrounding them in the purple substance, rendering them immobilized.

== history ==
the betrayer used this spell whilst attacking harrison fears with shocklash. the power was able to maneuver itself around harrison's stormshield power and paralyze him from behind. the betrayer later cast a doublespell version of the spell to paralyze lucas casterwill and sandra lambert. whilst fighting dante vale, the betrayer used the spell on him. however, dante was able to resist the power long enough to grab the betrayer, allowing lok lambert to plunge the willblade through the betrayer's back, defeating him. following his demise, harrison, sandra and lucas were released from the spell. huntik:page:7009:
lok and the huntik team are on the trail of avalon. sophie is drawn to a crystal cave, where she must prove herself to the casterwill elder, nimue. sophie learns she is a direct descendant of lord casterwill and bonds with the titan she thought was lost, empowering her and turning her into powerbonded sabriel. nimue promises to help her find avalon and the willblade.

== synopsis ==
seeking the willblade, the huntik team finally reaches the mythical island of avalon with some help from nimue. however, the team is ambushed by the organization and a new titan in wilder's possession, divine mirror kagami which was found by hoffman, who can turn a titan's power against it. lok and sophie find the willblade. ambushed by wilder, lok must unlock the true power of the willblade with help from the ancient seeker, lord casterwill, to save sophie.

== plot ==
the organization attack

in a cave in the chu-goku mount in japan, hoffman and eathon the dog unearth the amulet of divine mirror kagami. hoffman vows to make the huntik team pay for the professor's demise.

on the english coast, lok and cherit look out to sea as they study another of nostradamus' quatrains, hoping for clues on the location of avalon. however a group of suits attack the team's tents from the cliffs. sophie invokes sabriel to protect them while the suits summon venomaster and bonelasher. the huntik team disperse and lok runs into the woods, closely followed by gigadrone. lok invokes kipperin and, with help from cherit, defeats their pursuer. dante crushes bonelasher under a falling tree while sophie and sabriel defeat venomaster. the team regroup at the crystal caves where the suits refuse to follow them in, for fear of the casterwill family magic protecting the place. hoffman scoffs that, in his day, cowards would never be allowed in the organization, but, regardless, he backs off.

the dragon's breath

nimue casterwill believes the sword mentioned in the quatrain is the willblade, forged by the elder daughter of casterwill, and takes the huntik team to an ancient site called the dragon's cliffs. cherit lights up the lamps in the cliff face, revealing a bridge of blue light stretching out across the sea - the dragon's breath. two suits arrive and threaten to open fire on nimue unless they are given access to the bridge, to which dante agrees. the smug agents jump off the cliff, but fall straight through the light and into the water. nimue points out the bridge is not physical and is only meant to serve as a guide. the team bid farewell to nimue and vivian before setting off in the speedboat to follow the mist trail. nimue summons undine to accompany them for protection.

avalon

as team arrive at the shore of avalon, their boat is entangled in protruding roots cast by none other than dark dryad. undine rescues the team and they escape as the boat explodes. aware that the organization is on their way, sophie senses the castle and leads the team there. keen to get the upper hand, wilder invokes divine mirror kagami while stack uses hidesight to render her invisible. at the ruins, lok and sophie go to find the willblade while dante, zhalia and leblanche hold off the organization. zhalia invokes king basilisk but things take a disastrous turn when kagami appears reflect his stonegaze ability. dante jumps in front of zhalia, and he and caliban are turned to stone along with king basilisk.

inside the castle, lok and sophie find the willblade only for sophie to be knocked out by wilder and incubane. invoking dendras, lok takes control of incubane. however, wilder invokes kagami, reflecting dendras' ability and taking control of him. overpowering lok, wilder blasts him backwards, landing and hitting his head on the stone in which the willblade sits.

the sword and the comet

while albion defeats redcap, leblanche uses newlife to allow zhalia to invoke king basilisk again, saving dante and turning him and caliban back. hoffman, stack and the suit quickly retreat.

as wilder approaches the willblade, sophie grabs his leg determined to stop him. as wilder prepares to use venomhand to deal with her permanently, an injured lok reaches for anything to help him save her. grabbing the sword, there is a burst of blue light. all of a sudden, lord casterwill appears, knighting lok and empowering him. as incubane, kagami and dendras attack, lok summons the legendary titan of champions, pendragon, who breaks wilder's control over dendras, and defeats his titans. wilder is knocked out after being struck by the handle of the willblade and pendragon returns to the sword. as the castle collapses, lok and dante rescue sophie. the team watches in shock as a red comet appears in the sky. something has been set in motion and it's going to change the life of every seeker on earth.

back at dante vale's house, lok and cherit are unable to recall what happened on avalon. as everyone leaves, cherit ponders in mystery, sure that he saw his old friend, lord casterwill, whose spectral form glows in the room.

==trivia==
* in the french dub, incubane was initially called "incubane" as well but from this episode onward, his name was translated to "diablosaure" for all subsequent apparitions.

==production errors==
* when leblanche uses newlife to restore king basilisk, wilder is seen outside, standing next to stack. however, at this point in the episode he is already inside the castle, fighting with lok and sophie.

back at dante vale's house, lok and cherit are unable to recall what happened on avalon. as everyone leaves, cherit ponders in mystery, sure that he saw his old friend, lord casterwill, whose spectral form glows in the room.

huntik:page:7015:
northern england: avalon

the huntik team finally reaches avalon. leblanche, dante, and zhalia hold off the organization as lok and sophie recover the willblade. wilder ambushes sophie, and lok unlocks the true power of the willblade and its legendary titan to save her at the last moment. however, neither he nor sophie remembers the event.

== synopsis ==
sophie's brother wants to stop the team from continuing their dangerous quest; sophie resolves to complete a mission for lucas and discover the location of void, the mysterious and evil titan.

== plot ==
;secret of the sword
 
huntik team researches the books in library that sophie casterwill found last year in hope of finding something more about willblade, since none of them can remember how it happened or why lok lambert drew it out. lok, bored with searching, plays around with the artefact and manages to knock something lose on the handle. he discovers that the pieces are supposed to turn, as part of a puzzle, and moves them to reveal a picture of willblade. the sword glows and reveals an amulet hidden in the blue stone on the handle. sophie remarks that lok may have already begun to bond with the titan. lok removes the amulet but he cannot summon the titan, he doesn't even feel any connection but at the same time the power feels familiar. zhalia wonders if the titan isn't bound with someone else. dante scans it with holotome but to no avail as the amulet is protected by strange and ancient power.

;down memory lane
 
in that moment the team is interrupted by three seekers, two of whom had previously watched sophie enter the library [memory lane]. the new team claim to be protecting the library's secrets. a fight ensues, and the strangers seemingly gain the upper hand. dante, recognizing that the attackers are casterwills, tells them that they have no reason to fight. the huntik team is set free. sophie asks the leader about his reasons to fight her team. he replies that he does it to save her life, adding that she would have no idea about dangers casterwills face, as evinced by their being defeated so quickly. however, dante reveals that it's not so; zhalia switches off her thoughtspecter power, revealing king basilisk, gar-ghoul, and kilthane each placing the casterwill team in check. dante asks the leader about his identity and reason for such interest in sophie. the young man reluctantly reveals to be sophie's older brother, lucas casterwill.

;a bittersweet reunion
 
outside the library, lucas reveals that he and sophie were separated during the fire and that he had believed sophie to be dead until she begun to help the foundation. sophie asks him why didn't he come to see her sooner, but lucas is reluctant to respond. zhalia then points out that he came for sophie now. lucas tells them it's because of the appearance of the red comet, but doesn't want to go into further detail despite the team's arguments about sophie having nimue's blessing. he is not impressed with the acquisition of the willblade by lok due to him not being a part of the casterwill lineage. as sophie tries to argue to no avail, lok remembers that casterwills always put their team to a test. sophie demands to be tested according to casterwill law, and lucas's teammates, dellix and lane, tell them about the amulet of void, which had been stolen by the organization. lucas, fearing for sophie's safety, tries to convince his sister to let it go, but she and lok on the mission, pleading with her brother to believe in herself and in lok.

;preparations
 
the team prepares for their mission in prague, czech republic, but sophie still feels down because of her brother's lack of faith. dante reassures her that everything will be alright, pointing out that lucas only seems to want to protect her. lok agrees but also states that lucas has no idea how to do so properly. zhalia informs the team about upgraded security at the organization's headquarters, and about the house of jodis lore now being in hands of the organization. dante instructs lok and sophie that they're taking the lead, as per the test, while lok deduces that dante and zhalia would be working behind the scenes.

;ambushed
 
lok and sophie observe the organization, while on another roof zhalia watches lucas and his team. zhalia makes a phone call to one of the patrolling suits with a message for wilder. distracted, the suit is attacked and defeated by lok and sophie. the teens head and search for the information, but it's a trap: wilder and his men are already just outside the house. lucas and his team can do nothing but watch. lok, sophie, and cherit are ambushed and defeated by the organization as wilder asks them what are they doing here. sophie, in a ploy to get wilder to reveal the information they seek, tells him that she will reveal everything provided he gives her information on void. despite stack's warnings, wilder agrees, telling them that void is hidden in klaus' bookshop.

;a clandestine plan
 
outside zhalia faces the casterwill team and talks to them revealing that the capture of lok and sophie is part of their team's plan. lok and sophie, being transported as prisoners to organization central in prague, signal to cherit to free himself and to give lok baselaird's amulet which cherit had swallowed in order to get it past the organization. fully prepared, cherit goes into the trunk of the car, signaling to dante who is observing the road from a nearby rooftop. dante and zhalia ambush the organization, so the casterwill squad, convinced by zhalia, comes to help. working together, they defeat stack and his suit as lok calls upon baselaird to blow up the car and to allow him and sophie to escape. stack and his suits then retreat. dante praises the casterwills and the teens, while lucas admits his sister was brave. lane likewise states that they make a good team as casterwills alongside the huntik foundation.

;void and the betrayer
 
as the night draws in, lucas reveals that his reason for not contacting sophie was that he wanted to keep her safe and happy away from the dangers associated with being a casterwill. sophie, thanking her brother, tells him that ever since the red comet had appeared she feels as if she has some important mission and that failure could very well mean the end of the world. after some persuading, lucas tells the team the history of the betrayer and the spiral mark. with the help of the amulet of void and with the red comet high in the sky, the nullifiers were once summoned back to earth by the betrayer. lucas says that it cannot be allowed to happen again as dante states that their quest for void is not yet over.

the powerbond is a rare and advanced form of synchronization between a titan and their seeker. when the bond between a seeker and their titan reaches extraordinary strength, the titan can become powerbonded, transforming in appearance and gaining enhanced powers, new abilities, and perfect telepathic communication with its seeker. historically an incredibly rare phenomenon, the occurrence of powerbonded titans appears to be increasing among the new generation of seekers.

== history ==
across history, it was extremely rare to encounter a powerbonded titan. [cave of the casterwills] in the modern age, knowledge of the powerbond was widespread amongst seekers including nimue casterwill [s2e29], dante vale [s2e27], and tantras who knew that the mechanics of its power and abilities were not to be underestimated. [s2e36]

at some point in the 16th century, nostradamus formed a powerbond with his titan, sorcerel. lok lambert and sophie casterwill encountered her when they were sent back in time by kronos and fought with nostradamus and viktor casterwill. sophie, who had acquired the same sorcerel herself but centuries later, was surprised to see a powerbonded version of her. [hm17]

 for the first time]]
lok lambert first discovered the powerbond power while searching for his father’s last known whereabouts in peru, a mission of significant emotional importance to him. upon summoning kipperin, he was surprised to find that the titan had drastically changed upon invocation, merging with him to form one body. dante vale then explained that, because his bond to his father's titan was so strong, they had become powerbonded. later, lok powerbonded with baselaird, to save dante and zhalia from wilder and the organization. [s2e27]

in the crystal caves, sophie casterwill was able to empower and invoke the spirit of sabriel despite sabriel’s amulet having been destroyed. this was made possible in part by the presence of sorcerel, sabriel’s sister and a kindred spirit, who was resting within the crystal caves and with whom sophie was actively attempting to form a bond. through this connection, sophie was able to reestablish a connection with sabriel’s spirit and powerbond with her, bypassing the traditional requirement of an amulet. throughout these events, residual energy associated with sabriel was shown lingering around sophie’s hand within the caves, indicating an ongoing connection that ultimately culminated in the formation of the powerbond. [s2e29]

dante vale invoked the powerbond with caliban in a last effort to save himself from rassimov and the blood spiral in klaus' bookshop, with powerbonded caliban’s martial arts abilities helping to even the battle and give the team an opportunity to escape. [s2e32]
 while under attack from arc]]
in order to protect lok from the legendary titan of fate, arc, lindorm became powerbonded with him. [s2e34] 

when zhalia moon was discovered infiltrating the blood spiral by tantras, gareon became powerbonded with her and used his scramblemind ability to erase tantras’ memory of her being a double agent. [s2e39]

when sophie casterwill was fighting against kiel at the fortress of iron will, she powerbonded with sorcerel, thus regaining her strength to fight kiel. [s2e40]

when the blood spiral travelled to the castle of vlad dracul, harrison fears managed to bond with the vampiric antedeluvian and then powerbond with him, at an exceptionally rapid pace. [s2e43] 
]]

breaker became powerbonded to grier during a battle in the professor's castle in order to save him from asphyxiation at the hands wilder's grand façade, much to the amazement of den fears. powerbonded breaker then defeated grand façade with his "crushing grip" power. [s2e46]

in egypt, dante became powerbonded to ariel while under attack from rassimov and the legendary titan of war, legion. dante intended for ariel to get his team to safety, while he led rassimov away with the necklace of tutankhamun. however, solwing snatched the necklace himself, leading rassimov and legion away and saving dante. powerbonded ariel stopped dante from going after him and reminded him to save the team. [s2e47]
, the first known legendary titan to powerbond]]
at the blood spiral base, after faltering during his final battle with his brother, harrison, den fears sensed vigilante becoming powerbonded, reminding him that him not to let his friends down. after invoking powerbonded vigilante, den merged with him using his new "cindercloak" ability and fought and defeated powerbonded antedeluvian. before he could defeat harrison however, vigilante was disrupted by falling rocks and sent back to his amulet. [s2e51]

during the final battle with the betrayer, pendragon's amulet independently emerged from the willblade to save lok from demigorgan, the titan of betrayal. pendragon was then revealed to have become powerbonded, defeating the titan copies of sabriel, raijin and gareon created by demigorgan. [s2e52]

== process ==
]]
while the context and situation of a powerbond is different for every seeker and their titan, the process often consists of these stages:
# strong bond - the titan and seeker must develop deep mutual trust and synchronization.
# emotional growth - often triggered by heightened stakes, emotional struggle, or shared hardship.
# transformation - physically and spiritually, the titan transforms into its powerbonded form, revealing enhanced abilities and sometimes new combat forms.
# shared abilities - in some cases, the seeker may gain shared or complementary abilities that augment their combat synergy.

==== exceptions and variations ====
 means she can be summoned from her hand]]
in exceptional circumstances, the powerbond can bypass the requirement of an amulet, seen in the case of sabriel whose bond with sophie casterwill was so strong that, despite her amulet being destroyed, sophie was able to reestablish a connection with sabriel’s spirit and powerbond with her, now summoning her from her hand. this anomaly was made possible in part by the presence of sorcerel, sabriel’s sister, who was resting within the crystal caves and with whom sophie was actively attempting to form a bond. [s2e29] 

the formation of a powerbond may also occur far more rapidly in rare cases of extreme compatibility. harrison fears summoned antedeluvian in his powerbonded form only shortly after acquiring his amulet, suggesting that a powerbond can be established almost instantaneously when a seeker’s disposition significantly aligns with a titan’s nature, particularly where a seeker’s personality is similar to a titan’s previous seeker, as harrison was to vlad dracul. [s2e43] 

==characteristics==
 gains an additional pair of arms and a second tail]]
upon their transformation, powerbonded titans typically gain golden or gilded armor, often covering areas that were previously unarmoured or less defined. this is frequently accompanied by an increased physical stature, with some titans appearing larger or more imposing than their original forms, seen significantly in the cases of baselaird and gareon. [s2e39] another defining feature is the appearance of a gem embedded in the centre of the chest, [doorway to huntik] which visually corresponds to gem on the titan's amulet, which itself signifies their titan type. [huntik.com] in some cases, the powerbond can result in more dramatic anatomical changes. lindorm developed an additional pair of arms and a second tail, increasing his total number of limbs and altering his physical form. [s2e34]

a powerbond also establishes an exceptionally strong empathic link between the seeker and titan. as a result, when a seeker is injured, their powerbonded titan may experience or react to the seeker’s pain, reflecting the depth of their synchronization. this effect was seen when lok lambert was struck by a poisonfang power, with his titan baselaird also experiencing the effects and becoming temporarily stunned. [s2e28]

== abilities ==
 and a suit in perfect sync]]
powerbonded titans display significantly enhanced combat skills, including increased offensive and defensive capabilities, as well as the manifestation of new abilities made possible through heightened mental and physical synchronization with their seeker. these abilities are typically in direct coordination with the powerbonded titan, as demonstrated by dante vale and caliban’s "mirror fight", zhalia moon and gareon’s "scramblemind", and lok lambert and lindorm’s "spinnerslash". [s2e36] 

powerbonded titans are composed of a distinct form of powerbonded energy. in the case of baselaird, this energy could be transferred to his seeker, allowing lok lambert to enhance his own abilities through the technique known as "focus blade". [s2e45] 

in some cases, powerbonding enables a titan and seeker to temporarily merge into a single combined entity, acting as one both physically and mentally. this was demonstrated by lok lambert and kipperin with the "winged fusion" ability [s2e27] as well as den fears and vigilante through the "cindercloak" ability, representing most extreme manifestations of seeker–titan synchronization. [s2e51]

== trivia ==
* in the original italian version and a few other dubs, powerbonded titans are voiced and reply outloud to their seeker's orders. in the english dub however, powerbonded titans are mute.
* according to huntik magazine issue 18’s crossword game, the powerbond is defined as “the power that strengthens the bond between a seeker and their titan”.

[s2e47]
, the first known legendary titan to powerbond]]
at the blood spiral base, after faltering during his final battle with his brother, harrison, den fears sensed vigilante becoming powerbonded, reminding him that him not to let his friends down. after invoking powerbonded vigilante, den merged with him using his new "cindercloak" ability and fought and defeated powerbonded antedeluvian. before he could defeat harrison however, vigilante was disrupted by falling rocks and sent back to his amulet. [s2e51]

during the final battle with the betrayer, pendragon's amulet independently emerged from the willblade to save lok from demigorgan, the titan of betrayal. pendragon was then revealed to have become powerbonded, defeating the titan copies of sabriel, raijin and gareon created by demigorgan. [s2e52]
]]
while the context and situation of a powerbond is different for every seeker and their titan, the process often consists of these stages:
# strong bond - the titan and seeker must develop deep mutual trust and synchronization.
# emotional growth - often triggered by heightened stakes, emotional struggle, or shared hardship.
# transformation - physically and spiritually, the titan transforms into its powerbonded form, revealing enhanced abilities and sometimes new combat forms.
# shared abilities - in some cases, the seeker may gain shared or complementary abilities that augment their combat synergy.
means she can be summoned from her hand]]
in exceptional circumstances, the powerbond can bypass the requirement of an amulet, seen in the case of sabriel whose bond with sophie casterwill was so strong that, despite her amulet being destroyed, sophie was able to reestablish a connection with sabriel’s spirit and powerbond with her, now summoning her from her hand. this anomaly was made possible in part by the presence of sorcerel, sabriel’s sister, who was resting within the crystal caves and with whom sophie was actively attempting to form a bond. [s2e29] 

the formation of a powerbond may also occur far more rapidly in rare cases of extreme compatibility. harrison fears summoned antedeluvian in his powerbonded form only shortly after acquiring his amulet, suggesting that a powerbond can be established almost instantaneously when a seeker’s disposition significantly aligns with a titan’s nature, particularly where a seeker’s personality is similar to a titan’s previous seeker, as harrison was to vlad dracul. [s2e43]
gains an additional pair of arms and a second tail]]
upon their transformation, powerbonded titans typically gain golden or gilded armor, often covering areas that were previously unarmoured or less defined. this is frequently accompanied by an increased physical stature, with some titans appearing larger or more imposing than their original forms, seen significantly in the cases of baselaird and gareon. [s2e39] another defining feature is the appearance of a gem embedded in the centre of the chest, [doorway to huntik] which visually corresponds to gem on the titan's amulet, which itself signifies their titan type. [huntik.com] in some cases, the powerbond can result in more dramatic anatomical changes. lindorm developed an additional pair of arms and a second tail, increasing his total number of limbs and altering his physical form. [s2e34]

a powerbond also establishes an exceptionally strong empathic link between the seeker and titan. as a result, when a seeker is injured, their powerbonded titan may experience or react to the seeker’s pain, reflecting the depth of their synchronization. this effect was seen when lok lambert was struck by a poisonfang power, with his titan baselaird also experiencing the effects and becoming temporarily stunned. [s2e28]
and a suit in perfect sync]]
powerbonded titans display significantly enhanced combat skills, including increased offensive and defensive capabilities, as well as the manifestation of new abilities made possible through heightened mental and physical synchronization with their seeker. these abilities are typically in direct coordination with the powerbonded titan, as demonstrated by dante vale and caliban’s "mirror fight", zhalia moon and gareon’s "scramblemind", and lok lambert and lindorm’s "spinnerslash". [s2e36] 

powerbonded titans are composed of a distinct form of powerbonded energy. in the case of baselaird, this energy could be transferred to his seeker, allowing lok lambert to enhance his own abilities through the technique known as "focus blade". [s2e45] 

in some cases, powerbonding enables a titan and seeker to temporarily merge into a single combined entity, acting as one both physically and mentally. this was demonstrated by lok lambert and kipperin with the "winged fusion" ability [s2e27] as well as den fears and vigilante through the "cindercloak" ability, representing most extreme manifestations of seeker–titan synchronization. [s2e51]
* in the original italian version and a few other dubs, powerbonded titans are voiced and reply outloud to their seeker's orders. in the english dub however, powerbonded titans are mute.
* according to huntik magazine issue 18’s crossword game, the powerbond is defined as “the power that strengthens the bond between a seeker and their titan”.

prague, the czech republic

the huntik team faces off against lucas casterwill, sophie's brother. they come to an understanding and help find the missing amulet of void. zhalia's plan lets them trick the organization into revealing its location in klaus' library. lucas explains the history of the betrayer, who tried to summon the nullifiers in the past.

== synopsis ==
the huntik team return to the lab of their old enemy, klaus, where they face heavy resistance from wilder and his team. however, both factions are soon ambushed by an even more deadly threat, the blood spiral...

== plot ==
;help from klaus
at huntik foundation italian hq, the huntik team find klaus' statue, whom zhalia turned to stone with king basilisk. after turning him back, zhalia and the team ask him for help to recover the amulet of void. klaus recalls the stories of the spiral mark and devastation that would take place if the amulet fell into the wrong hands. to the team's relief, he agrees to help.

;organization territory 
at klaus's bookstore, the team are ambushed by wilder and the organization. a fight ensues but the huntik team defeat them and, with assistance from springer, make their way down into the vault. they are ambushed again by stack and dark dryad, but lok manages to recover void's amulet from the vault. however, a alarming warning from a terrified eathon lambert via the holotome tells lok that something terrible is going to happen.

;a new faction
both factions are startled when another group arrives to claim void: the blood spiral brotherhood. with masses of silent soldiers, and their titans, harlekin and marauder, the blood spiral are extremely powerful. shauna and wind defeat wilder, stack and the rest of the organization easily. dante attempts to disrupt the powerful shakrit by using archwarder, but their old enemy rassimov emerges from the shadows and uses darkvoid to destroy his amulet. as the spirals close in, it looks like the end for dante.

;the powerbond
with one final chance, he calls on caliban, powerbonding with the titan and fighting back against the spiral's powerful forces. however shauna overpowers lok and claims the amulet of void. victorious, the spirals leave, burning klaus' base to the ground in the process, with the team barely make it out alive. zhalia is saddened at the loss of her only real home growing up while dante must make a full report to the huntik council. lok and sophie inform lucas casterwill of what has happened.

== trivia ==
* this marks the third time (out of a total of five times) that an episode's title is said by a character in that same episode.
**when rassimov moves in to attack dante and reveals the blood spiral's motives at the end of the episode, he says: "fear the blood spiral!".
* when klaus is freed, he says "i'm out of it for a little while, and everyone gets delusions of grandeur", which is a reference to han solo's same line in the movie star wars: episode vi - return of the jedi.
* when hoffman casts poisonfang, the spell appears as a violet bolt instead of the usual green sludge, much like the spell's tcg card.

huntik:page:7134:
vienna, austria

zhalia leads the huntik team into klaus' library to find the amulet of void. both the foundation and the organization are ambushed by a devastating new menace, the blood spirals, led by their old foe, rassimov. dante manages to save himself by bonding with powerbonded caliban, but the spirals are too strong. void ends up in their hands.

== synopsis ==
zhalia discovers a group of orphans that tantras is trying to recruit for the blood spiral. one of them, harrison, goes with tantras to ambush lok and sophie as a test, but his brother, den, goes to the foundation for help.

== plot ==

business in rotterdam

lok, sophie, and cherit are in rotterdam on a mission to deliver the amulet of vigilante to a huntik foundation safehouse. because vigilante previously belonged to an evil seeker, its dark energy will naturally attract evil seekers.
unbeknownst to them, two silent soldiers are watching them from a rooftop. 

meanwhile, zhalia is taking time off for personal business and returns to her childhood orphanage, reflecting on her own dark past following her home in vienna burning down. she sees one orphan, harrison, being targeted by bullies but his brother den intervenes and fights the bullies, bruno and dirk. during the fight, den manifests a seeker power, much to his amazement. the blood spiral tantras arrives posing as a talent scout offering the orphans a way out. zhalia alerts dante who is attending a meeting with the huntik foundation council in new york. he warns the council that the spirals are on the move. 

training the orphans

recognizing harrison's anger, isolation, and resentment toward the world, tantras manipulates him into embracing his hatred and fear. harrison gives in to the dark power and successfully bonds with the titan marauder, who advances on bruno and dirk. seeing their fear, tantras gives them each a harlekin amulet and manipulates them into summoning their titans. a scuffle ensues, with marauder ovepowering one of the harlekins but the other tries to attack harrison. den rushes in to protect him and blasts the titan back to its amulet. harrison tells den to calm down; he is enjoying having this newfound power. zhalia, who has been watching nearby, tries to advise the boys against trusting the blood spirals, drawing on her own experience as a former misguided orphan. however, harrison ignores her and warns her off, fully intent on joining the blood spirals. 

tantras teaches the orphans to control their titans, creating fog monsters for them to defeat. den is unable to summon marauder much to tantras' disgust. he demands that den attack one of his former bullies as a test, but den refuses to participate in the cruel games. tantras threatens to leave den behind to rot at the orphanage while harrison reprimands den for holding him back and warns him to not mess it up for him.

under pursuit

as lok, sophie, and cherit navigate rotterdam's winding streets toward the safe house, they run into the silent soldiers in an alley. lok uses the willblade to fight their marauder who cherit defeats with an energy charge. the spirals flee, but sophie is suspicious why they didn't put up much of a fight. later, they realize they are being tailed by blood spiral soldiers. lok uses a new spell rearview to confirm the pursuit. to avoid leading enemies straight to the huntik foundation's secret base, lok and sophie attempt a diversion, using featherdrop simultaneously to jump down between two skyscrapers and send them in the wrong direction. 

as night falls, rassimov meets tantras' four new recruits and endows them with the tattoo of the blood spiral. den is terrified and runs away to find zhalia, who assures him he did the right thing. harrison arrives looking for den but den refuses to hurt anyone for no good reason. intoxicated by his power, harrison turns hostile towards his brother and leaves with tantras, who tells zhalia that one day she will desire the power of the blood spiral too. 

battle on the erasmus bridge 

tantras brings harrison, bruno and dirk to the erasmus bridge for their final initiation test: attacking lok and sophie. the orphans rush into the fight willingly and engage in combat with the huntik seekers. zhalia arrives to assist lok and sophie but tantras summons his own titan, jericho. shauna and wind are on their way to assist tantras, but are jumped by dante who invokes caliban. together they defeat ash and dervish, and dante uses stopglue to stick the enemy seekers to the ground so he can help the others. 

during the chaotic battle, lok the amulet of vigilante drops to the ground. harrison rushes to claim it for himself but den reaches it first and instantly bonds with the titan, invoking it. harrison is furious and begins to throttle den, weakening vigilante in the process for harlekin to defeat him. lok steps in and blasts harrison away with a touchram and helps den. zhalia invokes king basilisk who defeats jericho. dante arrives to help the team, and caliban defeats harlekin, pushing back tantras and his forces. realizing they are outmatched, tantras uses darkfog to mask their retreat. back at the orphanage, he welcomes harrison with into the blood spiral order.

at dante's house, although den is devastated by his brother's turn to darkness, dante and zhalia welcome him into the huntik foundation. den vows to train as a seeker so he can one day save harrison from the blood spirals. sophie apologises for messing up the delivery, but dante is pleased; the long-term objective was to find a good seeker to bond with vigilante, and den is exactly that.

when the ring of arc vanishes, lok, dante, sophie, and zhalia head into the catacombs to find it. however, the ring is actually the legendary titan of fate, arc. she traps each seeker inside a dream world they must escape. the huntik team manages to defeat arc, but dante's dream leaves him worried about the future.

==synopsis==
the huntik team must race the organization and a new team of blood spiral casterwill hunters, led by the explosive kiel, to recover the dangerous titan medusa. however, the mission soon takes a drastic turn, forcing zhalia to adopt a new plan.

== plot ==
;the most brutal student
at the blood spiral base, rassimov reports to the betrayer, who can be seen sitting on a throne at the top of some stairs. molten grey liquid overflows from cauldrons on either side of the betrayer and flows down the stairs towards rassimov. rassimov glows with power and cries out in pain, during which the betrayer apparently speaks to him, asking that he increase the number of blood spiral members. rassimov agrees. he is then interrupted by shauna, wind, tantras, and kiel, who tell him that stack wishes to join the brotherhood. rassimov at first commands them to destroy stack, but changes mind upon hearing that stack will give them the titan medusa as proof of his allegiance. tantras suggests sending kiel, as he is powerful enough that he can defeat the organization even if it is a trap, and rassimov agrees.

;fighting wilder
still unsettled by the visions of arc, the huntik team are all feeling down as they travel by boat to medusa's island. they arrive to discover wilder. hoffman and the suits waiting on the beach. wilder smugly reveals that with stack infiltrating the blood spiral, he can control them from the inside. realizing wilder won't be convinced to help them fight the spiral, dante invokes caliban to fight venomaster and myrmidon while lok invokes kipperin. while the rest of the team fights the organization, zhalia tracks down stack, who leads kiel and some blood spiral members to medusa's cave. she decides to report back to her team once she reaches the cave instead of infiltrating it.

lok battles with wilder but is sent crashing to ground when kipperin is hit by a weakenshade spell. wilder sees an opportunity to get his hands on the willblade but is interrupted by dante. wilder summons incubane who fights caliban and sabriel. cherit defeats incubane with an energy blast while lok and dante hit wilder together, defeating him. reluctant to leave stack and ruin their plan, wilder angrily vows that they'll meet again some day before withdrawing with his men.

;ambushing kiel
stack uses divine mirror kagami as his secret weapon to defeat medusa but she proves harder to contain than anticipated. the team comes up with a plan to capture kiel, using dendras to neutralize his titan, vulcana and metagolem to restrain kiel. the plan is abruptly ruined however by marduk and some casterwill hunters inside the cave who the team were unaware of. lok summons baselaird to fight off the harlekins but they are isolated by vulcana. sophie recognizes kiel as they fight while dante tells lok that it's up to him to finish the mission.

south america: jungle

dante, lok, den, and sophie meet with the huntik council. the casterwill liaison, teien asks them to find and activate the blue star to signal a meeting of casterwill elders. lok activates the signal as dante and sophie hold off kiel. but kiel reveals he's the one who destroyed sophie's home when she was young.

== synopsis ==
the casterwill family and dante's team gather in the fortress of iron will while the blood spiral's army prepares to wage war against the family. with sophie's capabilities of leading the family called into question, she must face the trial of courage, with lok as her champion, to become the leader of the casterwill elders. at the end of the tests lies the statue of the legendary titan of bravery, mythras.

== plot ==
;iron will
with the blue star activated, the casterwill family and dante's team meet inside the fortress of iron will in great rift valley, africa. nimue casterwill begins the proceedings by recognizing lok lambert and sophie casterwill for activating the blue star. however, focauld casterwill and the rue guardian object to the presence of non-casterwills, even despite lok's ability to use the willblade, which he summons with bladecall. when nimue asks the reason for the meeting, sophie, encouraged by lok and cherit, proposes a formal alliance between the casterwills and the huntik foundation in response to the blood spiral, despite her nervousness.

;chasing the spy
meanwhile, den fears and dante vale keep watch outside of the forest. while they discuss the lack of food, dante casts boltflare on a nearby branch, revealing midnight rook as it flies away. dante invokes solwing, and they follow the spy into the jungle.

in the jungle, the seekers encounter midnight rook's master, defeating the silent soldier. a group of more silent soldier arrives, invoking harlekin to attack solwing and casting poisonfang to attack dante. den attacks a silent soldier with raypulse. the soldier evades the attack and punches den in the stomach in return, winding him. den dodges the following attacks and retaliates by giving the soldier a headbutt to the stomach, defeating him. another silent soldier casts nullcurse towards dante, who evades by using spidertouch. using nimblefire and touchram, dante defeats the remaining silent soldiers while den invokes cursed archer to defeat midnight rook and harlekin. dante then ties up the spirals using ropetrick and explains that interrogation spells like simplemind wouldn't work against seekers such as the silent soldiers.

;the vote
in iron will, the casterwill elders assemble to vote: nimue casterwill of the house of blademakers, focauld casterwill of the house of knodledge, teien casterwill of the house of strategists, and the rue guardian of curses and secrets. lok becomes concerned about a house of curses, but sophie presumes that as a casterwill he likely has good intentions. as the heir of the house of nobles, lucas casterwill takes his place and begins the hearing.

nimue begins with her support of sophie in protecting against the nullifiers, but focauld doubts the family's remaining numbers. despite teien's reminder of having allies in the huntik foundation, focauld and the rue guardian oppose direct action from the family. questioned by nimue, lucas proposes focusing on protecting the many members of the family who aren't at iron will.

the decision makes sophie angry, and she insists on fighting in the name of the family by herself. in response, lucas proposes the trial of courage if she wishes to take on the leadership of the family. sophie accepts, even though failure would mean having to go into hiding for her protection.

;the spiral march
deep in the jungle the spiral army marches towards the fortress of iron will. marduk informs tantras that his hunters haven't discovered anything yet, so tantras responds that they will wait for rassimov's message. as harrison fears remarks that their days of traveling needs to be worthwhile, zhalia moon is unable to use logosbook to contact dante due to the close eye of tantras.

;the trial begins
sophie and lok proceed to the door leading to the trial of courage but are stopped by leblanche, who apologizes for not being able to prepare sophie as well as her birth family could have. with no way of contacting the casterwills, leblanche was unable to teach her the family secrets. sophie, however, tells leblanche that his training made her who she is and that he was like a father to her. she then assures leblanche and santiago that she will pass the test but is cautioned by lucas, who tells her that even he failed the test.

angered by her brother's words, sophie enters with lok and cherit. cherit reminds her that lucas' actions stem from his desire to protect sophie, though she finds no way to accept those actions. reaching a narrow stone bridge covered by fog, they begin to cross. accidentally setting off the trap, lok slips, saving himself with spidertouch.

upon reaching the other side, they find a hallway full of paintings of the casterwill family, including one of cherit with lord casterwill. finding three passageways, lok has cherit pick over a hunch that cherit has been there before.

;the approaching war
in the blood spiral base, rassimov speaks with the betrayer to try to find out iron will. finally he gets the vision, which he passes on to his troops in kenya through their spiral marks. meanwhile, dante and den are still looking for the spirals in the jungle. suddenly, den's mark is activated, and he runs off after harrison, followed by dante.

inside the fortress, the unsuspecting casterwills await sophie's return. the family argues over the wisdom of sending sophie to the test of courage as the test was designed by the strongest rue guardians to be unforgiving. lucas states that he believes that sophie's failure would be for her own good.

;the test of courage
nearing the corridor of the test of courage, sophie begins to doubt herself but is comforted by lok, who trusts the clues from eathon's holotome. near the door, lok uses bladecall to summon the willblade as they find runes indicating "the champion of casterwill" around a lever protected by a trap of spikes. though lok wants to use stoneglove to protect himself, sophie reminds him that the test is about bravery and reaches out to the lever herself. light shines from the willblade as sophie pulls the lever, opening the door. cherit then wonders if the light was lok's power.

as they enter, they find the statue of the legendary titan of valor, mythras. sophie again doubts herself, noting that the wilblade bonded with lok and not herself and that she may not be capable of leading the casterwill family. an illusion of lucas, embodying her fears, taunts them and summons serpentine shadow monsters to attack. lok and sophie invoke ironsquire and sorcerel, respectively, but to no avail. as sophie's raypulse and kindlestrike only cause more monsters to appear, lok eventually deduces that these monsters can only be defeated by facing her fears. walking past the monsters and the illusion of her brother, sophie places her hand on the statue. with lok's encouragement reminding her of her friends' faith in her, sophie bonds with mythras and invokes the legendary titan to complete the trial and to re-energize lok.

;the spiral army
as the blood spiral marches onwards, zhalia finally manages to sneak away to warn her team using logosbook. however, tantras follows her and uses terrorsight to steal and read the book. finding her information to dante, he remarks that she must care for him before attempting to kill her using acidheart and blood spiral magic. in a last ditch effort, she powerbonds with gareon and uses his scramblemind ability to erase tantras' memory. harrison shortly arrives, and he and zhalia assist a defeated tantras.

meanwhile at the edge of the jungle, dante and den receive the message from zhalia using logosbook. the message warns of a full blown spiral army, which den sees marching just over the ridge.

king arthur of camelot was the head of the knights of the round table and the husband of guinevere. the legends of king arthur are a central part of english and medieval folklore, and include stories of arthur's island of avalon, resting place of the willblade. his symbol was famously a dragon. 

== history ==
king arthur was married to guinevere. his champion, sir lancelot, fell from grace by falling in love with guinevere. [memory lane] the two had a nephew, sir gawain, who was named after king arthur's favored titan, gawain. [huntik.com]

king arthur's island, avalon, became the resting place of the one of the most powerful casterwill family artifacts, the willblade. [knight of the willblade]

rotterdam, the netherlands

zhalia returns to her old orphanage to find the blood spirals there, recruiting orphans. she meets two orphan brothers, harrison, who chooses to join the spirals, and den, who turns to zhalia for help. the huntik team comes to the rescue, and they end up with a new huntik foundation seeker, den.

== synopsis ==
when clements goes missing, the huntik team are sent to paris, to find him. after a battle with some possessed titans outside of the cathedral of notre dame, the they find clements is trapped in a dream world created by the ring of arc. to rescue him, the team must each enter a dream world, each showing them the nightmares of their future.

== plot ==
;the star of chaos and the circle of fate
a member of the huntik foundation in paris, france, named clements had been doing tests on the ring of arc. he spoke on the phone with metz upon hearing a voice coming from the ring of arc. before clements was able to finish, the ring of arc somehow invoked the titans from three nearby amulets.

meanwhile, after practicing chess with den fears, lok lambert and sophie casterwill realize that one of the quatrains from eathon lambert's holotome points to the ring of arc currently being held in paris. as the two go to inform dante vale, they find that they already have a mission in paris, which dante says cannot be a coincidence.

while in paris, the team has to fight off freelancer, hoplite, and ironsquire titans which had been summoned by the ring while simultaneously running crowd control. to keep the world of seekers a secret, dante casts hidesight on a taxi driver while zhalia casts simplemind on a family. after defeating the titans, the huntik seekers enter the paris catacombs to find the ring's location. there, they found the ring on the finger of clements. in an attempt to free him, the seekers each touch the ring and enter their own dreams while cherit is left to guard them.

;sophie's dream of losing control
sophie casterwill finds herself wearing dante's trench coat and playing as the queen of the casterwills in a chess match against the evil betrayer and his army of spiral demon creatures. seeing her family members in danger, she intervenes only to destroy the chess board. she then finds herself hurtling through space and presented with the power of a goddess. here, she attempts to knock the red comet from its course only to hit a planet out of orbit.

;zhalia's dream of her masquerade
zhalia moon finds herself at a statue of dante where she is confronted by numerous silent soldiers. seeing dante being overwhelmed, she tries to help, only to become overwhelmed by the number of spirals herself. the silent soldiers then reveal themselves to be none other than zhalia and try to put a blood spiral mask on her. though she tries to resist, she is restrained and forced to become a silent soldier under the watch of the betrayer.

;lok's dream of betrayal
lok lambert finds himself alongside cherit and confronted by several harlekin titans. to fight off the enemies, lok tries to invoke freelancer and later baselaird, but his titans merely warp into more harlekin titans. cherit also transforms into a harlekin, and the willblade becomes cracked.

aegean sea: medusa's island

on the trail of the titan, medusa, the huntik team meets the explosive spiral hunter, kiel. zhalia's plan to ambush kiel fails, and it is nearly a disaster. but lok solves the puzzle and recovers the amulet. sad, zhalia leaves dante and the others to do what she does best: infiltrate the spirals.

== synopsis ==
den and harrison fears both train with their factions. den is recruited by the huntik team to replace zhalia but the pressure gets too much and he runs away. lok and cherit race to find him before tantras and the blood spiral do.

== plot ==
;new recruits
 
at huntik foundation italian hq, den trains under clease but, struggling to complete the numerous tasks, loses his temper. after heading back to the library, a frustrated den walks out, throwing a book at clease to catch, accidentally causing all the shelves to be knocked over. lok, sophie, dante and cherit rush in, worried that they are under attack. after helping clease, they stop den and ask him to join their team, noting how zhalia herself recommended him as her replacement. although initially unsure, den agrees, but first, he must clean up the library.

at the blood spiral base, a far more brutal training regime is taking place as harrison spars against tantras and jericho. harrison invokes a new titan, hitokiri but, as they are overpowered, the session is interrupted when zhalia and the other new recruits arrive, eager to learn. tantras brings forward a crippled stack and, as a lesson to his students for what becomes of spies, kills him as he screams in pain. 

;looking for den
 
at dante vale's house, clease contacts the team, saying that den has gone missing. understanding how den must feel, lok and cherit go to find him. dante rightly fears they're not the only one looking for him; tantras tells his students that they will go after den for turning his back on the blood spiral.

lok and cherit search the streets of venice before finally catching up with den. as lok tries to convince him to return, they run into a pair of a thugs who den provokes, leaving lok to fight them. with help from cherit, lok uses spidertouch to subdue the thugs before saving den from falling into the canal. lok reminds den how he used to protect the weaker kids at his orphanage, pointing out that he is already a hero and has what it takes to be part of the team. as den agrees, they are interrupted by tantras' students. lok holds them off, telling den to run, but den uses a boltflare to hit one of them in the back. accidentally knocking a gondolier into the water, lok invokes kipperin and they escape. watching from the rooftops are tantras, harrison and zhalia, who uses logosbook to warn dante.

;taking on the blood spiral
 
back at dante's house, impressed with den's courage, lok gives him his freelancer amulet while dante decides that they face the spirals. in the moonlight, the team wait in the streets as the spirals emerge. tantras demands they surrender den but dante refuses. as two groups clash, the blue-haired orphan invokes harlekin. desperate to protect sophie, lok summons lindorm and together they manage to defeat the enemy titan. lok pursues one of the students across the canal and into an abandoned warehouse. the student launches a surprise attack but lindorm bursts and defeats him.

harrison and den fight, but den falters against harrison's new blood spiral powers. as harrison summons hitokiri, den invokes freelancer, turning the tables and matching his brother. as cherit and freelancer defeat hitokiri, den overpowers harrison. 

;dante vs tantras
 
tantras fights against dante one on one but is outmatched by his martial arts, so two of students his restrain dante. using skingrip to the hold all three down, tantras prepares to eliminate dante using bladewave, even hitting his own men. sophie intervenes in time with honorguard but tantras continues to attack. lok and lindorm arrive, and unsettled at the appearance of a powerbonded titan, tantras uses darkfog and retreats with his students. den attempts to take an unconscious harrison back to the foundation, but zhalia uses darksleep on him and brings harrison to tantras. he rewards her for proving herself, ordaining her arm with the spiral symbol and making her harrison's bodyguard.

sophie is impressed as lok helps to teach den in the library, giving him study tips. dante agrees that they have a lot more potential but things are going to get a lot more dangerous.

== trivia ==
*the english title of this episode is a spoof on the well known phrase "boys will be boys".
*the two street thugs who attack lok were seen attacking zhalia moon in a flashback of her past in the beautiful trap.
*the scene where the gondolier is knocked into the water by lok is a reference to a seeker is born in which the same event occurred.

venice, italy:

den joins the huntik team to replace zhalia but is not ready to be a hero. meanwhile, his brother, harrison, is training to be a blood spiral and is getting strong. den runs away from the foundation and is attacked by the spirals. the huntik team saves him while zhalia protects harrison and proves herself to the spirals.

== synopsis ==
the huntik team are sent to manhattan to rescue focauld, a casterwill elder who has been targeted by kiel and his powerful blood spiral team. they not only have to fight their way out of the cloisters, but focauld’s contrary personality isn’t making it any easier.

== plot ==

a trip to new york

seeking a break, the huntik team are in new york city with leblanche and santiago, under the premise of rest and relaxation. however, sophie reveals her real motive: visiting as many museums as possible. a small fly lands on santiago but he swots it away and it flies off out of the city centre. 

meanwhile, at the cloisters, an elderly casterwill scholar, focauld casterwill, the keeper of knowledge, is attacked by a silent soldier. focauld knocks him out by rebounding his spell, but discovers a snail-like tracking device signalling a distress call to other devices in the distance. the fly-like drone communicates an ominous message: "we've finally found you, casterwill". focauld realizes that the blood spiral hunters are on their way and there is little time to waste. 

the councillors coordinate

at huntik international hq, chairman metz and the huntik council receive a dire code blue alert. the masked female member of the council dressed in a kimono reveals herself to be teien casterwill, the liaison between the huntik foundation and her scattered family. she asks for help to save the casterwill refuge in the cloister and metz mobilizes dante and the team, who are enjoying a rollercoaster ride on the coney island cyclone. he orders the team to rescue focuald and prevent the blood spirals from obtaining the hidden locations of the casterwill family.

kiel and marduk arrive with their team on bazela's insect fliers and are held off by focauld who locks the building down. over the cypherdex, teien interrogates the capture silent soldier, using her oathmaker power to compel him to speak the truth. the soldier chillingly reveals that the blood spiral intends to open the spiral mark to unleash the nullifiers, leaving only the brotherhood to rule the earth. metz tells focauld help is on the way, but focauld is not impressed with the idea of sophie coming to help. 

the rescue

the huntik team arrives by plane, dropping directly onto the roof of the cloisters. dante, sophie, lok, and den engage the casterwill hunters. dante invokes caliban and lok summons ironsquire who face off against midnight rook and dark pharaoh. sophie is almost sucked into a portal created by a hunter's abyssalfall power but is rescued by lok as leblanche provides sniper fire from the jet to back up the team. 

focauld holds off kiel and his ignatius titan inside the hidden library and uses knowledgelock to seal all the knowledge from the casterwill tomes into a single cypherdex crystal. this renders him exhausted but dante's team bursts through the sky light just in time and battle the blood spiral seekers and their titans. marduk invokes cerberus who defeats both den's vigilante and leblanche's albion. 

the power amplifier gambit

cornered by kiel's superior attacks, sophie devises a high-risk tactic. she orders leblanche to align the jet overhead and activate its experimental power amplifier. despite focauld's complaints, sophie casts a magical force field around the team and the jet's amplifier boosts the spell to catastrophic levels, generating a massive shockwave that collapses the ceiling and incapacitates the entire squad of blood spiral hunters and their titans. with the help of kipperin, lok manages to catch the cypherdex crystal from cerberus' jaws. with the enemy temporarily stunned, the team pull focauld to safety through the debris and fly off.

safe inside the huntik foundation jet, sophie confronts focauld, demanding full transparency regarding her family's secrets and legacy. focauld remains skeptical of sophie's rashness, remarking that keeping her in the dark was the wiser choice. dante resolves that the blood spiral threat can no longer be handled in secret, declaring that the team will bring the matter directly before the entire huntik foundation council.

== trivia ==
*the museum that huntik team visit is museum of modern art, also known as the "moma". it is also the basis for momax's name.
*the roller coaster that the huntik team visit is the coney island cyclone, better known as "the cyclone", a historic wooden rollercoaster in new york, usa.

kiel and marduk arrive with their team on bazela's insect fliers and are held off by focauld who locks the building down. over the cypherdex, teien interrogates the capture silent soldier, using her oathmaker power to compel him to speak the truth. the soldier chillingly reveals that the blood spiral intends to open the spiral mark to unleash the nullifiers, leaving only the brotherhood to rule the earth. metz tells focauld help is on the way, but focauld is not impressed with the idea of sophie coming to help. 

the rescue

the huntik team arrives by plane, dropping directly onto the roof of the cloisters. dante, sophie, lok, and den engage the casterwill hunters. dante invokes caliban and lok summons ironsquire who face off against midnight rook and dark pharaoh. sophie is almost sucked into a portal created by a hunter's abyssalfall power but is rescued by lok as leblanche provides sniper fire from the jet to back up the team. 

focauld holds off kiel and his ignatius titan inside the hidden library and uses knowledgelock to seal all the knowledge from the casterwill tomes into a single cypherdex crystal. this renders him exhausted but dante's team bursts through the sky light just in time and battle the blood spiral seekers and their titans. marduk invokes cerberus who defeats both den's vigilante and leblanche's albion. 

the power amplifier gambit

cornered by kiel's superior attacks, sophie devises a high-risk tactic. she orders leblanche to align the jet overhead and activate its experimental power amplifier. despite focauld's complaints, sophie casts a magical force field around the team and the jet's amplifier boosts the spell to catastrophic levels, generating a massive shockwave that collapses the ceiling and incapacitates the entire squad of blood spiral hunters and their titans. with the help of kipperin, lok manages to catch the cypherdex crystal from cerberus' jaws. with the enemy temporarily stunned, the team pull focauld to safety through the debris and fly off.

safe inside the huntik foundation jet, sophie confronts focauld, demanding full transparency regarding her family's secrets and legacy. focauld remains skeptical of sophie's rashness, remarking that keeping her in the dark was the wiser choice. dante resolves that the blood spiral threat can no longer be handled in secret, declaring that the team will bring the matter directly before the entire huntik foundation council.
*the museum that huntik team visit is museum of modern art, also known as the "moma". it is also the basis for momax's name.
*the roller coaster that the huntik team visit is the coney island cyclone, better known as "the cyclone", a historic wooden rollercoaster in new york, usa.

new york city, usa

casterwill elder focauld is under attack by kiel's deadly blood spirals. dante and the huntik team are sent to the cloisters to rescue him. in the heat of battle, sophie is forced to prove herself to the surly focauld, saving everyone. however, focauld is too stubborn to welcome sophie into the casterwill family secrets.

== synopsis ==
dante, lok, den, and sophie meet with the huntik foundation council. the casterwill elder, teien, asks them to find and activate the blue star to signify the meeting of casterwill elders. 

==plot==
;the forest
 
dante, sophie and lok venture through the forest looking for den , who has been captured by the blood spirals. lok thinks that he may have gotten lost, but dante realises they are being hunted as marduk and kiel watch from above. meanwhile, rassimov speaks with the the main members of the blood spiral, shauna, wind, and tantras, saying that the events towards their goals have been set in motion. on the longest the night of the year, the world shall burn, leaving only the faithful blood spirals. shauna loses her temper, but rassimov releases a burst of energy, both holding her back and reassuring her.

;finding den
 
cherit spots the temple, but lok is more worried about den. however, sophie realizes that dante has also disappeared. they both see the two blood spirals that are watching them from a tree. kiel and marduk appear with a helpless den. but dante is right above them. kiel tries to use rippleburst, but dante evades it with touchram. cherit removes den's gag, and he escapes with dragonfist, beating down marduk at the same time. everyone is surprised, as no one ever taught him the spell. one of the casterwill hunters summons a harlekin, while dante responds with metagolem. metagolem covers their exit. all of them use nimblefire, escaping down the cliff. the blood spirals follow, but are defeated. lok uses kipperin to attack, and marduk traps metagolem with bristlebind. kiel finishes him off with enderflame. however, the huntik team escapes.

;the temple
 
in the forest, the whole team remembers their previous meeting with the huntik foundation council. teien told them to activate the blue star. marduk's midnight rook spies on them as the team finally arrives at the temple, only to be ambushed by kiel and marduk once again. lok and sophie venture into the temple, while dante and den fight the blood spirals. lok summons springer to search for hidden locks. he reveals a secret room full of blue fireworks. den comes in to warn lok and sophie about the ambush. they all head out. dante insists all three of them activate the blue star, while he fights the blood spirals. kiel sends out balenpyre. sophie decides to head back, much to lok's dismay.

;summoning of quetzalcoatl
 
dante summons elf king oberon to stop kiel. kiel tries to enter the temple, but is stopped by sophie's boltflare. sophie summons enfluxion, a gift from teien. kiel responds with vulcana. lok ignites the small blue monument, revealing a pit. kiel creates a circle of fire around sophie. kiel reveals that he was the one who killed sophie's parents. lok and den start to throw the blue powder in the pit after lok realizes they have to create a huge blue bonfire, but are ambushed by marduk. while lok takes care of him, den continues to throw in the powder. when lok and marduk fall into the pit, marduk is blasted away as lok is lifted up into the sky, summoning quetzalcoatl, who flies up to become the blue star. the whole casterwill family looks up in pleasure as it joins the red comet in the sky while sophie hugs lok in joy, stating that the blue star marked the start of the real battle against the blood spiral.

nasher is a member of the huntik foundation council. he currently quarters in huntik international hq in new york city. he is also in charge of the foundation base in tower of nostradamus in salon, france.

== history ==
nasher was present during the holographic council called by a bedridden metz to congratulate them on their efforts against the organization. [coming of age]

nasher alerted the council after receiving an emergency call from his agents in tower of nostradamus after they were taken prisoner by wilder and his organization team. [the tower of nostradamus]

nasher was later present when focauld casterwill alerted teien casterwill that the blood spiral had found him, a matter teien brought before the council. [the casterwill connection] nasher was also present when dante's team came before the council to discuss the blood spiral and were tasked with the mission call of the casterwill. [the titan in the temple of sun]

nasher joined the council on the longest night of the year to discuss plans to stop the activation of the spiral mark. [words from eathon] during the final battle at the spiral mark, he helped clements and billie. he stepped in to protect billie and knocked out a silent soldier who was attacking her. [dante's return]

following the defeat of the betrayer, nasher was seen with the council as they were joined by a new member, dante vale. [dante's return]

==personality==
nasher seems to be very protective of his subordinates. when they got attacked by the organization, he seemed really concerned to bring help to them as soon as possible. [the tower of nostradamus] he is willing to save them no matter what the cost and even risks his life for them, such as when he personally protected them from the blood spiral. huntik:page:7427:
the tower of nostradamus is one of the huntik foundation's bases located in salon, france. peter, billie, and annette quarter here.

== history ==
nostradamus spent many years in the tower, as a base to conduct his work as a visionary dictating his prophecies of the future in the form of quatrains. he left many artifacts in his secret room including his scrying glass with three sentry triclops titans to guard it. [the tower of nostradamus]

many years later, the tower was swept by the huntik foundation and converted into a museum. [the tower of nostradamus]

after stack informed wilder that the huntik foundation were investigating nostradamus' quatrains, wilder and his team planned to discover the tower's secrets. unbeknownst to them, peter, billie and annette were stationed there. after recognizing hoffman from their files, billie and peter tried to stop the organization team from accessing nostradamus' secret room. however, they failed and were taken captive. however annette's emergency distress call managed to reach the huntik foundation council. they were later rescued by dante vale's team who, after defeating the organization, recovered the scrying glass which translated the quatrains and pointed them in the direction of avalon. [the tower of nostradamus]

the huntik foundation council is a group consisting of nine (later ten) of the most experienced huntik foundation seekers from across the globe, controlling the foundation's work and making important decisions about future goals, alliances and missions. they are based in huntik international hq in manhattan, new york.

==history==

in the 1900s, following the creation of the huntik foundation to protect history and preserve the traditions of the ancient cultures, the huntik council was set up some years after. the first council was made up of seven members, including eathon lambert. a painting of the first meeting was hung on a wall in the huntik foundation italian hq. [the secret of two generations]

when metz, the leader of the council, fell victim to the curse of the legendary titans, the meetings weren't held in person but through holograms. [coming of age] however, following metz' recovery, the council members gathered in the hq and started to deliberate again.

the council discussed the reemergence of the organization following the defeat of the professor. nasher then alerted the council that his seekers in tower of nostradamus had been attacked by the organization. [the tower of nostradamus]
