== titan profiles ==

== trivia ==
* when the legend of the pied piper is mentioned, the resolution of the episode can be predicted quite easily.
* the flower that distracts guggenheim at the market is centaurea cyanus.
* in the dubs where powerbonded titans are voiced, suit 057 is surprised by the fact that sabriel answered sophie's order to cast truth shield. in the dubs where powerbonded titans are mute, suit 057 is just surprised by the ability truth shield itself, and the dialogue is quite different.

== production errors ==
*gremlow is misidentified as a yama-titan by the holotome, contradicting with gremlow's multiple litho-titan traits: his stone-like armor and physiology, purple energy essence, litho-titan amulet coloration, and geographical and mythological ties to europe. moreover, gremlow is listed as a litho-titan on the show's official artist reference sheets, therefore the line is confirmed to be a scripting error.
*when sophie summons powerbonded sabriel, her non-powerbonded icon is incorrectly shown.
*the city of hamelin, germany, was misspelled as hamlin.

==international titles==

== full episode ==
lok, sophie and den meet with guggenheim to investigate a rogue titan, gremlow, in hamelin cathedral. unfortunately the titan keeps multiplying. meanwhile, dante explores the cavern of hernán cortés in order to locate the titan umbra.
;separate missions
 exploring the sea of cortés]]
dante vale decided to split the team: while he navigates the stormy sea of cortés alone, he sent lok lambert, sophie casterwill and den fears to the city of hamelin in germany for a purpose they don't know. there, the trio meets with guggenheim, who gives them the task to investigate mysterious perturbations happening at the local cathedral and report back on their findings.

;infinite infestation
at sunset, lok, sophie and den start exploring the cathedral. it is completely silent, until lok sees scattered candles. the trio walks toward a stained glass which depicts the legend of hamelin and contains what seems to be an amulet, and sophie recounts the legend of the pied piper. lok then notices a chalice bouncing off a table and steps closer, but gets startled by the sudden appearance of a small rat-like titan, called gremlow. the holotome says these titans move in swarms but lok, seemingly confident, tries to gain the lonely rat's sympathy. sophie and den suddenly start yell to warn him: al swarm of gremlows is now running down the walls of the cathedral to attack them. 
]]
they use a variety of spells to eliminate the gremlows, but quickly notice that they resurrect and even multiply. the rats end up swarming the whole cathedral and swallowing up sophie. lok and den invoke dendras and cursed archer to free her, but the team realizes that no matter how hard they fight, the rats keep on reapparing. sophie glances at the stained glass and understands that they need the song from the legend of the pied piper to eliminate the gremlows. completely overwhelmed, the team runs out of the cathedral as fast as possible, and sophie uses stopglue to temporarily seal the doors.

;shopping for a flute
a flashback shows a pre-recorded message from eathon lambert, telling lok to follow one of nostradamus' quatrains in order to find one of the legendary titans. the quatrain talks about a "child's song" to be used in the waters of the conqueror to the west. the team realizes the reason why dante went exploring the sea of cortés, and sophie also seems to understand why he sent them to this town. she asks guggenheim where they can find a flute, but cherit suddenly arrives and warns them that the doors of the cathedral are about to break open. lok and den are off to contain the gremlows while sophie and guggenheim go find a flute. 

in the sea of cortés, dante parks his boat and dives in the sea. he stumbles upon a threatening giant squid but scares him off with metagolem. the titan also opens up a passage to an underwater cave and dante realizes he's on the right track. meanwhile, sophie and guggenheim walk through the market of hamelin and sophie finally finds a shop that sells instruments. she buys a flute while guggenheim, distracted by the smell of flowers, left her alone. 

sophie is followed by two suits as she walks away from the shop. they end up cornering her in an alley and she invokes sabriel, but the suits overwhelm her with shadow agent, doom warden and their spells. in the cathedral, lok and den manage to wipe out the entire army of gremlows. guggenheim arrives, telling them about how he lost track of sophie in the market. in the sea of cortés, dante enters the underwater crypt and discovers a titan as well as an unbreakable force field that have been left there to guard hernán cortés' treasure. dante understands that, just like the quatrain says, they need a child's song to break the defenses.

;a new pied piper
sophie is in bad posture but den suddenly arrives with cherit to save her, and together with sabriel and vigilante, they defeat the suits. meanwhile in the cathedral, lok and guggenheim struggle to contain the everlasting gremlows. guggenheim showcases his powers and uses his bulreguard to wipe off a large portion of them, but they end up reapparing again.
]]
suddenly, they both hear a melody as sophie walks in the cathedral while playing the flute. the gremlows' attitude immediately changes and they start placing themselves behind sophie. lok tells her to walk them up to the stained glass, and that effectively leads all the gremlows to jump back inside their amulet.

after they are all gone, a ray of magic transforms sophie's flute into the original flute of the pied piper. the team goes back to italy and have a call with dante who is still abroad. sophie explains that the notes of the melody were written on the stained glass. dante tells the team that the flute will be of use again, and invites them to join him in california.

vlad dracul (also known as vlad the impaler, vlad tepes, and dracula) was an ancient and evil seeker, and an enemy of the casterwill family. due to his reputation for evil and inhuman cruelty, ordinary people figured him to be a monster. with his vampiric titan, antedeluvian, vlad became known as the vampire, dracula.

==history==
vlad dracul was the prince of wallachia during the fifteenth century and an inheritor of the dark power of the betrayer. [lok's leadership] a truly evil seeker, he was a fierce enemy of the casterwill family. [artbook]like his father, he was a member of the order of the dragon. vlad dracul became known as vlad the impaler, or vlad țepeș in romanian, due to having executed his enemies by having them impaled on sharp wooden stakes. he was even believed to have eaten dinner while watching these grisly spectacles. before his death, he cast a spell which allowed his titans to remain invoked for centuries. [the vampire loses its fangs]

the huntik team under dante vale were later sent to reclaim vlad's bag of amulets from the castle of vlad dracul. [the vampire loses its fangs] though initially reclaimed by the huntik foundation, the blood spiral managed to lay claim to the amulets. tantras was able to claim the power of the powerful heart of vlad dracul, but was foiled by dante vale, who had ignatius burn up the artifact. [lok's leadership]

==abilities==
vlad dracul was a very powerful seeker who used many dark spells. unbeknownst to vlad, he was an inheritor of the power of the betrayer through the powerful artifact known as the heart of vlad dracul, which resided under his throne in his castle. his signature titan was the vampiric antedeluvian, although he possessed many more. vlad managed to place an enchantment which allowed his titans to remain invoked, and wild, after his death.

=== bonded titans ===
* antedeluvian
* multiple unnamed titans

=== artifacts used ===
* heart of vlad dracul

== trivia ==
* his last name of dracul means dragon, and dracula means son of the dragon, both of which reference the order of the dragon.
* the real vlad iii dracula was a romanian nobleman who inspired bram stoker's dracula. vlad iii was also known as vlad dracul, vlad the impaler, and vlad țepeș.

kronos is the legendary titan of time and the progenitor of the krono-titans. a hooded figure in the visage of the grim reaper, kronos dons purple and gold armor and wields a large scythe, capable of wiping out those he strikes from ever having been born.

== history ==
kronos belonged to the casterwill family, and remained hidden in the astronomical clock of prague for many years before being stolen by viktor casterwill in the seventeenth century. it was eventually passed down to his descendant, dr. benway. [the power of kronos]

dr. benway and the professor fought each other for ownership of the ring of kronos with the professor coming out victorious. he used araknos to put benway in a wheelchair for good and become a loyal scientist and advisor to him. the professor often attempted to summon kronos but never succeeded. [the power of kronos]

after the defeat of the professor, dr. benway reclaimed kronos's ring, and also helped himself to the most powerful titans in the organization's collection. [the power of kronos] when the huntik team attempted to obtain the ring, benway set a trap and lured them to his base. summoning kronos, he attempted to use kronos to wipe lok and sophie from existence, but missing, created a vortex that sucked in, sending them back in time to the seventeenth century. 

there, they found the ring in the astronomical clock but were interrupted by viktor casterwill and michel de notre dame. after defeating viktor, lok and sophie found they had changed history by stopping the ring falling into the hands of his lineag, thus preventing it from ever falling into the hands of dr. benway. after explaining the situation to michel, he agreed to use kronos and help them get home. the casterwill council then hid the amulet of kronos elsewhere. in the modern day, it was seen to be in a clock workshop as the ring on the shop employee's hand. [the power of kronos]

== abilities ==
kronos is an unimaginably powerful titan who is able to manipulate the flow of time, speeding it up and slowing down at will. his sharp and perfectly aimed scythe is unable to be stopped by swords or shields and can wipe those he strikes from history, preventing them from ever having existed. [the power of kronos] his sheer power was so difficult to control, even a seeker as powerful as the professor was unable to invoke him. [the power of kronos]

== gallery ==

kronos's amulet.jpg|kronos' ring
kronos.jpg|kronos

== trivia ==
* in a deleted finished scene of the comic the power of kronos, kronos defeated both lok's baselaird and sophie's sabriel in one single hit. this was scrapped because it contradicted with later scenes where lok summoned powerbonded baselaird later in the issue, as the story was set during season 2.
* kronos is based on the titan king and father of the olympian gods in greek mythology, who was also named cronus; his appearance is instead based on that of the grim reaper.

frostanna is a litho-titan used by ford. also known as the snow lady, she can control ice, freezing water particles in the air through her hair and generating cooling rays from her long claws.

== history ==
frostanna was first used by ford to freeze and capture gil in tel aviv. [the fire of georgiopolis]

in venice, italy, ford summoned her to attack lok when he attempted to obtain the medallion of saint mark. [the carnival of deception]

frostanna was invoked by ford to attack lok but she was defeated by headless hessian. [the headless horseman]

ford invoked fostanna who attacked the huntik team and froze lok, dante and sophie. she searched for zhalia moon but did not see her suspended on the ceiling. [the curse of venice]

after ford joined the huntik foundation, frostanna used was against the organization.

frostanna was later invoked fight alongside ignatius against lee roy's executioner. [the titan of the stage]

== abilities ==
frostanna can fire ice blasts and can easily freeze or trap her foes in ice. she is quick and nimble so she can dodge attacks or pursue a target. in addition, she can also float around, giving her added mobility advantages over her enemies.

the adventure game was an interactive online game on huntik.com that allowed registered users to go on seeker missions in chapters corresponding to each episode of huntik. each adventure game chapter had different choices that could be taken which would affect the outcome of the chapter. completing different chapters allowed unlocked different titans in the secret files as well as the possibility of new spells or titans to use in other chapters of of the adventure game. information about the huntik adventure game is archived below. 

== chapter 1 ==

the player has not yet completed seeker training and is instructed to be careful on the first mission due to organization activity in the area of venice, italy. the player then hears a commotion caused by some suits down one of the streets.

the player may choose to grab a snack at the pastry café to satiate his or her hunger. if the player decides to go to the café, the player hears a suspicious noise and returns to the street. to progress, the player must choose whether to be stealthy and not attract attention or to rush into the trouble.

upon choosing to investigate, the player realizes that three organization suits were the cause of the noise. as the street is a dead end, the player must choose whether or not to hide in the dumpster. the player escapes by jumping into the dumpster. if the player does not jump into the dumpster, the player is hit by a raypulse spell. the suits recognize the player's holotome, deducing that the player must be a part of the huntik foundation, and capture the player.

== trivia ==
*a new power, friendface, is introduced as means of infiltrating the organization sites.
*gareon is used by the suits. the player can pick up its amulet in of the organization safehouses. 
*chapter 14 of the adventure game reveals the first name of charlene hubbs and reveals her to be an old collleague of the player. as a favour, she tells the players about some of the recent goings on in the organization.

the spear of vlad the impaler is an artifact that was necessary to enter the castle of vlad dracul and at one time held the titan antedeluvian. it is able to unlock the castle by being inserted into the molded wound of one of the statues at the castle's gates.

== history ==
according to sophie casterwill, the spear at one time did hold the vampiric titan antedeluvian, who later bonded with vlad dracul, the impaler. [the bookshop hunter]

the spear eventually fell into the hands of the organization and was stored in klaus' bookshop alongside the bottle of djinn. after outsmarting klaus, dante acquired the spear. [the bookshop hunter]

dante used the spear to allow him and the huntik team entry into the castle by inserting into the wound of vlad's statue. [the vampire loses its fangs]

zhalia moon used the spear to allow the blood spiral entry to the castle after they had taken out the huntik foundation operatives stationed outside the castle. [lok's leadership]

the argo was a mythical ship owned and used by jason and the argonauts that was sunk just off of the shores of sutos island. many of the argonauts' treasures were sealed away here including the apple of paris, hercules' arrow the golden fleece and the hoplite amulets that were recovered by dante vale's team.

== history ==
on their mission, jason and the argonauts, dante's team hoped to track down the argo and recover jason's titans, the hoplites. after travelling to the stavropolous river in velo, greece, the team dived down a shipwreck that they believed to be the argo. however, after arduously working to bring the ship to the surface, they learned that the ship belonged to atalanta. the hull of the ship did however provide a map detailing where the argo was sunk. [the treasures of the argonauts]

the team continued their search for the argo but had to stop off at madea island after their speedboat was damaged by a malignant plant. whilst there, they encountered the deadly illusions of jason's titan, madea. [the beautiful trap]

the team traveled to shores of sutos where zhalia moon single-handedly dived down to retrieve jason's hoplite amulets to complete the team's mission while the rest of the team confronted grier and his suits. whilst in the ship, she encountered numerous other treasures of the argonauts, including the apple of paris, hercules' arrow and the golden fleece along with the dragon's teeth and chest of hoplite. [like father, unlike son]

dr. benway is a member of the organization who fought against his leader, the professor, for control of kronos. he is a descendant of viktor casterwill, who betrayed the casterwill family, making him a disowned member of the casterwill clan. his assistant is miss fitch.

== history ==
dr. benway grew up as a disowned casterwill, growing up in an old mansion in prague and inheriting kronos from his ancestor viktor casterwill who had betrayed the casterwill family by stealing the kronos' ring from the astronomical clock of prague. [the power of kronos]

dr. benway and the professor fought each other for ownership of the ring of kronos with the professor coming out victorious, leaving benway hospitalised. he used araknos to put benway in a wheelchair for good and become a loyal scientist and advisor to the organization. the professor often attempted to summon kronos but never succeeded. [the power of kronos] after the defeat of the professor, araknos' hold over dr. benway was broken. he reclaimed kronos's ring, and also helped himself to the most powerful titans in the organization's collection. [the power of kronos] he set about trying to gain control of the organization and used the services of the mercenary rahmas to get himself to a high status. however, benway disappeared before he could pay rahmas much to his annoyance.[cerberus (comic)] 

after years of his experts' failed attempts, benway succeeded in obtaining the amulet of the titan cerberus after posing as an italian archaeologist and tricking dante vale into recovering it for him. he sent the titan to attack the huntik team and then attempted to execute dante and rahmas who he had also betrayed. however, benway and his team were defeated by dante and rahmas, inadvertently working together. dante took cerberus' amulet from benway before giving it to rahmas in exchange for him calling him back to his amulet and saving the huntik team. [cerberus (comic)]

when the huntik team launched a mission to obtain the ring of kronos, benway set a trap with miss fitch and lured them to his base. summoning kronos, he attempted to use him to wipe lok and sophie from existence, but missing, created a vortex that sucked in, sending them back in time to the seventeenth century. the ring of kronos vanished much to benway's despair. this was, in fact, due to lok and sophie altering the past, stopping viktor casterwill from taking the ring, therefore preventing it from ever falling into benway's hands. he and his accomplices were arrested by the huntik foundation while lok and sophie returned to the present day after getting help from one michel de notre dame. [the power of kronos]

== personality ==
benway was cruel and self-centred, and often used deception to get one over those around him. he betrayed rahmas to avoid paying him for his work, and attempted to execute him and dante vale, showing no limit to his evil. however, he was also brave enough to take on the professor, a move that cost him his ability to walk. 

== abilities ==
although in a wheelchair, dr. benway possessed a wide range of powers as he was able to hold his own against the professor. he was also able to summon the incredibly unstable legendary titan of time, kronos, something the professor himself was unable to do. [the power of kronos] after the professor's defeat, he helped himself to some of the most powerful titans in the organization's collection. [the power of kronos]

=== spells utilized ===
* armorbrand

===bonded titans===
* cerberus (taken by dante, given to rahmas)
* kronos (lost after lok and sophie changed history)

triton is a rare, aquatic krono-titan that resembles a heavily armored merman. unlike other titans that look completely identical across multiple invocations, triton is unique in that each of the four known amulets contains an individualised, alternate version of the titan, including a much darker, corrupted fourth variant. 

== history ==
four unique triton amulets originally belonged to the famous alexander the great, who used them to guard the underwater ruins of the legendary lighthouse of alexandria in egypt. their presence beneath the waves inspired the historical legend of four massive sea juggernauts protecting the structure. after alexander's death, all four amulets remained sealed deep beneath the ocean floor. [the treasures of alexandria]

many centuries later, the huntik team discovered the hidden chamber housing the artifacts. by solving a series of ancient riddles, sophie casterwill, lok lambert, and dante vale successfully recovered the first three triton amulets respectively. however, captain caine of the organization managed to seize the fourth amulet. 

lok and sophie invoked their newly acquired tritons for an underwater battle against caine, who summoned his own triton along with megladeath. dante subsequently gave his unused triton amulet to zhalia moon, as only seekers physically carrying a triton amulet could safely pass through alexander's magical energy barrier back to the surface. when caine returned to the surface, he gave his triton amulet to gregor, having completed his mission to obtain it. however, dante, having escaped by using metagolem to shatter the force field, used farslip to take the amulet from gregor, ensuring that the organization left empty-handed. [the treasures of alexandria]

lok later summoned his triton to battle the organization on the island of sinbad, using its aquatic skills to disrupt the boat of captain caine and his suits. [hm07]

== variants ==

while all tritons share a baseline merman physiology and carry tridents, each of the four titans has a unique appearance with an individualized color scheme:
* the first triton: features a sharp, red hair plume, heavy golden armor plates embossed with red gems, and a deep-sea slate-blue tail. this variant was recovered by sophie casterwill.

* the second triton: features a bright yellow/gold hair plume flowing from its helmet, pale yellow armor plates embossed with light blue gems, and a glowing, light aquamarine tail. this variant was recovered by lok lambert.

* the third triton: the third of the amulets, this variant was never explicitly invoked or shown on-panel. based on the established pattern, it likely possessed its own unique armor trim and plume color. this variant was recovered by dante vale and given to zhalia moon.

* the fourth triton: this variant features the most distinct appearance of the four, drastically differing from its counterparts to reflect its sinister nature: it lacks a hair plume entirely, instead wearing a heavy, dark-grey spiked helmet, silver cross-hatched chainmail over swamp-green skin, and a murky chartreuse tail. this version was recovered and used by captain caine. he then delivered it to gregor before it was taken from him by dante vale. 

== abilities ==
the tritons are apex underwater combatants and powerful swimmers. they are highly specialized for deep-sea tracking and heavy aquatic warfare. each warrior is armed with a magically-infused trident fixed to its right arm, which is used for both piercing attacks and parrying close-range strikes. when invoked together, multiple tritons can coordinate their movements to form a synchronized defensive front against gargantuan threats.

== trivia ==
* triton is based on triton, the mythological messenger god of the sea and son of poseidon. while classical myth eventually evolved the concept into a vast, nameless race of mermen called *tritones*, the huntik comic adaptation uniquely fixed their number to a specific set of four distinct guardians.
* the four different versions are all referred to straight as "triton", including in its huntik magazine fact file, confirming that they are all versions of the same titan and share the same name.

== history ==

== playing strategies ==
mirram is a perfect example of a titan to use on the perfect foe mission.

this meso-titan from down under has 1 atk and 1 def. the hop power doesn’t sound impressive, but it opens up many possibilities for you. for one, it lets mirram move and start combats if it’s already exhausted. you can use mirram to play an exhaust action like expendable help and then also use it to move forward and brawl with some enemy heroes. similarly, it can move forward without exhausting. it can hop forward into a zone with a feature (like the pyramid in the mission) and then exhaust to use that feature in the same round.

mirram isn’t the toughest titan, so you want to hold it in your hand and try to lull your opponent to feel secure enough to exhaust all their heroes. if your opponent exhausted all their heroes on the first round in zone 1 to play actions, mirram could then hop all the way across the map and ko its mirror image on the first round.

== history ==
grand dragon leviathan was once a favoured titan of lord casterwill. after his death, no seeker was ever able to control the titan again. [grand dragon leviathan (comic)] 

grand dragon leviathan rose from the canals of venice, italy, and fought the huntik team along with ignatius, icarus, kipperin and king basilisk. [the curse of venice]

the nexus is a gateway to the spirit world of huntik, the world from which the titans originated. the nexus in peru is a large, blue colored crystal situated within a cave behind a waterfall.

== history ==
at some point in his explorations, eathon lambert had discovered a nexus in peru.
in an attempt to evade the professor and his suits, eathon jumped from a waterfall which concealed the cave of the nexus. using the power of the nexus, eathon escaped into the spirit world of huntik, leaving earth as well as his friends and family behind.

this nexus was later re-discovered by the huntik foundation following the fall of the professor. using the ability of januseea the gatekeeper, a meso-titan given to zhalia moon, lok lambert was able to speak with a projection of his father. after a while, though, the chamber containing the nexus began to cave in, eventually cracking and destroying the nexus, due to wilder and his two right hand man stack and hoffman wanting to take over the organization. [doorway to huntik]

the huntik team joins montehue and tersly for a mission to recover the casterwill titan, phoenix. but powers and titans cannot be used because of the lodestone, and the blood spirals have a head start. lok destroys the lodestone, and dante plans to ambush the spirals before they realize magic can be used again.

== synopsis ==
the team continues on their mission with montehue and tersly. they come up with a plan to take out the silent soldiers guarding the volcano's entrance. while montehue and tersly hold off the guards, dante, lok, den, and sophie face off against wind and shauna. sophie knows she must face her fears as the lava calls for her to dive in.

== plot ==
;preparing a plan
cherit spies on the silent soldiers and reports on their moves to the team. to enter the volcano through the old lava tunnel that they're guarding, they set up a trap in the jungle to ward them off the entrance and then take them out with their powers and titans before they can react to the news of magic being functional again. meanwhile, wind and shauna order soldiers, who are trying to retrieve the amulet from lava pits in the volcano.

;inside the volcano
the team's plan is successful, but with more guards coming, dante orders metagolem to block up the tunnel, leaving montehue and tersly outside to battle them out. inside the volcano, lok and sophie spot wind, shauna and guards rummaging the lava pits. perched on their ledge, they realize that the floor motif resembles the amulet of will, and sophie guesses that the amulet is hidden in the leftmost pit, which is where the red gem is placed on the real amulet.

;defeating wind and shauna
while montehue and tersley keep fighting guards off outside, dante, lok, sophie and den swiftly take out wind and shauna with powers and titans before they can react. while the blood spiral is in check, they go over possible ways to retrieve the amulet from the lava pit, without success. but as they let their guard down, wind and shauna strike back and invoke their powerful titans.

;the lost daughter rises from red ashes
in the middle of her fight with shauna, sophie feels like something deep in the volcano is calling for her. yet again, the team is unable to keep up with the sheer power of wind and shauna and is soon in a bad posture. lok suddenly understands that the "lost daughter" mentioned by nostradamus is none other than sophie, and in last resort, she dives head first into the lava pit where the amulet lies. the volcano starts erupting and both the huntik team and the blood spiral get out as fast as possible. outside, they witness the legendary titan of rebirth phoenix flying above the erupting volcano, alongside sophie who is now bonded to it.

back in italy, the team scans phoenix's amulet with a cypherdex. dante points out that it is most likely that sophie was protected from the lava, rather than resurrected, but also notes that they are yet to know all the powers phoenix might have. in a moment of calm, lok tells sophie that he always knew she would come out alive.

== card strategies ==
zhalia’s suit version is notable for being the first major hero suit. her 5 atk / 4 def stats are about average for a major hero, but her ability is a killer. she can strike your opponent’s heroes anywhere on the mission map, picking off heroes left by themselves, or with the help of a strikemode , wiping out several of your opponent’s heroes at once.
this card offers a lot of strategic options. ms. moon is a great deterrent—just having her in zone 1 forces your opponent to play around her ability to avoid losing their heroes, which can put them into a really tough situation. if you've got the cunning and the patience, you can lure your opponent into a trap by waiting to play your zhalia until late in the round.

the casterwill hunters are members of the blood spiral that are specially trained to kill members of the casterwill family through any means necessary. even more dangerous than the silent soldiers, they have no shame in destroying members of the huntik foundation for being allies of the casterwills. 

== history ==
a group of casterwill hunters accompanied kiel to medusa's island to meet stack who promised to recover medusa. after kiel was taken prisoner by the huntik foundation in medusa's cave, the hunters arrived with marduk, rescuing him and fighting dante vale. [zhalia's mission]

two casterwill hunters traveled with kiel and marduk to the cloisters in new york, usa in an attempt to discover the hidden hiding places of the casterwill family. the two hunters were defeated after a fight with the huntik team on the roof of the cloisters. [the casterwill connection] more of kiel's casterwill hunters traveled to mexico where they fought against dante vale outside the pyramid of the sun in an attempt to stop the activation of the blue star. [the titan in the temple of sun] 

hundreds of casterwill hunters traveled to the great rift valley, africa as part of the huge blood spiral army. [sophie on trial] they later fought against the casterwill family in the attack on the fortress of iron will. one group, led by marduk, reached the top of the cliff face but were defeated by nimue casterwill who sacrificed herself. [the spiral war]

a group of casterwill hunters ambushed the huntik team on phoenix' island, trapping lok and sophie in a lava tube. [the dead magic island] more casterwill hunters were ambushed by the huntik team before they descended into the volcano to find phoenix. the hunters were held off by montehue and tersly. [the phoenix's ashes]

on the longest night of the year, marduk and his hunters attempted to stop the team reaching nostradamus' grave. after destroying their plane using psikofen, the hunters followed the team to the graveyard where they fought again. the huntik team escaped using umbra. [words from eathon] during the final battle, the hunters fought the huntik foundation and casterwill family. [lok and the betrayer] the hunters fought until the defeat of the betrayer. [dante's return]

== personality ==
the casterwill hunters, like the silent soldiers, are trained to mindlessly follow the orders of their superiors within the blood spiral like fanatics. trained to be efficient assassins, they will let nothing come in the way of ruthlessly killing off a member of the casterwill family through whatever force necessary. they will even fight each other over who gets to disintegrate a casterwill.[the casterwill connection]

== abilities ==
]]
the casterwill hunters are violent and ruthless combatants, and are much stronger and difficult to take down than the average silent soldiers. they are skilled in martial arts, something dante vale noticed, [zhalia's mission] and are trained in using dark powers that can prove deadly. [the casterwill connection] their arsenal of titans are of a much greater variety than the lower level members of the spiral, and these tend to be associated with darkness, shadows and death. like the silent soldiers, their principle fighting titan is harlekin.

lok leads the huntik team in a mission to romania to capture the wild titan, antedeluvian. however, harrison has already bonded to the titan, and is waiting for them. lok fails to invoke pendragon to save them but, luckily, dante returns from his secret training in time, defeating tantras with a new power, copykind.

== synopsis ==
on an island where powers and titans don’t work, the spirals are searching a volcano for the legendary titan, phoenix. to stop them, our heroes with montehue and tersly must first destroy the very thing that makes powers inactive: the lodestone.

== plot ==
the race for phoenix

at the blood spiral base, the betrayer orders rassimov to recover the legendary titan of rebirth, phoenix, hidden within a volcanic island in indonesia. the site is shielded by a mysterious anti-magic field that negates all seeker powers including the invocation of titan. rassimov assures him that shauna and wind have already located the phoenix volcano and are searching for the amulet. 
 and tersly]]
meanwhile,montehue and tersly arrive on the island and meet the huntik team. they decode one of nostradamus's lost quatrains from eathon's holotome:

"the lost daughter rises from red ashes 
only when the drought comes to an end.
the underworld holds the answer, 
but a stone with three sides threatens all."

the team realize that the "drought" refers to the absence of magic caused by an ancient casterwill artifact called the lodestone, which was left to protect phoenix. to reach phoenix and take on the blood spiral, the team must enter the island's underground passages and destroy the stone.

skirmish in the lava tube
 tries to dispatch shadow kuolit]]
as the team venture through the jungle, they are ambushed by a group of casterwill hunters, with lok, sophie and cherit sent tumbling into an underground lava tube. while sophie and cherit are trapped under a log, another hunter emerges from the darkness and fights with lok and kipperin. the hunter summons dark pharaoh while sophie summons sabriel. on the surface, dante and montehue work together to take out the spirals. montehue invokes fenris who clashes with the hunter's shadow kuolit. although fenris floors the enermy titan, it can use its shadows to attack which catches fenris by surprise. montehue rescues tersly and den, and dante invokes caliban who outsmarts shadow kuolit by standing directly in sunlight and using his shadow to counter and defeat the titan. one of the spirals ruthlessly sacrifices nighlurker to power up her bladewave, causing the lava tube to collapse in on itself, but lok manges to carry sophie and cherit to safety. 

using red searcher and kaioh the tracker to scout ahead, the team search for the entrance to the underground passage. however, as soon as they step into the lodestone's radius, their active titans are sent back to their amulets and their spells fail completely. because cherit can't enter the vicinity, he is forced to stay behind. the team find the door to cave and descend into the labyrinth while tersly stations himself outside the entrance.

into the labyrinth

lok, dante, sophie, and den venture into a subterranean maze but even the holotome is neutralized because it is seeker technology. they soon attacked by a group of ancient stone creatures that have activated to defend the maze. without access to magic or titans, the team resort to hand-to-hand combat and martial arts, with montehue using his axes to smash the stone constructs.
s]]
as the group navigates deeper, they realize the maze walls are shifting continuously in a cyclic pattern to keep intruders walking in circles. lok decrypts the final line of nostradamus's riddle - "the stone with three sides" - and recalls a large triangular stone set on a pedestal near the entrance chamber. the team rush back to where they they entered but a swarm of the lodestone guardians corner them, now led by a larger leader variant. dante, montehue, sophie and den hold off the guardians with pure physical defense while lok tries to shatter the lodestone but to no avail. 

meanwhile, tersly tries to navigate the team via radio. he is noticed by a nearby lioness, forcing him to hide behind a rock while it takes interest in his equipment before advancing on him. tersly desperately tries to summon venadek but can't due to the anti-magic field. 

ending the drought 

the huntik team are overpowered and out of time, and dante is injured taking a hit to protect den. as lok tries to help, he is grabbed by one of the constructs. during the struggle the pair topple over onto the lodestone, and the weight of the guardian shatters the triangular relic. the anti-magic field collapses, instantly restoring magic across the island, with tersly finally managing to summon venadek who scares off the lioness just in time. lok summons the willblade and turns the tide on the remaining constructs, saving the team. 

the group reconvene with tersly outside the maze, and dante uses everfight to heal from his injury. knowing the blood spirals are still unaware that the anti-magic field is down, the huntik team prepares to launch a surprise counter-attack to claim the amulet of phoenix. meanwhile, a bored cherit waits for the team and hopes they haven't forgotten about him...

den befriends a native american seeker and is given a new titan, kaioh the tracker. wilder makes his return and captures the huntik team as they explore the vault of cortés. things look grim, but dante saves everyone by bonding with the legendary titan of dimensions, umbra - the shadow jaguar.

== synopsis ==
with dante away in china, lok leads his first mission, to capture the wild titan, antedeluvian at the castle of vlad dracul. however, it might also be his last when tantras and an empowered harrison turn up.

== plot ==
;dante's trip to china
dante arrives at a waterfall in the taihang mountains where he is attacked by a knife-throwing woman. the two fight and are evenly matched, and it is revealed that the seeker is lin storm, an old friend of dante's. dante has come to see her grandfather and follows her to him.

;lok's in charge
at dante vale's house, lok has been left in charge as sophie tries to tutor den who insists of splashing her with water. metz calls with a mission to help secure the wild titan, antedeluvian at the castle of vlad dracul. outside the castle, the foundation agents stationed there are ambushed by the blood spiral who swiftly knock them out. tantras leads harrison fears and zhalia moon to the throne room where he plans to use the power of the heart of vlad dracul to activate the spiral mark.

;dante prepares for his fate
dante is reunited with master storm, who trained him in his youth. the master senses he is deeply troubled, and dante reveals that it is his fate, shown to him by arc, of his friends mourning his death. to meet his fate head-on, dante and caliban embark on an intense training session. as he rests, lin encourages dante to open up to her but his mind is on someone else - zhalia...

;unwelcome guests
the huntik team arrive at the castle where they are immediately attacked by harrison who has grown significantly more powerful. invoking hitokiri, he keeps the team pinned down as lok struggles to work out how to get past him. sophie fights zhalia, who warns sophie that the they must hurry. stepping to his responsibility, lok invokes lindorm who helps clear the path while sabriel defeats hitokiri. harrison is angered as the team quickly get inside the castle.

master storm teaches dante his strongest power, copykind, which allows a seeker to borrow their titans' abilities. they are interrupted by a call from metz who is worried about the team. determined to get to the castle, dante invokes umbra and plans to use copykind, to borrow umbra's ability and teleport himself there.

;facing antedeluvian
the team burst in on tantras who in the middle of his ritual, with only two marauders at his side. to outnumber them, den summons kaioh the tracker but before they can storm him, harrison and zhalia burst through the window. harrison has a big surprise up his sleeve; he has powerbonded with antedeluvian. as the team attack, antedeluvian picks off their titans, taking their powers and using them against the team. sophie invokes sorcerel, who together with sabriel, creates the triple truth shield, but this is quickly jeopardized by harrison's drybite, defeating sabriel. with tantras on the brink of succeeding, lok tries to summon pendragon with the willblade, but fails and is knocked to the floor by zhalia.

;turning the tide
having arrived at the castle, dante enters the throne room with ignatius. using copykind, he creates a fire around tantras, distracting him and disrupting the ritual. dante and ignatius hit antedeluvian from both sides, defeating him while everyone watches in shock as tantras' power is drained by dracul's heart. the blood spiral flee while the huntik team watch the heart disappear back into the floor. back at dante's house, lok feels he should have handled being team leader better but the others all agree he did a great job. lok says dante will forever be their leader, but dante looks unsure. he quickly invites everyone to the courtyard to see his new moves, to which den decided to have another water fight, soaking sophie.
